"""Target-free provider hook projection. Ansible remains the variable resolver."""
import hashlib
import re

try:
    from .application_libraries import resolve_connection, finding
except ImportError:
    from application_libraries import resolve_connection, finding

NAME = re.compile(r'^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$')
USER = re.compile(r'^[a-z_][a-z0-9_-]{0,62}$')
GRANTS = {'schema': {'USAGE'}, 'table': {'SELECT', 'INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE'},
          'sequence': {'USAGE', 'SELECT', 'UPDATE'}}


def normalize_redis_grants(value, sentinel=False):
    """Typed ACL tokens only; no categories, raw ACL rules or global defaults."""
    allowed = {'commands'} if sentinel else {'commands', 'keys', 'channels'}
    if not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) - allowed:
        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
    result = {}
    for key in allowed:
        values = value.get(key, [])
        if not isinstance(values, list) or len(values) > 256 or any(not isinstance(item, str) or not item or len(item) > 256 for item in values):
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
        if key == 'commands':
            if not values or any(not re.fullmatch(r'[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:\|[a-z][a-z0-9-]*)?', item) for item in values):
                raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
            # Only discovery, never Sentinel administration in application hooks.
            if sentinel and not set(values) <= {'ping', 'auth', 'hello', 'sentinel|get-master-addr-by-name'}:
                raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
            if not sentinel and any(item.split('|')[0] in {'acl', 'config', 'flushall', 'flushdb', 'shutdown', 'module', 'debug', 'replicaof', 'slaveof', 'sentinel'} for item in values):
                raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
        elif any(any(char.isspace() or ord(char) < 32 for char in item) or item[0] in {'~', '&', '+', '-', '#', '>', '<', '%'} for item in values):
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
        result[key] = sorted(set(values))
    return result


def normalize_clickhouse_grants(values, databases, provider_id):
    if not isinstance(values, list) or len(values) > 256:
        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
    merged = {}
    for value in values:
        if not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) != {'databaseRef', 'tables', 'privileges'}:
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
        database = databases.get(value['databaseRef'])
        tables, privileges = value['tables'], value['privileges']
        if (not database or database['providerId'] != provider_id or not isinstance(tables, list) or not tables or len(tables) > 256
                or not isinstance(privileges, list) or not privileges or any(not isinstance(item, str) for item in privileges)
                or not set(privileges) <= {'SELECT', 'INSERT'}):
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
        for table in tables:
            name = '*' if table == '*' else identifier(table)
            merged.setdefault((database['name'], name), set()).update(privileges)
    return [dict(database=key[0], table=key[1], privileges=sorted(value)) for key, value in sorted(merged.items())]


def identifier(value, username=False):
    if (not isinstance(value, str) or not (USER if username else NAME).fullmatch(value)
            or value.startswith('pg_') or value in {'postgres', 'template0', 'template1', 'public'}):
        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_IDENTIFIER_INVALID')
    return value


def marker(project, provider, library, kind, identity):
    return 'platform.application/v1:' + ':'.join((project, provider, library, kind, identity))


def normalize_grants(values):
    result = []
    if not isinstance(values, list) or len(values) > 256:
        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
    for value in values:
        if not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) - {'schema', 'tables', 'sequences', 'privileges'}:
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
        schema = identifier(value.get('schema'))
        if 'tables' in value and 'sequences' in value:
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
        kind = 'table' if 'tables' in value else 'sequence' if 'sequences' in value else 'schema'
        privileges = value.get('privileges')
        if (not isinstance(privileges, list) or not privileges or
                any(not isinstance(p, str) for p in privileges) or not set(privileges) <= GRANTS[kind]):
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
        objects = value.get('tables' if kind == 'table' else 'sequences', [schema])
        if not isinstance(objects, list) or not objects or len(objects) > 256:
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
        for name in objects:
            result.append({'kind': kind, 'schema': schema, 'name': identifier(name),
                           'privileges': sorted(set(privileges))})
    merged = {}
    for grant in result:
        key = (grant['kind'], grant['schema'], grant['name'])
        merged.setdefault(key, set()).update(grant['privileges'])
    return [dict(kind=k[0], schema=k[1], name=k[2], privileges=sorted(v)) for k, v in sorted(merged.items())]


def project_providers(rows, snapshot, configuration, desired, catalog):
    """Discovery per provider; mutation batches per library and logical instance."""
    jobs, findings, names, logical = {}, [], {}, {}
    applications = snapshot.get('applicationLibraries', {})
    if applications.get('status') != 'PASS':
        return {'status': 'BLOCKED', 'jobs': [], 'findings': [finding('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_INPUT_INVALID', 'applicationLibraryDeployments')]}
    topology = snapshot.get('topology', {}).get('resolved', {}).get('serviceDeployments', {})
    materialized = dict(desired, serviceDeployments={key: dict(value, members=topology.get(key, {}).get('members', value.get('members', {})))
                                                 for key, value in desired.get('serviceDeployments', {}).items()})
    project_id = snapshot['project']['id']

    def provider(ref):
        deployment = materialized['serviceDeployments'][ref]
        definition = catalog['definitions'][deployment['serviceType']]
        service_type = deployment['serviceType']
        modes = {'postgresql': {'standalone', 'pg_auto_failover'}, 'redis': {'standalone', 'sentinel-ha'},
                 'clickhouse': {'standalone', 'raft-ha'}}
        if deployment['mode'] not in modes.get(service_type, set()):
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_MODE_UNSUPPORTED')
        capabilities = {'postgresql': {'service.postgresql.database', 'service.postgresql.schema', 'service.postgresql.account'},
                        'redis': {'service.redis.account'}, 'clickhouse': {'service.clickhouse.database', 'service.clickhouse.account'}}
        if not capabilities[service_type] <= set(definition.get('capabilities', [])):
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED')
        if ref not in jobs:
            connection = resolve_connection(ref, {'purpose': 'native' if service_type == 'clickhouse' else 'client'}, None, materialized, configuration, catalog, snapshot['hosts'])
            targets = connection['targets']
            if service_type == 'postgresql' and len(targets) != (1 if deployment['mode'] == 'standalone' else 2):
                raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_MEMBERS_INVALID')
            jobs[ref] = {'providerId': ref, 'projectId': project_id, 'mode': deployment['mode'],
                         'serviceType': service_type, 'candidates': targets, 'libraries': [], 'databases': [], 'accounts': []}
        return jobs[ref]

    def claim(key, owner, mode):
        previous = names.setdefault(key, (owner, mode))
        if previous != (owner, mode) and not (mode == previous[1] == 'existing'):
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_NAME_CONFLICT')

    try:
        for row in rows:
            key = (row['libraryId'], row['instanceId'])
            identity = {k: row.get(k) for k in ('resources', 'bindings', 'connectionDefaults')}
            identity['accounts'] = row['settings'].get('accounts', {})
            if key in logical and logical[key] != identity:
                raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_HOST_CONFLICT')
            logical[key] = identity
        for library_id, library in sorted(applications['libraries'].items()):
            library_rows = [row for row in rows if row['libraryId'] == library_id]
            row = library_rows[0]
            if any({k: other.get(k) for k in ('resources', 'bindings', 'connectionDefaults')} !=
                   {k: row.get(k) for k in ('resources', 'bindings', 'connectionDefaults')} for other in library_rows):
                raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_HOST_CONFLICT')
            databases, schemas = {}, []
            for resource_id, resource in sorted(library.get('resources', {}).items()):
                if resource['kind'] not in {'postgresql.database', 'postgresql.schema', 'clickhouse.database'}:
                    raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED')
                ref = row['bindings'].get(resource['binding'], {}).get('deploymentRef')
                job = provider(ref)
                if resource['kind'].split('.')[0] != job['serviceType']:
                    raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_RESOURCE_INVALID')
                if set(resource['parameters']) != {'name'}:
                    raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_RESOURCE_INVALID')
                name, mode = identifier(resource['parameters']['name']), resource.get('mode', 'managed')
                value = dict(resourceId=resource_id, name=name, mode=mode,
                             marker=marker(project_id, ref, library_id, resource['kind'], resource_id))
                if resource['kind'] in {'postgresql.database', 'clickhouse.database'}:
                    owner = 'pla_' + hashlib.sha256((project_id + ':' + ref + ':' + library_id).encode()).hexdigest()[:24]
                    value.update(providerId=ref, libraryId=library_id, owner=owner, schemas=[], accounts=[],
                                 ownerMarker=marker(project_id, ref, library_id, 'owner', library_id))
                    claim((ref, 'database', name), (library_id, resource_id), mode)
                    databases[resource_id] = value
                    job['databases'].append(value)
                    if job['serviceType'] == 'postgresql' and mode == 'managed' and not any(o['name'] == owner for o in job['libraries']):
                        job['libraries'].append({'name': owner, 'marker': value['ownerMarker']})
                else:
                    schemas.append((ref, resource, value))
            for ref, source, schema in schemas:
                database = databases.get(source.get('databaseRef'))
                if not database or database['providerId'] != ref or (schema['mode'] == 'managed' and database['mode'] != 'managed'):
                    raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_DATABASE_REF_INVALID')
                claim((ref, database['name'], schema['name']), (library_id, schema['resourceId']), schema['mode'])
                database['schemas'].append(schema)
            for instance_id, instance in sorted(library.get('instances', {}).items()):
                for account_id, account in sorted(instance.get('credentialRequirements', {}).items()):
                    connection = instance['connections'].get(account_id, {})
                    service_type = connection.get('serviceType')
                    if service_type not in {'postgresql', 'redis', 'clickhouse'}:
                        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED')
                    ref = connection['deploymentRef']
                    job = provider(ref)
                    database = databases.get(account.get('databaseRef'))
                    if service_type != 'redis' and (not database or database['providerId'] != ref or (account['mode'] == 'managed' and database['mode'] != 'managed')):
                        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_DATABASE_REF_INVALID')
                    credentials = account['credentials']
                    if set(credentials) != {'username', 'password'} or credentials['username']['source']['kind'] != 'literal':
                        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_INVALID')
                    if credentials['password']['source']['kind'] not in {'runtime_secret_ref', 'vault_ref'}:
                        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_SOURCE_DEFERRED')
                    username = identifier(credentials['username']['source']['value'], True)
                    admin = configuration['services'][ref]['configuration'].get('adminSuperuser', {}).get('value', {}).get('username')
                    if username in {admin, 'default', 'autoctl_node', 'pgautofailover_replicator'}:
                        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_IDENTIFIER_INVALID')
                    listener = connection.get('connectionRef', 'client')
                    if service_type == 'redis':
                        if listener == 'sentinel' and 'service.redis.sentinel.account' not in catalog['definitions']['redis'].get('capabilities', []):
                            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED')
                        grants = normalize_redis_grants(account.get('grants', {}), listener == 'sentinel')
                        if 'databaseRef' in account:
                            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_DATABASE_REF_INVALID')
                    elif service_type == 'clickhouse':
                        grants = normalize_clickhouse_grants(account.get('grants', []), databases, ref)
                        if account['mode'] == 'managed' and any(databases[g['databaseRef']]['mode'] != 'managed' for g in account.get('grants', [])):
                            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
                    else:
                        grants = normalize_grants(account.get('grants', []))
                        schemas_by_name = {s['name']: s for s in database['schemas']}
                        if any(g['schema'] not in schemas_by_name or
                               (account['mode'] == 'managed' and schemas_by_name[g['schema']]['mode'] != 'managed') for g in grants):
                            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_GRANTS_INVALID')
                    claim((ref, listener if service_type == 'redis' else 'account', username), (library_id, instance_id, account_id), account['mode'])
                    value = dict(name=username, mode=account['mode'], instanceId=instance_id, accountId=account_id,
                                 database=database['name'] if database else None, libraryId=library_id,
                                 listener=listener, candidates=connection.get('targets', job['candidates']),
                                 passwordRef=(credentials['password']['source']['ref'] if credentials['password']['source']['kind'] == 'runtime_secret_ref' else 'pla-vault-'+hashlib.sha256(repr(sorted(credentials['password']['source'].items())).encode()).hexdigest()[:32]), grants=grants,
                                 marker=marker(project_id, ref, library_id, 'account', instance_id + '/' + account_id))
                    job['accounts'].append(value)
                    if database:
                        database['accounts'].append(value)
    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError) as error:
        code = str(error)
        if not code.startswith('APPLICATION_PROVIDER_'):
            code = 'APPLICATION_PROVIDER_INPUT_INVALID'
        findings.append(finding(code, 'applicationLibraryDeployments'))
    providers = [] if findings else [jobs[k] for k in sorted(jobs)]
    library_jobs, instance_jobs = split_provider_jobs(providers)
    return {'status': 'BLOCKED' if findings else 'PASS', 'jobs': providers,
            'libraryJobs': library_jobs, 'instanceJobs': instance_jobs, 'findings': findings}


def split_provider_jobs(providers):
    """Execution boundaries are a library resource batch and one instance hook."""
    library_jobs, instance_jobs = [], []
    for job in providers:
        for library_id in sorted({db['libraryId'] for db in job['databases']}):
            databases = [dict(db, accounts=[]) for db in job['databases'] if db['libraryId'] == library_id]
            owners = {db['owner'] for db in databases if db['mode'] == 'managed'}
            library_jobs.append(dict(job, libraryId=library_id, databases=databases, accounts=[],
                                     libraries=[owner for owner in job['libraries'] if owner['name'] in owners]))
        for library_id, instance_id in sorted({(a['libraryId'], a['instanceId']) for a in job['accounts']}):
            accounts = [a for a in job['accounts'] if (a['libraryId'], a['instanceId']) == (library_id, instance_id)]
            database_names = {a['database'] for a in accounts}
            if job.get('serviceType') == 'clickhouse':
                database_names.update(grant['database'] for account in accounts for grant in account['grants'])
            databases = [dict(db, accounts=[a for a in accounts if a['database'] == db['name']])
                         for db in job['databases'] if db['name'] in database_names]
            instance_jobs.append(dict(job, libraryId=library_id, instanceId=instance_id, libraries=[],
                                      databases=databases, accounts=accounts))
    return library_jobs, instance_jobs

"""Typed A2 preflight. Ansible owns precedence, templates and target execution."""
import hashlib
import os
import re

try:
    from .application_libraries import checked_file, invocation_package_loader, nonsecret_values
    from .artifact_authority import assemble_authority
except ImportError:
    from application_libraries import checked_file, invocation_package_loader, nonsecret_values

DIGEST = re.compile(r"^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$")
REFERENCE = re.compile(r"^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._:/-]*(?:@sha256:[0-9a-f]{64})?$")
LABEL = "platform.installer.config-digest"


def runtime_reference(image_id):
    if not isinstance(image_id, str) or not DIGEST.fullmatch(image_id):
        raise ValueError("APPLICATION_IMAGE_ID_INVALID")
    return "platform-application:sha256-" + image_id.split(":", 1)[1]


def pinned_registry_reference(reference, digest):
    if not isinstance(reference, str) or not REFERENCE.fullmatch(reference) or "@" in reference or not DIGEST.fullmatch(digest):
        raise ValueError("APPLICATION_REGISTRY_REFERENCE_INVALID")
    prefix, slash, name = reference.rpartition("/")
    name = name.split(":", 1)[0]
    return (prefix + slash + name) + "@" + digest


def safe_relative(value):
    return (isinstance(value, str) and bool(value) and not value.startswith("/") and
            "\\" not in value and not any(x in ("", ".", "..") for x in value.split("/")))


def image_requirement(instance_id, image_name, image):
    """One locked image identity for standalone execution and target-free planning."""
    if not isinstance(image_name, str) or not REFERENCE.fullmatch(image_name) or not isinstance(image, dict):
        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_IMAGE_NOT_LOCKED')
    reference = runtime_reference(image['imageId'])
    platform = image.get('platform')
    if (not isinstance(platform, dict) or set(platform) - {'os', 'architecture', 'variant'} or
            platform.get('os') != 'linux' or platform.get('architecture') not in ('amd64', 'arm64') or
            ('variant' in platform and (not isinstance(platform['variant'], str) or
             re.fullmatch(r'[a-z0-9]+', platform['variant']) is None))):
        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_IMAGE_PLATFORM_INVALID')
    if image.get('localReference', reference) != reference:
        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_IMAGE_REFERENCE_NOT_BOUND')
    return dict(id=instance_id + ':image', name=image_name, artifactType='container-image',
                imageId=image['imageId'], platform=image['platform'], localReference=reference)


def resolve_image_lock(native_lock, manifest_lock):
    """Existing standalone lock conflict rule, shared by snapshot and runtime."""
    if native_lock is not None and manifest_lock is not None and native_lock != manifest_lock:
        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_ARTIFACT_LOCK_CONFLICT')
    return (native_lock or manifest_lock or {}).get('x-container-images', {})


def bundle_archive(root, digest, record, loader):
    """Verify the locked manifest and selected component; no bundle mutation."""
    manifest_path = checked_file(root, "manifest.yaml")
    with open(manifest_path, "rb") as stream:
        if "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(stream.read()).hexdigest() != digest:
            raise ValueError("APPLICATION_BUNDLE_DIGEST_INVALID")
    manifest = loader(manifest_path)
    if manifest.get("apiVersion") != "platform.installer/execution-bundle/v1alpha1" or manifest.get("kind") != "ExecutionRuntimeBundle":
        raise ValueError("APPLICATION_BUNDLE_MANIFEST_INVALID")
    matches = [x for x in manifest.get("components", []) if x.get("path") == record["ref"]]
    if len(matches) != 1 or matches[0].get("sha256") != record["sha256"] or matches[0].get("size") != record["size"]:
        raise ValueError("APPLICATION_IMAGE_ARCHIVE_NOT_LOCKED")
    if not safe_relative(record["ref"]) or not record["ref"].startswith("runtime/artifacts/"):
        raise ValueError("APPLICATION_IMAGE_ARCHIVE_PATH_INVALID")
    path = os.path.abspath(root)
    for part in record["ref"].split("/"):
        path = os.path.join(path, part)
        if os.path.islink(path):
            raise ValueError("APPLICATION_IMAGE_ARCHIVE_PATH_INVALID")
    if not os.path.isfile(path):
        raise ValueError("APPLICATION_IMAGE_ARCHIVE_MISSING")
    sha = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path, "rb") as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            sha.update(chunk)
    if "sha256:" + sha.hexdigest() != record["sha256"] or os.path.getsize(path) != record["size"]:
        raise ValueError("APPLICATION_IMAGE_ARCHIVE_INVALID")
    return path


def selected_archive(root, source, offline, loader):
    """Validate fallback bytes only after the target selected the fallback."""
    if source == "REPOSITORY":
        return None
    if source != "OFFLINE_BUNDLE" or not offline:
        raise ValueError("APPLICATION_IMAGE_SOURCE_INVALID")
    if not root:
        raise ValueError("APPLICATION_BUNDLE_REQUIRED")
    return bundle_archive(root, offline["bundleDigest"], offline, loader)


def validate_compose(config, job, instance_path, digest):
    """Check only values projected by Core; leave package-authored Compose fields alone."""
    services = config.get("services", {})
    if config.get("name") != job["placement"]["composeProject"] or set(services) != {job["instanceId"]}:
        raise ValueError("APPLICATION_COMPOSE_IDENTITY_INVALID")
    service = services[job["instanceId"]]
    if (service.get("image") != job["authority"]["requirement"]["localReference"] or
            service.get("container_name") != job["placement"]["containerName"]):
        raise ValueError("APPLICATION_COMPOSE_IDENTITY_INVALID")
    launch = service.get("entrypoint") or service.get("command")
    expected_launch = ['/usr/bin/vault', 'agent', '-config=/opt/vault/agent.hcl'] if job.get('agentTemplate') else job['settings']['command']
    if launch != expected_launch or (service.get("entrypoint") and service.get("command")):
        raise ValueError("APPLICATION_COMPOSE_COMMAND_INVALID")
    for key in ("user", "restart"):
        if key in job["settings"] and service.get(key) != job["settings"][key]:
            raise ValueError("APPLICATION_COMPOSE_CONFIGURATION_INVALID")
    if job["settings"].get("readiness", {}).get("mode") == "healthcheck" and not service.get("healthcheck"):
        raise ValueError("APPLICATION_HEALTHCHECK_REQUIRED")
    expected_labels = {"platform.installer.project": job["projectId"], "platform.installer.library": job["libraryId"],
                       "platform.installer.instance": job["instanceId"], "platform.installer.host": job["hostId"], LABEL: digest}
    labels = service.get("labels", {})
    if any(labels.get(name) != value for name, value in expected_labels.items()):
        raise ValueError("APPLICATION_COMPOSE_LABEL_INVALID")
    expected_env = dict(job["settings"].get("environment", {}), **{key: job["instanceId"] for key in job["identityNames"]})
    environment = service.get("environment", {})
    if any(environment.get(key) != str(value) for key, value in expected_env.items()):
        raise ValueError("APPLICATION_COMPOSE_ENVIRONMENT_INVALID")
    findings = []
    nonsecret_values(environment, "environment", findings)
    if findings:
        raise ValueError("APPLICATION_COMPOSE_SECRET_INVALID")
    expected_ports = sorted((str(x["published"]), x["container"]) for x in job["settings"].get("ports", {}).values())
    ports = service.get("ports", [])
    if sorted((str(x["published"]), x["target"]) for x in ports) != expected_ports:
        raise ValueError("APPLICATION_COMPOSE_PORT_INVALID")
    expected_mounts = {os.path.join(instance_path, "config", x["destination"]): None for x in job["configs"]}
    core_mounts = {os.path.join(instance_path, 'vault'): '/opt/vault'} if job.get('agentTemplate') else {}
    if job.get('vault', {}).get('pkiPlans'):
        core_mounts[os.path.join(instance_path, 'pki')] = '/opt/application/pki'
    expected_mounts.update(core_mounts)
    for source, target in expected_mounts.items():
        matches = [x for x in service.get("volumes", []) if x.get("source") == source]
        if len(matches) != 1 or matches[0].get("type") != "bind" or not matches[0].get("read_only"):
            raise ValueError("APPLICATION_COMPOSE_MOUNT_INVALID")
        if (target is not None and matches[0].get("target") != target) or not matches[0].get("target", "").startswith("/"):
            raise ValueError("APPLICATION_COMPOSE_MOUNT_INVALID")
    return True


def prepare_runtime(root, snapshot, rows, desired, lock, validator, loader):
    libraries = snapshot.get("applicationLibraries", {})
    if snapshot.get("validation", {}).get("status") != "PASS" or libraries.get("status") != "PASS":
        raise ValueError("APPLICATION_RUNTIME_PROJECT_BLOCKED")
    schema = os.path.join(validator.schema_root, "artifact-source/v1alpha2/image-lock.schema.json")
    image_lock = lock.get("x-container-images", {}) if isinstance(lock, dict) else {}
    if validator.validate(image_lock, schema) or not DIGEST.fullmatch(lock.get("digest", "")):
        raise ValueError("APPLICATION_IMAGE_LOCK_INVALID")
    jobs = []
    package_loader = invocation_package_loader(root, loader, validator)
    for row in rows:
        lib_id, app_id, host = row["libraryId"], row["instanceId"], row["hostId"]
        library = libraries["libraries"][lib_id]
        instance = library["instances"][app_id]
        placement = instance["placements"][host]
        settings = row["settings"]
        if (any(r['kind'] not in {'postgresql.database', 'postgresql.schema', 'clickhouse.database'} for r in row['resources'].values()) or
                any(instance['connections'].get(k, {}).get('serviceType') not in {'postgresql', 'redis', 'clickhouse'} for k in instance['credentialRequirements']) or
                any(x.get("tls") for x in instance["connections"].values())):
            raise ValueError("APPLICATION_RUNTIME_DEFERRED_FEATURE")
        # Recheck packages after native variable composition, before any rendering.
        app_ref = row["applicationName"] + "@" + row["applicationVersion"]
        app = package_loader(app_ref, "application")
        lib = package_loader(row["libraryRef"], "library")
        if row["packageIdentity"] != {"application": app["digest"], "library": lib["digest"]}:
            raise ValueError("APPLICATION_PACKAGE_CHANGED")
        app_render, lib_render = app.get("render", {}), lib.get("render", {})
        agent_template = app_render.get('agent_template') if instance['agentRequired'] else None
        if instance['agentRequired'] and (not agent_template or agent_template not in app['files']):
            raise ValueError('APPLICATION_AGENT_TEMPLATE_REQUIRED')
        if not app_render.get("compose_template") or not lib_render.get("base_compose_template"):
            raise ValueError("APPLICATION_RENDER_REQUIRED")
        for package, key in ((app, "compose_template"), (lib, "base_compose_template")):
            if package["render"][key] not in package["files"]:
                raise ValueError("APPLICATION_RENDER_NOT_ALLOWLISTED")
        configs = []
        for config in settings.get("config_files", []):
            name = config.get("template", config.get("source"))
            if name not in app["files"] or not safe_relative(config["destination"]):
                raise ValueError("APPLICATION_CONFIG_NOT_ALLOWLISTED")
            configs.append(dict(config, path=checked_file(root, app["logicalPath"] + "/" + name)))
        if len({x["destination"] for x in configs}) != len(configs):
            raise ValueError("APPLICATION_CONFIG_DESTINATION_COLLISION")
        image = image_lock["images"].get(settings["image"])
        if not image:
            raise ValueError("APPLICATION_IMAGE_NOT_LOCKED")
        reference = runtime_reference(image["imageId"])
        if not REFERENCE.fullmatch(settings["image"]):
            raise ValueError("APPLICATION_IMAGE_REFERENCE_INVALID")
        if image.get("localReference", reference) != reference:
            raise ValueError("APPLICATION_IMAGE_REFERENCE_NOT_BOUND")
        registry = image.get("registry")
        if registry and (not REFERENCE.fullmatch(registry["reference"]) or "@" in registry["reference"]):
            raise ValueError("APPLICATION_REGISTRY_REFERENCE_INVALID")
        # Registry allowlist is node scoped, independent of package defaults.
        configuration = snapshot["effectiveConfiguration"]["services"][row["runtimeRef"]]["configuration"]
        account_setting = configuration.get("accountName", {})
        account = account_setting.get("value") if account_setting.get("state") == "RESOLVED" else None
        if not isinstance(account, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[a-z_][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}", account):
            raise ValueError("APPLICATION_DOCKER_ACCOUNT_REQUIRED")
        offline = image.get("archive")
        archive_path = None
        if offline:
            if not safe_relative(offline["ref"]) or not offline["ref"].startswith("runtime/artifacts/"):
                raise ValueError("APPLICATION_IMAGE_ARCHIVE_PATH_INVALID")
            offline = dict(offline, kind="OFFLINE_BUNDLE", type="archive", bundleDigest=lock["digest"])
        requirement = image_requirement(app_id, settings['image'], image)
        authority = assemble_authority(requirement, offline, dict(registry or {}, kind="REPOSITORY"), image=True)
        jobs.append(dict(row, placement=placement, account=account, configs=configs,
                         agentTemplate=checked_file(root, app['logicalPath']+'/'+agent_template) if agent_template else None,
                         appTemplate=checked_file(root, app["logicalPath"] + "/" + app_render["compose_template"]),
                         baseTemplate=checked_file(root, lib["logicalPath"] + "/" + lib_render["base_compose_template"]),
                         baseFilename=lib_render["base_compose_filename"], baseService=lib_render["base_service"],
                         envSource=checked_file(root, lib["logicalPath"] + "/files/.env") if "files/.env" in lib["files"] else None,
                         archivePath=archive_path, authority=authority))
    return jobs


def validate_config_contents(configs):
    for item in configs:
        content = item["content"]
        if not isinstance(content, str) or len(content.encode("utf-8")) > 1024 * 1024:
            raise ValueError("APPLICATION_CONFIG_CONTENT_INVALID")
        findings = []
        nonsecret_values(content, "config", findings)
        if findings or re.search(r"(?:password|passphrase|token|secret|role.?id)\s*[:=]", content, re.I):
            raise ValueError("APPLICATION_CONFIG_SECRET_FORBIDDEN")
    return True


def agent_config(runtime):
    """Closed supervisor profile: no arbitrary exec, template files or token sinks."""
    import json
    vault = runtime['vault']
    q = json.dumps
    lines = ['exit_after_auth = false', 'vault {', '  address = '+q(vault['endpoint_url']),
             '  ca_cert = '+q(vault['ca_container_path']), '}', 'auto_auth {', '  method "approle" {',
             '    mount_path = '+q(vault['auth_mount']), '    config = {',
             '      role_id_file_path = '+q(vault['role_id_container_path']), '    }', '  }', '}']
    lines += ['template_config {', '  exit_on_retry_failure = true', '}']
    for binding in vault['env_templates']:
        lines += ['env_template '+q(binding['name'])+' {', '  contents = '+q(binding['contents']),
                  '  error_on_missing_key = true', '}']
    lines += ['exec {', '  command = '+q(runtime['application_command']),
              '  restart_on_secret_changes = "always"', '}']
    return '\n'.join(lines)+'\n'


def validate_agent(content, runtime):
    if content.replace('\r\n', '\n').strip() != agent_config(runtime).strip():
        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_AGENT_PROFILE_INVALID')
    return True

import hashlib
import json
import re

SEGMENT = re.compile(r'^[A-Za-z0-9_-][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,127}$')


def segment(value):
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not SEGMENT.fullmatch(value) or value in {'.', '..'}:
        raise ValueError('APPLICATION_VAULT_REFERENCE_INVALID')
    return value


def kv_source(source, row):
    if source.get('kind') == 'vault_ref':
        ref = row['bindings'].get(source['binding'], {}).get('deploymentRef')
        parts = source['document'].split('/')
        for part in parts:
            segment(part)
        return dict(providerId=ref, mount=segment(source['mount']), document='/'.join(parts), field=segment(source['field']))
    return None


def project_vault(rows, prepared):

                paths.add(path)
                read_fields.setdefault(path, []).append(location['field'])
                if not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*', location['field']):
                    raise ValueError('APPLICATION_VAULT_AGENT_FIELD_INVALID')
                # Supervisor templates are keyed by contents. Distinct env names
                # reading one field need a no-output comment to remain distinct.
                contents = '{{/* %s */}}{{ with secret %s }}{{ .Data.data.%s }}{{ end }}' % (name, json.dumps(path), location['field'])
                envs.append(dict(name=name, contents=contents))
            identity = 'pla-'+hashlib.sha256((':'.join((project, library_id, instance_id))).encode()).hexdigest()[:32]
            owner = 'platform.application/v1:'+':'.join((project, library_id, instance_id))
            policy = '# '+owner+'\n'+''.join('path %s { capabilities = ["read"] }\n' % json.dumps(p) for p in sorted(paths))
            policy += 'path "auth/token/lookup-self" { capabilities = ["read"] }\npath "auth/token/renew-self" { capabilities = ["update"] }\n'
            policy += 'path "auth/token/revoke-self" { capabilities = ["update"] }\n'
            instance_jobs.append(dict(providerId=ref, libraryId=library_id, instanceId=instance_id,
                                     hosts=sorted(instance['placements']), documents=account_docs, identity=identity,
                                     owner=owner, policy=policy, envTemplates=envs, readFields=read_fields, mounts=sorted({p.split('/')[0] for p in paths})))
    for job in library_jobs+instance_jobs:
        for doc in job['documents']:
            doc['owner'] = 'platform.application/v1:'+':'.join((project, job['libraryId'], doc['document']))
    return dict(providers=[providers[k] for k in sorted(providers)], libraryJobs=library_jobs, instanceJobs=instance_jobs, sourceJobs=source_jobs)

API_VERSION = "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha2"
MANIFEST_API_VERSION = "platform.installer/execution-manifest/v1alpha1"

_SECRET_INPUT_REF = re.compile(r"^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$")
_SECRET_INPUT_DEPLOYMENT = re.compile(r"^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:[-_.][a-z0-9]+)*$")
