BACKEND_FIELDS = set(("balance", "check", "fall", "rise", "ssl", "sslVerify",
                      "checkInterval", "httpCheck", "maxconn", "timeoutConnect", "timeoutServer"))


def _finding(code, field, message):
    return {"apiVersion": "platform.installer/finding/v1alpha1", "kind": "Finding",
            "code": code, "status": "BLOCKED", "category": "haproxy-resolution",
            "field": field, "safeMessage": message}


def _definitions(catalog):
    value = catalog.get("definitions", catalog) if isinstance(catalog, dict) else {}
    return value if isinstance(value, dict) else {}


def _catalog_default_port(definition):
    listeners = definition.get("listeners", {}) if isinstance(definition, dict) else {}
    candidates = [
        value.get("defaultPort")
        for value in listeners.values()
        if isinstance(value, dict) and value.get("scope") == "deployment"
        and isinstance(value.get("defaultPort"), int)
    ]
    return candidates[0] if len(candidates) == 1 else None


def _valid_port(value):
    return isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool) and 1 <= value <= 65535


def _valid_endpoint_target(target):
    if not isinstance(target, dict) or not _valid_port(target.get('port')):
        return False
    try:
        return (ipaddress.ip_address(target.get('address')).version == 4 and
                isinstance(target.get('serverName'), str) and
                re.fullmatch(r'[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]{1,128}', target['serverName']) is not None)
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return False


def _member_client_allocation(definition):
    descriptor = definition.get("x-backendClientListener") if isinstance(definition, dict) else None
    if descriptor is None:
        return None
    if not isinstance(descriptor, dict) or set(descriptor) != {"listener", "allocation"}:
        raise ValueError("HAPROXY_CLIENT_LISTENER_DESCRIPTOR_INVALID")
    listener_name = descriptor.get("listener")
    listeners = definition.get("listeners")
    if not isinstance(listener_name, str) or not isinstance(listeners, dict):
        raise ValueError("HAPROXY_CLIENT_LISTENER_DESCRIPTOR_INVALID")
    listener = listeners.get(listener_name)
    allocation = descriptor["allocation"]
    settings = (definition.get("configuration") or {}).get("settings", {})
    port_setting = settings.get("port") if isinstance(settings, dict) else None
    if (not isinstance(listener, dict) or listener.get("scope") != "member" or
            not _valid_port(listener.get("defaultPort")) or
            not isinstance(allocation, dict) or set(allocation) != {"kind", "stride"} or
            allocation.get("kind") != "HOST_LOCAL_ORDINAL" or
            not _valid_port(allocation.get("stride")) or
            not isinstance(port_setting, dict) or
            "member" not in port_setting.get("scopes", [])):
        raise ValueError("HAPROXY_CLIENT_LISTENER_DESCRIPTOR_INVALID")
    return allocation["stride"]


def _inventory_members_for_deployment(inventory_deployments, deployment_id):
    """Build the ephemeral member view from inventory-owned placements."""
    members = {}
    duplicate_ids = set()
    source = inventory_deployments if isinstance(inventory_deployments, dict) else {}
    for host_id in sorted(source):
        placements = source.get(host_id)
        placement = placements.get(deployment_id) if isinstance(placements, dict) else None
        candidate_members = placement.get("members") if isinstance(placement, dict) else None
        if not isinstance(candidate_members, dict):
            continue
        for member_id, member in sorted(candidate_members.items()):
            if member_id in members:
                duplicate_ids.add(member_id)
                continue
            if not isinstance(member, dict):
                continue
            projected = dict(member)
            # Inventory ownership is authoritative for the target host.
            projected["host"] = host_id
            members[member_id] = projected
    return members, sorted(duplicate_ids)


def _safe_dns_name(value):
    return (isinstance(value, str) and 1 <= len(value) <= 253 and
            all(re.fullmatch(r"[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?", label)
                for label in value.split(".")))


def _request_dns_covers_name(dns_names, expected_name):
    """Accept an exact SAN or a wildcard covering exactly one DNS label."""
    if not isinstance(dns_names, list) or not _safe_dns_name(expected_name):
        return False
    for candidate in dns_names:
        if candidate == expected_name:
            return True
        if isinstance(candidate, str) and candidate.startswith("*.") and _safe_dns_name(candidate[2:]):
            suffix = candidate[1:]
            if expected_name.endswith(suffix) and "." not in expected_name[:-len(suffix)]:
                return True
    return False


def normalize_backend_settings(defaults, override, field):
    defaults = defaults if isinstance(defaults, dict) else {}
    override = override if isinstance(override, dict) else {}
    findings = []
    for layer, name in ((defaults, "defaults"), (override, "backend")):
        unknown = sorted(set(layer).difference(BACKEND_FIELDS))
        for key in unknown:
            findings.append(_finding("HAPROXY_BACKEND_PROPERTY_UNKNOWN", field + "." + name + "." + key, "BackendSettings contains an unsupported property"))
    effective = dict(defaults)
    effective.update(override)
    if effective.get("ssl") is False:
        effective.pop("sslVerify", None)
    if effective.get("check") is False:
        effective.pop("fall", None)
        effective.pop("rise", None)
    if not isinstance(effective.get("balance"), str) or effective.get("balance") not in ("roundrobin", "leastconn", "source"):
        findings.append(_finding("HAPROXY_BACKEND_BALANCE_INVALID", field, "Effective BackendSettings balance must be roundrobin, leastconn or source"))
    for key in ("ssl", "check"):
        if not isinstance(effective.get(key), bool):
            findings.append(_finding("HAPROXY_BACKEND_%s_INVALID" % key.upper(), field, "Effective BackendSettings %s must be boolean" % key))
    if effective.get("ssl") is True and effective.get("sslVerify") not in ("required", "none"):
        findings.append(_finding("HAPROXY_BACKEND_SSL_VERIFY_REQUIRED", field, "TLS backend settings require sslVerify"))
    if effective.get("ssl") is False and "sslVerify" in effective:
        findings.append(_finding("HAPROXY_BACKEND_SSL_VERIFY_FORBIDDEN", field, "sslVerify is valid only when ssl is true"))
    if effective.get("check") is True:
        for key in ("fall", "rise"):
            if not isinstance(effective.get(key), int) or not 1 <= effective[key] <= 20:
                findings.append(_finding("HAPROXY_BACKEND_%s_REQUIRED" % key.upper(), field, "Health checks require %s between 1 and 20" % key))
    if effective.get("check") is False and ("fall" in effective or "rise" in effective):
        findings.append(_finding("HAPROXY_BACKEND_CHECK_DEPENDENCY_FORBIDDEN", field, "fall and rise are valid only when check is true"))
    for key in ('checkInterval', 'timeoutConnect', 'timeoutServer'):
        if key in effective:
            value = effective[key]
            match = re.fullmatch(r'([1-9][0-9]*)(ms|s)', value) if isinstance(value, str) else None
            millis = int(match[1]) * (1000 if match[2] == 's' else 1) if match else 0
            if not 100 <= millis <= (60000 if key == 'checkInterval' else 300000):
                findings.append(_finding('HAPROXY_BACKEND_DURATION_INVALID', field + '.' + key, 'Invalid bounded duration'))
    if 'maxconn' in effective and (type(effective['maxconn']) is not int or not 1 <= effective['maxconn'] <= 100000):
        findings.append(_finding('HAPROXY_BACKEND_MAXCONN_INVALID', field, 'Invalid maxconn'))
    if 'httpCheck' in effective:
        check = effective['httpCheck']
        if (not isinstance(check, dict) or set(check) != {'method', 'path', 'expectedStatus'} or
                check.get('method') not in {'GET', 'HEAD'} or
                not isinstance(check.get('path'), str) or not re.fullmatch(r'/[^\s\x00-\x1f\x7f]{0,2047}', check['path']) or
                type(check.get('expectedStatus')) is not int or not 100 <= check['expectedStatus'] <= 599 or
                effective.get('check') is not True):
            findings.append(_finding('HAPROXY_BACKEND_HTTP_CHECK_INVALID', field, 'Invalid HTTP health check'))
    return effective, findings


def resolve_haproxy_backends(topology, service_catalog, inventory_hosts, inventory_deployments,
                             resolved_endpoints, backend_defaults=None, resolved_configuration=None,
                             pki_requests=None, target_deployment_ids=None, endpoint_sources=None):
    topology = topology if isinstance(topology, dict) else {}
    deployments = topology.get("serviceDeployments", {}) if isinstance(topology.get("serviceDeployments"), dict) else {}
    definitions = _definitions(service_catalog)
    inventory_hosts = inventory_hosts if isinstance(inventory_hosts, dict) else {}
    inventory_deployments = inventory_deployments if isinstance(inventory_deployments, dict) else {}
    endpoint_map = resolved_endpoints.get("endpoints", {}) if isinstance(resolved_endpoints, dict) else {}
    selected_ids = set(target_deployment_ids) if isinstance(target_deployment_ids, list) else None
    findings, resolved = [], {}
    for target_id, target in sorted(deployments.items()):
        if selected_ids is not None and target_id not in selected_ids:
            continue
        proxy_hosts = haproxy_provider_hosts(topology, inventory_deployments, target)
        if not proxy_hosts:
            continue
        relation = target.get("haproxy", {})
        field = "serviceDeployments.%s.haproxy" % target_id
        if not isinstance(relation, dict) or set(relation).difference(("deploymentRef", "backend")):
            findings.append(_finding("HAPROXY_INTEGRATION_INVALID", field, "HAProxy integration must contain only deploymentRef and backend"))
            continue
        definition = definitions.get(target.get("serviceType"), {})
        if not isinstance(definition.get("endpoint"), dict):
            findings.append(_finding("HAPROXY_TARGET_ENDPOINT_UNSUPPORTED", field, "HAProxy target service must support generic endpoints"))
        try:
            member_stride = _member_client_allocation(definition)
        except ValueError:
            findings.append(_finding("HAPROXY_CLIENT_LISTENER_DESCRIPTOR_INVALID", field, "Client listener metadata is invalid"))
            continue
        configuration = target.get("configuration", {}) if isinstance(target.get("configuration"), dict) else {}
        port = configuration.get("port")
        if not _valid_port(port):
            effective = (((resolved_configuration or {}).get("services", {}).get(target_id, {})
                          .get("configuration", {}).get("port", {})))
            port = effective.get("value") if isinstance(effective, dict) else None
        if not _valid_port(port):
            if member_stride is not None:
                port = definition["listeners"][definition["x-backendClientListener"]["listener"]]["defaultPort"]
            else:
                port = _catalog_default_port(definition)
        if not _valid_port(port):
            findings.append(_finding("HAPROXY_BACKEND_PORT_UNRESOLVED", "serviceDeployments.%s.configuration.port" % target_id, "HAProxy target requires a valid configuration.port"))
        package_defaults = definition.get("x-haproxyBackendDefaults", {})
        if not isinstance(package_defaults, dict):
            findings.append(_finding("HAPROXY_BACKEND_DEFAULTS_INVALID", field, "Service package backend defaults must be a mapping"))
            continue
        defaults = dict(package_defaults)
        defaults.update((backend_defaults or {}).get(target.get("serviceType"), {}))
        effective, setting_findings = normalize_backend_settings(defaults, relation.get("backend", {}), field)
        findings.extend(setting_findings)
        if findings:
            continue
        targets = []
        if member_stride is None:
            for host_id, placements in sorted(inventory_deployments.items()):
                if isinstance(placements, dict) and target_id in placements:
                    values = inventory_hosts.get(host_id, {}) if isinstance(inventory_hosts.get(host_id), dict) else {}
                    targets.append({"hostId": host_id, "address": values.get("ansible_host", host_id), "port": port, "serverName": host_id})
            for member_id, member in sorted((target.get("members", {}) if isinstance(target.get("members"), dict) else {}).items()):
                host_id = member.get("host") if isinstance(member, dict) else None
                if isinstance(host_id, str):
                    values = inventory_hosts.get(host_id, {}) if isinstance(inventory_hosts.get(host_id), dict) else {}
                    targets.append({"hostId": host_id, "address": values.get("ansible_host", host_id), "port": port, "serverName": host_id})
            targets = sorted({item["hostId"]: item for item in targets}.values(), key=lambda item: item["hostId"])
        else:
            host_counts, used = {}, set()
            members = target.get("members", {}) if isinstance(target.get("members"), dict) else {}
            if not members:
                members, duplicate_member_ids = _inventory_members_for_deployment(
                    inventory_deployments, target_id
                )
                if duplicate_member_ids:
                    findings.append(_finding(
                        "HAPROXY_BACKEND_TARGETS_UNRESOLVED",
                        field,
                        "Inventory-owned deployment members are duplicated",
                    ))
            for member_id, member in sorted(members.items()):
                host_id = member.get("host") if isinstance(member, dict) else None
                if not isinstance(host_id, str) or host_id not in inventory_hosts:
                    findings.append(_finding("HAPROXY_BACKEND_TARGETS_UNRESOLVED", field, "Member host cannot be resolved"))
                    break
                member_config = member.get("configuration", {}) if isinstance(member.get("configuration"), dict) else {}
                explicit = member_config.get("port")
                if explicit is None:
                    resolved_member = (((resolved_configuration or {}).get("services", {}).get(target_id, {})
                                        .get("members", {}).get(member_id, {}).get("configuration", {}).get("port")))
                    if isinstance(resolved_member, dict) and resolved_member.get("source") == "MEMBER_OVERRIDE":
                        explicit = resolved_member.get("value")
                member_port = explicit if explicit is not None else port + member_stride * host_counts.get(host_id, 0)
                if not _valid_port(member_port) or (host_id, member_port) in used:
                    findings.append(_finding("HAPROXY_BACKEND_PORT_COLLISION", field, "Member client ports collide or exceed valid range"))
                    break
                host_counts[host_id] = host_counts.get(host_id, 0) + 1
                used.add((host_id, member_port))
                values = inventory_hosts[host_id]
                targets.append({"hostId": host_id, "memberId": member_id,
                                "address": values.get("ansible_host", host_id) if isinstance(values, dict) else host_id,
                                "port": member_port, "serverName": member_id})
            if findings:
                continue
        if not targets:
            findings.append(_finding("HAPROXY_BACKEND_TARGETS_UNRESOLVED", field, "HAProxy target has no resolved host placements"))
            continue
        endpoint_group_id = target.get("endpointGroup")
        expected_name = None
        if member_stride is not None and effective.get("ssl") is True and effective.get("sslVerify") == "required":
            endpoint = endpoint_map.get(target_id, {})
            expected_name = endpoint.get("fqdn") if isinstance(endpoint, dict) else None
            if not _safe_dns_name(expected_name):
                findings.append(_finding("HAPROXY_BACKEND_TLS_IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED", field, "Backend TLS identity is unavailable"))
                continue
            if pki_requests is not None:
                for member_target in targets:
                    matched = any(
                        isinstance(request, dict) and
                        _request_dns_covers_name(request.get("dnsNames"), expected_name) and
                        any(isinstance(consumer, dict) and
                            consumer.get("deploymentId") == target_id and
                            consumer.get("memberId") == member_target["memberId"] and
                            consumer.get("hostId") == member_target["hostId"]
                            for consumer in request.get("consumers", []))
                        for request in pki_requests
                    )
                    if not matched:
                        findings.append(_finding("HAPROXY_BACKEND_TLS_IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED", field, "Backend certificate request lacks the endpoint DNS identity"))
                        break
                if findings:
                    continue
        record = {"targetDeploymentId": target_id, "backendName": "%s-%s" % (target_id, endpoint_group_id),
                  "configFileName": "30-backend-%s-%s.cfg" % (target_id, endpoint_group_id),
                  "endpoint": endpoint_map.get(target_id, {}), "settings": effective, "targets": targets}
        if expected_name is not None:
            record["expectedServerName"] = expected_name
        for haproxy_id, provider_hosts in sorted(proxy_hosts.items()):
            provider_record = dict(record, providerHostIds=provider_hosts)
            provider_record["fingerprint"] = canonical_digest(provider_record)
            resolved.setdefault(haproxy_id, []).append(provider_record)
    for source_id, source in sorted((endpoint_sources or {}).items()):
        if selected_ids is not None and source_id not in selected_ids:
            continue
        endpoint = endpoint_map.get(source_id, {})
        group_id = endpoint.get('endpointGroupId')
        proxy_hosts = haproxy_provider_hosts(topology, inventory_deployments, {'endpointGroup': group_id})
        effective, errors = normalize_backend_settings({}, source.get('settings', {}), 'endpointSources.' + source_id)
        findings.extend(errors)
        targets = source.get('targets', [])
        if not targets or not isinstance(targets, list) or any(not _valid_endpoint_target(t) for t in targets):
            findings.append(_finding('HAPROXY_BACKEND_TARGETS_UNRESOLVED', 'endpointSources.' + source_id, 'Invalid endpoint targets'))
        if not endpoint:
            findings.append(_finding('HAPROXY_TARGET_ENDPOINT_UNSUPPORTED', 'endpointSources.' + source_id, 'Endpoint source is unresolved'))
        record = {'targetDeploymentId': source_id, 'backendName': source_id + '-' + str(group_id),
                  'configFileName': '30-backend-' + source_id + '-' + str(group_id) + '.cfg',
                  'endpoint': endpoint, 'settings': effective, 'targets': targets}
        if source.get('probe'):
            record['probe'] = source['probe']
        if effective.get('ssl'):
            if effective.get('sslVerify') != 'required':
                findings.append(_finding('HAPROXY_BACKEND_SSL_VERIFY_REQUIRED', 'endpointSources.' + source_id, 'Endpoint TLS requires verified identity'))
            record['expectedServerName'] = endpoint.get('fqdn')
        for provider_id, provider_hosts in sorted(proxy_hosts.items()):
            value = dict(record, providerHostIds=provider_hosts)
            value['fingerprint'] = canonical_digest(value)
            resolved.setdefault(provider_id, []).append(value)
    if findings:
        resolved = {}
    return {"apiVersion": "platform.installer/resolved-haproxy-backend/v1alpha1", "kind": "ResolvedHAProxyBackends",
            "backends": {key: sorted(value, key=lambda item: item["backendName"]) for key, value in sorted(resolved.items())},
            "fingerprint": canonical_digest(resolved), "findings": sorted(findings, key=lambda item: (item["field"], item["code"])),
            "status": "BLOCKED" if findings else "PASS"}

@@PORTABLE {"path":"ansible-core/collections/ansible_collections/platform/core/plugins/module_utils/identity_persistence.py","mode":420,"size":7370,"sha256":"46a42f408909607a2928983f474789b286f2f8caffa8f5ce69aaa28d6558af8c","index":0,"count":1,"encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":7370}
from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function

__metaclass__ = type

import hashlib
import json
import os
import tempfile

try:
    import yaml
except ImportError:
    yaml = None


def _hash(data):
    return "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def _read_bytes(path):
    with open(path, "rb") as source:
        return source.read()


def _dump(document):
    if yaml is None:
        raise RuntimeError("PyYAML is required for identity persistence")
    return yaml.safe_dump(document, allow_unicode=True, default_flow_style=False, sort_keys=False, width=100).encode("utf-8")


def persist_generated_state(state_path, document):
    """Atomically persist one machine-owned state document without rewriting inventory."""
    path = os.path.abspath(state_path)
    directory = os.path.dirname(path)
    os.makedirs(directory, exist_ok=True)
    original = _read_bytes(path) if os.path.exists(path) else b""
    candidate = _dump(document)
    if original:
        try:
            if yaml.safe_load(original) == document:
                return {"status": "PASS", "changed": False, "candidateHash": _hash(original)}
        except (TypeError, ValueError, yaml.YAMLError):
            pass
    fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".%s." % os.path.basename(path), dir=directory)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as output:
            output.write(candidate)
            output.flush()
            os.fsync(output.fileno())
        if os.path.exists(path) and _hash(_read_bytes(path)) != _hash(original):
            raise RuntimeError("MATERIALIZATION_CONCURRENT_EDIT")
        os.replace(temporary, path)
        return {"status": "PASS", "changed": True, "candidateHash": _hash(candidate)}
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(temporary):
            os.unlink(temporary)


def persist_identity_documents(project_path, inventory_path, project, inventory, transaction_dir=None, before_commit=None):
    """Persist a complete project/inventory pair with optimistic locking.

    Inputs must be parsed candidate documents. This function never edits
    group_vars/host_vars and never performs identity decisions.
    """
    paths = [os.path.abspath(project_path), os.path.abspath(inventory_path)]
    originals = [_read_bytes(path) for path in paths]
    if yaml is not None:
        try:
            if yaml.safe_load(originals[0]) == project and yaml.safe_load(originals[1]) == inventory:
                return {"status": "PASS", "changed": False, "candidateHashes": [_hash(v) for v in originals]}
        except (TypeError, ValueError, yaml.YAMLError):
            pass
    candidates = [_dump(project), _dump(inventory)]
    if all(_hash(value) == _hash(original) for value, original in zip(candidates, originals)):
        return {"status": "PASS", "changed": False, "candidateHashes": [_hash(v) for v in candidates]}
    if transaction_dir is None:
        transaction_dir = os.path.dirname(paths[0])
    os.makedirs(transaction_dir, exist_ok=True)
    txid = next(tempfile._get_candidate_names())
    marker_path = os.path.join(transaction_dir, ".identity-materialization-%s.json" % txid)
    temp_paths = []
    rollback_paths = []
    for path, original in zip(paths, originals):
        rollback_path = os.path.join(transaction_dir, ".%s.%s.rollback" % (txid, os.path.basename(path)))
        with open(rollback_path, "wb") as backup:
            backup.write(original)
            backup.flush()
            os.fsync(backup.fileno())
        rollback_paths.append(rollback_path)
    marker = {"transactionId": txid, "targets": paths, "rollbackPaths": rollback_paths, "originalHashes": [_hash(v) for v in originals], "candidateHashes": [_hash(v) for v in candidates], "state": "PREPARED"}
    with open(marker_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as marker_file:
        json.dump(marker, marker_file, sort_keys=True)
        marker_file.flush()
        os.fsync(marker_file.fileno())
    try:
        for path, content in zip(paths, candidates):
            fd, temp_path = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".%s." % os.path.basename(path), dir=os.path.dirname(path))
            temp_paths.append(temp_path)
            with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as output:
                output.write(content)
                output.flush()
                os.fsync(output.fileno())
        if before_commit is not None:
            before_commit(paths)
        current = [_read_bytes(path) for path in paths]
        if [_hash(v) for v in current] != marker["originalHashes"]:
            raise RuntimeError("MATERIALIZATION_CONCURRENT_EDIT")
        for temp_path, path in zip(temp_paths, paths):
            os.replace(temp_path, path)
        marker["state"] = "COMMITTED"
        with open(marker_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as marker_file:
            json.dump(marker, marker_file, sort_keys=True)
            marker_file.flush()
            os.fsync(marker_file.fileno())
        os.unlink(marker_path)
        for rollback_path in rollback_paths:
            if os.path.exists(rollback_path):
                os.unlink(rollback_path)
        return {"status": "PASS", "changed": originals != candidates, "candidateHashes": marker["candidateHashes"]}
    except Exception:
        for temp_path in temp_paths:
            if os.path.exists(temp_path):
                os.unlink(temp_path)
        for path, original in zip(paths, originals):
            if os.path.exists(path) and _hash(_read_bytes(path)) != _hash(original):
                fd, rollback = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".rollback.", dir=os.path.dirname(path))
                with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as output:
                    output.write(original)
                    output.flush()
                    os.fsync(output.fileno())
                os.replace(rollback, path)
        if os.path.exists(marker_path):
            os.unlink(marker_path)
        for rollback_path in rollback_paths:
            if os.path.exists(rollback_path):
                os.unlink(rollback_path)
        raise


def recover_identity_transaction(marker_path):
    """Recover an interrupted transaction before a new managed apply."""
    with open(marker_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as source:
        marker = json.load(source)
    current = [_hash(_read_bytes(path)) for path in marker["targets"]]
    if current == marker["candidateHashes"]:
        os.unlink(marker_path)
        for path in marker.get("rollbackPaths", []):
            if os.path.exists(path):
                os.unlink(path)
        return {"status": "COMMITTED", "changed": False}
    if current == marker["originalHashes"]:
        os.unlink(marker_path)
        for path in marker.get("rollbackPaths", []):
            if os.path.exists(path):
                os.unlink(path)
        return {"status": "ROLLED_BACK", "changed": False}
    for target, rollback in zip(marker["targets"], marker["rollbackPaths"]):
        with open(rollback, "rb") as source, tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False, dir=os.path.dirname(target)) as output:
            output.write(source.read())
            output.flush()
            os.fsync(output.fileno())
            temporary = output.name
        os.replace(temporary, target)
    os.unlink(marker_path)
    for path in marker.get("rollbackPaths", []):
        if os.path.exists(path):
            os.unlink(path)
    return {"status": "ROLLED_BACK", "changed": True}

def parse_meta_properties(deployment_id, member_id, host_id, metadata_path, content, exists=True, read_error=None):
    """Parse only Kafka identity metadata; never creates or mutates storage."""
    record = {"deploymentId": deployment_id, "memberId": member_id, "hostId": host_id, "metadataPath": metadata_path}
    if read_error:
        record.update(state="UNKNOWN", diagnostics={"reason": str(read_error)})
        return record
    if not exists:
        record["state"] = "UNINITIALIZED"
        return record
    values = {}
    for line in (content or "").splitlines():
        if "=" in line:
            key, value = line.split("=", 1)
            values[key.strip()] = value.strip()
    required = ("cluster.id", "node.id")
    if any(not values.get(key) for key in required):
        record.update(state="UNKNOWN", diagnostics={"reason": "malformed meta.properties"})
        return record
    record.update(state="INITIALIZED", clusterId=values["cluster.id"], nodeId=values["node.id"])
    if values.get("directory.id"):
        record["directoryId"] = values["directory.id"]
    return record

import base64

def _finding(code, field, message):
    return {"code": code, "status": "BLOCKED", "field": field, "safeMessage": message}


def _new_id(random_bytes):
    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(random_bytes(16)).decode("ascii").rstrip("=")


def validate_kafka_discovery(member_ids, records):
    """Validate the complete read-only discovery projection for a deployment."""
    expected = set(member_ids)
    seen = {}
    findings = []
    for record in records if isinstance(records, list) else []:
        if not isinstance(record, dict) or not record.get("memberId"):
            continue
        member_id = record["memberId"]
        if member_id in seen:
            findings.append(_finding("KAFKA_IDENTITY_DISCOVERY_DUPLICATE", "discovery", "Kafka identity discovery returned duplicate member records"))
        seen[member_id] = record
    missing = sorted(expected - set(seen))
    unknown = sorted(set(seen) - expected)
    if missing:
        findings.append(_finding("KAFKA_IDENTITY_DISCOVERY_INCOMPLETE", "discovery", "Kafka identity discovery is missing expected deployment members"))
    if unknown:
        findings.append(_finding("KAFKA_IDENTITY_DISCOVERY_UNKNOWN_MEMBER", "discovery", "Kafka identity discovery returned a member outside the deployment"))
    if any(record.get("state") == "UNKNOWN" for record in seen.values()):
        findings.append(_finding("KAFKA_IDENTITY_DISCOVERY_UNKNOWN", "discovery", "Kafka identity discovery could not establish storage state"))
    return findings


def materialize_kafka_identities(deployment_id, deployment, members, metadata, random_bytes=os.urandom):
    """Pure Kafka-specific identity decision before persistence or mutation.

    metadata is an inventory-member keyed read-only projection of meta.properties.
    The caller persists the returned complete patch atomically before projecting
    the role runtime input; this function never formats or changes storage.
    """
    deployment = deployment if isinstance(deployment, dict) else {}
    members = members if isinstance(members, dict) else {}
    metadata = metadata if isinstance(metadata, dict) else {}
    identity = deployment.get("identity", {}) if isinstance(deployment.get("identity"), dict) else {}
    discovered_clusters = sorted(set(
        value.get("clusterId") for value in metadata.values()
        if isinstance(value, dict) and (value.get("initialized") or value.get("state") == "INITIALIZED") and value.get("clusterId")
    ))
    findings = []
    if len(discovered_clusters) > 1:
        findings.append(_finding("KAFKA_CLUSTER_ID_DISCOVERY_CONFLICT", "identity.clusterId", "Initialized Kafka members disagree on cluster identity"))
    cluster_id = identity.get("clusterId")
    if cluster_id and discovered_clusters and cluster_id != discovered_clusters[0]:
        findings.append(_finding("KAFKA_CLUSTER_ID_METADATA_MISMATCH", "identity.clusterId", "Persisted cluster identity does not match initialized Kafka storage"))
    if findings:
        return {"status": "BLOCKED", "findings": findings}
    patch = {"deploymentIdentity": {}, "memberIdentities": {}}
    if not cluster_id:
        patch["deploymentIdentity"]["clusterId"] = discovered_clusters[0] if discovered_clusters else _new_id(random_bytes)
    required = [member_id for member_id, member in sorted(members.items()) if "controller" in member.get("roles", [])]
    if not metadata:
        return {"status": "BLOCKED", "findings": [_finding("KAFKA_IDENTITY_DISCOVERY_REQUIRED", "discovery", "Kafka identity generation requires a successful read-only storage discovery") ]}
    missing = [member_id for member_id in required if member_id not in metadata]
    if missing:
        return {"status": "BLOCKED", "findings": [_finding("KAFKA_IDENTITY_DISCOVERY_INCOMPLETE", "discovery", "Kafka identity discovery is incomplete for required controller members") ]}
    for member_id in required:
        member = members[member_id]
        persisted = member.get("identity", {}).get("directoryId") if isinstance(member.get("identity"), dict) else None
        observed = metadata.get(member_id, {}) if isinstance(metadata.get(member_id), dict) else {}
        recovered = observed.get("directoryId") if (observed.get("initialized") or observed.get("state") == "INITIALIZED") else None
        if persisted and recovered and persisted != recovered:
            findings.append(_finding("KAFKA_DIRECTORY_ID_METADATA_MISMATCH", "members.%s.identity.directoryId" % member_id, "Persisted controller identity does not match initialized Kafka storage"))
        elif not persisted:
            patch["memberIdentities"][member_id] = {"directoryId": recovered or _new_id(random_bytes)}
    if findings:
        return {"status": "BLOCKED", "findings": findings}
    changed = bool(patch["deploymentIdentity"] or patch["memberIdentities"])
    return {"status": "PASS", "changed": changed, "patch": patch, "findings": []}

SUPPORTED_PURPOSES = ("client", "interBroker", "controller")
SUPPORTED_PROTOCOLS = ("PLAINTEXT", "SSL")


def _finding(code, path, message, details=None):
    finding = {"code": code, "path": path, "message": message}
    if details:
        finding["safeDetails"] = details
    return finding


def _address(listener, member):
    bind = listener.get("bindAddress", "0.0.0.0")
    advertised = listener.get("advertisedAddress", member.get("advertised_host"))
    return bind, advertised


def normalize_listeners(configuration, member, path="configuration.listeners"):
    """Normalize named listeners without reading Ansible variables or precedence."""
    configuration = configuration if isinstance(configuration, dict) else {}
    named = configuration.get("listeners")
    if named is None:
        return {"status": "BLOCKED", "findings": [_finding("LISTENERS_REQUIRED", path, "Kafka requires an explicit named listener map")], "listeners": {}}
    if not isinstance(named, dict) or not named:
        return {"status": "BLOCKED", "findings": [_finding("LISTENERS_INVALID", path, "listeners must be a non-empty object")], "listeners": {}}

    listeners = {}
    findings = []
    for name, raw in sorted(named.items()):
        item_path = "%s.%s" % (path, name)
        if not isinstance(name, str) or not name or not name.replace("_", "").replace("-", "").isalnum() or name.upper() != name:
            findings.append(_finding("LISTENER_NAME_INVALID", item_path, "Listener names must be explicit uppercase identifiers"))
            continue
        if not isinstance(raw, dict):
            findings.append(_finding("LISTENER_INVALID", item_path, "Listener must be an object"))
            continue
        listener = dict(raw)
        listener["name"] = name
        purpose = listener.get("purpose")
        protocol = listener.get("securityProtocol")
        port = listener.get("port")
        if purpose not in SUPPORTED_PURPOSES:
            findings.append(_finding("LISTENER_PURPOSE_INVALID", item_path + ".purpose", "Unsupported listener purpose"))
        if protocol not in SUPPORTED_PROTOCOLS:
            findings.append(_finding("LISTENER_PROTOCOL_INVALID", item_path + ".securityProtocol", "Only PLAINTEXT and SSL are supported"))
        if not isinstance(port, int) or isinstance(port, bool) or not 1 <= port <= 65535:
            findings.append(_finding("LISTENER_PORT_INVALID", item_path + ".port", "Listener port must be an integer from 1 through 65535"))
        listeners[name] = listener

    if findings:
        return {"status": "BLOCKED", "findings": findings, "listeners": {}}
    ports = {}
    for name, listener in listeners.items():
        if isinstance(listener.get("port"), int) and not isinstance(listener.get("port"), bool):
            ports.setdefault(listener["port"], []).append(name)
    for port, names in sorted(ports.items()):
        if len(names) > 1:
            findings.append(_finding("LISTENER_PORT_COLLISION", "%s.%s.port" % (path, names[0]), "Listener ports must be unique within a logical member", {"port": port, "listeners": names}))
    if findings:
        return {"status": "BLOCKED", "findings": findings, "listeners": {}}
    return {"status": "PASS", "findings": [], "listeners": listeners, "source": "named"}


def project_member_listeners(configuration, member):
    normalized = normalize_listeners(configuration, member)
    if normalized["status"] != "PASS":
        return normalized
    projected = []
    for name, listener in normalized["listeners"].items():
        purpose = listener["purpose"]
        roles = member.get("roles", [])
        # KRaft brokers also need the controller listener to reach the
        # controller quorum; controller-only members still exclude broker
        # listeners below.
        if purpose in ("client", "interBroker") and "broker" not in roles:
            continue
        bind, advertised = _address(listener, member)
        item = dict(listener)
        item["bindAddress"] = bind
        item["advertisedAddress"] = advertised
        projected.append(item)
    projected.sort(key=lambda item: item["name"])
    return {"status": "PASS", "findings": [], "listeners": projected, "source": normalized["source"]}


def listener_runtime_properties(configuration, member):
    projected = project_member_listeners(configuration, member)
    if projected["status"] != "PASS":
        return projected
    listeners = projected["listeners"]
    if not listeners:
        return {"status": "BLOCKED", "findings": [_finding("LISTENER_ROLE_PROJECTION_EMPTY", "configuration.listeners", "No listener applies to this member role")], "properties": {}}
    properties = {
        "listeners": ",".join("%s://%s:%s" % (item["name"], item["bindAddress"], item["port"]) for item in listeners),
        "advertised.listeners": ",".join("%s://%s:%s" % (item["name"], item["advertisedAddress"], item["port"]) for item in listeners),
        "listener.security.protocol.map": ",".join("%s:%s" % (item["name"], item["securityProtocol"]) for item in listeners),
    }
    controller = [item["name"] for item in listeners if item["purpose"] == "controller"]
    inter_broker = [item["name"] for item in listeners if item["purpose"] == "interBroker"]
    if "controller" in member.get("roles", []) and not controller:
        return {"status": "BLOCKED", "findings": [_finding("CONTROLLER_LISTENER_REQUIRED", "configuration.listeners", "Controller member requires a controller listener")], "properties": {}}
    if "broker" in member.get("roles", []) and not inter_broker:
        return {"status": "BLOCKED", "findings": [_finding("INTER_BROKER_LISTENER_REQUIRED", "configuration.listeners", "Broker member requires an interBroker listener")], "properties": {}}
    if controller:
        properties["controller.listener.names"] = ",".join(controller)
    if inter_broker:
        properties["inter.broker.listener.name"] = inter_broker[0]
    return {"status": "PASS", "findings": [], "properties": properties, "listeners": listeners,
            "listenerFingerprint": canonical_digest(listeners)}

def project_kafka_runtime(resolved_topology, resolved_configuration, host_addresses=None):
    """Build the public platform_kafka_instances input from final Core projections.

    This is deliberately a pure controller-side adapter. It neither reads
    Ansible precedence nor changes the standalone role contract.
    """
    topology = resolved_topology.get("resolvedTopology", {}) if isinstance(resolved_topology, dict) else {}
    services = resolved_configuration.get("services", {}) if isinstance(resolved_configuration, dict) else {}
    addresses = host_addresses if isinstance(host_addresses, dict) else {}
    output = {}
    for deployment_id, deployment in sorted(topology.get("serviceDeployments", {}).items()):
        if deployment.get("serviceType") != "kafka":
            continue
        service = services.get(deployment_id, {})
        instances = []
        for member_id, member in sorted(deployment.get("members", {}).items()):
            effective = service.get("members", {}).get(member_id, {}).get("configuration", {})
            host = member.get("host")
            address = effective.get("advertisedHost", addresses.get(host, host))
            deployment_config = service.get("configuration", {})
            namespace = deployment_config.get("runtimePathNamespace", deployment_id)
            data_root = deployment_config.get("dataDirectory", "/var/lib/%s" % deployment_id)
            co_located = sum(1 for other in deployment.get("members", {}).values()
                             if other.get("host") == host) > 1
            log_root = deployment_config.get("logDirectoryRoot", "/var/log/kafka")
            config_root = deployment_config.get("configDirectoryRoot", "/etc/kafka")
            if deployment.get("mode") == "kraft-standalone":
                data_path = effective.get("dataDirectory", data_root + ("/" + member_id if co_located else ""))
                log_path = deployment_config.get("logDirectory", log_root)
                config_path = deployment_config.get("configDirectory", config_root)
            else:
                data_path = effective.get("dataDirectory", data_root + ("/" + member_id if co_located else ""))
                log_path = "%s/%s/%s" % (log_root.rstrip("/"), namespace, member_id)
                config_path = "%s/%s/%s" % (config_root.rstrip("/"), deployment_config.get("configPathNamespace", "kafka"), member_id)
            instance = {
                "id": member_id, "host": host, "roles": sorted(member.get("roles", [])),
                "node_id": effective.get("nodeId"), "advertised_host": address,
                "data_directory": data_path,
                "log_directory": log_path,
                "config_directory": config_path,
            }
            member_identity = member.get("identity", {}) if isinstance(member.get("identity"), dict) else {}
            if "directoryId" in member_identity:
                instance["directory_id"] = member_identity["directoryId"]
            listener_projection = listener_runtime_properties(effective, instance)
            if listener_projection["status"] == "PASS":
                instance["listeners"] = listener_projection["listeners"]
                instance["listener_properties"] = listener_projection["properties"]
                instance["listener_fingerprint"] = listener_projection["listenerFingerprint"]
            else:
                instance["listener_findings"] = listener_projection["findings"]
            instances.append(instance)
        projection = {
            "clusterId": (deployment.get("identity", {}) if isinstance(deployment.get("identity"), dict) else {}).get("clusterId"),
            "quorumMode": service.get("configuration", {}).get("quorumMode", "dynamic"),
            "instances": instances,
        }
        projection["runtimeProjectionFingerprint"] = canonical_digest(projection)
        output[deployment_id] = projection
    return output

def resolved_value(configuration, name, default=None):
    value = configuration.get(name, default)
    if isinstance(value, dict) and "state" in value:
        return value.get("value", default) if value.get("state") == "RESOLVED" else default
    return value


def properties_value(value):
    """Escape one Java properties value without interpreting its contents."""
    return (str(value).replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("\r", "\\r").replace("\n", "\\n")
            .replace("\t", "\\t").replace(" ", "\\ ").replace("=", "\\=").replace(":", "\\:"))


def registry_projection(members, enabled=True, listener="SSL", http_port=8081,
                        https_port=8082, name="schema-registry", config_root="/etc/schema-registry",
                        log_root="/var/log/schema-registry"):
    """Consume final member values; never evaluate Ansible precedence or secrets."""
    findings, output, groups, occupied, units = [], [], {}, {}, set()

    def issue(code, member, message):
        findings.append({"code": code, "field": "members.%s.schemaRegistry" % member.get("id", "unknown"),
                         "message": message})

    if not isinstance(enabled, bool):
        return {"instances": [], "findings": [{"code": "SCHEMA_REGISTRY_ENABLED_INVALID",
                "field": "schemaRegistryEnabled", "message": "Expected a boolean"}]}
    for member in members:
        host = member.get("host")
        for entry in member.get("listeners", {}).values():
            purpose = entry.get("purpose")
            if ((purpose == "controller" and "controller" in member.get("roles", [])) or
                    (purpose != "controller" and "broker" in member.get("roles", []))):
                occupied.setdefault((host, entry.get("port")), "Kafka")
        if "broker" in member.get("roles", []):
            groups.setdefault(member.get("deployment_id", "kafka"), []).append(member)
    # Even disabled instances have deterministic resources, for ownership-safe removal guards.
    for deployment, brokers in sorted(groups.items()):
        endpoints, protocols = [], set()
        for member in sorted(brokers, key=lambda item: item.get("id", "")):
            entry = member.get("listeners", {}).get(listener)
            if not isinstance(entry, dict) or entry.get("purpose") not in ("client", "interBroker"):
                if enabled:
                    issue("SCHEMA_REGISTRY_LISTENER_INVALID", member, "Selected broker listener is missing or is a controller listener")
                continue
            protocol = entry.get("securityProtocol")
            if protocol not in ("PLAINTEXT", "SSL"):
                if enabled:
                    issue("SCHEMA_REGISTRY_PROTOCOL_UNSUPPORTED", member, "Only PLAINTEXT and SSL broker connections are supported")
                continue
            protocols.add(protocol)
            address = entry.get("advertisedAddress", member.get("advertised_host", member.get("host")))
            if not isinstance(address, str) or not address or re.search(r"[\s/,=]", address):
                issue("SCHEMA_REGISTRY_ADDRESS_INVALID", member, "Invalid advertised broker address")
                continue
            if ":" in address and not address.startswith("["):
                address = "[%s]" % address
            endpoints.append("%s://%s:%s" % (protocol, address, entry.get("port")))
        if enabled and len(protocols) != 1:
            issue("SCHEMA_REGISTRY_PROTOCOL_MISMATCH", brokers[0], "Selected broker listeners must use one security protocol")
        for member in sorted(brokers, key=lambda item: item.get("id", "")):
            settings = member.get("schema_registry", {})
            ports = [settings.get("http_port", http_port), settings.get("https_port", https_port)]
            if any(isinstance(port, bool) or not isinstance(port, int) or not 1 <= port <= 65535 for port in ports):
                issue("SCHEMA_REGISTRY_PORT_INVALID", member, "REST ports must be integers from 1 to 65535")
                continue
            if enabled:
                for port in ports:
                    key = (member.get("host"), port)
                    if key in occupied:
                        issue("SCHEMA_REGISTRY_PORT_COLLISION", member, "REST port collides on this host; set member port overrides")
                    occupied[key] = member.get("id")
            address = member.get("advertised_host", member.get("host"))
            if not isinstance(address, str) or not address or re.search(r"[\s/,=]", address):
                issue("SCHEMA_REGISTRY_ADDRESS_INVALID", member, "Invalid Registry advertised address")
                continue
            suffix = str(member.get("id", "")).rsplit("-", 1)[-1]
            if not re.fullmatch(r"[1-9][0-9]*", suffix) or not re.fullmatch(r"[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*", deployment):
                issue("SCHEMA_REGISTRY_IDENTITY_INVALID", member, "Registry requires a deployment and numeric member identity")
                continue
            unit = "%s@%s-%s.service" % (name, deployment, suffix)
            if (member.get("host"), unit) in units:
                issue("SCHEMA_REGISTRY_UNIT_COLLISION", member, "Registry unit identity collides on this host")
            units.add((member.get("host"), unit))
            config = "%s/%s/%s/%s" % (config_root.rstrip("/"), name, deployment, member["id"])
            logs = "%s/%s/%s/%s" % (log_root.rstrip("/"), name, deployment, member["id"])
            if ".." in str(member["id"]) or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+", str(member["id"])):
                issue("SCHEMA_REGISTRY_IDENTITY_INVALID", member, "Unsafe member identity")
                continue
            # Kafka directories may be 0750 owned by kafka; Registry must not rely on traversing them.
            if any(not path.startswith("/") or ".." in path.split("/") or re.search(r"[\s\n]", path) for path in (config, logs)) or any(root in ('/', '/etc', '/var', '/var/log') for root in (config_root, log_root)):
                issue("SCHEMA_REGISTRY_PATH_INVALID", member, "Registry requires safe absolute member paths")
                continue
            url_host = "[%s]" % address if ":" in address and not address.startswith("[") else address
            output.append({"id": member["id"], "deployment_id": deployment, "host": member["host"],
                           "advertised_host": address, "http_port": ports[0], "https_port": ports[1],
                           "http_url": "http://%s:%s" % (url_host, ports[0]),
                           "https_url": "https://%s:%s" % (url_host, ports[1]),
                           "bootstrap_servers": ",".join(endpoints),
                           "broker_ids": sorted([broker["node_id"] for broker in brokers if isinstance(broker.get("node_id"), int)]),
                           "security_protocol": next(iter(protocols)) if len(protocols) == 1 else "SSL",
                           "config_directory": config, "log_directory": logs,
                           "managed_paths": [config, config + "/pki", logs],
                           "ownership_paths": [config, logs],
                           "guard_paths": sorted(set([config, config + "/pki", logs] +
                               [str(parent) for path in (config, logs) for parent in PurePosixPath(path).parents if str(parent) != "/"])),
                           "unit_name": unit, "unit_path": "/etc/systemd/system/" + unit,
                           "ownership_marker": "# platform-schema-registry-managed: " + unit,
                           "tls_profile": settings.get("tls_profile", member.get("tls_profile", "infrastructure-tls")),
                           "replication_factor": min(3, len(brokers)),
                           "min_insync_replicas": 1 if len(brokers) == 1 else 2})
    return {"instances": output, "findings": findings}


def configuration_registry_findings(services, resolved_topology):
    """Validate already resolved configuration; no target inspection."""
    members = []
    findings = []
    topology = resolved_topology.get("resolvedTopology", {}).get("serviceDeployments", {})
    for deployment, service in sorted(services.items()):
        if service.get("serviceType") != "kafka":
            continue
        config = service.get("configuration", {})
        enabled = resolved_value(config, "schemaRegistryEnabled", False)
        # Older service definitions without this setting retain their previous contract.
        if "schemaRegistryEnabled" not in config or enabled is False:
            continue
        local = []
        for member_id, member in sorted(topology.get(deployment, {}).get("members", {}).items()):
            effective = service.get("members", {}).get(member_id, {}).get("configuration", {})
            local.append({"id": member_id, "deployment_id": deployment, "host": member.get("host"),
                          "roles": member.get("roles", []), "advertised_host": member.get("host"),
                          "listeners": resolved_value(effective, "listeners", resolved_value(config, "listeners", {})),
                          "schema_registry": {"http_port": resolved_value(effective, "schemaRegistryHttpPort", 8081),
                                              "https_port": resolved_value(effective, "schemaRegistryHttpsPort", 8082)}})
        broker_count = sum("broker" in member.get("roles", []) for member in local)
        advanced = resolved_value(config, "advancedConfig", {})
        if isinstance(advanced, dict) and "offsets.topic.replication.factor" in advanced:
            factor = advanced["offsets.topic.replication.factor"]
            if isinstance(factor, bool) or not isinstance(factor, int) or not 1 <= factor <= broker_count:
                findings.append({"code": "SCHEMA_REGISTRY_OFFSETS_TOPIC_REPLICATION_UNSATISFIABLE",
                                 "field": "serviceDeployments.%s.configuration.advancedConfig" % deployment,
                                 "message": "Offsets topic replication factor exceeds the desired broker capacity"})
        projection = registry_projection(local, enabled, resolved_value(config, "schemaRegistryKafkaListener", "SSL"))
        for finding in projection["findings"]:
            finding["field"] = "serviceDeployments.%s.%s" % (deployment, finding["field"])
            findings.append(finding)
        members.extend(projection["instances"])
    seen = set()
    for instance in members:
        for port in (instance["http_port"], instance["https_port"]):
            key = (instance["host"], port)
            if key in seen:
                findings.append({"code": "SCHEMA_REGISTRY_PORT_COLLISION", "field": "serviceDeployments.%s" % instance["deployment_id"],
                                 "message": "Registry ports collide across deployments on this host"})
            seen.add(key)
    return findings

import copy

def _inventory_hosts_with_managed_deployments(inventory_path, inventory):
    """Return inventory hosts with their canonical per-host deployment input.

    Installer-managed projects own the fixed
    ``inventory/host_vars/<host>/platform-installer.yml`` document.  The flat
    ``inventory/host_vars/<host>.yml`` form remains a standalone-Ansible
    compatibility input when the managed document is absent.  Identity
    materialization reads only ``platform_deployments``; it neither scans
    arbitrary files nor writes host variables.
    """
    hosts = (inventory.get("all", {}).get("hosts", {}) or {}) if isinstance(inventory, dict) else {}
    host_vars_root = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.fspath(inventory_path)), "host_vars")
    for host, host_data in sorted(hosts.items()):
        effective = copy.deepcopy(host_data) if isinstance(host_data, dict) else {}
        if not isinstance(host, str) or not host:
            yield host, effective
            continue
        managed_path = os.path.join(host_vars_root, host, "platform-installer.yml")
        legacy_path = os.path.join(host_vars_root, host + ".yml")
        host_vars_path = managed_path if os.path.isfile(managed_path) else legacy_path
        if os.path.isfile(host_vars_path):
            with open(host_vars_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as source:
                host_vars = yaml.safe_load(source) or {}
            if isinstance(host_vars, dict) and "platform_deployments" in host_vars:
                effective["platform_deployments"] = copy.deepcopy(host_vars["platform_deployments"])
        yield host, effective


def materialize_ansible_kafka(desired_state, inventory_path, state_path, discovery, project_id="ansible-project", random_bytes=None):
    """Materialize Kafka identities into machine-owned Ansible state only."""
    with open(inventory_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as source:
        inventory = yaml.safe_load(source) or {}
    if state_path and os.path.exists(state_path):
        with open(state_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as source:
            loaded_document = yaml.safe_load(source) or {}
    else:
        loaded_document = {}
    loaded = loaded_document.get("platform_generated_state", {}) if isinstance(loaded_document, dict) else {}
    state = copy.deepcopy(loaded) if isinstance(loaded, dict) else {}
    state.setdefault("apiVersion", "platform.installer/generated-state/v1alpha1")
    state.setdefault("kind", "PlatformGeneratedState")
    state.setdefault("metadata", {"projectId": project_id})
    state.setdefault("serviceDeployments", {})
    deployments = desired_state.get("serviceDeployments", {}) if isinstance(desired_state, dict) else {}
    result = {"status": "PASS", "changed": False, "decisions": {}}
    for deployment_id, declared in sorted(deployments.items()):
        if not isinstance(declared, dict) or declared.get("serviceType") != "kafka":
            continue
        deployment_state = state["serviceDeployments"].setdefault(deployment_id, {})
        effective = copy.deepcopy(declared)
        effective.setdefault("identity", {}).update(deployment_state.get("identity", {}))
        members = {}
        for host, host_data in _inventory_hosts_with_managed_deployments(inventory_path, inventory):
            owned = (host_data.get("platform_deployments", {}) if isinstance(host_data, dict) else {}).get(deployment_id, {})
            for member_id, member in sorted((owned.get("members", {}) if isinstance(owned, dict) else {}).items()):
                normalized = copy.deepcopy(member)
                normalized.setdefault("identity", {}).update(
                    deployment_state.get("members", {}).get(member_id, {}).get("identity", {})
                )
                members[member_id] = normalized
        metadata, records = {}, []
        for host_discovery in discovery.values() if isinstance(discovery, dict) else []:
            values = host_discovery if isinstance(host_discovery, list) else []
            for record in values:
                if isinstance(record, dict) and record.get("deploymentId") in (None, deployment_id) and record.get("memberId"):
                    records.append(record)
                    metadata[record["memberId"]] = record
        findings = validate_kafka_discovery(members.keys(), records)
        if findings:
            return dict(result, status="BLOCKED", findings=findings)
        kwargs = {"random_bytes": random_bytes} if random_bytes is not None else {}
        decision = materialize_kafka_identities(deployment_id, effective, members, metadata, **kwargs)
        result["decisions"][deployment_id] = decision
        if decision["status"] != "PASS":
            return dict(result, status="BLOCKED", findings=decision.get("findings", []))
        patch = decision.get("patch", {})
        if patch.get("deploymentIdentity"):
            deployment_state.setdefault("identity", {}).update(patch["deploymentIdentity"])
        for member_id, identity in patch.get("memberIdentities", {}).items():
            deployment_state.setdefault("members", {}).setdefault(member_id, {}).setdefault("identity", {}).update(identity)
        result["changed"] = result["changed"] or bool(decision.get("changed"))
    if result["changed"] or not loaded:
        persisted = persist_generated_state(state_path, {"platform_generated_state": state})
        result["changed"] = persisted["changed"]
    with open(state_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as source:
        result["stateDocument"] = yaml.safe_load(source) or {}
    return result


def materialize_managed_kafka(project_path, inventory_path, discovery, random_bytes=None):
    """Materialize all Kafka identities, then reload canonical documents.

    Discovery is read-only input collected by the Ansible target phase. The
    returned documents are always loaded from disk after persistence.
    """
    with open(project_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as source:
        project = yaml.safe_load(source) or {}
    with open(inventory_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as source:
        inventory = yaml.safe_load(source) or {}
    desired = project.get("desiredState", {})
    deployments = desired.get("serviceDeployments", {}) if isinstance(desired, dict) else {}
    result = {"status": "PASS", "changed": False, "decisions": {}}
    candidate_project = copy.deepcopy(project)
    candidate_inventory = copy.deepcopy(inventory)
    for deployment_id, deployment in sorted(deployments.items()):
        if not isinstance(deployment, dict) or deployment.get("serviceType") != "kafka":
            continue
        members = {}
        for host, host_data in _inventory_hosts_with_managed_deployments(inventory_path, inventory):
            owned = (host_data.get("platform_deployments", {}) if isinstance(host_data, dict) else {}).get(deployment_id, {})
            for member_id, member in sorted((owned.get("members", {}) if isinstance(owned, dict) else {}).items()):
                members[member_id] = member
        metadata = {}
        discovery_records = []
        if isinstance(discovery, dict):
            for host_discovery in discovery.values():
                if isinstance(host_discovery, list):
                    for record in host_discovery:
                        if isinstance(record, dict) and record.get("memberId"):
                            if record.get("deploymentId") not in (None, deployment_id):
                                continue
                            discovery_records.append(record)
                            metadata[record["memberId"]] = record
                    continue
                if isinstance(host_discovery, dict):
                    nested = host_discovery.get(deployment_id, {}) or {}
                    if isinstance(nested, dict):
                        for member_id, record in nested.items():
                            if isinstance(record, dict):
                                normalized = dict(record)
                                normalized.setdefault("memberId", member_id)
                                normalized.setdefault("deploymentId", deployment_id)
                                discovery_records.append(normalized)
                                metadata[member_id] = normalized
        discovery_findings = validate_kafka_discovery(members.keys(), discovery_records)
        if discovery_findings:
            return dict(result, status="BLOCKED", findings=discovery_findings)
        kwargs = {"random_bytes": random_bytes} if random_bytes is not None else {}
        decision = materialize_kafka_identities(deployment_id, deployment, members, metadata, **kwargs)
        result["decisions"][deployment_id] = decision
        if decision["status"] != "PASS":
            return dict(result, status="BLOCKED", findings=decision.get("findings", []))
        patch = decision.get("patch", {})
        if patch.get("deploymentIdentity"):
            candidate_project["desiredState"]["serviceDeployments"][deployment_id].setdefault("identity", {}).update(patch["deploymentIdentity"])
        for host, host_data in sorted((candidate_inventory.get("all", {}).get("hosts", {}) or {}).items()):
            owned = (host_data.get("platform_deployments", {}) if isinstance(host_data, dict) else {}).get(deployment_id, {})
            for member_id, identity in patch.get("memberIdentities", {}).items():
                if member_id in (owned.get("members", {}) if isinstance(owned, dict) else {}):
                    owned["members"][member_id].setdefault("identity", {}).update(identity)
        result["changed"] = result["changed"] or bool(decision.get("changed"))
    if result["changed"]:
        persist_identity_documents(project_path, inventory_path, candidate_project, candidate_inventory)
    with open(project_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as source:
        result["project"] = yaml.safe_load(source) or {}
    with open(inventory_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as source:
        result["inventory"] = yaml.safe_load(source) or {}
    return result

"""Read only the protected, request-scoped PKI markers used by reissue.

This module is shared by target-free Core planning and the fixed execution
controller. It does not resolve certificate semantics or write PKI state.
"""

import os
import re
import stat


_PROJECT_ID = re.compile(r"[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,127}\Z")
_REQUEST_ID = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}\Z")
_FINGERPRINT = re.compile(r"sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}\Z")
_DIR_FLAGS = os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0)
_FILE_FLAGS = os.O_RDONLY | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0)
_MATERIAL_FILES = ("leaf.key", "leaf.crt", "keystore.p12", "truststore.p12")


def _directory(root, parts):
    if not isinstance(root, str) or not os.path.isabs(root):
        raise ValueError("PKI_REISSUE_STATE_UNAVAILABLE")
    segments = [part for part in os.path.normpath(root).split(os.sep) if part] + list(parts)
    descriptor = os.open(os.sep, _DIR_FLAGS)
    try:
        for segment in segments:
            if segment in ("", ".", "..") or os.sep in segment:
                raise ValueError("PKI_REISSUE_STATE_UNAVAILABLE")
            try:
                child = os.open(segment, _DIR_FLAGS, dir_fd=descriptor)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                return None
            os.close(descriptor)
            descriptor = child
        return os.dup(descriptor)
    except OSError:
        raise ValueError("PKI_REISSUE_STATE_UNAVAILABLE")
    finally:
        os.close(descriptor)


def _file(directory, name, marker=False):
    if directory is None:
        return None
    try:
        descriptor = os.open(name, _FILE_FLAGS, dir_fd=directory)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return None
    except OSError:
        raise ValueError("PKI_REISSUE_STATE_UNAVAILABLE")
    try:
        details = os.fstat(descriptor)
        if not stat.S_ISREG(details.st_mode) or details.st_size > (80 if marker else 1 << 30):
            raise ValueError("PKI_REISSUE_STATE_UNAVAILABLE")
        if marker:
            raw = os.read(descriptor, 81)
            try:
                value = raw.decode("ascii").rstrip("\n")
            except UnicodeDecodeError:
                raise ValueError("PKI_REISSUE_STATE_UNAVAILABLE")
            if _FINGERPRINT.fullmatch(value) is None:
                raise ValueError("PKI_REISSUE_STATE_UNAVAILABLE")
            return value
        return True
    finally:
        os.close(descriptor)


def inspect_reissue(state_root, project_identity, requests):
    """Return deterministic changed/resumable request marker observations."""
    if (_PROJECT_ID.fullmatch(project_identity or "") is None or
            not isinstance(requests, list) or len(requests) > 4096):
        raise ValueError("PKI_REISSUE_STATE_UNAVAILABLE")
    base = os.path.join(state_root, "pki")
    result, seen = [], set()
    for request in sorted(requests, key=lambda item: item.get("id", "") if isinstance(item, dict) else ""):
        if not isinstance(request, dict):
            raise ValueError("PKI_REISSUE_STATE_UNAVAILABLE")
        request_id, desired = request.get("id"), request.get("certificateRequestFingerprint")
        authority_id, authority_fingerprint = request.get("authorityId"), request.get("authorityFingerprint")
        if (not isinstance(request_id, str) or _REQUEST_ID.fullmatch(request_id) is None or
                request_id in seen or not isinstance(desired, str) or
                _FINGERPRINT.fullmatch(desired) is None or
                not isinstance(authority_id, str) or _REQUEST_ID.fullmatch(authority_id) is None or
                not isinstance(authority_fingerprint, str) or _FINGERPRINT.fullmatch(authority_fingerprint) is None):
            raise ValueError("PKI_REISSUE_STATE_UNAVAILABLE")
        seen.add(request_id)
        request_dir = recovery_dir = authority_dir = None
        try:
            request_dir = _directory(base, (project_identity, "requests", request_id))
            recovery_dir = _directory(base, (project_identity, "reissues"))
            authority_dir = _directory(base, (project_identity, "authorities", authority_id))
            old = _file(request_dir, "request-fingerprint", marker=True)
            recovery = _file(recovery_dir, request_id + ".fingerprint", marker=True)
            if recovery is not None and recovery != desired:
                raise ValueError("PKI_REISSUE_RECOVERY_MISMATCH")
            if recovery is None:
                material = [_file(request_dir, name) is not None for name in _MATERIAL_FILES]
                if (old is None and any(material)) or (old is not None and not all(material[:2])):
                    raise ValueError("PKI_REISSUE_STATE_INCOMPLETE")
            if recovery is not None or (old is not None and old != desired):
                authority_marker = _file(authority_dir, "authority-fingerprint", marker=True)
                if (authority_marker != authority_fingerprint or
                        _file(authority_dir, "ca.key") is None or
                        _file(authority_dir, "ca.crt") is None):
                    raise ValueError("PKI_REISSUE_AUTHORITY_CHANGED")
                result.append({"requestId": request_id, "expectedOldFingerprint": old,
                               "desiredFingerprint": desired, "recoveryFingerprint": recovery,
                               "authorityId": authority_id, "authorityFingerprint": authority_marker})
        finally:
            if request_dir is not None:
                os.close(request_dir)
            if recovery_dir is not None:
                os.close(recovery_dir)
            if authority_dir is not None:
                os.close(authority_dir)
    return result


def assert_reissue_unchanged(state_root, project_identity, expected):
    if not isinstance(expected, list) or not expected or len(expected) > 256:
        raise ValueError("PKI_REISSUE_STATE_UNAVAILABLE")
    requests = [{"id": item.get("requestId"), "certificateRequestFingerprint": item.get("desiredFingerprint"),
                 "authorityId": item.get("authorityId"), "authorityFingerprint": item.get("authorityFingerprint")}
                for item in expected if isinstance(item, dict)]
    if len(requests) != len(expected) or inspect_reissue(state_root, project_identity, requests) != expected:
        raise ValueError("PKI_REISSUE_PLAN_STALE")

    return {
        "apiVersion": "platform.installer/finding/v1alpha1",
        "kind": "Finding",
        "code": code,
        "status": status,
