def _string_list(values):
    return sorted(set(value for value in values if isinstance(value, str) and value))


def _safe_identity_value(value):
    return isinstance(value, str) and value and "\n" not in value and "\r" not in value and "\x00" not in value


def _host_identity(host_id, host_vars):
    values = host_vars.get(host_id, {}) if isinstance(host_vars, dict) else {}
    values = values if isinstance(values, dict) else {}
    address = values.get("ansible_host") or host_id
    dns_names = _string_list([host_id] + ([address] if isinstance(address, str) and not _looks_like_ip(address) else []))
    ip_addresses = _string_list([address] if _looks_like_ip(address) else [])
    return {"hostId": host_id, "dnsNames": dns_names, "ipAddresses": ip_addresses}


def _looks_like_ip(value):
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        return False
    if ":" in value:
        return True
    parts = value.split(".")
    return len(parts) == 4 and all(part.isdigit() and 0 <= int(part) <= 255 for part in parts)


def _profile_defaults(profile, defaults):
    profile = profile if isinstance(profile, dict) else {}
    policy = profile.get("sanPolicy", {}) if isinstance(profile.get("sanPolicy"), dict) else {}
    subject = profile.get("subject", {}) if isinstance(profile.get("subject"), dict) else {}
    return {
        "authorityRef": profile.get("authorityRef"),
        "keyAlgorithm": profile.get("keyAlgorithm", defaults["keyAlgorithm"]),
        "keySize": profile.get("keySize", defaults["keySize"]),
        "validityDays": profile.get("validityDays", defaults["leafValidityDays"]),
        "usages": _string_list(profile.get("usages", defaults["usages"])),
        "sanPolicy": {
            "includeHostDns": policy.get("includeHostDns", defaults["sanPolicy"]["includeHostDns"]),
            "includeHostIp": policy.get("includeHostIp", defaults["sanPolicy"]["includeHostIp"]),
            "includeEndpointFqdns": policy.get("includeEndpointFqdns", defaults["sanPolicy"]["includeEndpointFqdns"]),
            "includeEndpointWildcard": policy.get("includeEndpointWildcard", defaults["sanPolicy"]["includeEndpointWildcard"]),
            "includeEndpointVip": policy.get("includeEndpointVip", defaults["sanPolicy"]["includeEndpointVip"]),
        },
        "subject": dict(defaults["subject"], **subject),
    }


def _consumer_records(topology, inventory_deployments=None):
    records = []
    deployments = topology.get("serviceDeployments", {}) if isinstance(topology, dict) else {}
    for deployment_id, deployment in sorted(deployments.items()):
        if not isinstance(deployment, dict):
            continue
        deployment_config = deployment.get("configuration", {}) if isinstance(deployment.get("configuration"), dict) else {}
        members = deployment.get("members", {}) if isinstance(deployment.get("members"), dict) else {}
        for member_id, member in sorted(members.items()):
            if not isinstance(member, dict):
                continue
            member_config = member.get("configuration", {}) if isinstance(member.get("configuration"), dict) else {}
            tls_profile = member_config.get("tlsProfile", deployment_config.get("tlsProfile"))
            if isinstance(tls_profile, str) and tls_profile:
                records.append({
                    "deploymentId": deployment_id,
                    "memberId": member_id,
                    "hostId": member.get("host"),
                    "tlsProfileRef": tls_profile,
                })
        # Host-scoped services use inventory placement instead of logical
        # members.  Preserve the same generic tlsProfile contract.
        for host_id, placements in sorted((inventory_deployments or {}).items()):
            placement = placements.get(deployment_id) if isinstance(placements, dict) else None
            if not isinstance(placement, dict):
                continue
            placement_config = placement.get("configuration", {}) if isinstance(placement.get("configuration"), dict) else {}
            tls_profile = placement_config.get("tlsProfile", deployment_config.get("tlsProfile"))
            if isinstance(tls_profile, str) and tls_profile:
                records.append({
                    "deploymentId": deployment_id, "memberId": "host--%s" % host_id,
                    "hostId": host_id, "tlsProfileRef": tls_profile,
                })
    unique = {}
    for record in records:
        unique[(record["deploymentId"], record["memberId"], record.get("hostId"), record["tlsProfileRef"])] = record
    return [unique[key] for key in sorted(unique)]


def _scope_key(scope, consumer):
    if scope == "MEMBER":
        return "%s--%s--%s" % (consumer["tlsProfileRef"], consumer["deploymentId"], consumer["memberId"])
    if scope == "DEPLOYMENT":
        return "%s--%s" % (consumer["tlsProfileRef"], consumer["deploymentId"])
    return "%s--%s" % (consumer["tlsProfileRef"], consumer["hostId"])


def _endpoint_values(topology, resolved_service_endpoints, deployment_ids, policy, host_id=None):
    projection = resolved_service_endpoints if isinstance(resolved_service_endpoints, dict) else {}
    endpoints = projection.get("endpoints", {}) if isinstance(projection.get("endpoints"), dict) else {}
    selected = [endpoints[key] for key in sorted(endpoints) if key in deployment_ids and isinstance(endpoints[key], dict)]
    host_endpoints = projection.get("hostEndpoints", {}) if isinstance(projection.get("hostEndpoints"), dict) else {}
    selected_host = [value for value in host_endpoints.values() if isinstance(value, dict)
                     and value.get("serviceDeploymentId") in deployment_ids
                     and (host_id is None or value.get("hostId") == host_id)]
    endpoint_groups = set(
        endpoint.get("endpointGroupId")
        for endpoint in selected
        if isinstance(endpoint.get("endpointGroupId"), str)
    )
    deployments = topology.get("serviceDeployments", {}) if isinstance(topology, dict) else {}
    provider_addresses = []
    if policy["includeEndpointVip"]:
        for deployment_id in sorted(deployments):
            deployment = deployments[deployment_id]
            if not isinstance(deployment, dict) or deployment.get("endpointGroupRef") not in endpoint_groups:
                continue
            virtual_addresses = deployment.get("virtualAddresses", [])
            if isinstance(virtual_addresses, list):
                provider_addresses.extend(
                    address.get("address") for address in virtual_addresses
                    if isinstance(address, dict) and _looks_like_ip(address.get("address"))
                )
    return {
        "dnsNames": _string_list(name for endpoint in selected + selected_host for name in endpoint.get("sanDnsNames", [])) if policy["includeEndpointFqdns"] else [],
        "wildcardDnsNames": _string_list(name for endpoint in selected + selected_host for name in endpoint.get("wildcardDnsNames", [])) if policy["includeEndpointWildcard"] else [],
        "ipAddresses": _string_list(provider_addresses),
    }


def resolve_certificate_requests(project_id, topology, host_vars, defaults=None, resolved_service_endpoints=None, inventory_deployments=None):
    """Purely derive certificate identity and target plans from topology bindings.

    It returns no key material or resolved secrets.  The generic `tlsProfile`
    reference is deliberately resolved from deployment/member configuration so
    services may opt in without manually creating one scope per Kafka member.
    """
    desired = topology if isinstance(topology, dict) else {}
    defaults = defaults if isinstance(defaults, dict) else {}
    missing_defaults = [key for key in REQUIRED_DEFAULT_KEYS if key not in defaults]
    if missing_defaults or not isinstance(defaults.get("sanPolicy"), dict) or not isinstance(defaults.get("subject"), dict):
        return {"status": "BLOCKED", "findings": [_finding("PKI_DEFAULTS_INVALID", "platform_pki_policy_defaults", "PKI policy defaults must be supplied by the materialization role")], "requests": [], "materializationPlans": []}
    authorities = desired.get("certificateAuthorities", {}) if isinstance(desired.get("certificateAuthorities"), dict) else {}
    profiles = desired.get("certificateProfiles", {}) if isinstance(desired.get("certificateProfiles"), dict) else {}
    tls_profiles = desired.get("tlsProfiles", {}) if isinstance(desired.get("tlsProfiles"), dict) else {}
    findings = []
    grouped = {}
    for consumer in _consumer_records(desired, inventory_deployments):
        tls_profile = tls_profiles.get(consumer["tlsProfileRef"])
        field = "serviceDeployments.%s.members.%s.configuration.tlsProfile" % (consumer["deploymentId"], consumer["memberId"])
        if not isinstance(tls_profile, dict):
            findings.append(_finding("TLS_PROFILE_NOT_FOUND", field, "TLS profile reference is not defined"))
            continue
        profile_ref = tls_profile.get("certificateProfileRef")
        profile = profiles.get(profile_ref)
        if not isinstance(profile, dict):
            findings.append(_finding("CERTIFICATE_PROFILE_NOT_FOUND", field, "TLS profile references an unknown certificate profile"))
            continue
        authority_ref = profile.get("authorityRef")
        authority = authorities.get(authority_ref)
        if not isinstance(authority, dict) or authority.get("mode") != "MANAGED":
            findings.append(_finding("CERTIFICATE_AUTHORITY_UNSUPPORTED", field, "TLS profile requires a defined MANAGED certificate authority"))
            continue
        if not consumer.get("hostId"):
            findings.append(_finding("CERTIFICATE_CONSUMER_HOST_REQUIRED", field, "TLS certificate consumer has no physical host placement"))
            continue
        scope = tls_profile.get("scope", defaults["scope"])
        if scope not in ("HOST", "MEMBER", "DEPLOYMENT"):
            findings.append(_finding("CERTIFICATE_SCOPE_INVALID", field, "TLS profile scope must be HOST, MEMBER or DEPLOYMENT"))
            continue
        grouped.setdefault(_scope_key(scope, consumer), {"scope": scope, "tlsProfile": tls_profile, "tlsProfileId": consumer["tlsProfileRef"], "profileRef": profile_ref, "authorityRef": authority_ref, "consumers": []})["consumers"].append(consumer)
    if findings:
        return {"status": "BLOCKED", "findings": findings, "requests": [], "materializationPlans": []}

    requests, plans = [], []
    for scope_id, group in sorted(grouped.items()):
        profile = _profile_defaults(profiles[group["profileRef"]], defaults)
        authority = authorities[group["authorityRef"]]
        consumers = sorted(group["consumers"], key=lambda value: (value["hostId"], value["deploymentId"], value["memberId"]))
        hosts = _string_list(value["hostId"] for value in consumers)
        identities = [_host_identity(host_id, host_vars) for host_id in hosts]
        dns_names = _string_list(name for identity in identities for name in identity["dnsNames"]) if profile["sanPolicy"]["includeHostDns"] else []
        ip_addresses = _string_list(address for identity in identities for address in identity["ipAddresses"]) if profile["sanPolicy"]["includeHostIp"] else []
        endpoint_values = _endpoint_values(desired, resolved_service_endpoints, set(value["deploymentId"] for value in consumers), profile["sanPolicy"], hosts[0] if len(hosts) == 1 else None)
        dns_names = _string_list(dns_names + endpoint_values["dnsNames"] + endpoint_values["wildcardDnsNames"])
        ip_addresses = _string_list(ip_addresses + endpoint_values["ipAddresses"])
        request = {
            "id": scope_id,
            "projectId": project_id,
            "scope": group["scope"],
            "profileId": group["profileRef"],
            "authorityId": group["authorityRef"],
            "authorityCommonName": authority.get("commonName", group["authorityRef"]),
            "authorityValidityDays": authority.get("validityDays", defaults["authorityValidityDays"]),
            "commonName": (dns_names or ip_addresses or [scope_id])[0],
            "dnsNames": dns_names,
            "ipAddresses": ip_addresses,
            "keyAlgorithm": profile["keyAlgorithm"],
            "keySize": profile["keySize"],
            "validityDays": profile["validityDays"],
            "usages": profile["usages"],
            "subject": profile["subject"],
            "consumers": consumers,
        }
        unsafe_values = [request["commonName"]] + request["dnsNames"] + request["ipAddresses"] + [request["authorityCommonName"]] + [value for value in request["subject"].values() if value]
        if not all(_safe_identity_value(value) for value in unsafe_values):
            findings.append(_finding("CERTIFICATE_IDENTITY_VALUE_INVALID", "certificateProfiles.%s" % group["profileRef"], "Certificate identity values must not contain control characters"))
            continue
        request["authorityFingerprint"] = canonical_digest({
            "authorityId": request["authorityId"],
            "commonName": request["authorityCommonName"],
            "validityDays": request["authorityValidityDays"],
            "mode": authority.get("mode"),
        })
        request["certificateRequestFingerprint"] = canonical_digest(request)
        requests.append(request)
        for host_id in hosts:
            target_root = "%s/%s/%s" % (defaults["targetRoot"].rstrip("/"), project_id, scope_id)
            plan = {
                "id": "%s--%s" % (scope_id, host_id),
                "requestId": scope_id,
                "tlsProfileId": group["tlsProfileId"],
                "authorityId": group["authorityRef"],
                "hostId": host_id,
                "targetDirectory": target_root,
                "formats": ["PEM", "PKCS12_KEYSTORE", "PKCS12_TRUSTSTORE"],
                "keyAlias": "platform-%s" % scope_id.replace("_", "-"),
                "trustAlias": "platform-ca-%s" % group["authorityRef"].replace("_", "-"),
                "storePasswordSecretRef": group["tlsProfile"].get("storePasswordSecretRef"),
            }
            plan["materializationFingerprint"] = canonical_digest({
                "requestFingerprint": request["certificateRequestFingerprint"],
                "hostId": host_id,
                "targetDirectory": target_root,
                "formats": plan["formats"],
                "keyAlias": plan["keyAlias"],
                "trustAlias": plan["trustAlias"],
            })
            plans.append(plan)
    if findings:
        return {"status": "BLOCKED", "findings": findings, "requests": [], "materializationPlans": []}
    return {"status": "PASS", "findings": [], "requests": requests, "materializationPlans": plans}

from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function

import hashlib
import os
import re

try:
    from .project_validation import canonical_digest
    from .service_integration_resolution import service_integration_relations
except ImportError:
    from project_validation import canonical_digest
    from service_integration_resolution import service_integration_relations


API_VERSION = "platform.installer/project-snapshot/v1alpha1"
GENERATED_PATH = "inventory/group_vars/all/platform-state.yml"
_SECRET_KEY = re.compile(r"password|passphrase|private.?key|token|secret", re.I)


def _logical(path):
    return path.replace("\\", "/")


def project_documents(project_root, installer_owned_paths=None):
    """Fingerprint canonical project bytes without parsing or rewriting them."""
    root = os.path.realpath(project_root)
    owned = set(_logical(item) for item in (installer_owned_paths or []))
    candidates = ["project.yml", "ansible.cfg", "inventory/hosts.yml"]
    try:
        from .application_libraries import package_inputs
    except ImportError:
        from application_libraries import package_inputs
    candidates.extend(package_inputs(root))
    for directory in ("inventory/group_vars", "inventory/host_vars"):
        absolute = os.path.join(root, directory.replace("/", os.sep))
        if not os.path.isdir(absolute):
            continue
        for current, dirs, files in os.walk(absolute):
            if any(os.path.islink(os.path.join(current, item)) for item in dirs):
                raise ValueError("Canonical project variable directories must not contain symlinks")
            dirs[:] = sorted(item for item in dirs if not os.path.islink(os.path.join(current, item)))
            for name in sorted(files):
                if os.path.splitext(name)[1].lower() in (".yml", ".yaml", ".json"):
                    candidates.append(_logical(os.path.relpath(os.path.join(current, name), root)))
    documents = []
    revision_parts = []
    for logical_path in sorted(set(candidates)):
        absolute = os.path.join(root, logical_path.replace("/", os.sep))
        if os.path.islink(absolute):
            raise ValueError("Canonical project documents must not be symlinks")
        if not os.path.isfile(absolute):
            continue
        with open(absolute, "rb") as stream:
            content = stream.read()
        generated = logical_path == GENERATED_PATH
        digest = "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()
        documents.append({
            "logicalPath": logical_path,
            "digest": digest,
            "ownership": "GENERATED_READ_ONLY" if generated else (
                "INSTALLER_OWNED" if logical_path in owned else "USER_OWNED_READ_ONLY"
            ),
            "revisionIncluded": not generated,
        })
        if not generated:
            revision_parts.append(logical_path.encode("utf-8") + b"\0" + digest.encode("ascii") + b"\0")
    revision = "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(b"".join(revision_parts)).hexdigest()
    return documents, revision


def redact(value, key=None):
    """Defence-in-depth redaction for every value crossing the query boundary."""
    if key and _SECRET_KEY.search(str(key)) and not str(key).lower().endswith(("secretref", "credentialref")):
        return "[REDACTED]"
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {item: redact(value[item], item) for item in sorted(value)}
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [redact(item) for item in value]
    return value


def _catalog_view(catalog):
    definitions = catalog.get("definitions", {}) if isinstance(catalog, dict) else {}
    result = {}
    for service_type, definition in sorted(definitions.items()):
        if not isinstance(definition, dict):
            continue
        if definition.get("x-conformanceOnly") is True:
            continue
        metadata = definition.get("metadata", {}) if isinstance(definition, dict) else {}
        result[service_type] = {
            "definitionVersion": metadata.get("version"),
            "displayName": metadata.get("displayName", service_type),
            "description": metadata.get("description"),
            "modes": sorted((definition.get("modes") or {}).keys()),
            "topology": definition.get("modes", {}),
            "capabilities": sorted(definition.get("capabilities") or []),
            "configuration": definition.get("configuration", {}),
            "endpoint": definition.get("endpoint"),
            "endpointProvider": definition.get("endpointProvider"),
            "compatibilityRef": definition.get("compatibilityRef"),
            "definitionDigest": definition.get("x-definitionDigest"),
        }
    return result


def _configuration_view(configuration, desired_state_path, role_default_paths, ownership):
    result = redact(configuration)
    for deployment_id, service in result.get("services", {}).items():
        service_type = service.get("serviceType")
        for setting_name, setting in service.get("configuration", {}).items():
            source = setting.get("source") if isinstance(setting, dict) else None
            logical_path = "serviceDeployments.%s.configuration.%s" % (deployment_id, setting_name)
            if source == "ROLE_DEFAULT":
                setting["physicalOrigin"] = {"kind": "ROLE_DEFAULT", "logicalPath": role_default_paths.get(service_type)}
                setting["editPolicy"] = "OVERRIDE"
                setting["semanticSource"] = "ROLE_DEFAULT"
                setting["logicalPath"] = logical_path
                if desired_state_path:
                    setting["overrideTarget"] = {"intendedDocument": desired_state_path, "logicalPath": logical_path}
            elif source == "DEPLOYMENT_OVERRIDE":
                setting["physicalOrigin"] = ({"kind": "GROUP_VARS", "logicalPath": desired_state_path}
                                             if desired_state_path else {"kind": "UNKNOWN"})
                setting["editPolicy"] = ("FUTURE_EDITABLE" if ownership.get(desired_state_path) == "INSTALLER_OWNED"
                                         else "READ_ONLY_UNRESOLVED" if not desired_state_path else "READ_ONLY")
                setting["semanticSource"] = "USER_PROJECT_VALUE"
                setting["logicalPath"] = logical_path
            else:
                setting.setdefault("editPolicy", "READ_ONLY_UNRESOLVED")
                setting.setdefault("semanticSource", source or "DERIVED")
                setting.setdefault("physicalOrigin", {"kind": "UNKNOWN"})
        for member in service.get("members", {}).values():
            for setting in member.get("configuration", {}).values():
                if isinstance(setting, dict) and setting.get("source") == "MEMBER_OVERRIDE":
                    setting["physicalOrigin"] = {"kind": "INVENTORY", "logicalPath": "inventory/hosts.yml"}
                    setting["editPolicy"] = "READ_ONLY"
                    setting["semanticSource"] = "USER_PROJECT_VALUE"
    return result


def _integration_view(desired_state, catalog, endpoint_result, haproxy_result, dns_result, hosts):
    deployments = desired_state.get("serviceDeployments", {}) if isinstance(desired_state, dict) else {}
    definitions = catalog.get("definitions", {}) if isinstance(catalog, dict) else {}
    providers = {}
    for deployment_id, deployment in sorted(deployments.items()):
        definition = definitions.get(deployment.get("serviceType"), {}) if isinstance(deployment, dict) else {}
        group_id = deployment.get("endpointGroupRef") if isinstance(deployment, dict) else None
        if group_id and isinstance(definition.get("endpointProvider"), dict):
            providers.setdefault(group_id, []).append({
                "deploymentId": deployment_id,
                "virtualAddresses": deployment.get("virtualAddresses", []),
                "status": "STATIC_VALID",
            })
    relations = service_integration_relations(desired_state, set(
        item.get("serviceType") for item in deployments.values() if isinstance(item, dict)
    ), inventory_deployments={host: value.get("platformDeployments", {}) for host, value in hosts.items()})
    for relation in relations:
        relation["endpoint"] = endpoint_result.get("endpoints", {}).get(relation["sourceDeploymentId"])
        relation["addressProviders"] = providers.get(relation.get("endpointGroupId"), [])
    return {
        "relations": relations,
        "addressProvidersByEndpointGroup": providers,
        "haproxyBackends": haproxy_result.get("backends", {}),
        "dnsZones": dns_result.get("zones", {}),
    }


def build_project_snapshot(project_id, project_name, documents, project_revision, catalog,
                           hosts, desired_state, topology_result, configuration_result,
                           endpoint_result, pki_result, haproxy_result,
                           dns_result, desired_state_path, role_default_paths, core_version="0.1.0", identity_source="PROJECT_MANIFEST", references=None):
    ownership = {item["logicalPath"]: item["ownership"] for item in documents}
    results = (topology_result, configuration_result, endpoint_result, pki_result, haproxy_result, dns_result)
    findings = []
    for item in results:
        findings.extend(item.get("findings", []) if isinstance(item, dict) else [])
    unique = {}
    for finding in findings:
        key = (finding.get("field", ""), finding.get("code", ""), finding.get("safeMessage", ""))
        unique[key] = finding
    findings = [unique[key] for key in sorted(unique)]
    blocked = bool(findings)
    topology = topology_result.get("resolvedTopology") if topology_result.get("status") == "PASS" else None
    configuration = _configuration_view(configuration_result, desired_state_path, role_default_paths, ownership)
    requests = pki_result.get("requests", []) if pki_result.get("status") == "PASS" else []
    identities = [{key: item[key] for key in (
        "id", "scope", "tlsProfileId", "dnsNames", "ipAddresses", "consumers",
        "certificateRequestFingerprint") if key in item} for item in requests]
    deployments = desired_state.get("serviceDeployments", {}) if isinstance(desired_state, dict) else {}
    readiness = {}
    for deployment_id in sorted(deployments):
        affected = any(deployment_id in finding.get("field", "") for finding in findings)
        readiness[deployment_id] = {
            "status": "BLOCKED" if affected else "REQUIRES_PREPARATION",
            "runtime": "NOT_CHECKED",
        }
    validation = {
        "apiVersion": "platform.installer/validation-result/v1alpha1",
        "kind": "ValidationResult",
        "status": "BLOCKED" if blocked else "PASS",
        "summary": {"blocked": len(findings), "pass": 0 if blocked else 1},
        "findings": findings,
    }
    snapshot = {
        "apiVersion": API_VERSION,
        "kind": "ProjectSnapshot",
        "status": "PARTIAL" if blocked else "PASS",
        "partial": blocked,
        "project": {"id": project_id, "name": project_name, "identitySource": identity_source},
        "projectRevision": project_revision,
        "catalogRevision": catalog.get("digest"),
        "coreVersion": core_version,
        "documents": documents,
        "hosts": {key: hosts[key] for key in sorted(hosts)},
        "references": redact(references if isinstance(references, dict) else {"hosts": {}}),
        "serviceCatalog": _catalog_view(catalog),
        "serviceDeployments": redact(deployments),
        "effectiveConfiguration": configuration,
        "endpointGroups": redact(desired_state.get("endpointGroups", {})),
        "topology": {"resolved": topology, "placementsByHost": {
            host_id: hosts[host_id].get("platformDeployments", {}) for host_id in sorted(hosts)
        }} if topology is not None else None,
        "endpoints": redact({
            "deployments": endpoint_result.get("endpoints", {}),
            "hosts": endpoint_result.get("hostEndpoints", {}),
        }),
        "integrations": redact(_integration_view(
            desired_state, catalog, endpoint_result, haproxy_result, dns_result, hosts,
        )),
        "pki": {"status": pki_result.get("status"), "certificateIdentities": redact(identities)},
        "validation": validation,
        "readiness": {"status": "BLOCKED" if blocked else "REQUIRES_PREPARATION", "services": readiness},
        "findings": findings,
    }
    snapshot["snapshotFingerprint"] = canonical_digest(snapshot)
    return redact(snapshot)

def finding(code, field, message, status="BLOCKED"):
    return {
        "apiVersion": "platform.installer/finding/v1alpha1",
        "kind": "Finding",
        "code": code,
        "status": status,
        "category": "project-state",
        "field": field,
        "safeMessage": message,
    }


def select_desired_state(manifest, legacy_topology, ansible_desired_state=None):
    """Choose Ansible-native desired state with bounded project compatibility."""
    manifest = manifest if isinstance(manifest, dict) else {}
    legacy = legacy_topology if isinstance(legacy_topology, dict) else {}
    native = ansible_desired_state if isinstance(ansible_desired_state, dict) else {}
    current = manifest.get("desiredState")
    has_current = isinstance(current, dict)
    has_legacy = bool(legacy)
    has_native = bool(native)
    findings = []
    if has_native:
        compatibility = []
        if has_current:
            compatibility.append(("project.yml desiredState", current))
        if has_legacy:
            compatibility.append(("platform_project", legacy))
        if any(canonical_digest(candidate) != canonical_digest(native) for _, candidate in compatibility):
            findings.append(finding(
                "ANSIBLE_DESIRED_STATE_CONFLICT", "platform_desired_state",
                "Ansible-native desired state differs from a compatibility desired-state source",
            ))
        elif compatibility:
            findings.append(finding(
                "ANSIBLE_DESIRED_STATE_COMPATIBILITY_DEPRECATED", "platform_desired_state",
                "Ansible-native desired state duplicates deprecated compatibility input: %s" %
                ", ".join(source for source, _ in compatibility), "DEPRECATED",
            ))
        return native, findings
    if has_current and has_legacy:
        if canonical_digest(current) != canonical_digest(legacy):
            findings.append(finding(
                "DESIRED_STATE_LEGACY_CONFLICT", "desiredState",
                "project.yml desiredState and legacy platform_project differ",
            ))
        else:
            findings.append(finding(
                "LEGACY_PLATFORM_PROJECT_DEPRECATED", "platform_project",
                "Legacy platform_project duplicates project.yml desiredState", "DEPRECATED",
            ))
        return current, findings
    if has_current:
        return current, findings
    if has_legacy:
        findings.append(finding(
            "LEGACY_PLATFORM_PROJECT_DEPRECATED", "platform_project",
            "Legacy platform_project is a compatibility input; migrate to project.yml desiredState",
            "DEPRECATED",
        ))
        return legacy, findings
    return {}, findings


def synthesize_ansible_manifest(desired_state, service_catalog, project_id="ansible-project"):
    """Build an ephemeral validation manifest; it is never persisted as desired state."""
    desired_state = desired_state if isinstance(desired_state, dict) else {}
    service_catalog = service_catalog if isinstance(service_catalog, dict) else {}
    definitions = service_catalog.get("definitions", {}) if isinstance(service_catalog.get("definitions"), dict) else {}
    deployments = desired_state.get("serviceDeployments", {}) if isinstance(desired_state.get("serviceDeployments"), dict) else {}
    used = sorted(set(
        item.get("serviceType") for item in deployments.values()
        if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("serviceType")
    ))
    services = {}
    for service_type in used:
        definition = definitions.get(service_type, {})
        metadata = definition.get("metadata", {}) if isinstance(definition, dict) else {}
        services[service_type] = {
            "definitionVersion": metadata.get("version", "unknown"),
            "digest": definition.get("x-definitionDigest", "sha256:" + ("0" * 64)),
        }
    return {
        "apiVersion": "platform.installer/v2alpha1",
        "kind": "PlatformProject",
        "metadata": {"id": project_id or "ansible-project"},
        "desiredStateContract": "platform.installer/project-desired-state/v2alpha1",
        "catalogLock": {
            "apiVersion": "platform.installer/catalog/v1alpha1",
            "digest": service_catalog.get("digest", "sha256:" + ("0" * 64)),
            "services": services,
        },
        "artifactLock": {
            "apiVersion": "platform.installer/artifacts/v1alpha1",
            "digest": "sha256:" + ("0" * 64),
        },
    }


def canonical_placements(placement_by_host, inventory_hosts):
    """Canonicalize inventory host-level platform_members without Ansible precedence."""
    inventory_set = set(inventory_hosts or [])
    source = placement_by_host if isinstance(placement_by_host, dict) else {}
    result, findings = {}, []
    for host_id in sorted(source):
        deployments = source[host_id]
        if host_id not in inventory_set:
            findings.append(finding("PLACEMENT_HOST_NOT_TARGET", "platform_members.%s" % host_id,
                                    "Placement host is not a platform target"))
            continue
        if not isinstance(deployments, dict):
            findings.append(finding("PLACEMENT_ENTRY_INVALID", "platform_members.%s" % host_id,
                                    "Host platform_members must be a deployment map"))
            continue
        for deployment_id in sorted(deployments):
            members = deployments[deployment_id]
            if not isinstance(members, list):
                findings.append(finding("PLACEMENT_ENTRY_INVALID", "platform_members.%s.%s" % (host_id, deployment_id),
                                        "Deployment placement must be a member list"))
                continue
            for member_id in members:
                key = (deployment_id, member_id)
                if key in result:
                    findings.append(finding("PLACEMENT_ENTRY_DUPLICATE", "platform_members.%s.%s" % (host_id, deployment_id),
                                            "A member may be placed only once"))
                result[key] = host_id
    return result, findings


def canonical_inventory_members(deployments_by_host, inventory_hosts):
    """Normalize reserved host.platform_deployments into canonical members."""
    inventory_set = set(inventory_hosts or [])
    source = deployments_by_host if isinstance(deployments_by_host, dict) else {}
    result, findings = {}, []
    for host_id in sorted(source):
        deployments = source[host_id]
        field_prefix = "platform_deployments.%s" % host_id
        if host_id not in inventory_set:
            findings.append(finding("MEMBER_HOST_NOT_TARGET", field_prefix,
                                    "Host with platform_deployments is not a platform target"))
            continue
        if not isinstance(deployments, dict):
            findings.append(finding("INVENTORY_DEPLOYMENTS_INVALID", field_prefix,
                                    "platform_deployments must be a deployment map"))
            continue
        for deployment_id in sorted(deployments):
            deployment = deployments[deployment_id]
            if not isinstance(deployment, dict):
                findings.append(finding("INVENTORY_DEPLOYMENT_INVALID", "%s.%s" % (field_prefix, deployment_id),
                                        "Inventory deployment must be an object"))
                continue
            # A deployment without members is a host-scoped placement.  Its
            # service manifest decides whether that shape is valid; preserving
            # it here avoids inventing logical member ids for host-native roles.
            if "members" not in deployment:
                continue
            members = deployment.get("members")
            member_prefix = "%s.%s.members" % (field_prefix, deployment_id)
            if not isinstance(members, dict):
                findings.append(finding("INVENTORY_MEMBERS_INVALID", member_prefix,
                                        "Deployment members must be an object keyed by member id"))
                continue
            for member_id in sorted(members):
                member = members[member_id]
                key = (deployment_id, member_id)
                if key in result:
                    findings.append(finding("INVENTORY_MEMBER_DUPLICATE", member_prefix,
                                            "A member may be owned by only one inventory host"))
                    continue
                if not isinstance(member, dict):
                    findings.append(finding("INVENTORY_MEMBER_INVALID", "%s.%s" % (member_prefix, member_id),
                                            "Inventory member must be an object"))
                    continue
                result[key] = {
                    "host": host_id,
                    "roles": member.get("roles", []),
                    "configuration": member.get("configuration", {}),
                    "identity": member.get("identity", {}),
                }
    return result, findings


def topology_with_inventory_members(desired_state, inventory_members):
    """Compose the ephemeral resolver view; persistent project state stays member-free."""
    desired_state = desired_state if isinstance(desired_state, dict) else {}
    deployments = desired_state.get("serviceDeployments", {})
    result = dict(desired_state)
    result_deployments = {}
    for deployment_id, deployment in (deployments.items() if isinstance(deployments, dict) else []):
        copied = dict(deployment) if isinstance(deployment, dict) else deployment
        if isinstance(copied, dict):
            copied["members"] = {
                member_id: dict(member)
                for (candidate_deployment, member_id), member in sorted(inventory_members.items())
                if candidate_deployment == deployment_id
            }
        result_deployments[deployment_id] = copied
    result["serviceDeployments"] = result_deployments
    return result

from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function

__metaclass__ = type

import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import tempfile
from difflib import get_close_matches


RESULT_API_VERSION = "platform.installer/validation-result/v1alpha1"
SUPPORTED_PROJECT_API_VERSION = "platform.installer/v2alpha1"
DIGEST_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$")
SECRET_KEY_TERMS = ("password", "passphrase", "privatekey", "token", "secret")
IDENTIFIER_MAP_FIELDS = {
    "serviceDeployments",
    "members",
    "dependencies",
    "endpointGroups",
    "certificateAuthorities",
    "certificateProfiles",
    "tlsProfiles",
    "certificateScopes",
    "secretRequirements",
