API_VERSION = "platform.installer/resolved-service-configuration/v1alpha1"
JINJA_MARKER = re.compile(r"{{|}}|{%|%}|{#|#}")


def _finding(code, field, message, details=None):
    finding = {
        "apiVersion": "platform.installer/finding/v1alpha1",
        "kind": "Finding",
        "code": code,
        "status": "BLOCKED",
        "category": "service-configuration-resolution",
        "field": field,
        "safeMessage": message,
    }
    if details:
        finding["safeDetails"] = details
    return finding


def _literal(value):
    return not (isinstance(value, str) and JINJA_MARKER.search(value))


def _canonical_mapping(mapping):
    return {
        key: mapping[key]
        for key in sorted(mapping)
        if isinstance(key, str)
    }


def _canonical_defaults(role_defaults, mapping):
    return {
        logical: role_defaults.get(entry.get("roleVariable"))
        for logical, entry in sorted(mapping.items())
        if isinstance(entry, dict) and entry.get("roleVariable") in role_defaults
    }


def _merge_mapping_defaults(default_value, override_value):
    """Match Ansible's configured hash merge for one resolved object setting."""
    if not isinstance(default_value, dict) or not isinstance(override_value, dict):
        return override_value
    result = {key: copy.deepcopy(value) for key, value in default_value.items()}
    for key, value in override_value.items():
        result[key] = _merge_mapping_defaults(result[key], value) if key in result else copy.deepcopy(value)
    return result


_EXACT_REFERENCE = re.compile(r"^{{\s*([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*(?:\.[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)?)\s*}}$")


def _exact_reference(value):
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        return None
    match = _EXACT_REFERENCE.match(value)
    return match.group(1) if match else None


def _mapping_scopes(entry):
    if not isinstance(entry, dict):
        return []
    scopes = entry.get("scopes", ["deployment"])
    return scopes if isinstance(scopes, list) else []


def _value(state, source, **extra):
    result = {"state": state, "source": source}
    result.update(extra)
    return result


_SECRET_TERMS = ("password", "passphrase", "privatekey", "token", "secret")


def _opaque_variable(name, value, source, path, **identity):
    entry = {
        "state": "OPAQUE",
        "name": name,
        "origin": dict({"source": source, "path": path}, **identity),
    }
    normalized = name.lower().replace("_", "").replace("-", "") if isinstance(name, str) else ""
    if any(term in normalized for term in _SECRET_TERMS):
        entry["redacted"] = True
    elif _literal(value):
        entry["value"] = value
    else:
        entry["expression"] = value
    return entry


def _logical_path(path):
    if not isinstance(path, str) or not path:
        return None
    normalized = posixpath.normpath(path.replace("\\", "/"))
    if normalized in (".", "") or normalized.startswith("/") or normalized.startswith("../") or re.match(r"^[A-Za-z]:", normalized):
        return None
    return normalized


def _service_definition_digest(definition):
    if not isinstance(definition, dict):
        return None
    return definition.get("x-definitionDigest")


def _matches_type(value, expected):
    if expected == "integer":
        return isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool)
    if expected == "number":
        return isinstance(value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(value, bool)
    if expected == "object":
        return isinstance(value, dict)
    if expected == "array":
        return isinstance(value, list)
    if expected == "string":
        return isinstance(value, str)
    if expected == "boolean":
        return isinstance(value, bool)
    if expected == "null":
        return value is None
    return True


def _validate_override(logical, value, schema, field):
    """Validate the simple configuration-schema vocabulary used by CORE-03.

    The published offline Draft 2020-12 engine remains the authoritative
    schema validator. This small preflight only creates resolver findings for
    the direct property/type/range contract and never evaluates expressions.
    """
    findings = []
    if not isinstance(schema, dict):
        return findings
    properties = schema.get("properties", {})
    if schema.get("additionalProperties") is False and logical not in properties:
        findings.append(_finding(
            "SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_PROPERTY_UNKNOWN",
            "%s.%s" % (field, logical),
            "Configuration property is not declared by the service schema",
        ))
        return findings
    if isinstance(value, str) and JINJA_MARKER.search(value):
        return findings
    definition = properties.get(logical, {}) if isinstance(properties, dict) else {}
    expected = definition.get("type") if isinstance(definition, dict) else None
    expected_types = expected if isinstance(expected, list) else [expected]
    if expected and not any(_matches_type(value, item) for item in expected_types):
        findings.append(_finding(
            "SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_TYPE_INVALID",
            "%s.%s" % (field, logical),
            "Configuration property does not match the service schema type",
            {"expected": expected_types},
        ))
        return findings
    if isinstance(definition, dict) and "enum" in definition and value not in definition["enum"]:
        findings.append(_finding(
            "SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_ENUM_INVALID",
            "%s.%s" % (field, logical),
            "Configuration property is not one of the values allowed by the service schema",
        ))
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(value, bool):
        for keyword, code, message in (
            ("minimum", "SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_MINIMUM_INVALID", "Configuration property is below the service schema minimum"),
            ("maximum", "SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_MAXIMUM_INVALID", "Configuration property is above the service schema maximum"),
        ):
            limit = definition.get(keyword) if isinstance(definition, dict) else None
            if limit is not None and ((keyword == "minimum" and value < limit) or (keyword == "maximum" and value > limit)):
                findings.append(_finding(code, "%s.%s" % (field, logical), message))
    if isinstance(value, str) and isinstance(definition, dict) and len(value) < definition.get("minLength", 0):
        findings.append(_finding(
            "SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_MIN_LENGTH_INVALID",
            "%s.%s" % (field, logical),
            "Configuration string is shorter than the service schema minimum",
        ))
    return findings


def resolve_service_configuration(
    resolved_topology, topology, service_catalog, role_defaults, configuration_schemas=None,
    host_contexts=None, variable_documents=None,
):
    """Resolve static deployment/member configuration without being Ansible.

    This deliberately implements only exact variable references. It does not
    evaluate filters, facts, lookups, expressions or host vars. The resulting
    member projections are keyed by deployment/member identity, not by host.
    """
    resolved_topology = resolved_topology if isinstance(resolved_topology, dict) else {}
    topology = topology if isinstance(topology, dict) else {}
    service_catalog = service_catalog if isinstance(service_catalog, dict) else {}
    role_defaults = role_defaults if isinstance(role_defaults, dict) else {}
    configuration_schemas = configuration_schemas if isinstance(configuration_schemas, dict) else {}
    host_contexts = host_contexts if isinstance(host_contexts, dict) else {}
    variable_documents = variable_documents if isinstance(variable_documents, list) else []
    definitions = service_catalog.get("definitions", service_catalog)
    desired_deployments = topology.get("serviceDeployments", {})
    resolved_deployments = resolved_topology.get("resolvedTopology", {}).get("serviceDeployments", {})
    services = {}
    findings = []
    opaque_host_variables = []
    for host_id in sorted(host_contexts):
        values = host_contexts[host_id]
        if not isinstance(values, dict):
            continue
        for name, value in sorted(values.items()):
            opaque_host_variables.append(_opaque_variable(
                name,
                value,
                "HOST_CONTEXT",
                "inventory/host_vars/%s.yml" % host_id,
            ))
    for document in variable_documents:
        if not isinstance(document, dict) or document.get("kind") != "HOST_VARS":
            continue
        variables = document.get("variables")
        path = _logical_path(document.get("logicalPath"))
        host_id = document.get("hostId")
        if not isinstance(variables, dict) or not isinstance(path, str) or not path or not isinstance(host_id, str) or not host_id:
            findings.append(_finding(
                "VARIABLE_DOCUMENT_ORIGIN_INVALID",
                "variableDocuments",
                "HOST_VARS documents require variables, logicalPath and hostId",
            ))
            continue
        for name, value in sorted(variables.items()):
            opaque_host_variables.append(_opaque_variable(
                name, value, "HOST_VARS", path, hostId=host_id,
            ))
    for document in variable_documents:
        if not isinstance(document, dict) or document.get("kind") != "GROUP_VARS":
            continue
        if document.get("deploymentId") and document.get("serviceType"):
            continue
        variables = document.get("variables")
        path = _logical_path(document.get("logicalPath"))
        group_id = document.get("groupId")
        if not isinstance(variables, dict) or not isinstance(path, str) or not path or not isinstance(group_id, str) or not group_id:
            findings.append(_finding(
                "VARIABLE_DOCUMENT_ORIGIN_INVALID",
                "variableDocuments",
                "Unbound GROUP_VARS documents require variables, logicalPath and groupId",
            ))
            continue
        for name, value in sorted(variables.items()):
            opaque_host_variables.append(_opaque_variable(
                name, value, "GROUP_VARS", path, groupId=group_id,
            ))

    for deployment_id in sorted(resolved_deployments):
        resolved = resolved_deployments[deployment_id]
        desired = desired_deployments.get(deployment_id, {})
        service_type = resolved.get("serviceType")
        definition = definitions.get(service_type, {}) if isinstance(definitions, dict) else {}
        metadata = definition.get("metadata", {}) if isinstance(definition, dict) else {}
        service_definition_version = resolved.get("definitionVersion") or (
            metadata.get("version") if isinstance(metadata, dict) else None
        )
        mapping, contract_issues, contract_form = canonical_settings(definition)
        contract_issues.extend(validate_settings(mapping) if contract_form == "canonical" else [])
        defaults = role_defaults.get(service_type, {})
        field_prefix = "serviceDeployments.%s.configuration" % deployment_id

        for issue in contract_issues:
            findings.append(_finding(
                issue["code"],
                "catalog.definitions.%s.%s" % (service_type, issue["path"]),
                issue["message"],
            ))
        if not isinstance(mapping, dict) or not mapping:
            findings.append(_finding(
                "SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_MAPPING_REQUIRED",
                "catalog.definitions.%s.configurationMapping" % service_type,
                "Service package must declare a logical configuration mapping",
                {"serviceType": service_type},
            ))
            mapping = {}
        if not isinstance(defaults, dict):
            findings.append(_finding(
                "ROLE_DEFAULTS_INVALID",
                "catalog.definitions.%s.roleDefaults" % service_type,
                "Loaded role defaults must be an object",
                {"serviceType": service_type},
            ))
            defaults = {}

        overrides = desired.get("configuration", {}) if isinstance(desired, dict) else {}
        if not isinstance(overrides, dict):
            findings.append(_finding(
                "SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_INVALID",
                field_prefix,
                "Deployment configuration override must be an object",
            ))
            overrides = {}
        members = desired.get("members", {}) if isinstance(desired, dict) else {}
        members = members if isinstance(members, dict) else {}

        document_overrides = {}
        document_origins = {}
        document_opaque_variables = []
        role_to_logical = {
            entry.get("roleVariable"): logical
            for logical, entry in mapping.items()
            if isinstance(entry, dict) and entry.get("roleVariable")
        }
        for document in variable_documents:
            if not isinstance(document, dict):
                continue
            if document.get("deploymentId") != deployment_id or document.get("serviceType") != service_type:
                continue
            if document.get("kind") != "GROUP_VARS":
                continue
            if not isinstance(document.get("variables"), dict):
                findings.append(_finding(
                    "VARIABLE_DOCUMENT_BINDING_INVALID",
                    "variableDocuments",
                    "Managed Ansible variable documents require GROUP_VARS and an object variables payload",
                    {"deploymentId": deployment_id, "serviceType": service_type},
                ))
                continue
            path = _logical_path(document.get("logicalPath"))
            group_id = document.get("groupId")
            if not isinstance(path, str) or not path or not isinstance(group_id, str) or not group_id:
                findings.append(_finding(
                    "VARIABLE_DOCUMENT_ORIGIN_INVALID",
                    "variableDocuments",
                    "Managed Ansible variable documents require logicalPath and groupId",
                ))
                continue
            for name, value in sorted(document["variables"].items()):
                logical = role_to_logical.get(name)
                if logical is None:
                    document_opaque_variables.append(_opaque_variable(
                        name, value, "GROUP_VARS", path, groupId=group_id,
                    ))
                    continue
                if logical in document_overrides or logical in overrides:
                    findings.append(_finding(
                        "MANAGED_VARIABLE_SOURCE_CONFLICT",
                        "%s.%s" % (field_prefix, logical),
                        "A managed setting may have one explicit deployment override source",
                        {"setting": logical},
                    ))
                    continue
                document_overrides[logical] = value
                document_origins[logical] = {
                    "kind": "GROUP_VARS", "logicalPath": path, "groupId": group_id,
                }

        for logical in sorted(mapping):
            entry = mapping.get(logical)
            if not isinstance(entry, dict) or not entry.get("roleVariable"):
                findings.append(_finding(
                    "SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_MAPPING_INVALID",
                    "catalog.definitions.%s.configurationMapping.%s" % (service_type, logical),
                    "Logical configuration property must map to one role variable",
                ))
        schema = configuration_schemas.get(service_type)
        configuration_is_closed = isinstance(schema, dict) and schema.get("additionalProperties") is False
        if configuration_is_closed:
            for logical in sorted(set(overrides).difference(mapping)):
                findings.append(_finding(
                    "SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_PROPERTY_UNKNOWN",
                    "%s.%s" % (field_prefix, logical),
                    "Configuration property is not declared by the service schema",
                ))
        mapped_role_variables = {
            entry.get("roleVariable")
            for entry in mapping.values()
            if isinstance(entry, dict) and entry.get("roleVariable")
        }
        opaque_variables = [
            _opaque_variable(
                role_variable,
                defaults[role_variable],
                "ROLE_DEFAULT",
                "roles/%s/defaults/main.yml" % service_type,
            )
            for role_variable in sorted(defaults)
            if role_variable not in mapped_role_variables
        ]
        opaque_variables.extend(
            _opaque_variable(
                logical,
                value,
                "DEPLOYMENT_CONFIGURATION",
                "%s.%s" % (field_prefix, logical),
            )
            for logical, value in sorted(overrides.items())
            if logical not in mapping and not configuration_is_closed
        )
        opaque_variables.extend(document_opaque_variables)

        def resolve_scope(scope_member=None):
            scope_name = "member" if scope_member is not None else "deployment"
            scope_field_prefix = field_prefix if scope_member is None else "serviceDeployments.%s.members.%s.configuration" % (deployment_id, scope_member.get("id", ""))
            member_overrides = scope_member.get("configuration", {}) if isinstance(scope_member, dict) else {}
            member_overrides = member_overrides if isinstance(member_overrides, dict) else {}
            values = {}
            visiting = []

            def source_for(logical):
                entry = mapping.get(logical)
                if not isinstance(entry, dict) or not entry.get("roleVariable"):
                    return None
                role_variable = entry["roleVariable"]
                default_value = defaults.get(role_variable)
                if scope_name == "member" and logical in member_overrides and "member" in _mapping_scopes(entry):
                    return "MEMBER_OVERRIDE", _merge_mapping_defaults(default_value, member_overrides[logical]), None
                if logical in overrides:
                    return "DEPLOYMENT_OVERRIDE", _merge_mapping_defaults(default_value, overrides[logical]), None
                if logical in document_overrides:
                    return "DEPLOYMENT_OVERRIDE", _merge_mapping_defaults(default_value, document_overrides[logical]), document_origins[logical]
                if role_variable in defaults:
                    return "ROLE_DEFAULT", defaults[role_variable], None
                return None

            def resolve_variable(name):
                if name in mapping:
                    return resolve_setting(name)
                for logical, entry in mapping.items():
                    if isinstance(entry, dict) and entry.get("roleVariable") == name:
                        return resolve_setting(logical)
                if name in defaults:
                    return resolve_raw(name, defaults[name])
                if "." in name:
                    namespace, key = name.split(".", 1)
                    candidate = defaults.get(namespace)
                    if isinstance(candidate, dict) and key in candidate:
                        return resolve_raw(name, candidate[key])
                return {"state": "UNRESOLVED", "reason": "STATIC_REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND", "source": "STATIC_REFERENCE", "reference": name}

            def resolve_raw(name, raw):
                if name in visiting:
                    return {"state": "CYCLIC", "reason": "STATIC_REFERENCE_CYCLE", "source": "STATIC_REFERENCE", "reference": name}
                reference = _exact_reference(raw)
                if reference:
                    visiting.append(name)
                    resolved = resolve_variable(reference)
                    visiting.pop()
                    if resolved.get("state") == "RESOLVED":
                        return _value("RESOLVED", "STATIC_REFERENCE", value=resolved["value"], reference=reference)
                    return dict(resolved, source="STATIC_REFERENCE", reference=reference)
                if _literal(raw):
                    return {"state": "RESOLVED", "value": raw}
                return {"state": "DEFERRED", "reason": "NON_LITERAL_CONFIGURATION", "source": "RUNTIME_DEFERRED", "expression": raw}

            def resolve_setting(logical):
                if logical in values:
                    return values[logical]
                if logical in visiting:
                    return {"state": "CYCLIC", "reason": "STATIC_REFERENCE_CYCLE", "source": "STATIC_REFERENCE", "reference": logical}
                entry = mapping.get(logical)
                if not isinstance(entry, dict) or not entry.get("roleVariable"):
                    return None
                source = source_for(logical)
                if source is None:
                    if contract_form == "canonical":
                        return None
                    findings.append(_finding(
                        "ROLE_DEFAULT_NOT_DECLARED",
                        "%s.%s" % (scope_field_prefix, logical),
                        "Mapped logical configuration has no corresponding role default",
                        {"roleVariable": entry["roleVariable"]},
                    ))
                    return None
                source_name, raw, physical_origin = source
                reference = _exact_reference(raw)
                if reference:
                    visiting.append(logical)
                    resolved = resolve_variable(reference)
                    visiting.pop()
                    if resolved.get("state") == "RESOLVED":
                        result = _value("RESOLVED", "STATIC_REFERENCE", value=resolved["value"], reference=reference, origin=source_name)
                        if physical_origin:
                            result["physicalOrigin"] = physical_origin
                    else:
                        result = dict(resolved, source="STATIC_REFERENCE", reference=reference)
                elif _literal(raw):
                    result = _value("RESOLVED", source_name, value=raw)
                    if physical_origin:
                        result["physicalOrigin"] = physical_origin
                else:
                    result = {
                        "state": "DEFERRED",
                        "reason": "NON_LITERAL_ROLE_DEFAULT" if source_name == "ROLE_DEFAULT" else "NON_LITERAL_CONFIGURATION",
                        "source": "RUNTIME_DEFERRED",
                        "expression": raw,
                    }
                    if physical_origin:
                        result["physicalOrigin"] = physical_origin
                values[logical] = result
                if result.get("state") in ("UNRESOLVED", "CYCLIC"):
                    findings.append(_finding(
                        "STATIC_REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND" if result["state"] == "UNRESOLVED" else "STATIC_REFERENCE_CYCLE",
                        "%s.%s" % (scope_field_prefix, logical),
                        "Static configuration reference could not be resolved" if result["state"] == "UNRESOLVED" else "Static configuration reference is cyclic",
                        {"reference": result.get("reference")},
                    ))
                return result

            for logical in sorted(mapping):
                result = resolve_setting(logical)
                if result is not None:
                    values[logical] = result
            return values

        deployment_configuration = resolve_scope()
        for logical, value in sorted(overrides.items()):
            if logical in mapping:
                findings.extend(_validate_override(logical, value, schema, field_prefix))
        for logical, value in sorted(document_overrides.items()):
            findings.extend(_validate_override(logical, value, schema, field_prefix))
        service = services.setdefault(deployment_id, {})
        service["configuration"] = deployment_configuration
        service["opaqueVariables"] = opaque_variables

        scoped_members = {}
        for member_id in sorted(members):
            member = members[member_id]
            member_configuration = member.get("configuration", {}) if isinstance(member, dict) else {}
            member_opaque_variables = []
            if not isinstance(member_configuration, dict):
                findings.append(_finding(
                    "INVALID_MEMBER_CONFIGURATION",
                    "serviceDeployments.%s.members.%s.configuration" % (deployment_id, member_id),
                    "Member configuration must be an object",
                ))
                member_configuration = {}
            for logical, value in sorted(member_configuration.items()):
                entry = mapping.get(logical)
                if not isinstance(entry, dict) or not entry.get("roleVariable"):
                    if configuration_is_closed:
                        findings.append(_finding(
                            "SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_PROPERTY_UNKNOWN",
                            "serviceDeployments.%s.members.%s.configuration.%s" % (deployment_id, member_id, logical),
                            "Configuration property is not declared by the service schema",
                        ))
                    else:
                        member_opaque_variables.append(_opaque_variable(
                            logical,
                            value,
                            "MEMBER_CONFIGURATION",
                            "serviceDeployments.%s.members.%s.configuration.%s" % (deployment_id, member_id, logical),
                        ))
                elif "member" not in _mapping_scopes(entry):
                    findings.append(_finding(
                        "MEMBER_SCOPE_SETTING_NOT_ALLOWED",
                        "serviceDeployments.%s.members.%s.configuration.%s" % (deployment_id, member_id, logical),
                        "Configuration setting does not allow member scope",
                        {"setting": logical, "allowedScopes": _mapping_scopes(entry)},
                    ))
                if logical in mapping:
                    findings.extend(_validate_override(
                        logical, value, schema,
                        "serviceDeployments.%s.members.%s.configuration" % (deployment_id, member_id),
                    ))
            member_values = resolve_scope(dict(member, id=member_id) if isinstance(member, dict) else {"id": member_id})
            resolved_member = resolved.get("members", {}).get(member_id, {}) if isinstance(resolved, dict) else {}
            host_id = resolved_member.get("host") if isinstance(resolved_member, dict) else None
            context = {"deploymentId": deployment_id, "memberId": member_id, "hostId": host_id}
            member_fingerprint = canonical_digest({"serviceType": service_type, "definitionVersion": service_definition_version, "mode": resolved.get("mode"), "configuration": member_values, "inputs": {"serviceDefinitionDigest": _service_definition_digest(definition), "configurationSchemaDigest": canonical_digest(schema if schema is not None else {}), "roleDefaultsDigest": canonical_digest(_canonical_defaults(defaults, mapping)), "mappingDigest": canonical_digest(_canonical_mapping(mapping))}})
            scoped_members[member_id] = {"variableContext": context, "configuration": member_values, "opaqueVariables": member_opaque_variables, "configurationFingerprint": member_fingerprint, "opaqueVariablesFingerprint": canonical_digest(sorted(member_opaque_variables, key=lambda item: (item["name"], item["origin"]["source"], item["origin"]["path"]))) }
        service["members"] = scoped_members

        service.update({
            "serviceType": service_type,
            "definitionVersion": service_definition_version,
            "mode": resolved.get("mode"),
        })
        schema_ref = definition.get("configurationSchema", {}).get("$ref") if isinstance(definition.get("configurationSchema"), dict) else None
        service["inputs"] = {
            "topologyFingerprint": resolved_topology.get("topologyFingerprint"),
            "serviceDefinitionDigest": _service_definition_digest(definition),
            "configurationSchemaDigest": canonical_digest(schema if schema is not None else {"ref": schema_ref}),
            "roleDefaultsDigest": canonical_digest(_canonical_defaults(defaults, mapping)),
            "mappingDigest": canonical_digest(_canonical_mapping(mapping)),
        }
        service["configurationFingerprint"] = canonical_digest({
            "serviceType": service_type,
            "definitionVersion": service["definitionVersion"],
            "mode": service["mode"],
            "configuration": service["configuration"],
            "members": {member_id: {"configuration": value["configuration"]} for member_id, value in sorted(scoped_members.items())},
            "inputs": {key: value for key, value in service["inputs"].items() if key != "topologyFingerprint"},
        })
        service["opaqueVariablesFingerprint"] = canonical_digest(sorted(service["opaqueVariables"], key=lambda item: (item["name"], item["origin"]["source"], item["origin"]["path"])))

    for service in services.values():
        service["configuration"] = {
            key: service.get("configuration", {})[key]
            for key in sorted(service.get("configuration", {}))
        }
        service["inputs"] = {
            key: value for key, value in service["inputs"].items() if value is not None
        }
    findings.extend(
        _finding(item["code"], item["field"], item["message"])
        for item in configuration_registry_findings(services, resolved_topology)
    )
    findings.sort(key=lambda item: (item["field"], item["code"]))
    fingerprint_input = {
        "services": {
            deployment_id: {
                "serviceType": service["serviceType"],
                "definitionVersion": service["definitionVersion"],
                "mode": service["mode"],
                "configuration": service["configuration"],
                "members": {
                    member_id: {
                        "configuration": value["configuration"],
                    }
                    for member_id, value in sorted(service.get("members", {}).items())
                },
                "inputs": {
                    key: value for key, value in service["inputs"].items()
                    if key != "topologyFingerprint"
                },
            }
            for deployment_id, service in sorted(services.items())
        }
    }
    return {
        "apiVersion": API_VERSION,
        "kind": "ResolvedServiceConfiguration",
        "services": services,
        "opaqueVariables": opaque_host_variables,
        "opaqueVariablesFingerprint": canonical_digest({
            "hosts": sorted(opaque_host_variables, key=lambda item: (item["name"], item["origin"]["source"], item["origin"]["path"])),
            "services": {
                deployment_id: {
                    "opaqueVariables": sorted(service.get("opaqueVariables", []), key=lambda item: (item["name"], item["origin"]["source"], item["origin"]["path"])),
                    "members": {
                        member_id: sorted(value.get("opaqueVariables", []), key=lambda item: (item["name"], item["origin"]["source"], item["origin"]["path"]))
                        for member_id, value in sorted(service.get("members", {}).items())
                    },
                }
                for deployment_id, service in sorted(services.items())
            },
        }),
        "configurationFingerprint": canonical_digest(fingerprint_input),
        "findings": findings,
        "status": "BLOCKED" if findings else "PASS",
    }

from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function

import re

try:
    from .project_validation import canonical_digest
except ImportError:
    from project_validation import canonical_digest


API_VERSION = "platform.installer/resolved-service-endpoint/v1alpha1"
DNS_LABEL = re.compile(r"^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$")
DNS_DOMAIN = re.compile(r"^(?=.{1,253}$)(?:[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?\.)+[a-z]{2,63}$")


def _finding(code, field, message, details=None):
    result = {
        "apiVersion": "platform.installer/finding/v1alpha1",
        "kind": "Finding",
        "code": code,
        "status": "BLOCKED",
        "category": "service-endpoint-resolution",
        "field": field,
        "safeMessage": message,
    }
    if details:
        result["safeDetails"] = details
    return result


def _definitions(catalog):
    catalog = catalog if isinstance(catalog, dict) else {}
    values = catalog.get("definitions", catalog)
    return values if isinstance(values, dict) else {}


def resolve_service_endpoints(topology, service_catalog, resolved_service_configuration=None, inventory_deployments=None, deployment_ids=None, endpoint_sources=None):
    """Derive generic client endpoint identity from desired topology.

    Transport ports and routing are deliberately deferred to NET-03. This function
    has no filesystem, inventory, target, generated-state or secret access.
    """
    topology = topology if isinstance(topology, dict) else {}
    deployments = topology.get("serviceDeployments", {}) if isinstance(topology.get("serviceDeployments"), dict) else {}
    groups = topology.get("endpointGroups", {}) if isinstance(topology.get("endpointGroups"), dict) else {}
    definitions = _definitions(service_catalog)
    findings, endpoints, host_endpoints = [], {}, {}
    inventory_deployments = inventory_deployments if isinstance(inventory_deployments, dict) else {}
    selected_ids = set(deployment_ids) if isinstance(deployment_ids, list) else None

    domains = {}
    for group_id, group in sorted(groups.items()):
        domain = (group.get('address') or {}).get('domain', '') if isinstance(group, dict) else ''
        normalized = domain.lower().rstrip('.') if isinstance(domain, str) else ''
        if normalized in domains:
            findings.append(_finding('ENDPOINT_GROUP_DOMAIN_DUPLICATE', 'endpointGroups.' + group_id,
                                     'Endpoint groups must have distinct domains'))
        elif normalized:
            domains[normalized] = group_id

    for source_id, source in sorted((endpoint_sources or {}).items()):
        if selected_ids is not None and source_id not in selected_ids:
            continue
        record = source.get('endpoint', {})
        if source_id in deployments or not DNS_LABEL.fullmatch(source_id):
            findings.append(_finding('ENDPOINT_SOURCE_ID_COLLISION', 'endpointSources.' + source_id,
                                     'Endpoint source identity is invalid or already used'))
            continue
        group_id = record.get('endpointGroupId')
        domain = (groups.get(group_id, {}).get('address') or {}).get('domain')
        if (not isinstance(domain, str) or not DNS_DOMAIN.fullmatch(domain) or
                record.get('fqdn') != source_id + '.' + domain or
                record.get('serviceDeploymentId') != source_id or record.get('scope') != 'deployment'):
            findings.append(_finding('ENDPOINT_SOURCE_INVALID', 'endpointSources.' + source_id,
                                     'Endpoint source must reference a valid group and DNS identity'))
            continue
        endpoints[source_id] = dict(record, endpointFingerprint=canonical_digest(record))

    for deployment_id, deployment in sorted(deployments.items()):
        if selected_ids is not None and deployment_id not in selected_ids:
            continue
        if not isinstance(deployment, dict) or "endpointGroup" not in deployment:
            continue
        prefix = "serviceDeployments.%s" % deployment_id
        group_id = deployment.get("endpointGroup")
        group = groups.get(group_id)
        if not isinstance(group, dict):
            findings.append(_finding("ENDPOINT_GROUP_NOT_FOUND", prefix + ".endpointGroup", "Endpoint group reference is not defined"))
            continue
        address = group.get("address") if isinstance(group.get("address"), dict) else {}
        domain = address.get("domain")
        if not isinstance(domain, str) or not DNS_DOMAIN.match(domain):
            findings.append(_finding("ENDPOINT_GROUP_DOMAIN_INVALID", "endpointGroups.%s.address.domain" % group_id, "Endpoint group domain must be a lowercase fully qualified DNS suffix"))
            continue
        if not isinstance(deployment_id, str) or not DNS_LABEL.match(deployment_id):
            findings.append(_finding("ENDPOINT_DEPLOYMENT_ID_NOT_DNS_LABEL", prefix, "Endpoint-enabled service deployment id must be a lowercase DNS label"))
            continue
        service_type = deployment.get("serviceType")
        definition = definitions.get(service_type)
        endpoint = definition.get("endpoint") if isinstance(definition, dict) else None
        if not isinstance(endpoint, dict):
            findings.append(_finding("ENDPOINT_SERVICE_UNSUPPORTED", prefix + ".endpointGroup", "Service package does not support a generic client endpoint", {"serviceType": service_type}))
            continue
        fqdn = "%s.%s" % (deployment_id, domain)
        record = {
            "scope": "deployment",
            "serviceDeploymentId": deployment_id,
            "serviceType": service_type,
            "endpointGroupId": group_id,
            "fqdn": fqdn,
            "sanDnsNames": [fqdn],
            # Certificate SAN candidates; DNS wildcard publication is independent.
            "wildcardDnsNames": ["*.%s" % domain],
        }
        record["endpointFingerprint"] = canonical_digest(record)
        endpoints[deployment_id] = record

        # A host endpoint is an inventory opt-in, never a second desired-state
        # entity.  It is intentionally generic so DNS, PKI and future services
        # consume one endpoint projection rather than service-specific logic.
        for host_id, placements in sorted(inventory_deployments.items()):
            placement = placements.get(deployment_id) if isinstance(placements, dict) else None
            field = "platform_deployments.%s.%s.hostEndpoint" % (host_id, deployment_id)
            if not isinstance(placement, dict) or "hostEndpoint" not in placement:
                continue
            if not isinstance(placement.get("hostEndpoint"), bool):
                findings.append(_finding("HOST_ENDPOINT_INVALID", field, "hostEndpoint must be a boolean"))
                continue
            if not placement["hostEndpoint"]:
                continue
            if not isinstance(host_id, str) or not DNS_LABEL.match(host_id):
                findings.append(_finding("HOST_ENDPOINT_HOST_ID_NOT_DNS_LABEL", field, "Host id used for hostEndpoint must be a lowercase DNS label"))
                continue
            if address.get("wildcard") is not True:
                findings.append(_finding("HOST_ENDPOINT_WILDCARD_REQUIRED", field, "hostEndpoint requires an endpoint group with wildcard DNS enabled"))
                continue
            host_fqdn = "%s-%s.%s" % (deployment_id, host_id, domain)
            key = "%s--%s" % (deployment_id, host_id)
            host_record = {
                "scope": "host", "serviceDeploymentId": deployment_id,
                "serviceType": service_type, "hostId": host_id,
                "endpointGroupId": group_id, "fqdn": host_fqdn,
                "sanDnsNames": [host_fqdn],
                "wildcardDnsNames": ["*.%s" % domain],
            }
            host_record["endpointFingerprint"] = canonical_digest(host_record)
            host_endpoints[key] = host_record

    fqdn_owner, backend_owner = {}, {}
    for deployment_id, endpoint in sorted(endpoints.items()):
        fqdn = endpoint["fqdn"]
        backend_name = deployment_id + '-' + endpoint['endpointGroupId']
        if backend_name in backend_owner:
            findings.append(_finding('ENDPOINT_BACKEND_NAME_COLLISION', 'endpointSources.' + deployment_id,
                                     'Endpoint backend and filename identity collides'))
        backend_owner[backend_name] = deployment_id
        if fqdn in fqdn_owner:
            findings.append(_finding("ENDPOINT_FQDN_COLLISION", "serviceDeployments.%s.endpointGroup" % deployment_id, "Resolved endpoint FQDN collides with another service deployment", {"fqdn": fqdn, "otherDeploymentId": fqdn_owner[fqdn]}))
        else:
            fqdn_owner[fqdn] = deployment_id
    for key, endpoint in sorted(host_endpoints.items()):
        fqdn = endpoint["fqdn"]
        if fqdn in fqdn_owner:
            findings.append(_finding("HOST_ENDPOINT_FQDN_COLLISION", "platform_deployments.%s.%s.hostEndpoint" % (endpoint["hostId"], endpoint["serviceDeploymentId"]), "Resolved host endpoint FQDN collides with another endpoint", {"fqdn": fqdn, "otherEndpoint": fqdn_owner[fqdn]}))
        else:
            fqdn_owner[fqdn] = key
    if findings:
        endpoints, host_endpoints = {}, {}
    fingerprint = canonical_digest({"endpoints": endpoints, "hostEndpoints": host_endpoints})
    return {
        "apiVersion": API_VERSION,
        "kind": "ResolvedServiceEndpoints",
        "endpoints": endpoints,
        "hostEndpoints": host_endpoints,
        "endpointFingerprint": fingerprint,
        "findings": sorted(findings, key=lambda item: (item["field"], item["code"])),
        "status": "BLOCKED" if findings else "PASS",
    }

def haproxy_provider_hosts(desired_state, inventory_deployments, source):
    """Select desired HAProxy placements through the endpoint's Keepalived hosts."""
    deployments = desired_state.get("serviceDeployments", {})
    group_id = source.get("endpointGroup") if isinstance(source, dict) else None
    if not group_id or source.get("serviceType") == "haproxy":
        return {}
    placements = inventory_deployments if isinstance(inventory_deployments, dict) else {}
    keepalived_ids = {key for key, value in deployments.items()
                      if isinstance(value, dict) and value.get("serviceType") == "keepalived"
                      and value.get("endpointGroupRef") == group_id}
    vip_hosts = {host for host, values in placements.items()
                 if isinstance(values, dict) and keepalived_ids.intersection(values)}
    return {key: sorted(host for host in vip_hosts
                        if key in placements[host])
            for key, value in sorted(deployments.items())
            if isinstance(value, dict) and value.get("serviceType") == "haproxy"
            and value.get("endpointGroup") == group_id
            and any(key in placements[host] for host in vip_hosts)}


def service_integration_relations(desired_state, source_service_types=None, source_deployment_id=None,
                                  inventory_deployments=None, endpoint_sources=None):
    """Return deterministic source-to-provider relations from canonical state."""
    desired_state = desired_state if isinstance(desired_state, dict) else {}
    deployments = desired_state.get("serviceDeployments", {})
    deployments = deployments if isinstance(deployments, dict) else {}
    groups = desired_state.get("endpointGroups", {})
    groups = groups if isinstance(groups, dict) else {}
    source_service_types = set(source_service_types or [])
    relations = []

    sources = dict(deployments)
    sources.update(endpoint_sources or {})
    for source_id, source in sorted(sources.items()):
        if source_deployment_id is not None and source_id != source_deployment_id:
            continue
        if not isinstance(source, dict) or source.get("serviceType") not in source_service_types:
            if source_deployment_id is None or not isinstance(source, dict):
                continue
        dns_deployments = set()
        endpoint_group_id = source.get("endpointGroup")
        endpoint_group = groups.get(endpoint_group_id)
        address = endpoint_group.get("address") if isinstance(endpoint_group, dict) else {}
        domain = address.get("domain") if isinstance(address, dict) else None
        if isinstance(domain, str):
            for provider_id, provider in sorted(deployments.items()):
                configuration = provider.get("configuration", {}) if isinstance(provider, dict) else {}
                zone = configuration.get("zone") if isinstance(configuration, dict) else None
                if (isinstance(provider, dict) and provider.get("serviceType") == "bind"
                        and isinstance(zone, str) and (domain == zone or domain.endswith("." + zone))):
                    dns_deployments.add(provider_id)
        proxy_hosts = haproxy_provider_hosts(desired_state, inventory_deployments, source)
        if dns_deployments or proxy_hosts or (endpoint_group_id and source.get("serviceType") != "haproxy"):
            relations.append({
                "sourceDeploymentId": source_id,
                "endpointGroupId": endpoint_group_id,
                "dnsDeploymentIds": sorted(dns_deployments),
                "haproxyDeploymentIds": sorted(proxy_hosts),
                "haproxyHostsByDeployment": proxy_hosts,
            })
    return relations


def resolve_service_integrations(desired_state, source_service_types=None, source_deployment_id=None,
                                 inventory_deployments=None, endpoint_sources=None):
    """Resolve provider deployments implied by successful source lifecycles.

    This intentionally returns only provider deployment identifiers. Providers
    rebuild their complete models from canonical desired state themselves.
    """
    desired_state = desired_state if isinstance(desired_state, dict) else {}
    deployments = desired_state.get("serviceDeployments", {})
    deployments = deployments if isinstance(deployments, dict) else {}
    sources = dict(deployments)
    sources.update(endpoint_sources or {})
    findings = []
    if source_deployment_id is not None and source_deployment_id not in sources:
        findings.append({
            "apiVersion": "platform.installer/finding/v1alpha1", "kind": "Finding",
            "code": "SERVICE_INTEGRATION_SOURCE_NOT_FOUND", "status": "BLOCKED",
            "category": "service-integration", "field": "serviceDeployments.%s" % source_deployment_id,
            "safeMessage": "Selected source service deployment does not exist",
        })
    relations = service_integration_relations(desired_state, source_service_types, source_deployment_id,
                                             inventory_deployments, endpoint_sources)
    dns_deployments = set()
    haproxy_deployments = set()
    for relation in relations:
        dns_deployments.update(relation["dnsDeploymentIds"])
        haproxy_deployments.update(relation["haproxyDeploymentIds"])

    result = {
        "sources": relations,
        "dnsDeployments": sorted(dns_deployments),
        "haproxyDeployments": sorted(haproxy_deployments),
        "haproxyHosts": sorted({host for relation in relations
                                for hosts in relation["haproxyHostsByDeployment"].values() for host in hosts}),
        "missingHAProxySources": sorted(relation["sourceDeploymentId"] for relation in relations
                                        if relation["endpointGroupId"] and not relation["haproxyDeploymentIds"]
                                        and sources[relation["sourceDeploymentId"]].get("serviceType") != "haproxy"),
    }
    result["fingerprint"] = canonical_digest(result)
    return {
        "apiVersion": "platform.installer/resolved-service-integrations/v1alpha2",
        "kind": "ResolvedServiceIntegrations",
        "status": "BLOCKED" if findings else "PASS",
        "integrations": result,
        "findings": findings,
    }

@@PORTABLE {"path":"ansible-core/collections/ansible_collections/platform/core/plugins/module_utils/topology_resolution.py","mode":420,"size":11814,"sha256":"11059fabc77df3bf93a2227bf1fb6246d939161d13c982447ac3d231eabb327d","index":0,"count":1,"encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":11814}
from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function

__metaclass__ = type

try:
    from .project_validation import canonical_digest, validate_project
    from .project_state import (
        canonical_inventory_members,

TOPOLOGY_FIELDS = ("serviceType", "mode", "identity", "members")


def _with_placement_hosts(topology, placements):
    """Compatibility validation view; placement remains inventory-owned."""
    if placements is None:
        return topology
    result = dict(topology)
    deployments = topology.get("serviceDeployments", {}) if isinstance(topology, dict) else {}
    result_deployments = {}
    for deployment_id, deployment in deployments.items():
        copied = dict(deployment) if isinstance(deployment, dict) else deployment
        if isinstance(copied, dict):
            members = copied.get("members", {})
            copied_members = {}
            for member_id, member in members.items() if isinstance(members, dict) else []:
                copied_member = dict(member) if isinstance(member, dict) else member
                if isinstance(copied_member, dict) and (deployment_id, member_id) in placements:
                    copied_member["host"] = placements[(deployment_id, member_id)]
                copied_members[member_id] = copied_member
            copied["members"] = copied_members
        result_deployments[deployment_id] = copied
    result["serviceDeployments"] = result_deployments
    return result


def _canonical_roles(roles):
    return sorted(role for role in roles if isinstance(role, str))


def _canonical_member(member, host=None):
    return {
        "host": host if host is not None else member.get("host"),
        "roles": _canonical_roles(member.get("roles", [])),
        "identity": member.get("identity", {}),
    }


def canonical_topology(topology, placements=None):
    """Return only the explicit topology fields in stable identifier order."""
    deployments = topology.get("serviceDeployments", {})
    canonical_deployments = {}
    for deployment_id in sorted(deployments):
        deployment = deployments[deployment_id]
        if not isinstance(deployment, dict):
            continue
        members = deployment.get("members", {})
        canonical_deployments[deployment_id] = {
            field: (
                {
                    member_id: _canonical_member(
                        members[member_id],
                        placements.get((deployment_id, member_id)) if placements is not None else None,
                    )
                    for member_id in sorted(members)
                }
                if field == "members"
                else deployment.get(field)
            )
            for field in TOPOLOGY_FIELDS
            if field in deployment
        }
    return {"serviceDeployments": canonical_deployments}


def _used_definition_digests(topology, service_catalog):
    definitions = service_catalog.get("definitions", service_catalog)
    deployments = topology.get("serviceDeployments", {})
    used_types = sorted(
        set(
            deployment.get("serviceType")
            for deployment in deployments.values()
            if isinstance(deployment, dict) and deployment.get("serviceType")
        )
    )
    return {
        service_type: definitions[service_type].get("x-definitionDigest")
        for service_type in used_types
        if isinstance(definitions.get(service_type), dict)
    }


def resolve_topology(manifest, topology, inventory_hosts, service_catalog, placement_by_host=None,
                     inventory_deployments_by_host=None, ansible_desired_state=None,
                     inventory_host_addresses=None):
    """Resolve explicit topology without filesystem, Ansible or host-var knowledge.

    CORE-01 remains responsible for project/catalog/reference and manifest
    constraint validation. This function only canonicalizes the validated
    topology and fingerprints it with digests of definitions actually used.
    """
    desired_state, state_findings = select_desired_state(manifest, topology, ansible_desired_state)
    effective_manifest = manifest
    if ansible_desired_state and not isinstance(manifest.get("desiredState"), dict):
        effective_manifest = synthesize_ansible_manifest(desired_state, service_catalog)
    placements = None
    placement_findings = []
    host_scoped_deployments = {}
    if inventory_deployments_by_host is not None:
        inventory_members, inventory_findings = canonical_inventory_members(
            inventory_deployments_by_host, inventory_hosts
        )
        deployments = desired_state.get("serviceDeployments", {})
        for host_id, host_deployments in sorted((inventory_deployments_by_host or {}).items()):
            if not isinstance(host_deployments, dict):
                continue
            for deployment_id, host_configuration in sorted(host_deployments.items()):
                if isinstance(host_configuration, dict) and "members" not in host_configuration:
                    host_scoped_deployments.setdefault(deployment_id, {})[host_id] = dict(host_configuration)
        for deployment_id, deployment in (sorted(deployments.items()) if isinstance(deployments, dict) else []):
            if isinstance(deployment, dict) and "members" in deployment:
                placement_findings.append({
                    "apiVersion": "platform.installer/finding/v1alpha1", "kind": "Finding",
                    "code": "PERSISTED_MEMBERS_NOT_ALLOWED", "status": "BLOCKED",
                    "category": "project-state", "field": "serviceDeployments.%s.members" % deployment_id,
                    "safeMessage": "Ansible desired state must not duplicate inventory-owned service members",
                })
        for deployment_id, member_id in sorted(inventory_members):
            if deployment_id not in deployments:
                placement_findings.append({
                    "apiVersion": "platform.installer/finding/v1alpha1", "kind": "Finding",
                    "code": "INVENTORY_DEPLOYMENT_NOT_FOUND", "status": "BLOCKED",
                    "category": "project-state", "field": "platform_deployments.%s.%s" % (inventory_members[(deployment_id, member_id)]["host"], deployment_id),
                    "safeMessage": "Inventory member references an unknown deployment",
                })
        for deployment_id in sorted(host_scoped_deployments):
            if deployment_id not in deployments:
                placement_findings.append({
                    "apiVersion": "platform.installer/finding/v1alpha1", "kind": "Finding",
                    "code": "INVENTORY_DEPLOYMENT_NOT_FOUND", "status": "BLOCKED",
                    "category": "project-state", "field": "platform_deployments.%s" % deployment_id,
                    "safeMessage": "Inventory host-scoped deployment references an unknown deployment",
                })
        desired_state = topology_with_inventory_members(desired_state, inventory_members)
        for deployment_id in host_scoped_deployments:
            if isinstance(desired_state.get("serviceDeployments", {}).get(deployment_id), dict):
                desired_state["serviceDeployments"][deployment_id].pop("members", None)
        placements = {key: member["host"] for key, member in inventory_members.items()}
        placement_findings.extend(inventory_findings)
    elif placement_by_host is not None:
        placements, placement_findings = canonical_placements(placement_by_host, inventory_hosts)
        deployments = desired_state.get("serviceDeployments", {})
        if isinstance(deployments, dict):
            for deployment_id in sorted(deployments):
                members = deployments[deployment_id].get("members", {}) if isinstance(deployments[deployment_id], dict) else {}
                for member_id in sorted(members) if isinstance(members, dict) else []:
                    key = (deployment_id, member_id)
                    host = placements.get(key)
                    if host is None:
                        placement_findings.append({
                            "apiVersion": "platform.installer/finding/v1alpha1", "kind": "Finding",
                            "code": "MEMBER_PLACEMENT_UNASSIGNED", "status": "BLOCKED",
                            "category": "project-state", "field": "serviceDeployments.%s.members.%s" % key,
                            "safeMessage": "Logical member has no inventory placement",
                        })
                    elif isinstance(members[member_id], dict) and members[member_id].get("host") and members[member_id]["host"] != host:
                        placement_findings.append({
                            "apiVersion": "platform.installer/finding/v1alpha1", "kind": "Finding",
                            "code": "LEGACY_MEMBER_HOST_CONFLICT", "status": "BLOCKED",
                            "category": "project-state", "field": "serviceDeployments.%s.members.%s.host" % key,
                            "safeMessage": "Legacy member host conflicts with canonical inventory placement",
                        })
            for deployment_id, member_id in sorted(placements):
                if deployment_id not in deployments:
                    placement_findings.append({"apiVersion": "platform.installer/finding/v1alpha1", "kind": "Finding", "code": "PLACEMENT_DEPLOYMENT_NOT_FOUND", "status": "BLOCKED", "category": "project-state", "field": "platform_members.%s" % deployment_id, "safeMessage": "Placement references an unknown deployment"})
                elif member_id not in deployments[deployment_id].get("members", {}):
                    placement_findings.append({"apiVersion": "platform.installer/finding/v1alpha1", "kind": "Finding", "code": "PLACEMENT_MEMBER_NOT_FOUND", "status": "BLOCKED", "category": "project-state", "field": "platform_members.%s.%s" % (deployment_id, member_id), "safeMessage": "Placement references an unknown member"})
    validation = validate_project(
        manifest=effective_manifest,
        topology=desired_state,
        desired_hosts={},
        service_catalog=service_catalog,
        inventory_hosts=inventory_hosts,
        placements=placements,
        host_scoped_deployments=host_scoped_deployments,
        inventory_host_addresses=inventory_host_addresses,
    )
    findings = validation["findings"] + [item for item in state_findings if item["status"] == "BLOCKED"] + placement_findings
    if findings:
        return {
            "status": "BLOCKED",
            "findings": findings,
        }

    resolved = canonical_topology(desired_state, placements)
    definition_digests = _used_definition_digests(desired_state, service_catalog)
    fingerprint_input = {
        "resolvedTopology": resolved,
        "hostScopedDeployments": {
            deployment_id: {
                host_id: host_scoped_deployments[deployment_id][host_id]
                for host_id in sorted(host_scoped_deployments[deployment_id])
            }
            for deployment_id in sorted(host_scoped_deployments)
        },
        "serviceDefinitionDigests": definition_digests,
    }
    return {
        "status": "PASS",
        "resolvedTopology": resolved,
        "serviceDefinitionDigests": definition_digests,
        "topologyFingerprint": canonical_digest(fingerprint_input),
        "findings": state_findings,
    }

@@PORTABLE {"path":"ansible-core/collections/ansible_collections/platform/core/plugins/modules/application_identity_files.py","mode":420,"size":5209,"sha256":"37c792b0d456a6b5f13a7a9d30f2582c511d59484508a842ccbff10a93678a40","index":0,"count":1,"encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":5209}
#!/usr/bin/python
"""Private bind files for the actual rootless container UID, without secret output."""
import os
import pwd
import re
import stat
import tempfile
from ansible.module_utils.basic import AnsibleModule


def mapped(path, identity):
    with open(path, encoding='ascii') as stream:
        rows = [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stream]
    for inside, outside, length in rows:
        if inside <= identity < inside+length:
            return outside+identity-inside
    raise ValueError()


def custody(path, owners, directory=False):
    info = os.lstat(path)
    if stat.S_ISLNK(info.st_mode) or info.st_uid not in owners or info.st_mode & 0o022:
        raise ValueError()
    if directory and not stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode):
        raise ValueError()
    return info


def write(path, content, uid, gid):
    if os.path.lexists(path):
        info = custody(path, {uid})
        if not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or info.st_mode & 0o077:
            raise ValueError()
        with open(path, 'rb') as stream:
            if stream.read() == content:
                return False
    fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=os.path.dirname(path))
    try:
        os.fchmod(fd, 0o600)
        os.fchown(fd, uid, gid)
        with os.fdopen(fd, 'wb') as stream:
            stream.write(content)
            stream.flush()
            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        os.replace(temporary, path)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(temporary):
            os.unlink(temporary)
    return True


def main():
    module = AnsibleModule(argument_spec=dict(account=dict(required=True), user=dict(default='0:0'),
        instance_path=dict(required=True), role_id=dict(default='', no_log=True), ca=dict(default=''),
        agent=dict(default=''), pki_plans=dict(type='list', elements='dict', default=[]), preflight=dict(type='bool', default=False)), supports_check_mode=True)
    try:
        args = module.params
        account = pwd.getpwnam(args['account'])
        if not re.fullmatch(r'[0-9]+:[0-9]+', args['user']):
            raise ValueError()
        inside_uid, inside_gid = map(int, args['user'].split(':'))
        with open('/run/user/%s/docker.pid' % account.pw_uid, encoding='ascii') as stream:
            pid = int(stream.read().strip())
        uid = mapped('/proc/%s/uid_map' % pid, inside_uid)
        gid = mapped('/proc/%s/gid_map' % pid, inside_gid)
        if mapped('/proc/%s/uid_map' % pid, 0) != account.pw_uid:
            raise ValueError()
        root = args['instance_path']
        if not root.startswith(account.pw_dir+'/') or os.path.realpath(root) != root:
            raise ValueError()
        current = root
        while current != account.pw_dir:
            if os.path.lexists(current):
                custody(current, {account.pw_uid}, directory=True)
            current = os.path.dirname(current)
        payloads = {'vault': {'role-id': args['role_id'].encode(), 'agent.hcl': args['agent'].encode(), 'ca.pem': args['ca'].encode()}}
        if args['pki_plans']:
            if len(args['pki_plans']) != 1:
                raise ValueError()
            plan = args['pki_plans'][0]
            source = plan['targetDirectory']
            if not source.startswith('/etc/platform-installer/pki/') or os.path.realpath(source) != source:
                raise ValueError()
            payloads['pki'] = {}
            for name in ('keystore.p12', 'truststore.p12', 'ca-chain.pem'):
                path = source+'/'+name
                info = custody(path, {0})
                if not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or info.st_size > 1048576:
                    raise ValueError()
                with open(path, 'rb') as stream:
                    payloads['pki'][name] = stream.read(1048577)
        for name, contents in payloads.items():
            directory = root+'/'+name
            if os.path.lexists(directory):
                info = custody(directory, {uid}, directory=True)
                if info.st_mode & 0o077:
                    raise ValueError()
                for filename in contents:
                    path = directory+'/'+filename
                    if os.path.lexists(path):
                        info = custody(path, {uid})
                        if info.st_mode & 0o077 or not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode):
                            raise ValueError()
        if args['preflight'] or module.check_mode:
            module.exit_json(changed=False, host_uid=uid, host_gid=gid)
        changed = False
        for name, contents in payloads.items():
            directory = root+'/'+name
            if not os.path.exists(directory):
                os.mkdir(directory, 0o700)
                os.chown(directory, uid, gid)
                changed = True
            for filename, content in contents.items():
                if not content:
                    raise ValueError()
                changed = write(directory+'/'+filename, content, uid, gid) or changed
        module.exit_json(changed=changed, host_uid=uid, host_gid=gid)
    except (ValueError, KeyError, OSError):
        module.fail_json(msg='APPLICATION_PRIVATE_IDENTITY_MATERIALIZATION_INVALID')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

def main():

#!/usr/bin/python
from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function

import yaml
from ansible.module_utils.basic import AnsibleModule
from ansible_collections.platform.core.plugins.module_utils.pki_resolution import resolve_certificate_requests
from ansible_collections.platform.core.plugins.module_utils.project_state import canonical_inventory_members, topology_with_inventory_members


def _load_yaml(path):
    with open(path, "r") as handle:
        value = yaml.safe_load(handle) or {}
    return value if isinstance(value, dict) else {}


def _inventory_hosts(inventory):
    all_group = inventory.get("all", {}) if isinstance(inventory, dict) else {}
    hosts = all_group.get("hosts", {}) if isinstance(all_group, dict) else {}
    return hosts if isinstance(hosts, dict) else {}


def main():
    module = AnsibleModule(argument_spec={
        "project_path": {"type": "path", "required": False, "default": None},
        "inventory_path": {"type": "path", "required": False, "default": None},
        "desired_state": {"type": "dict", "required": False, "default": {}},
        "inventory_hosts": {"type": "dict", "required": False, "default": {}},
        "project_id": {"type": "str", "required": False, "default": "ansible-project"},
        "pki_defaults": {"type": "dict", "required": True},
        "resolved_service_endpoints": {"type": "dict", "required": False, "default": {}},
    }, supports_check_mode=True)
    try:
        if module.params["desired_state"]:
            desired = module.params["desired_state"]
            hosts = module.params["inventory_hosts"]
            project_id = module.params["project_id"]
        else:
            if not module.params["project_path"] or not module.params["inventory_path"]:
                module.fail_json(msg="Legacy PKI resolution requires project and inventory paths", error_code="PKI_LEGACY_PATH_REQUIRED")
            project = _load_yaml(module.params["project_path"])
            inventory = _load_yaml(module.params["inventory_path"])
            desired = project.get("desiredState", {}) if isinstance(project.get("desiredState"), dict) else {}
            hosts = _inventory_hosts(inventory)
            project_id = project.get("metadata", {}).get("id", "project")
        by_host = {host_id: values.get("platform_deployments", {}) for host_id, values in hosts.items() if isinstance(values, dict)}
        members, findings = canonical_inventory_members(by_host, hosts.keys())
        if findings:
            result = {"status": "BLOCKED", "findings": findings}
        else:
            result = resolve_certificate_requests(project_id, topology_with_inventory_members(desired, members), hosts, module.params["pki_defaults"], module.params["resolved_service_endpoints"], by_host)
    except Exception as error:
        module.fail_json(msg="PKI request resolution failed", error_code="PKI_RESOLUTION_FAILED", safe_details=str(error))
    if result.get("status") != "PASS":
        module.fail_json(msg="PKI request resolution is blocked", error_code="PKI_RESOLUTION_BLOCKED", findings=result.get("findings", []))
    module.exit_json(changed=False, pki=result)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import os

from ansible.module_utils.basic import AnsibleModule
from ansible_collections.platform.core.plugins.module_utils.project_validation import (
    validate_project,
    write_validation_artifact,
)
from ansible_collections.platform.core.plugins.module_utils.schema_validation import (
    SchemaValidationError,
    SchemaValidator,
)
from ansible_collections.platform.core.plugins.module_utils.project_state import (
    canonical_inventory_members,
    canonical_placements,
    select_desired_state,
    synthesize_ansible_manifest,
    topology_with_inventory_members,
)


def main():
    module = AnsibleModule(
        argument_spec={
            "manifest": {"type": "dict", "required": True},
            "topology": {"type": "dict", "required": True},
            "ansible_desired_state": {"type": "dict", "required": False, "default": {}},
            "generated_state": {"type": "dict", "required": False, "default": {}},
            "project_id": {"type": "str", "required": False, "default": "ansible-project"},
            "desired_hosts": {"type": "dict", "required": True},
            "service_catalog": {"type": "dict", "required": True},
            "inventory_hosts": {"type": "list", "elements": "str", "required": True},
            "placement_by_host": {"type": "dict", "required": False, "default": None},
            "inventory_deployments_by_host": {"type": "dict", "required": False, "default": None},
            "inventory_host_addresses": {"type": "dict", "required": False, "default": {}},
            "artifact_path": {"type": "path", "required": True},
            "contracts_root": {"type": "path", "required": True},
        },
        supports_check_mode=True,
    )

    native = module.params["ansible_desired_state"]
    topology, state_findings = select_desired_state(module.params["manifest"], module.params["topology"], native)
    manifest = module.params["manifest"]
    if native and not isinstance(manifest.get("desiredState"), dict):
        manifest = synthesize_ansible_manifest(topology, module.params["service_catalog"], module.params["project_id"])
    schema_topology = topology
    use_placements = isinstance(module.params["manifest"].get("desiredState"), dict) or bool(module.params["placement_by_host"])
    placements, placement_findings = canonical_placements(module.params["placement_by_host"] or {}, module.params["inventory_hosts"])
    inventory_deployments = module.params["inventory_deployments_by_host"]
    if isinstance(inventory_deployments, dict):
        inventory_members, inventory_findings = canonical_inventory_members(
            inventory_deployments, module.params["inventory_hosts"]
        )
        host_scoped_deployments = {}
        for host_id, host_deployments in sorted(inventory_deployments.items()):
            if not isinstance(host_deployments, dict):
                continue
            for deployment_id, host_configuration in sorted(host_deployments.items()):
                if isinstance(host_configuration, dict) and "members" not in host_configuration:
                    host_scoped_deployments.setdefault(deployment_id, {})[host_id] = dict(host_configuration)
        topology = topology_with_inventory_members(topology, inventory_members)
        for deployment_id in host_scoped_deployments:
            if isinstance(topology.get("serviceDeployments", {}).get(deployment_id), dict):
                topology["serviceDeployments"][deployment_id].pop("members", None)
        placements = {key: member["host"] for key, member in inventory_members.items()}
        placement_findings.extend(inventory_findings)
        deployments = schema_topology.get("serviceDeployments", {})
        for deployment_id, deployment in (sorted(deployments.items()) if isinstance(deployments, dict) else []):
            if isinstance(deployment, dict) and "members" in deployment:
                placement_findings.append({
                    "apiVersion": "platform.installer/finding/v1alpha1",
                    "kind": "Finding", "code": "PERSISTED_MEMBERS_NOT_ALLOWED",
                    "status": "BLOCKED", "category": "project-state",
                    "field": "serviceDeployments.%s.members" % deployment_id,
                    "safeMessage": "Ansible desired state must not duplicate inventory-owned service members",
                })
        for deployment_id, member_id in sorted(inventory_members):
            if deployment_id not in deployments:
                placement_findings.append({
                    "apiVersion": "platform.installer/finding/v1alpha1",
                    "kind": "Finding", "code": "INVENTORY_DEPLOYMENT_NOT_FOUND",
                    "status": "BLOCKED", "category": "project-state",
                    "field": "platform_deployments.%s.%s" % (inventory_members[(deployment_id, member_id)]["host"], deployment_id),
                    "safeMessage": "Inventory member references an unknown deployment",
                })
        use_placements = True
    result = validate_project(
        manifest=manifest,
        topology=topology,
        desired_hosts=module.params["desired_hosts"],
        service_catalog=module.params["service_catalog"],
        inventory_hosts=module.params["inventory_hosts"],
        placements=placements if use_placements else None,
        host_scoped_deployments=host_scoped_deployments if isinstance(inventory_deployments, dict) else None,
        inventory_host_addresses=module.params["inventory_host_addresses"],
    )
    if use_placements:
        result["findings"].extend(placement_findings)
    try:
        schema_validator = SchemaValidator(module.params["contracts_root"])
        contracts_root = os.path.abspath(os.path.expanduser(module.params["contracts_root"]))
        schema_specs = [
            (os.path.join(contracts_root, "project", "v2alpha1", "project-manifest.schema.json"), manifest),
            (os.path.join(contracts_root, "project", "v2alpha1", "desired-state.schema.json"), schema_topology),
            (os.path.join(contracts_root, "service-catalog", "v1alpha1", "schema.json"), module.params["service_catalog"]),
        ]
        if module.params["generated_state"]:
            schema_specs.append((os.path.join(contracts_root, "project", "v2alpha1", "generated-state.schema.json"), module.params["generated_state"]))
        for schema_path, document in schema_specs:
            result["findings"].extend(schema_validator.validate(document, schema_path))
        host_schema = os.path.join(contracts_root, "project", "v2alpha1", "host-desired-vars.schema.json")
        for host_name in sorted(module.params["desired_hosts"]):
            result["findings"].extend(schema_validator.validate(module.params["desired_hosts"][host_name], host_schema))
    except SchemaValidationError as error:
        result["findings"].append(
            {
                "apiVersion": "platform.installer/finding/v1alpha1",
                "kind": "Finding",
                "code": "SCHEMA_VALIDATION_ENGINE_ERROR",
                "status": "BLOCKED",
                "category": "schema-validation",
                "field": "schema",
                "safeMessage": "Не удалось выполнить проверку опубликованной схемы",
                "safeDetails": {"reason": str(error).split(":", 1)[0]},
            }
        )
    result["findings"].extend(state_findings)
    result["findings"].sort(key=lambda item: (item.get("field", ""), item.get("code", "")))
    blocked = [item for item in result["findings"] if item.get("status") == "BLOCKED"]
    result["summary"]["blocked"] = len(blocked)
    result["summary"]["pass"] = 0 if blocked else 1
    result["status"] = "BLOCKED" if blocked else "PASS"
    artifact_path = os.path.abspath(os.path.expanduser(module.params["artifact_path"]))

    try:
        write_validation_artifact(artifact_path, result)
    except OSError as error:
        module.fail_json(
            msg="Unable to write the structured validation artifact",
            error_code="VALIDATION_ARTIFACT_WRITE_FAILED",
            safe_details=str(error),
            artifact_path=artifact_path,
        )

    payload = {
        "changed": False,
        "validation": result,
        "artifact_path": artifact_path,
    }
    if result["status"] == "BLOCKED":
        module.fail_json(
            msg="Platform project validation is blocked; inspect the structured findings artifact",
            error_code="PROJECT_VALIDATION_BLOCKED",
            **payload,
        )
    module.exit_json(**payload)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
