- name: Reconcile PKI stores from validated PEM material
  block:
    - name: Inspect PKI request destination directory without following links
      ansible.builtin.stat:
        path: "{{ _platform_pki_request_dir }}"
        follow: false
      register: _platform_pki_request_directory_stat
      no_log: true

    - name: Require protected regular PKI request destination directory
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
          - _platform_pki_request_directory_stat.stat.isdir | default(false)
          - not (_platform_pki_request_directory_stat.stat.islnk | default(false))
          - _platform_pki_request_directory_stat.stat.pw_name == platform_pki_owner
          - _platform_pki_request_directory_stat.stat.mode == '0700'
        fail_msg: PKI_STORE_PATH_UNSAFE
      no_log: true

    - name: Create private same-filesystem PKI store staging directory
      ansible.builtin.tempfile:
        state: directory
        path: "{{ _platform_pki_request_dir }}"
        prefix: .pki-stores-
      register: _platform_pki_store_stage
      changed_when: false
      no_log: true

    - name: Enforce private PKI store staging directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ _platform_pki_store_stage.path }}"
        state: directory
        owner: "{{ platform_pki_owner }}"
        group: "{{ platform_pki_group }}"
        mode: '0700'
      changed_when: false
      no_log: true

    - name: Inspect authoritative PKI PEM files without following links
      ansible.builtin.stat:
        path: "{{ item }}"
        follow: false
      loop:
        - "{{ _platform_pki_authority_dir }}/ca.crt"
        - "{{ _platform_pki_request_dir }}/leaf.key"
        - "{{ _platform_pki_request_dir }}/leaf.crt"
      register: _platform_pki_authoritative_pem_stats
      no_log: true

    - name: Require protected regular authoritative PKI PEM files
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
          - item.stat.exists
          - item.stat.isreg | default(false)
          - item.stat.pw_name == platform_pki_owner
        fail_msg: PKI_AUTHORITATIVE_PEM_INVALID
      loop: "{{ _platform_pki_authoritative_pem_stats.results }}"
      no_log: true

    - name: Enforce protected PEM permissions before validation and store generation
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ item }}"
        owner: "{{ platform_pki_owner }}"
        group: "{{ platform_pki_group }}"
        mode: '0600'
      loop:
        - "{{ _platform_pki_authority_dir }}/ca.crt"
        - "{{ _platform_pki_request_dir }}/leaf.key"
        - "{{ _platform_pki_request_dir }}/leaf.crt"
      no_log: true

    - name: Recheck protected PEM permissions
      ansible.builtin.stat:
        path: "{{ item }}"
        follow: false
      loop:
        - "{{ _platform_pki_authority_dir }}/ca.crt"
        - "{{ _platform_pki_request_dir }}/leaf.key"
        - "{{ _platform_pki_request_dir }}/leaf.crt"
      register: _platform_pki_protected_pem_stats
      no_log: true

    - name: Require owner-only PEM permissions
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
          - item.stat.isreg | default(false)
          - item.stat.pw_name == platform_pki_owner
          - item.stat.mode == '0600'
        fail_msg: PKI_AUTHORITATIVE_PEM_INVALID
      loop: "{{ _platform_pki_protected_pem_stats.results }}"
      no_log: true

    - name: Verify existing managed leaf certificate chain before store work
      ansible.builtin.command:
        argv:
          - openssl
          - verify
          - -CAfile
          - "{{ _platform_pki_authority_dir }}/ca.crt"
          - "{{ _platform_pki_request_dir }}/leaf.crt"
      register: _platform_pki_existing_leaf_chain
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: false
      no_log: true

    - name: Require existing leaf certificate to chain to the managed CA
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
          - _platform_pki_existing_leaf_chain.rc == 0
        fail_msg: PKI_AUTHORITATIVE_PEM_CHAIN_INVALID
      no_log: true

    - name: Derive public key from authoritative leaf private key
      ansible.builtin.command:
        argv:
          - openssl
          - pkey
          - -in
          - "{{ _platform_pki_request_dir }}/leaf.key"
          - -pubout

          - "{{ _platform_pki_store_stage.path }}/source-key.pub"

      no_log: true

              - "{{ _platform_pki_authority_dir }}/ca.crt"

            mode: '0600'
          loop: [keystore.p12, truststore.p12]
          changed_when: false
          no_log: true

              - -v

              - -keystore

            argv:
              - keytool
              - -list
              - -v
              - -storetype
              - PKCS12
              - -keystore
              - "{{ _platform_pki_store_stage.path }}/truststore.p12"
              - -alias
              - "{{ _platform_pki_request_plans[0].trustAlias }}"
              - -storepass:file
              - "{{ _platform_pki_password_file }}"
          register: _platform_pki_candidate_truststore_check
          changed_when: false
          no_log: true

        - name: Export replacement keystore certificate
          ansible.builtin.command:
            argv:
              - keytool
              - -exportcert
              - -storetype
              - PKCS12
              - -keystore
              - "{{ _platform_pki_store_stage.path }}/keystore.p12"
              - -alias
              - "{{ _platform_pki_request_plans[0].keyAlias }}"
              - -storepass:file
              - "{{ _platform_pki_password_file }}"
              - -file
              - "{{ _platform_pki_store_stage.path }}/candidate-keystore.der"
          changed_when: false
          no_log: true

        - name: Extract replacement keystore private key
          ansible.builtin.command:
            argv:
              - openssl
              - pkcs12
              - -in
              - "{{ _platform_pki_store_stage.path }}/keystore.p12"
              - -nocerts
              - -nodes
              - -passin
              - "file:{{ _platform_pki_password_file }}"
              - -out
              - "{{ _platform_pki_store_stage.path }}/candidate-keystore.key"
          changed_when: false
          no_log: true

        - name: Restrict staged extracted private key permissions
          ansible.builtin.file:
            path: "{{ _platform_pki_store_stage.path }}/candidate-keystore.key"
            owner: "{{ platform_pki_owner }}"
            group: "{{ platform_pki_group }}"
            mode: '0600'
          changed_when: false
          no_log: true

        - name: Derive public key from replacement keystore
          ansible.builtin.command:
            argv:
              - openssl
              - pkey
              - -in
              - "{{ _platform_pki_store_stage.path }}/candidate-keystore.key"
              - -pubout
              - -out
              - "{{ _platform_pki_store_stage.path }}/candidate-keystore.pub"
          changed_when: false
          no_log: true

        - name: Export replacement truststore certificate
          ansible.builtin.command:
            argv:
              - keytool
              - -exportcert
              - -storetype
              - PKCS12
              - -keystore
              - "{{ _platform_pki_store_stage.path }}/truststore.p12"
              - -alias
              - "{{ _platform_pki_request_plans[0].trustAlias }}"
              - -storepass:file
              - "{{ _platform_pki_password_file }}"
              - -file
              - "{{ _platform_pki_store_stage.path }}/candidate-truststore.der"
          changed_when: false
          no_log: true

        - name: Require replacement stores to match authoritative PEM identity
          ansible.builtin.command:
            argv: [cmp, -s, "{{ item.left }}", "{{ item.right }}"]
          loop:
            - left: "{{ _platform_pki_store_stage.path }}/candidate-keystore.der"
              right: "{{ _platform_pki_store_stage.path }}/expected-leaf.der"
            - left: "{{ _platform_pki_store_stage.path }}/candidate-truststore.der"
              right: "{{ _platform_pki_store_stage.path }}/expected-ca.der"
            - left: "{{ _platform_pki_store_stage.path }}/candidate-keystore.pub"
              right: "{{ _platform_pki_store_stage.path }}/source-key.pub"
          changed_when: false
          no_log: true

              - "'trustedCertEntry' in _platform_pki_candidate_truststore_check.stdout"

          no_log: true

            remote_src: true
            owner: "{{ platform_pki_owner }}"
            group: "{{ platform_pki_group }}"
            mode: '0600'
            unsafe_writes: false
          register: _platform_pki_keystore_publish
          no_log: true

        - name: Atomically publish validated PKCS12 truststore
          ansible.builtin.copy:
            src: "{{ _platform_pki_store_stage.path }}/truststore.p12"
            dest: "{{ _platform_pki_request_dir }}/truststore.p12"
            remote_src: true
            owner: "{{ platform_pki_owner }}"
            group: "{{ platform_pki_group }}"
            mode: '0600'
            unsafe_writes: false
          register: _platform_pki_truststore_publish
          no_log: true

    - name: Recheck published PKCS12 stores
      ansible.builtin.command:
        argv:
          - keytool
          - -list
          - -storetype
          - PKCS12
          - -keystore
          - "{{ _platform_pki_request_dir }}/{{ item }}"
          - -storepass:file
          - "{{ _platform_pki_password_file }}"
      loop: [keystore.p12, truststore.p12]
      changed_when: false
      no_log: true

    - name: Remove private PKI store staging directory

        path: "{{ _platform_pki_store_stage.path }}"
        state: absent
      when: _platform_pki_store_stage.path is defined

- import_playbook: application-libraries-credential-root.yml
- name: Resolve and validate the complete standalone application scope
  hosts: localhost
  connection: local
  gather_facts: false
  any_errors_fatal: true
  tasks:
    - name: Resolve native application defaults and placements
      ansible.builtin.include_role:
        name: platform.core.resolve_application_libraries
    - name: Build existing read-only project snapshot
      platform.core.project_snapshot:
        project_root: "{{ platform_project_root | default(inventory_dir | dirname) }}"
        service_catalog_path: "{{ platform_service_catalog_path }}"
      register: application_snapshot
      no_log: true
    - name: Require a valid snapshot before preparing runtime hooks
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that: application_snapshot.snapshot.validation.status == 'PASS'
        fail_msg: "{{ application_snapshot.snapshot.findings | map(attribute='code') | unique | list }}"
    - name: Resolve Vault hooks from the same snapshot
      platform.core.prepare_application_vault:
        snapshot_result: "{{ application_snapshot }}"
      register: application_vault_inputs
      no_log: true
    - name: Resolve common endpoint sources before any target mutation
      platform.core.prepare_application_endpoints:
        snapshot: "{{ application_snapshot.snapshot }}"
        service_catalog_path: "{{ platform_service_catalog_path }}"
      register: application_endpoint_inputs
    - name: Require valid endpoint sources and publish shared hook input
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        platform_endpoint_sources: "{{ application_endpoint_inputs.sources }}"
      failed_when: application_endpoint_inputs.status != 'PASS'
    - name: Require valid Vault projection before target contacts
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that: application_vault_inputs.status == 'PASS'
        fail_msg: "{{ application_vault_inputs.code | default('APPLICATION_VAULT_INPUT_INVALID') }}"
    - name: Resolve infrastructure account and resource hooks from the same snapshot
      platform.core.prepare_application_providers:
        snapshot_result: "{{ application_snapshot }}"
        service_catalog_path: "{{ platform_service_catalog_path }}"
      register: application_provider_inputs
      no_log: true
    - name: Bind the same snapshot for runtime provider preflight
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        application_provider_snapshot: "{{ application_snapshot }}"
      no_log: true
    - name: Assemble standalone image authority without enabling deployment planner
      platform.core.prepare_application_runtime:
        project_root: "{{ platform_project_root | default(inventory_dir | dirname) }}"
        contracts_root: "{{ platform_contracts_root | default(playbook_dir ~ '/../../contracts') }}"
        snapshot: "{{ application_snapshot.snapshot }}"
      register: application_runtime_inputs
      no_log: true
    - name: Require successful standalone authority preparation
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
          - application_runtime_inputs.status == 'PASS'
          - application_provider_inputs.status == 'PASS'
        fail_msg: "{{ application_runtime_inputs.code | default('APPLICATION_RUNTIME_INPUT_INVALID') }}"

@@PORTABLE {"path":"ansible-core/tools/build_execution_runtime_bundle.py","mode":420,"size":16061,"sha256":"b7fbd406b4b0ba8cc196a5316f90efa79f093eefe2a2d9bf37bf0b64937cab94","index":0,"count":1,"encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":16061}
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build a deterministic, versioned offline Execution Node runtime directory.

The builder never downloads.  Missing runtime packages can be acquired by the
explicit Go acquisition operation from a selected node's configured repository,
then supplied here as a local input.
"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import shlex
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import sys

import yaml


REPOSITORY = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPOSITORY / "ansible-core" / "collections"))
from ansible_collections.platform.core.plugins.module_utils.service_configuration_preview import ordinary_presentation_value
SOURCE_ROOTS = (
    ("ansible-core", REPOSITORY / "ansible-core"),
    ("services", REPOSITORY / "services"),
    ("contracts", REPOSITORY / "contracts"),
    ("catalog", REPOSITORY / "examples" / "catalog"),
)
EXCLUDED_PARTS = {"tests", "__pycache__", ".pytest_cache", ".git", "docs"}


def digest_bytes(value):
    return "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()


def digest_file(path):
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as source:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: source.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return "sha256:" + digest.hexdigest()


def copy_tree(source, destination):
    if not source.is_dir():
        raise ValueError("required source is missing: %s" % source)
    for path in sorted(source.rglob("*")):
        relative = path.relative_to(source)
        target = destination / relative
        if any(part in EXCLUDED_PARTS for part in relative.parts):
            continue
        if path.is_symlink():
            raise ValueError("symlink source is not allowed: %s" % path)
        if path.is_dir():
            target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        elif path.is_file():
            if path.name in {"README.md", "README.rst"}:
                continue
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copyfile(path, target)
        else:
            raise ValueError("unsupported source entry: %s" % path)


def validate_catalog_layout(root):
    catalog_path = root / "catalog" / "service-catalog.yml"
    catalog = yaml.safe_load(catalog_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    definitions = catalog.get("definitions", {}) if isinstance(catalog, dict) else {}
    for service_type, definition in definitions.items():
        references = []
        schema = definition.get("configurationSchema", {}) if isinstance(definition, dict) else {}
        if isinstance(schema, dict) and isinstance(schema.get("$ref"), str):
            references.append(schema["$ref"])
        if isinstance(definition, dict) and isinstance(definition.get("compatibilityRef"), str):
            references.append(definition["compatibilityRef"])
        for reference in references:
            if reference.startswith("../../services/"):
                candidate = root / reference[6:]
            elif reference.startswith("../fixtures/"):
                candidate = root / "catalog" / reference[3:]
            else:
                candidate = (catalog_path.parent / reference).resolve()
            if root not in candidate.resolve().parents and candidate.resolve() != root:
                raise ValueError("catalog reference escapes bundle: %s.%s" % (service_type, reference))
            if not candidate.is_file():
                raise ValueError("catalog reference is missing from bundle: %s" % reference)


def write_ui_static_defaults(root):
    """Derive bounded presentation-only literals from trusted role defaults."""
    catalog = yaml.safe_load((root / "catalog" / "service-catalog.yml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    definitions = catalog.get("definitions", {}) if isinstance(catalog, dict) else {}
    result = {}
    for service_type, definition in sorted(definitions.items()):
        entrypoints = definition.get("roleEntrypoints", {}) if isinstance(definition, dict) else {}
        apply = entrypoints.get("apply", {}) if isinstance(entrypoints, dict) else {}
        parts = apply.get("fqcn", "").split(".") if isinstance(apply, dict) else []
        if len(parts) != 3 or any(not part or not part.replace("_", "").isalnum() for part in parts):
            result[service_type] = {}
            continue
        defaults_path = root / "services" / service_type / "ansible_collections" / parts[0] / parts[1] / "roles" / parts[2] / "defaults" / "main.yml"
        if not defaults_path.is_file() or defaults_path.is_symlink():
            result[service_type] = {}
            continue
        defaults = yaml.safe_load(defaults_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        if not isinstance(defaults, dict):
            raise ValueError("invalid role defaults for UI projection")
        settings = definition.get("configuration", {}).get("settings", {})
        if not isinstance(settings, dict):
            raise ValueError("invalid configuration settings for UI projection")
        projected = {}
        for setting_id, setting in sorted(settings.items()):
            if not isinstance(setting, dict) or setting.get("kind") != "MANAGED":
                continue
            ui = setting.get("ui", {})
            if not isinstance(ui, dict) or "x-runtimeSecretRequirement" in ui:
                continue
            variable = setting.get("roleVariable")
            if not isinstance(variable, str) or variable not in defaults:
                continue
            value = defaults[variable]
            if isinstance(value, str) and any(marker in value for marker in ("{{", "}}", "{%", "%}", "{#", "#}")):
                projected[setting_id] = {"state": "DEFERRED"}
            elif ordinary_presentation_value(setting, value):
                projected[setting_id] = {"state": "LITERAL", "value": value}
            else:
                projected[setting_id] = {"state": "UNAVAILABLE"}
        result[service_type] = projected
    (root / "catalog" / "ui-static-defaults.json").write_text(
        json.dumps({"apiVersion": "platform.installer/ui-static-defaults/v1alpha1", "services": result}, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8", newline="\n",
    )


def components(root):
    result = []
    files = [path for path in root.rglob("*") if path.is_file()]
    for path in sorted(files, key=lambda item: item.relative_to(root).as_posix()):
        if not path.is_file() or path.name == "manifest.yaml":
            continue
        if path.is_symlink():
            raise ValueError("bundle symlink is not allowed: %s" % path)
        result.append({
            "path": path.relative_to(root).as_posix(),
            "sha256": digest_file(path),
            "size": path.stat().st_size,
        })
    return result


def catalog_digest():
    catalog = REPOSITORY / "examples" / "catalog" / "service-catalog.yml"
    value = yaml.safe_load(catalog.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    digest = value.get("digest") if isinstance(value, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(digest, str) or not digest.startswith("sha256:"):
        raise ValueError("published catalog digest is missing")
    return digest


def schema_digest():
    entries = []
    for path in sorted((REPOSITORY / "contracts").rglob("*.json")):
        entries.append((path.relative_to(REPOSITORY).as_posix(), digest_file(path)))
    return digest_bytes(json.dumps(entries, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8"))


def parse_platform(value):
    parts = value.split(":")
    if len(parts) != 3 or any(part in {"", ".", ".."} or len(part) > 64 or
                              re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9._-]+", part) is None for part in parts):
        raise ValueError("platform must be OS:VERSION:ARCH with safe nonempty tokens")
    return dict(zip(("os", "version", "architecture"), parts))


def host_platform(os_release=Path("/etc/os-release"), architecture=None):
    if os.name != "posix":
        raise ValueError("empty runtime packages require --platform OS:VERSION:ARCH or Linux os-release")
    values = {}
    try:
        for line in os_release.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
            key, separator, value = line.partition("=")
            if separator and key in {"ID", "VERSION_ID"}:
                parsed = shlex.split(value, comments=True)
                if len(parsed) != 1 or key in values:
                    raise ValueError("invalid os-release identity")
                values[key] = parsed[0]
        return parse_platform("{}:{}:{}".format(values["ID"], values["VERSION_ID"],
                              architecture if architecture is not None else os.uname().machine))
    except (OSError, KeyError, ValueError) as error:
        raise ValueError("cannot infer Linux platform from os-release; specify --platform OS:VERSION:ARCH") from error


def runtime_platforms(runtime_root, declared=None):
    platforms = []
    package_root = runtime_root / "packages"
    for os_root in sorted(package_root.iterdir()) if package_root.is_dir() else []:
        if not os_root.is_dir():
            continue
        for version_root in sorted(os_root.iterdir()):
            if not version_root.is_dir():
                continue
            for architecture_root in sorted(version_root.iterdir()):
                if not architecture_root.is_dir() or not any(architecture_root.iterdir()):
                    continue
                platforms.append(parse_platform(":".join((os_root.name, version_root.name, architecture_root.name))))
    platforms.extend(parse_platform(value) for value in (declared or []))
    if not platforms:
        platforms.append(host_platform())
    unique = {(p["os"], p["version"], p["architecture"]) for p in platforms}
    return [dict(zip(("os", "version", "architecture"), item)) for item in sorted(unique)]


def artifact_type(media_type):
    return {
        "application/gzip": "archive",
        "application/x-gzip": "archive",
        "application/x-rpm": "package",
        "application/octet-stream": "file",
    }.get(media_type)


def artifact_sources(root):
    """Build the verified offline-source index from service metadata.

    The builder does not invent a candidate from a filename: every entry must
    join one catalog artifact declaration, its service artifact metadata and
    the exact copied runtime file.
    """
    catalog = yaml.safe_load((root / "catalog" / "service-catalog.yml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    definitions = catalog.get("definitions", {}) if isinstance(catalog, dict) else {}
    result = []
    for service_type, definition in sorted(definitions.items()):
        if not isinstance(service_type, str) or not isinstance(definition, dict):
            continue
        source_path = root / "services" / service_type / "artifacts.yml"
        if not source_path.is_file():
            continue
        source = yaml.safe_load(source_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        entries = source.get("artifacts", []) if isinstance(source, dict) else []
        by_identity = {}
        for entry in entries if isinstance(entries, list) else []:
            if not isinstance(entry, dict):
                continue
            digest = entry.get("sha256")
            if isinstance(digest, str) and not digest.startswith("sha256:"):
                digest = "sha256:" + digest
            key = (entry.get("id"), entry.get("version"), digest)
            if all(isinstance(value, str) and value for value in key):
                if key in by_identity:
                    raise ValueError("duplicate service artifact metadata: %s" % service_type)
                by_identity[key] = entry
        for requirement in definition.get("artifacts", []) if isinstance(definition.get("artifacts"), list) else []:
            if not isinstance(requirement, dict):
                continue
            key = (requirement.get("id"), str(requirement.get("version", "")), requirement.get("digest"))
            entry = by_identity.get(key)
            if entry is None:
                continue
            filename, media_type = entry.get("filename"), entry.get("mediaType")
            if not isinstance(filename, str) or filename != Path(filename).name or not filename or not isinstance(media_type, str) or artifact_type(media_type) is None:
                raise ValueError("invalid service artifact metadata: %s" % service_type)
            path = root / "runtime" / "artifacts" / service_type / filename
            if not path.is_file() or path.is_symlink():
                continue
            actual = digest_file(path)
            if actual != requirement.get("digest"):
                raise ValueError("runtime artifact digest mismatch: %s" % path)
            result.append({
                "serviceType": service_type,
                "requirementId": requirement["id"],
                "name": requirement.get("name", requirement["id"]),
                "version": str(requirement["version"]),
                "os": requirement.get("os", ""),
                "architecture": requirement.get("architecture", ""),
                "digest": requirement["digest"],
                "ref": path.relative_to(root).as_posix(),
                "sha256": actual,
                "size": path.stat().st_size,
                "type": artifact_type(media_type),
            })
    return sorted(result, key=lambda item: (item["serviceType"], item["requirementId"], item["ref"]))


def build(output, runtime, bundle_version, core_version, platforms=None):
    output = output.resolve()
    if output.exists():
        raise ValueError("output already exists: %s" % output)
    temporary = output.with_name(output.name + ".tmp")
    if temporary.exists():
        raise ValueError("temporary output already exists: %s" % temporary)
    try:
        temporary.mkdir(parents=True)
        for destination, source in SOURCE_ROOTS:
            copy_tree(source, temporary / destination)
        copy_tree(runtime, temporary / "runtime")
        for directory in ("packages", "python"):
            (temporary / "runtime" / directory).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        validate_catalog_layout(temporary)
        write_ui_static_defaults(temporary)
        manifest = {
            "apiVersion": "platform.installer/execution-bundle/v1alpha1",
            "kind": "ExecutionRuntimeBundle",
            "bundleVersion": bundle_version,
            "bootstrapProtocol": "v1alpha1",
            "coreVersion": core_version,
            "catalogDigest": catalog_digest(),
            "schemaDigest": schema_digest(),
            "platforms": runtime_platforms(runtime, platforms),
            "artifactSources": artifact_sources(temporary),
            "components": components(temporary),
        }
        (temporary / "manifest.yaml").write_text(
            yaml.safe_dump(manifest, allow_unicode=True, default_flow_style=False, sort_keys=False),
            encoding="utf-8",
            newline="\n",
        )
        temporary.replace(output)
    except Exception:
        shutil.rmtree(temporary, ignore_errors=True)
        raise


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--runtime-input", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--bundle-version", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--core-version", default="0.1.0")
    parser.add_argument("--platform", action="append", default=[], metavar="OS:VERSION:ARCH",
                        help="explicit platform; repeat for multiple targets, otherwise infer populated packages or Linux os-release")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        build(args.output, args.runtime_input.resolve(), args.bundle_version, args.core_version, args.platform)
    except ValueError as error:
        print("execution runtime bundle blocked: %s" % error, file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    print("execution runtime bundle created: %s" % args.output)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build/check the CORE-01 derived fixture catalog using offline PyYAML."""

import argparse
import copy
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys

import yaml


REPOSITORY = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
OUTPUT = REPOSITORY / "examples" / "catalog" / "service-catalog.yml"
SOURCES = (
    ("clickhouse", REPOSITORY / "services" / "clickhouse" / "service.yml"),
    ("docker", REPOSITORY / "services" / "docker" / "service.yml"),
    ("kafka", REPOSITORY / "services" / "kafka" / "service.yml"),
    ("postgresql", REPOSITORY / "services" / "postgresql" / "service.yml"),

    ("etcd", REPOSITORY / "examples" / "catalog" / "manifests" / "etcd.yml"),
)
PROJECT_MANIFEST_GLOBS = (
    "examples/valid/*/project.yml",
    "examples/invalid/*/project.yml",
    "ansible-core/examples/*/project.yml",
)


def canonical_bytes(value):
    return json.dumps(
        value,
        ensure_ascii=False,
        sort_keys=True,
        separators=(",", ":"),
    ).encode("utf-8")


def digest(value):
    return "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(canonical_bytes(value)).hexdigest()


def load_yaml(path):
    with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        value = yaml.safe_load(stream)
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise ValueError("%s must contain a YAML object" % path)
    return value


def _catalog_relative_reference(source, reference):
    if not isinstance(reference, str) or "://" in reference or reference.startswith("/"):
        return reference
    target = (source.parent / reference).resolve()
    return Path(os.path.relpath(target, OUTPUT.parent)).as_posix()


def _relocate_manifest_references(manifest, source):
    """Keep relative manifest references valid after embedding in the catalog."""
    relocated = copy.deepcopy(manifest)
    configuration_schema = relocated.get("configurationSchema", {})
    if isinstance(configuration_schema, dict) and "$ref" in configuration_schema:
        configuration_schema["$ref"] = _catalog_relative_reference(
            source, configuration_schema["$ref"]
        )
    if "compatibilityRef" in relocated:
        relocated["compatibilityRef"] = _catalog_relative_reference(
            source, relocated["compatibilityRef"]
        )
    for mode in relocated.get("modes", {}).values():
        if isinstance(mode, dict) and "configurationSchemaRef" in mode:
            mode["configurationSchemaRef"] = _catalog_relative_reference(
                source, mode["configurationSchemaRef"]
            )
    return relocated


def build_catalog():
    definitions = {}
    for service_type, source in SOURCES:
        manifest = load_yaml(source)
        metadata = manifest.get("metadata", {})
        if metadata.get("id") != service_type:
            raise ValueError("%s metadata.id must be %s" % (source, service_type))
        definition = _relocate_manifest_references(manifest, source)
        definition["x-definitionDigest"] = digest(definition)
        definition["x-sourceManifest"] = source.relative_to(REPOSITORY).as_posix()
        definitions[service_type] = definition

    unsigned = {
        "apiVersion": "platform.installer/catalog/v1alpha1",
        "kind": "ServiceCatalog",
        "definitions": definitions,
    }
    return {
        "apiVersion": unsigned["apiVersion"],
        "kind": unsigned["kind"],
        "digest": digest(unsigned),
        "definitions": definitions,
    }


def dump_yaml(value):
    return yaml.safe_dump(
        value,
        allow_unicode=True,
        default_flow_style=False,
        sort_keys=False,
        width=100,
    )


def project_manifests():
    manifests = []
    for pattern in PROJECT_MANIFEST_GLOBS:
        manifests.extend(REPOSITORY.glob(pattern))
    return sorted(set(manifests))


def lock_values(catalog, service_type):
    definition = catalog["definitions"][service_type]
    return {
        "definitionVersion": definition["metadata"]["version"],
        "digest": definition["x-definitionDigest"],
    }


def synchronize_project_locks(catalog):
    for path in project_manifests():
        manifest = load_yaml(path)
        lock = manifest.get("catalogLock", {})
        lock["digest"] = catalog["digest"]
        for service_type in list(lock.get("services", {})):
            if service_type not in catalog["definitions"]:
                raise ValueError("%s locks unknown service %s" % (path, service_type))
            lock["services"][service_type] = lock_values(catalog, service_type)
        path.write_text(dump_yaml(manifest), encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")


def verify_project_locks(catalog):
    errors = []
    for path in project_manifests():
        manifest = load_yaml(path)
        lock = manifest.get("catalogLock", {})
        if lock.get("digest") != catalog["digest"]:
            errors.append("%s has a stale catalog digest" % path)
        for service_type, service_lock in lock.get("services", {}).items():
            if service_type not in catalog["definitions"]:
                errors.append("%s locks unknown service %s" % (path, service_type))
            elif service_lock != lock_values(catalog, service_type):
                errors.append("%s has a stale %s lock" % (path, service_type))
    return errors


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument(
        "--check",
        action="store_true",
        help="fail when the committed catalog differs semantically from generated output",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()
    expected = build_catalog()

    if args.check:
        actual = load_yaml(OUTPUT)
        if actual != expected:
            print("fixture catalog is stale; run %s" % Path(__file__).name, file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        lock_errors = verify_project_locks(expected)
        if lock_errors:
            print("\n".join(lock_errors), file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        print("fixture catalog is reproducible: %s" % expected["digest"])
        return 0

    temporary = OUTPUT.with_suffix(".yml.tmp")
    temporary.write_text(dump_yaml(expected), encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    temporary.replace(OUTPUT)
    synchronize_project_locks(expected)
    print("wrote %s (%s)" % (OUTPUT, expected["digest"]))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate/check tracked configuration schemas from service manifests."""

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

import yaml

REPOSITORY = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
MODULE_UTILS = REPOSITORY / "ansible-core" / "collections" / "ansible_collections" / "platform" / "core" / "plugins" / "module_utils"
sys.path.insert(0, str(MODULE_UTILS))
from service_configuration_contract import generated_schema, validate_defaults


def canonical_json(value):
    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n"


def service_manifests():
    return sorted((REPOSITORY / "services").glob("*/service.yml"))


def output_path(manifest_path):
    return manifest_path.with_name("configuration.schema.json")


def role_defaults_path(manifest_path, manifest):
    entrypoints = manifest.get("roleEntrypoints", {})
    apply_entrypoint = entrypoints.get("apply", {}) if isinstance(entrypoints, dict) else {}
    fqcn = apply_entrypoint.get("fqcn", "") if isinstance(apply_entrypoint, dict) else ""
    parts = fqcn.split(".")
    if len(parts) != 3:
        return None
    return manifest_path.parent / "ansible_collections" / parts[0] / parts[1] / "roles" / parts[2] / "defaults" / "main.yml"


def is_literal(value):
    return not (isinstance(value, str) and any(marker in value for marker in ("{{", "}}", "{%", "%}", "{#", "#}")))


def build(manifest_path):
    with manifest_path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        manifest = yaml.safe_load(stream)
    if not isinstance(manifest, dict):
        raise ValueError("%s must contain a YAML object" % manifest_path)
    defaults_path = role_defaults_path(manifest_path, manifest)
    if defaults_path is not None and defaults_path.exists():
        with defaults_path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
            defaults = yaml.safe_load(stream) or {}
        issues = validate_defaults(manifest, defaults, is_literal)
        if issues:
            raise ValueError("%s: %s" % (issues[0]["path"], issues[0]["message"]))
    return canonical_json(generated_schema(manifest))


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true", help="fail when tracked schemas are stale")
    parser.add_argument("--service", action="append", default=[], help="service id to generate/check; defaults to all services")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    manifests = service_manifests()
    if args.service:
        requested = set(args.service)
        manifests = [path for path in manifests if path.parent.name in requested]
        missing = requested.difference({path.parent.name for path in manifests})
        if missing:
            parser.error("unknown service(s): %s" % ", ".join(sorted(missing)))
    stale = []
    for manifest in manifests:
        expected = build(manifest)
        output = output_path(manifest)
        if args.check:
            actual = output.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if output.exists() else None
            if actual != expected:
                stale.append(output.relative_to(REPOSITORY).as_posix())
        else:
            output.write_text(expected, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    if stale:
        print("generated configuration schemas are stale: %s" % ", ".join(stale), file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    print("configuration schemas are reproducible")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

@@END

"""Fixed Execution Node controller.  It never accepts a command or playbook."""

import errno
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import select
import signal

import subprocess
import sys
import time
