@@PORTABLE {"path":"docker/application-connection-probe/main.go","mode":420,"size":15303,"sha256":"0cf58a973035cc04ff5049559ba3d401e51099a10c7796fb28e6cd5807287294","index":0,"count":1,"encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":15303}
// application-connection-probe is a QA-only application started by Vault Agent.
// It never prints credential values or persists them in project files.
package main

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/tls"
	"crypto/x509"
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

type check struct {
	State  string `json:"state"`
	Reason string `json:"reason,omitempty"`
}

type status struct {
	Overall   string           `json:"overall"`
	Checks    map[string]check `json:"checks"`
	CheckedAt string           `json:"checkedAt"`
}

func env(name, fallback string) string {
	if value := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv(name)); value != "" {
		return value
	}
	return fallback
}

func result(err error) check {
	if err == nil {
		return check{State: "ok"}
	}
	// Errors may contain addresses, DSNs or fragments of server output. Expose only a code.
	return check{State: "failed", Reason: "CONNECTION_CHECK_FAILED"}
}

func require(names ...string) error {
	for _, name := range names {
		if os.Getenv(name) == "" {
			return errors.New("missing input")
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func trustedPool(ctx context.Context) (*x509.CertPool, string, error) {
	path := os.Getenv("PROBE_TRUSTSTORE_PKCS12")
	if path == "" {
		return nil, "", errors.New("missing truststore")
	}
	if err := require("PROBE_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD"); err != nil {
		return nil, "", err
	}
	cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "/usr/bin/openssl", "pkcs12", "-in", path,
		"-nokeys", "-passin", "env:PROBE_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD")
	pem, err := cmd.Output()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, "", errors.New("PKCS12_READ_FAILED")
	}
	pool := x509.NewCertPool()
	if !pool.AppendCertsFromPEM(pem) {
		return nil, "", errors.New("PKCS12_CERTS_MISSING")
	}
	// psql needs a file; /run/probe must be a container tmpfs, never a project mount.
	if err := os.MkdirAll("/run/probe", 0700); err != nil {
		return nil, "", err
	}
	path = filepath.Join("/run/probe", "ca.pem")
	if err := os.WriteFile(path, pem, 0600); err != nil {
		return nil, "", err
	}
	return pool, path, nil
}

func clientIdentity(ctx context.Context) (tls.Certificate, string, string, error) {
	path := os.Getenv("PROBE_KEYSTORE_PKCS12")
	if path == "" || os.Getenv("PROBE_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD") == "" {
		return tls.Certificate{}, "", "", errors.New("missing client keystore")
	}
	extract := func(args ...string) ([]byte, error) {
		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "/usr/bin/openssl", append([]string{
			"pkcs12", "-in", path, "-passin", "env:PROBE_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD"}, args...)...)
		output, err := cmd.Output()
		if err != nil {
			return nil, errors.New("PKCS12_CLIENT_READ_FAILED")
		}
		return output, nil
	}
	certPEM, err := extract("-clcerts", "-nokeys")
	if err != nil {
		return tls.Certificate{}, "", "", err
	}
	keyPEM, err := extract("-nocerts", "-nodes")
	if err != nil {
		return tls.Certificate{}, "", "", err
	}
	identity, err := tls.X509KeyPair(certPEM, keyPEM)
	if err != nil {
		return tls.Certificate{}, "", "", errors.New("PKCS12_CLIENT_INVALID")
	}
	if err := os.MkdirAll("/run/probe", 0700); err != nil {
		return tls.Certificate{}, "", "", err
	}
	certPath, keyPath := "/run/probe/client-cert.pem", "/run/probe/client-key.pem"
	if err := os.WriteFile(certPath, certPEM, 0600); err != nil {
		return tls.Certificate{}, "", "", err
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(keyPath, keyPEM, 0600); err != nil {
		return tls.Certificate{}, "", "", err
	}
	return identity, certPath, keyPath, nil
}

func postgres(ctx context.Context, caPath, certPath, keyPath string) error {
	if err := require("PGHOST", "PGPORT", "PGDATABASE", "PGUSER", "PGPASSWORD"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "/usr/bin/psql", "-X", "-A", "-t", "-q", "-c", "SELECT 1")
	cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(), "PGSSLMODE=verify-full", "PGSSLROOTCERT="+caPath,
		"PGSSLCERT="+certPath, "PGSSLKEY="+keyPath,
		"PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT=4", "PGOPTIONS=-c statement_timeout=3000")
	output, err := cmd.Output()
	if err != nil || strings.TrimSpace(string(output)) != "1" {
		return errors.New("POSTGRES_QUERY_FAILED")
	}
	return nil
}

func respWrite(conn net.Conn, args ...string) error {
	var builder strings.Builder
	fmt.Fprintf(&builder, "*%d\r\n", len(args))
	for _, arg := range args {
		fmt.Fprintf(&builder, "$%d\r\n%s\r\n", len(arg), arg)
	}
	_, err := io.WriteString(conn, builder.String())
	return err
}

func respLine(conn net.Conn) (string, error) {
	var bytes []byte
	for len(bytes) < 4096 {
		one := make([]byte, 1)
		if _, err := io.ReadFull(conn, one); err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		bytes = append(bytes, one[0])
		if len(bytes) >= 2 && bytes[len(bytes)-2] == '\r' && bytes[len(bytes)-1] == '\n' {
			return string(bytes[:len(bytes)-2]), nil
		}
	}
	return "", errors.New("RESP_TOO_LONG")
}

func respBulk(conn net.Conn) (string, error) {
	line, err := respLine(conn)
	if err != nil || !strings.HasPrefix(line, "$") {
		return "", errors.New("RESP_BULK_INVALID")
	}
	size, err := strconv.Atoi(line[1:])
	if err != nil || size < 0 || size > 4096 {
		return "", errors.New("RESP_BULK_INVALID")
	}
	value := make([]byte, size+2)
	if _, err = io.ReadFull(conn, value); err != nil || string(value[size:]) != "\r\n" {
		return "", errors.New("RESP_BULK_INVALID")
	}
	return string(value[:size]), nil
}

func redis(ctx context.Context, pool *x509.CertPool, identity tls.Certificate, prefix string) error {
	host, port, user, password := prefix+"_HOST", prefix+"_PORT", prefix+"_USER", prefix+"_PASSWORD"
	if err := require(host, port, user, password); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return redisAt(ctx, pool, identity, os.Getenv(host), os.Getenv(port), os.Getenv(user), os.Getenv(password), prefix)
}

func redisAt(ctx context.Context, pool *x509.CertPool, identity tls.Certificate, host, port, user, password, prefix string) error {
	dialer := &tls.Dialer{NetDialer: &net.Dialer{Timeout: 4 * time.Second},
		Config: &tls.Config{MinVersion: tls.VersionTLS12, RootCAs: pool, ServerName: host, Certificates: []tls.Certificate{identity}}}
	conn, err := dialer.DialContext(ctx, "tcp", net.JoinHostPort(host, port))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer conn.Close()
	_ = conn.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(4 * time.Second))
	if err = respWrite(conn, "AUTH", user, password); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	line, err := respLine(conn)
	if err != nil || line != "+OK" {
		return errors.New("REDIS_AUTH_FAILED")
	}
	if err = respWrite(conn, "PING"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	line, err = respLine(conn)
	if err != nil || line != "+PONG" {
		return errors.New("REDIS_PING_FAILED")
	}
	if prefix == "SENTINEL" {
		if err = require("SENTINEL_MASTER_NAME", "REDIS_TARGETS", "REDIS_USER", "REDIS_PASSWORD"); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err = respWrite(conn, "SENTINEL", "get-master-addr-by-name", os.Getenv("SENTINEL_MASTER_NAME")); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		line, err = respLine(conn)
		if err != nil || line != "*2" {
			return errors.New("SENTINEL_DISCOVERY_FAILED")
		}
		master, err := respBulk(conn)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		masterPort, err := respBulk(conn)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		address := net.JoinHostPort(master, masterPort)
		for _, target := range strings.Split(os.Getenv("REDIS_TARGETS"), ",") {
			if strings.TrimSpace(target) == address {
				return redisAt(ctx, pool, identity, master, masterPort, os.Getenv("REDIS_USER"), os.Getenv("REDIS_PASSWORD"), "MASTER")
			}
		}
		return errors.New("SENTINEL_MASTER_UNEXPECTED")
	}
	// Only this QA application may write, and only with an explicit fixture namespace.
	if prefix == "REDIS" && os.Getenv("PROBE_REDIS_KEY_PREFIX") != "" {
		key := os.Getenv("PROBE_REDIS_KEY_PREFIX") + "probe-" + strconv.FormatInt(time.Now().UnixNano(), 10)
		if err = respWrite(conn, "SET", key, "1", "EX", "30"); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if line, err = respLine(conn); err != nil || line != "+OK" {
			return errors.New("REDIS_WRITE_FAILED")
		}
		defer respWrite(conn, "DEL", key)
		if err = respWrite(conn, "GET", key); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if value, err := respBulk(conn); err != nil || value != "1" {
			return errors.New("REDIS_READ_FAILED")
		}
		if err = respWrite(conn, "DEL", key); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if line, err = respLine(conn); err != nil || line != ":1" {
			return errors.New("REDIS_DELETE_FAILED")
		}
		if err = respWrite(conn, "GET", "__platform_forbidden_namespace__:probe"); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if line, err = respLine(conn); err != nil || !strings.HasPrefix(line, "-NOPERM") {
			return errors.New("REDIS_NAMESPACE_UNRESTRICTED")
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func kafka(ctx context.Context, pool *x509.CertPool) error {
	if os.Getenv("KAFKA_TARGETS") != "" {
		for _, target := range strings.Split(os.Getenv("KAFKA_TARGETS"), ",") {
			host, port, err := net.SplitHostPort(strings.TrimSpace(target))
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if err = kafkaAt(ctx, pool, host, port); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		return nil
	}
	if err := require("KAFKA_HOST", "KAFKA_PORT"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return kafkaAt(ctx, pool, os.Getenv("KAFKA_HOST"), os.Getenv("KAFKA_PORT"))
}

func kafkaAt(ctx context.Context, pool *x509.CertPool, host, port string) error {
	dialer := &tls.Dialer{NetDialer: &net.Dialer{Timeout: 4 * time.Second},
		Config: &tls.Config{MinVersion: tls.VersionTLS12, RootCAs: pool, ServerName: host}}
	conn, err := dialer.DialContext(ctx, "tcp", net.JoinHostPort(host, port))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer conn.Close()
	_ = conn.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(4 * time.Second))
	// ApiVersions v0: request header only, no SASL identity or topic operation.
	request := []byte{0, 0, 0, 10, 0, 18, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0}
	if _, err = conn.Write(request); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var header [8]byte
	if _, err = io.ReadFull(conn, header[:]); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if size := binary.BigEndian.Uint32(header[:4]); size < 4 || size > 1<<20 || binary.BigEndian.Uint32(header[4:]) != 1 {
		return errors.New("KAFKA_PROTOCOL_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	}
	body := make([]byte, binary.BigEndian.Uint32(header[:4])-4)
	if _, err = io.ReadFull(conn, body); err != nil || len(body) < 6 || binary.BigEndian.Uint16(body[:2]) != 0 || binary.BigEndian.Uint32(body[2:6]) == 0 {
		return errors.New("KAFKA_API_VERSIONS_FAILED")
	}
	return nil
}

func clickhouse(ctx context.Context, pool *x509.CertPool, identity tls.Certificate) error {
	if err := require("CLICKHOUSE_URL", "CLICKHOUSE_USER", "CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	target := strings.TrimRight(os.Getenv("CLICKHOUSE_URL"), "/")
	if !strings.HasPrefix(target, "https://") {
		return errors.New("CLICKHOUSE_HTTPS_REQUIRED")
	}
	transport := &http.Transport{TLSClientConfig: &tls.Config{MinVersion: tls.VersionTLS12, RootCAs: pool, Certificates: []tls.Certificate{identity}}}
	defer transport.CloseIdleConnections()
	client := &http.Client{Timeout: 5 * time.Second, Transport: transport}
	query := func(sql string) (int, string, error) {
		request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, target+"/", strings.NewReader(sql))
		if err != nil {
			return 0, "", err
		}
		request.SetBasicAuth(os.Getenv("CLICKHOUSE_USER"), os.Getenv("CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD"))
		response, err := client.Do(request)
		if err != nil {
			return 0, "", err
		}
		defer response.Body.Close()
		body, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, 1024))
		return response.StatusCode, strings.TrimSpace(string(body)), err
	}
	code, body, err := query("SELECT 1 FORMAT TabSeparated")
	if err != nil || code != http.StatusOK || body != "1" {
		return errors.New("CLICKHOUSE_QUERY_FAILED")
	}
	if os.Getenv("PROBE_CLICKHOUSE_TABLE") != "" {
		database, table := os.Getenv("PROBE_CLICKHOUSE_DATABASE"), os.Getenv("PROBE_CLICKHOUSE_TABLE")
		deniedDatabase, deniedTable := os.Getenv("PROBE_CLICKHOUSE_DENIED_DATABASE"), os.Getenv("PROBE_CLICKHOUSE_DENIED_TABLE")
		for _, value := range []string{database, table, deniedDatabase, deniedTable} {
			if value == "" || len(value) > 63 || strings.IndexFunc(value, func(char rune) bool {
				return !(char >= 'a' && char <= 'z' || char >= '0' && char <= '9' || char == '_' || char == '-')
			}) >= 0 {
				return errors.New("CLICKHOUSE_FIXTURE_INVALID")
			}
		}
		code, body, err = query("SELECT count() FROM `" + database + "`.`" + table + "` FORMAT TabSeparated")
		if _, numberErr := strconv.ParseUint(body, 10, 64); err != nil || numberErr != nil || code != http.StatusOK {
			return errors.New("CLICKHOUSE_FIXTURE_SELECT_FAILED")
		}
		code, body, err = query("SELECT count() FROM `" + deniedDatabase + "`.`" + deniedTable + "` FORMAT TabSeparated")
		if err != nil || code == http.StatusOK || !strings.Contains(body, "Code: 497") {
			return errors.New("CLICKHOUSE_SCOPE_UNRESTRICTED")
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func vaultAgent() error {
	// Agent env_template must populate this from an allowed Vault KV path.
	// The value is never included in the status response.
	if os.Getenv("PROBE_VAULT_MARKER") == "" {
		return errors.New("VAULT_TEMPLATE_MISSING")
	}
	return nil
}

func collect(ctx context.Context) status {
	report := status{Overall: "ok", Checks: map[string]check{}, CheckedAt: time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)}
	pool, caPath, err := trustedPool(ctx)
	report.Checks["pkcs12"] = result(err)
	var identity tls.Certificate
	var certPath, keyPath string
	if err == nil {
		identity, certPath, keyPath, err = clientIdentity(ctx)
	}
	report.Checks["pkcs12Client"] = result(err)
	if err == nil {
		report.Checks["postgresql"] = result(postgres(ctx, caPath, certPath, keyPath))
		report.Checks["redis"] = result(redis(ctx, pool, identity, "REDIS"))
		report.Checks["sentinel"] = result(redis(ctx, pool, identity, "SENTINEL"))
		report.Checks["kafka"] = result(kafka(ctx, pool))
		report.Checks["clickhouse"] = result(clickhouse(ctx, pool, identity))
	} else {
		for _, name := range []string{"postgresql", "redis", "sentinel", "kafka", "clickhouse"} {
			report.Checks[name] = check{State: "blocked", Reason: "PKCS12_UNAVAILABLE"}
		}
	}
	report.Checks["vaultAgent"] = result(vaultAgent())
	for _, name := range []string{"pkcs12", "pkcs12Client", "postgresql", "redis", "sentinel", "kafka", "clickhouse", "vaultAgent"} {
		if report.Checks[name].State != "ok" {
			report.Overall = "failed"
		}
	}
	return report
}

func handler(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	if request.URL.Path != "/status" {
		http.NotFound(writer, request)
		return
	}
	if request.Method != http.MethodGet {
		writer.WriteHeader(http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
		return
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(request.Context(), 20*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	report := collect(ctx)
	writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	writer.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	if report.Overall != "ok" {
		writer.WriteHeader(http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
	}
	_ = json.NewEncoder(writer).Encode(report)
}

func main() {
	port := env("PROBE_PORT", "8080")
	if _, err := strconv.Atoi(port); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "INVALID_PORT")
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	server := &http.Server{Addr: "0.0.0.0:" + port, Handler: http.HandlerFunc(handler),
		ReadHeaderTimeout: 5 * time.Second}
	if err := server.ListenAndServe(); !errors.Is(err, http.ErrServerClosed) {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "PROBE_SERVER_FAILED")
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

  if (code === "BINDING_REQUIRED")
    return "Для проверки настройте узел выполнения на странице «Серверы». Сохранённый проект не изменён.";
  if (code === "EXECUTION_NODE_READY_REQUIRED")
    return "Для проверки нужен готовый узел выполнения. Откройте «Серверы» и проверьте его состояние.";
  if (code === "EXECUTION_RUNTIME_IDENTITY_UNCONFIRMED")
    return "Нет подтверждённой привязки к runtime узла выполнения. На странице «Серверы» задайте учётные данные сеанса, проверьте SSH-ключ и подготовьте узел, затем повторите проверку проекта.";

    ? code

function projectFolderNameError(value: string): string | null {
  const leaf = value.trim();
  if (!leaf) return null; // The existing required-field message handles this.
  if (
    value !== leaf ||
    new TextEncoder().encode(leaf).length > 256 ||
    /[<>:"/\\|?*\u0000-\u001f]/u.test(leaf) ||
    leaf === "." ||
    leaf === ".." ||
    leaf.endsWith(".") ||
    /^(con|prn|aux|nul|com[1-9]|lpt[1-9])(\..*)?$/iu.test(leaf)
  ) {
    return "Название должно быть допустимым именем одной папки Windows (не более 256 байт).";
  }
  return null;
}

function certificateSourceOptions(
  managed: OpenResult["managed"],
  intents: StructuralIntent[],
): CertificateSourceOptions {
  const hosts = new Set(Object.keys(managed?.servers || {}));
  const deployments = new Set(Object.keys(managed?.deployments || {}));
  const members = new Map<string, { deploymentId: string; memberId: string }>();
  for (const placement of managed?.memberPlacements || [])
    members.set(`${placement.deploymentId}\u0000${placement.memberId}`, {
      deploymentId: placement.deploymentId,
      memberId: placement.memberId,
    });
  for (const intent of intents) {
    if (intent.operation === "CreateServer") hosts.add(intent.hostId);
    if (intent.operation === "DeleteServer") hosts.delete(intent.hostId);
    if (intent.operation === "CreateServiceDeployment")
      deployments.add(intent.deploymentId);
    if (intent.operation === "DeleteServiceDeployment") {
      deployments.delete(intent.deploymentId);
      for (const [key, member] of members)
        if (member.deploymentId === intent.deploymentId) members.delete(key);
    }
    if (intent.operation === "ReconcileDeploymentPlacement") {
      for (const [key, member] of members)
        if (member.deploymentId === intent.deploymentId) members.delete(key);
      for (const member of intent.members)
        members.set(`${intent.deploymentId}\u0000${member.memberId}`, {
          deploymentId: intent.deploymentId,
          memberId: member.memberId,
        });
    }
  }
  return {
    hosts: [...hosts].sort(),
    deployments: [...deployments].sort(),
    members: [...members.values()]
      .filter((member) => deployments.has(member.deploymentId))
      .sort((left, right) =>
        `${left.deploymentId}\u0000${left.memberId}`.localeCompare(
          `${right.deploymentId}\u0000${right.memberId}`,
        ),
      ),
  };
}

    const root = result.root;

      request = api.getServiceConfigurationPreview();
      servicePreviewRequests.current.set(requestKey, request);
      const pending = request;
      const clear = () => {
        if (servicePreviewRequests.current.get(requestKey) === pending)
          servicePreviewRequests.current.delete(requestKey);
      };
      void pending.then(clear, clear);

          live &&
          value.projectRevision === revision &&
          value.runtimeDigest === runtimeDigest

            selectionKind,
            selectedHostId,
            safeLabel,

          )?.[1];

            `Core-проекция недоступна для текущей сохранённой ревизии.${safeCode ? ` Код: ${safeCode}.` : ""} Показаны безопасные локальные значения.`,
          );
        }
      });
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, [
    api,
    projectOpen,
    result.root,
    result.managed?.projectRevision,
    executionNode?.status,
    executionNode?.runtimeDigest,
    executionNode?.selectionKind,
    executionNode?.selectedHostId,
    executionNode?.safeLabel,

  const create = async (event: React.FormEvent) => {

  const refreshBundleUpdate = async () => {

      setBundleBusy(false);

  const confirmBundleUpdate = async () => {

      if (next.status === "UPDATED" && result.root)
        setResult(await api.openProject(result.root));
    } finally {
      setBundleBusy(false);
    }

  const [lastNodeCheck, setLastNodeCheck] = useState<{
    binding: string;

  } | null>(null);
  const nodeCheckBinding = (context: ExecutionNodeContext | null) =>
    JSON.stringify([
      result.root,

  const probeServerInformation = useCallback(

      if (!api.probeServerInformation)
        throw new Error("SERVER_INFORMATION_UNAVAILABLE");

  const checkServerInformation = async (probeId: string) => {
    if (!api.checkServerInformation)
      throw new Error("SERVER_INFORMATION_UNAVAILABLE");
    const binding = informationBindingRef.current;
    const info = await api.checkServerInformation(probeId);
    if (binding !== informationBindingRef.current)
      throw new Error("SERVER_INFORMATION_BINDING_CHANGED");
    if (info.hostId)
      setServerInformation((current) => ({ ...current, [info.hostId!]: info }));
    if (
      info.status === "CHECKED" &&
      info.hostId === executionNode?.selectedHostId
    ) {
      // Runtime readiness is independent and may take longer than SSH facts.
      void checkExecutionNode().catch(() => {});
    }
    return info;
  };
  const inspectOrphanRun = async () => {
    if (!api.inspectOrphanRun) return;
    setBundleBusy(true);
    try {
      const inspected = await api.inspectOrphanRun();
      setOrphanRun(inspected);
      if (
        ["RESOLVED", "NONE"].includes(inspected.status) &&
        api.chooseRuntimeBundleUpdate
      ) {
        setBundleUpdate(await api.chooseRuntimeBundleUpdate());
      }
    } finally {
      setBundleBusy(false);
    }
  };
  const refreshInstallationState = async () => {
    if (!api.getInstallationState) return;
    const next = await api.getInstallationState();
    setInstallationState(next);
  };
  const attachOrphanRun = async () => {
    if (!api.attachOrphanRun || !orphanRun?.recoveryId) return;
    setBundleBusy(true);
    try {
      const operation = await api.attachOrphanRun(orphanRun.recoveryId);
      if (operation.status !== "READY" || !operation.run) {
        setOrphanRun({
          ...orphanRun,
          status: "BLOCKED",
          error: operation.error,
        });
        return;
      }
      if (
        installationSubscriptionRef.current &&
        api.unsubscribeInstallationRun
      ) {
        await api.unsubscribeInstallationRun(
          installationSubscriptionRef.current,
        );
      }
      installationSubscriptionRef.current = "";
      setInstallationSubscription("");
      setInstallationRun(operation);
      setInstallationEvents([]);
      setRunPlan(undefined);
      activeRunIdRef.current = operation.run.runId;
      lastRecoveryCursorRef.current.delete(operation.run.runId);
      runProgressRef.current = beginRunProgress(operation.run.runId);
      setRunProgress(runProgressRef.current);
      setPage("installation");
      setInstallationTab(operation.result ? "result" : "execution");
      setOrphanRun(null);
      if (api.subscribeInstallationRun) {
        const subscription = await api.subscribeInstallationRun(
          operation.run.runId,
          0,
        );
        installationSubscriptionRef.current = subscription.subscriptionId || "";
        setInstallationSubscription(installationSubscriptionRef.current);
      }
    } finally {
      setBundleBusy(false);
    }
  };
  const installationOrderRef = useRef<string[]>([]);
  const createInstallationPlan = async (
    deploymentOrder: string[],
    executionMode: InstallationExecutionMode = "FULL_PROJECT",
  ) => {
    if (
      ["STARTING", "RUNNING", "CANCELLING"].includes(
        installationRun?.run?.state || "",
      )
    )
      return;
    if (!api.createInstallationPlan && !api.createInstallationPlanForMode)
      return;
    setInstallationBusy(true);
    installationOrderRef.current = deploymentOrder;
    try {
      const operation: InstallationPlanOperation =
        api.createInstallationPlanForMode
          ? await api.createInstallationPlanForMode({
              executionMode,
              deploymentOrder,
              applicationVaultSources: {},
            })
          : executionMode === "FULL_PROJECT" && api.createInstallationPlan
            ? await api.createInstallationPlan(deploymentOrder)
            : {
                status: "BLOCKED",
                error: {
                  code: "EXECUTION_MODE_RUNTIME_UNSUPPORTED",
                  message:
                    "Режим библиотек не поддерживается текущим transport. Полная установка не запущена.",
                },
              };
      setInstallationPlan(operation);
      await refreshInstallationState();
      setInstallationTab("plan");
    } finally {
      setInstallationBusy(false);
    }
  };
  const approveInstallationPlan = async (
    planId: string,
    acknowledgements: string[],
  ) => {
    if (
      ["STARTING", "RUNNING", "CANCELLING"].includes(
        installationRun?.run?.state || "",
      )
    )
      return;
    if (!api.approveInstallationPlan) return;
    setInstallationBusy(true);
    try {
      if (
        (installationPlan?.plan?.executionMode || "FULL_PROJECT") !==
        installationExecutionMode
      ) {
        if (!api.createInstallationPlanForMode) return;
        const fresh = await api.createInstallationPlanForMode({
          executionMode: installationExecutionMode,
          deploymentOrder: installationOrderRef.current,
          applicationVaultSources: {},
        });
        setInstallationPlan(fresh);
        const previous = installationPlan?.plan;
        const next = fresh.plan;
        if (
          !next ||
          next.status !== "EXECUTABLE" ||
          fresh.error ||
          installationExecutionMode === "FULL_PROJECT" ||
          next.executionNodeId !== previous?.executionNodeId ||
          JSON.stringify(next.runtime) !== JSON.stringify(previous?.runtime) ||
          next.projectRevision !== previous?.projectRevision ||
          next.acknowledgements.some(
            (item) =>
              !previous.acknowledgements.some(
                (old) =>
                  old.code === item.code &&
                  old.summary === item.summary &&
                  acknowledgements.includes(item.code),
              ),
          )
        ) {
          await refreshInstallationState();
          return;
        }
        planId = next.id;
        acknowledgements = next.acknowledgements.map((item) => item.code);
      }
      const operation = await api.approveInstallationPlan(
        planId,
        acknowledgements,
      );
      setInstallationPlan(operation);
      if (operation.error) setApprovalErrorAttempt((attempt) => attempt + 1);
      await refreshInstallationState();
    } finally {
      setInstallationBusy(false);
    }
  };
  const startApprovedInstallation = async (planId: string) => {
    if (
      ["STARTING", "RUNNING", "CANCELLING"].includes(
        installationRun?.run?.state || "",
      )
    )
      return;
    if (!api.startApprovedInstallation) return;
    setInstallationBusy(true);
    try {
      const operation = await api.startApprovedInstallation(planId);
      if (operation.status === "BLOCKED" && api.getInstallationPlan) {
        setInstallationPlan(await api.getInstallationPlan(planId));
      }
      setInstallationRun(operation);
      setInstallationEvents([]);
      setRunPlan(operation.run ? installationPlan?.plan : undefined);
      activeRunIdRef.current = operation.run?.runId || "";
      runProgressRef.current = operation.run
        ? beginRunProgress(operation.run.runId, installationPlan?.plan)
        : undefined;
      setRunProgress(runProgressRef.current);
      setInstallationTab("execution");
      if (operation.run && api.subscribeInstallationRun) {
        if (
          installationSubscriptionRef.current &&
          api.unsubscribeInstallationRun
        ) {
          await api.unsubscribeInstallationRun(
            installationSubscriptionRef.current,
          );
          installationSubscriptionRef.current = "";
        }
        const subscription = await api.subscribeInstallationRun(
          operation.run.runId,
          0,
        );
        installationSubscriptionRef.current = subscription.subscriptionId || "";
        setInstallationSubscription(installationSubscriptionRef.current);
      }
      await refreshInstallationState();
    } finally {
      setInstallationBusy(false);
    }
  };
  const cancelInstallationRun = async (runId: string) => {
    if (!api.cancelInstallationRun) return;
    setInstallationBusy(true);
    try {
      const operation = await api.cancelInstallationRun(runId);
      setInstallationRun({
        ...operation,
        run: operation.run ?? installationRun?.run,
      } as InstallationRunOperation);
      if (operation.status !== "BLOCKED") {
        setInstallationPlan(undefined);
        await refreshInstallationState();
      }
    } finally {
      setInstallationBusy(false);
    }
  };
  const setOutputEncryptionPassword = async (
    password: string,
    confirm: string,
  ) => {
    if (!api.setSecretOutputEncryptionPassword)
      throw new Error("SECRET_OUTPUT_UNAVAILABLE");
    await api.setSecretOutputEncryptionPassword(password, confirm);
    if (installationPlan?.plan?.id && api.getInstallationPlan) {
      setInstallationPlan(
        await api.getInstallationPlan(installationPlan.plan.id),
      );
    }
  };
  const refreshSecretOutputs = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!api.listPendingSecretOutputs) return;
    try {
      setSecretOutputPackages(await api.listPendingSecretOutputs());
    } catch {
      setSecretOutputPackages(secretOutputListingUnavailable());
    }
  }, [api]);
  const collectAndDeliverSecretOutputs = useCallback(
    async (runId: string, manual = false) => {
      if (!api.listPendingSecretOutputs) return;
      let pending: SecretOutputPackagesOperation;
      try {
        pending = await api.listPendingSecretOutputs();
      } catch {
        setSecretOutputPackages(secretOutputListingUnavailable());
        return;
      }
      setSecretOutputPackages(pending);
      const plan = installationPlan?.plan;
      if (
        pending.status !== "READY" ||
        (!manual &&
          (!plan?.secretOutputEncryptionRequired ||
            !plan.secretOutputEncryptionPasswordPresent))
      )
        return;
      const candidates = [...(pending.packages || [])];
      let cursor = pending.nextCursor;
      const seen = new Set<string>();
      for (let page = 1; cursor && page < 128; page++) {
        if (seen.has(cursor)) break;
        seen.add(cursor);
        let next: SecretOutputPackagesOperation;
        try {
          next = await api.listPendingSecretOutputs(cursor);
        } catch {
          setSecretOutputPackages(secretOutputListingUnavailable());
          return;
        }
        if (next.status !== "READY") break;
        candidates.push(...(next.packages || []));
        cursor = next.nextCursor;
      }
      for (const item of candidates) {
        if (
          (!manual && runId && item.sourceRunId !== runId) ||
          item.state === "LOCAL_DELIVERED"
        )
          continue;
        if (!api.deliverPendingSecretOutput) break;
        try {
          const delivery = await api.deliverPendingSecretOutput(item.packageId);
          setOutputDelivery(delivery);
          if (delivery.status !== "DELIVERED") break;
        } catch {
          setOutputDelivery(secretOutputDeliveryUnavailable());
          return;
        }
      }
      try {
        setSecretOutputPackages(await api.listPendingSecretOutputs());
      } catch {
        setSecretOutputPackages(secretOutputListingUnavailable());
      }
    },
    [api, installationPlan?.plan],
  );
  const recoverInstallationRunEvents = useCallback(
    async (runId: string, afterSequence: number) => {
      if (
        !api.subscribeInstallationRun ||
        !api.unsubscribeInstallationRun ||
        resyncingRunIdRef.current === runId
      )
        return;
      const lastAttempt = lastRecoveryCursorRef.current.get(runId);
      if (lastAttempt !== undefined && afterSequence <= lastAttempt) return;

            <strong>{title}</strong>
            <span>
              {result.root || "Выберите существующий проект или создайте новый"}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="app-header-statuses">
            {projectOpen && (
              <div className={sessionId ? "unsaved" : "readonly"}>
                {sessionId ? "Есть несохранённые изменения" : "Сохранено"}
              </div>
            )}
            {projectOpen &&
              (verification.error ? (
                <button
                  className="readonly outline"
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setPage("project")}
                  title={verificationErrorMessage(verification.error.code)}
                >
                  {verificationLabel(verification.status, true)}
                </button>
              ) : (
                <div className="readonly">
                  {verificationLabel(verification.status)}
                </div>
              ))}
          </div>
          {projectOpen && (
            <button
              className="execution-node-badge"
              aria-label="Открыть узел выполнения"
              onClick={() => setPage("servers")}
              title="Открыть узел выполнения на странице «Серверы»"
            >
              Узел выполнения:{" "}
              {executionNodeStatusLabel(
                executionNode?.status || "NOT_CONFIGURED",
              )}
              {executionNode?.safeLabel
                ? ` · ${executionNode.safeLabel.split(" · ")[0]}`
                : ""}
            </button>
          )}
          {projectOpen && (
            <button
              type="button"
              className={`installation-global-status ${installationView.tone}`}
              onClick={() => {
                setPage("installation");
                setInstallationTab(
                  installationView.stage === "result"
                    ? "result"
                    : installationView.stage === "execution"
                      ? "execution"
                      : "summary",
                );
              }}
              aria-label={`Открыть установку: ${installationView.label}${installationView.percent === undefined ? "" : `, ${installationView.percent}%`}`}
            >
              <strong>
                {installationView.label}
                {installationView.percent === undefined
                  ? ""
                  : ` · ${installationView.percent}%`}
              </strong>
              <small>{installationView.detail}</small>
            </button>
          )}
          <div className="app-header-actions">
            <button
              className="outline"
              onClick={() => setProjectDialog(true)}
              disabled={loading || creating || !!sessionId || refreshRequired}
            >
              Создать проект
            </button>
            <button
              className="outline"
              onClick={open}
              disabled={loading || creating || !!sessionId || refreshRequired}
            >
              Открыть проект
            </button>
            {sessionId && commandCount > 0 && (
              <button onClick={review} disabled={editBusy}>
                Сохранить
              </button>
            )}
            {projectOpen && (
              <button
                className="outline"
                onClick={verify}
                disabled={
                  editBusy ||
                  refreshRequired ||
                  verification.status === "VERIFYING"
                }
              >
                Проверить
              </button>
            )}
            {api.exitApplication && (
              <button
                className="outline"
                type="button"
                disabled={hostExitStatus !== ""}
                onClick={() => {
                  void api.exitApplication!()
                    .then((exit) => {
                      setHostExitStatus(
                        exit.status === "EXIT_AFTER_RUN"
                          ? "Приложение завершит работу после текущего выполнения."
                          : "Приложение завершает работу.",
                      );
                    })
                    .catch(() =>
                      setHostExitStatus("Не удалось завершить приложение."),
                    );
                }}
              >
                Выйти
              </button>
            )}
            {hostExitStatus && (
              <span role="status" aria-live="polite">
                {hostExitStatus}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        </header>
        <div className="workspace-content">
          {refreshRequired && (
            <section className="card refresh-required" role="alert">
              <h2>Проект сохранён, но текущее представление не обновлено</h2>
              <p>
                Канонические файлы уже записаны. Повторное сохранение
                недоступно, пока проект не будет безопасно перечитан.
              </p>
              {refreshError && <p className="field-error">{refreshError}</p>}
              <button
                onClick={refreshCommittedProject}
                disabled={editBusy || !refreshRoot}
              >
                Обновить проект
              </button>
            </section>
          )}
          {(loading || creating) && (
            <section className="card">
              {creating ? "Безопасное создание проекта…" : "Открытие проекта…"}
            </section>
          )}
          {!loading &&
            !creating &&
            result.status === "NO_PROJECT" &&
            page === "project" && (
              <section className="empty card">
                <h1>Создайте или откройте проект</h1>
                <p>
                  Новый проект содержит только метаданные и закреплённые версии
                  из проверенного локального пакета.
                </p>
                <button onClick={() => setProjectDialog(true)}>
                  Создать проект
                </button>
                <button className="outline" onClick={open}>
                  Открыть папку проекта
                </button>
              </section>
            )}
          {!loading &&
            !creating &&
            result.status === "ERROR" &&
            page === "project" && (
              <section className="error card">
                <h1>Проект не открыт</h1>
                <p>{result.error?.message}</p>
                <code>{result.error?.code}</code>
                <button onClick={() => setProjectDialog(true)}>
                  Создать проект
                </button>
                <button className="outline" onClick={open}>
                  Открыть другой проект
                </button>
              </section>
            )}
          {!loading && !creating && projectOpen && page === "project" && (
            <ProjectPage
              empty={!!empty}
              snapshot={snapshot}
              managed={managed}
              catalogStatus={result.catalog?.status}
              verification={verification}
              local={local}
              onClose={close}
              onServers={() => setPage("servers")}
              closeDisabled={!!sessionId || refreshRequired}
              exportAvailable={
                !sessionId &&
                !refreshRequired &&
                !!api.planProjectExport &&
                !!api.commitProjectExport
              }
              onExport={openExport}
              bundleUpdate={bundleUpdate}
              bundleBusy={bundleBusy}
              onRefreshBundle={refreshBundleUpdate}
              onConfirmBundle={confirmBundleUpdate}
            />
          )}
          {!loading && !creating && projectOpen && page === "servers" && (
            <ServersPage
              snapshot={snapshot}
              managed={managed}
              empty={!!empty}
              intents={intents.filter(
                (intent): intent is ServerIntent =>
                  intent.operation === "CreateServer" ||
                  intent.operation === "UpdateServer" ||
                  intent.operation === "DeleteServer",
              )}
              serverTypes={serverTypes}
              configError={configError}
              busy={editBusy}
              structuralDisabled={refreshRequired}
              onAppend={appendStructuralIntent}
              onReview={review}
              onDiscard={discard}
              commandCount={commandCount}
              credentialStatus={credentialStatus}
              onSetCredential={setSessionCredential}
              onClearCredential={clearSessionCredential}
              serverInformation={serverInformation}
              onProbeServerInformation={
                api.probeServerInformation ? probeServerInformation : undefined
              }
              onCheckServerInformation={
                api.checkServerInformation ? checkServerInformation : undefined
              }
              cachedNodeReadiness={
                lastNodeCheck?.binding === nodeCheckBinding(executionNode)
                  ? lastNodeCheck.readiness
                  : null
              }
              executionNode={executionNode}
              onSelectExecutionNode={selectExecutionNode}
              onCheckExecutionNode={checkExecutionNode}
              onProbeExecutionNodeHostKey={probeExecutionNodeHostKey}
              onApproveExecutionNodeHostKey={approveExecutionNodeHostKey}
              onDeclineExecutionNodeHostKey={declineExecutionNodeHostKey}
              onProbeTargetHostKey={probeTargetHostKey}
              onApproveTargetHostKey={approveTargetHostKey}
              onDeclineTargetHostKey={declineTargetHostKey}
              onPlanExecutionNodePreparation={planExecutionNodePreparation}
              runRecoveryPanel={
                <>
                  <button
                    className="outline"
                    onClick={inspectOrphanRun}
                    disabled={bundleBusy}
                  >
                    Проверить прежний запуск
                  </button>
                  {orphanRun?.runId && (
                    <div className="row" role="status">
                      <span>Запуск: {orphanRun.runId}</span>
                      {orphanRun.projectRevision && (
                        <span>Ревизия: {orphanRun.projectRevision}</span>
                      )}
                      <span>{orphanRun.runState}</span>
                      {orphanRun.status === "FOUND" && (
                        <button
                          className="outline"
                          disabled={bundleBusy}
                          onClick={attachOrphanRun}
                        >
                          Подключиться
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )}
                  {orphanRun?.status === "NONE" && (
                    <p role="status">Прежний активный запуск не найден.</p>
                  )}
                  {orphanRun?.status === "UNAVAILABLE" && (
                    <p role="status">
                      Запуск недоступен. Проверьте SSH-доступ и исходный узел
                      исполнения.
                    </p>
                  )}
                  {orphanRun?.status === "UNKNOWN" && (
                    <p role="status">
                      Состояние прежнего запуска не подтверждено.
                    </p>
                  )}
                  {orphanRun?.error && (
                    <p role="alert">{orphanRun.error.message}</p>
                  )}
                </>
              }
              onPrepareExecutionNode={prepareExecutionNode}
            />
          )}
          {!loading && !creating && projectOpen && page === "topology" && (
            <TopologyPage
              managed={managed}
              catalog={result.catalog}
              intents={intents.filter(
                (
                  intent,
                ): intent is
                  | DeploymentIntent
                  | PlacementIntent
                  | EndpointIntent
                  | ProviderIntent =>
                  intent.operation === "CreateServiceDeployment" ||
                  intent.operation === "DeleteServiceDeployment" ||
                  intent.operation === "ReconcileDeploymentPlacement" ||
                  intent.operation ===
                    "ReconcileHostScopedDeploymentPlacement" ||
                  intent.operation === "CreateEndpointGroup" ||
                  intent.operation === "UpdateEndpointGroup" ||
                  intent.operation === "DeleteEndpointGroup" ||
                  intent.operation === "SetServiceEndpointGroup" ||
                  intent.operation === "ClearServiceEndpointGroup" ||
                  intent.operation === "ReconcileEndpointProvider" ||
                  intent.operation === "ClearEndpointProvider",
              )}
              serverIntents={intents.filter(
                (intent): intent is ServerIntent =>
                  intent.operation === "CreateServer" ||
                  intent.operation === "UpdateServer" ||
                  intent.operation === "DeleteServer",
              )}
              busy={editBusy}
              structuralDisabled={refreshRequired}
              commandCount={commandCount}
              onAppend={appendStructuralIntent}
              onReview={review}
              onDiscard={discard}
              activeTab={topologyTab}
              onActiveTabChange={setTopologyTab}
              selectedDeploymentId={selectedTopologyDeployment}
              onSelectedDeploymentChange={setSelectedTopologyDeployment}
              selectedHostId={selectedTopologyHost}
              onSelectedHostChange={setSelectedTopologyHost}
              onConfigureDeployment={(deploymentId) => {
                setSelectedTopologyDeployment(deploymentId);
                setSelectedServiceDeployment(deploymentId);
                setSelectedServiceMember("");
                setFocusServiceMemberSettings(false);
                setServicesView("detail");
                setPage("services");
              }}
              onConfigureMember={(deploymentId, memberId) => {
                setSelectedTopologyDeployment(deploymentId);
                setSelectedServiceDeployment(deploymentId);
                setSelectedServiceMember(memberId);
                setFocusServiceMemberSettings(true);
                setServicesView("detail");
                setPage("services");
              }}
              preview={endpointPreview}
              verificationStatus={verification.status}
            />
          )}
          {!loading && !creating && projectOpen && page === "services" && (
            <ServicesPage
              key={serviceFormEpoch}
              managed={managed}
              catalog={result.catalog}
              effectivePreview={visibleServiceConfigurationPreview}
              corePreviewNotice={serviceConfigurationPreviewNotice}
              deploymentIntents={intents.filter(
                (intent): intent is DeploymentIntent =>
                  intent.operation === "CreateServiceDeployment" ||
                  intent.operation === "DeleteServiceDeployment",
              )}
              placementIntents={intents.filter(
                (intent): intent is PlacementIntent =>
                  intent.operation === "ReconcileDeploymentPlacement" ||
                  intent.operation === "ReconcileHostScopedDeploymentPlacement",
              )}
              certificateIntents={intents.filter(
                (intent): intent is CertificateIntent =>
                  intent.operation === "CreateCertificateAuthority" ||
                  intent.operation === "UpdateCertificateAuthority" ||
                  intent.operation === "DeleteCertificateAuthority" ||
                  intent.operation === "CreateCertificateProfile" ||
                  intent.operation === "UpdateCertificateProfile" ||
                  intent.operation === "DeleteCertificateProfile" ||
                  intent.operation === "CreateTLSProfile" ||
                  intent.operation === "UpdateTLSProfile" ||
                  intent.operation === "DeleteTLSProfile" ||
                  intent.operation === "CreateCertificateScope" ||
                  intent.operation === "UpdateCertificateScope" ||
                  intent.operation === "DeleteCertificateScope",
              )}
              configurationIntents={intents.filter(
                (intent): intent is ConfigurationIntent =>
                  intent.operation === "SetServiceConfigurationValue" ||
                  intent.operation === "RemoveServiceConfigurationOverride",
              )}
              busy={editBusy}
              structuralDisabled={refreshRequired}
              commandCount={commandCount}
              error={editError?.message}
              view={servicesView}
              selectedDeploymentId={selectedServiceDeployment}
              selectedMemberId={selectedServiceMember}
              focusMemberSettings={focusServiceMemberSettings}
              onSelectedMemberChange={setSelectedServiceMember}
              onOpenDeployment={(deploymentId) => {
                setSelectedServiceDeployment(deploymentId);
                setSelectedServiceMember("");
                setFocusServiceMemberSettings(false);
                setServicesView("detail");
              }}
              onBackToList={() => {
                setServicesView("list");
                setSelectedServiceDeployment("");
                setSelectedServiceMember("");
                setFocusServiceMemberSettings(false);
              }}
              onOpenTopology={() => setPage("topology")}
              onAmend={amendConfigurationIntent}
              onManageCertificates={(memberId) => {
                setCertificateReturn({
                  deploymentId: selectedServiceDeployment,
                  memberId,
                });
                setPage("certificates");
              }}
              onAppend={appendStructuralIntent}
              onReview={review}
              onDiscard={discard}
              onGetPendingRuntimeSecretDescriptors={
                getPendingRuntimeSecretDescriptors
              }
              onSetPendingDeploymentRuntimeSecretValues={
                setPendingDeploymentRuntimeSecretValues
              }
              onChoosePendingDeploymentRuntimeSecretFile={
                choosePendingDeploymentRuntimeSecretFile
              }
            />
          )}
          {!loading && !creating && projectOpen && page === "certificates" && (
            <CertificatesPage
              managed={managed}
              intents={intents.filter(
                (intent): intent is CertificateIntent =>
                  intent.operation === "CreateCertificateAuthority" ||
                  intent.operation === "UpdateCertificateAuthority" ||
                  intent.operation === "DeleteCertificateAuthority" ||
                  intent.operation === "CreateCertificateProfile" ||
                  intent.operation === "UpdateCertificateProfile" ||
                  intent.operation === "DeleteCertificateProfile" ||
                  intent.operation === "CreateTLSProfile" ||
                  intent.operation === "UpdateTLSProfile" ||
                  intent.operation === "DeleteTLSProfile" ||
                  intent.operation === "CreateCertificateScope" ||
                  intent.operation === "UpdateCertificateScope" ||
                  intent.operation === "DeleteCertificateScope",
              )}
              busy={editBusy}
              structuralDisabled={refreshRequired}
              commandCount={commandCount}
              sourceOptions={certificateSources}
              verification={verification}
              verifiedPKI={verifiedPKI}
              credentialStatus={credentialStatus}
              onAppend={appendStructuralIntent}
              onSetPKIStorePassword={setPKIStorePassword}
              onReview={review}
              onDiscard={discard}
              onVerify={verify}
              onReturnToServices={
                certificateReturn
                  ? () => {
                      setSelectedServiceDeployment(
                        certificateReturn.deploymentId,
                      );
                      setSelectedServiceMember(
                        certificateReturn.memberId || "",
                      );
                      setServicesView("detail");
                      setPage("services");
                      setCertificateReturn(null);
                    }
                  : undefined
              }
            />
          )}
          {!loading && !creating && projectOpen && page === "installation" && (
            <InstallationPage
              key={result.root}
              onGetRuntimeSecretDescriptors={api.getRuntimeSecretDescriptors}
              onSetRuntimeSecretValues={api.setDeploymentRuntimeSecretValues}
              state={installationState}
              draftActive={!!sessionId || refreshRequired}
              tab={installationTab}
              onTabChange={setInstallationTab}
              onOpenServers={() => setPage("servers")}
              plan={installationPlan}
              infrastructureObservation={infrastructureObservation}
              selectedExecutionMode={installationExecutionMode}
              onExecutionModeChange={setInstallationExecutionMode}
              busy={installationBusy}
              onCreatePlan={createInstallationPlan}
              serviceDeployments={Object.values(
                result.managed?.deployments || {},
              ).map((item) => ({
                deploymentId: item.deploymentId,
                serviceType: item.serviceType,
              }))}
              serviceExecutionPriorities={serviceExecutionPriorities}
              onApprovePlan={approveInstallationPlan}
              approvalErrorAttempt={approvalErrorAttempt}
              run={installationRun}
              runPlan={runPlan}
              runProgress={runProgress}
              events={installationEvents}
              credentialStatus={credentialStatus}
              onSetOutputEncryptionPassword={setOutputEncryptionPassword}
              secretOutputPackages={secretOutputPackages}
              outputDelivery={outputDelivery}
              onRefreshSecretOutputs={() => void refreshSecretOutputs()}
              onCollectSecretOutputs={() =>
                collectAndDeliverSecretOutputs(
                  installationRun?.run?.runId || "",
                  true,
                )
              }
              onStart={startApprovedInstallation}
              onCancel={cancelInstallationRun}
            />
          )}
          {!loading && !creating && (
            <UtilityPages
              page={page}
              managed={managed}
              projectSettingDraftValues={projectSettingValuesFromDraft(intents)}
              onAppendProjectSetting={appendStructuralIntent}
              editError={editError}
              events={installationEvents}
              runId={installationRun?.run?.runId}
              configVersion={applicationConfigVersion}
              serverTypes={serverTypes}
              configError={configError}
              onNavigate={setPage}
            />
          )}
          {projectDialog && (
            <div className="modal" role="presentation">
              <form className="card dialog" onSubmit={create}>
                <h1>Создать проект</h1>
                <label>
                  Название проекта
                  <input
                    maxLength={256}
                    value={name}
                    onChange={(event) => {
                      setName(event.target.value);
                      setNameRequired(false);
                      setCreateError(null);
                    }}
                    autoFocus
                    aria-invalid={nameRequired || !!nameError}
                  />
                </label>
                {nameRequired && (
                  <p className="field-error" role="alert">
                    Заполните «Название проекта»: оно задаёт новую папку
                    проекта.
                  </p>
                )}
                {nameError && (
                  <p className="field-error" role="alert">
                    {nameError}
                  </p>
                )}
                <label>
                  Новая папка проекта
                  <input
                    required
                    value={destination}
                    onChange={(event) => updateDestination(event.target.value)}
                    onBlur={adoptDestinationParent}
                    placeholder="C:\\Projects\\production"
                  />
                </label>
                <div className="actions">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="outline"
                    onClick={chooseParent}
                  >
                    Выбрать родительскую папку
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="outline"
                    onClick={() => setProjectDialog(false)}
                  >
                    Отмена
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    disabled={creating || !destination.trim()}
                  >
                    Создать проект
                  </button>
                </div>
                {createError && (
                  <p className="field-error" role="alert">
                    <code>{createError.code}</code> {createError.message}
                  </p>
                )}
                <p>
                  Название проекта всегда задаёт последнюю папку в пути. Будет
                  создан только <code>project.yml</code>.
                </p>
              </form>
            </div>
          )}
          {reviewOpen && (
            <ReviewDialog
              edit={edit}
              error={editError}
              busy={editBusy}
              onClose={() => setReviewOpen(false)}
              onReview={review}
              onSave={save}
              onDiscard={discard}
            />
          )}
          {exportDialog && (
            <ProjectExportDialog
              parent={exportParent}
              name={exportName}
              operation={exportOperation}
              busy={exportBusy}
              onParentChange={setExportParent}
              onNameChange={setExportName}
              onChooseParent={chooseExportParent}
              onPreview={previewExport}
              onCommit={commitExport}
              onReopen={reopenExport}
              onClose={() => !exportBusy && setExportDialog(false)}
            />
          )}
        </div>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

function ProjectPage({
  catalogStatus,
  bundleUpdate,
  bundleBusy,
  onRefreshBundle,
  onConfirmBundle,
  empty,
  snapshot,
  managed,
  verification,
  local,
  onClose,
  onServers,
  closeDisabled,
  exportAvailable,
  onExport,
}: {
  catalogStatus?: string;
  bundleUpdate: RuntimeBundleUpdate | null;
  bundleBusy: boolean;
  onRefreshBundle: () => void;
  onConfirmBundle: () => void;
  empty: boolean;
  snapshot: OpenResult["snapshot"];
  managed: OpenResult["managed"];
  verification: NonNullable<OpenResult["verification"]>;
  local: OpenResult["project"];
  onClose: () => void;
  onServers: () => void;
  closeDisabled: boolean;
  exportAvailable: boolean;
  onExport: () => void;
}) {
  const bundleCard = (
    <section className="card" aria-label="Набор установки">
      <h2>Набор установки</h2>
      {catalogStatus !== "READY" && (
        <p role="status">
          Нужна перепривязка набора установки: сохранённые данные проекта
          доступны, но текущий проверенный набор не соответствует проекту или
          отсутствует. Проверка Core и новый план пока недоступны.
        </p>
      )}
      <p>
        Поместите полученный набор целиком в папку bundle внутри проекта.
        Обнаружение не меняет привязку.
      </p>
      <button
        className="outline"
        onClick={onRefreshBundle}
        disabled={bundleBusy}
      >
        Проверить новый набор
      </button>
      {bundleUpdate?.status === "NOT_FOUND" && <p>Новый набор не найден.</p>}
      {bundleUpdate?.status === "UNCHANGED" && (
        <p>Набор уже привязан к проекту.</p>
      )}
      {bundleUpdate?.status === "PREVIEW" && (
        <>
          <dl>
            <dt>Текущий digest</dt>
            <dd>{bundleUpdate.currentArtifactDigest}</dd>
            <dt>Новый digest</dt>
            <dd>{bundleUpdate.newArtifactDigest}</dd>
            <dt>Каталог</dt>
            <dd>{bundleUpdate.newCatalogDigest}</dd>
            <dt>Версия набора / Core</dt>
            <dd>
              {bundleUpdate.bundleVersion} / {bundleUpdate.coreVersion}
            </dd>
          </dl>
          <p>
            После привязки прежняя проверка и одобренный план станут
            недействительными. Перед установкой заново подготовьте узел,
            проверьте проект и создайте план.
          </p>
          <button onClick={onConfirmBundle} disabled={bundleBusy}>
            Привязать
          </button>
        </>
      )}
      {bundleUpdate?.status === "UPDATED" && (
        <p>
          Новый набор привязан. Подготовьте узел выполнения и создайте свежий
          план.
        </p>
      )}
      {bundleUpdate?.status === "BLOCKED" &&
        bundleUpdate.error?.code !== "INSTALLATION_RUN_ACTIVE" && (
          <p role="alert">
            Привязка сейчас недоступна:{" "}
            {bundleUpdate.error?.message ||
              bundleUpdate.error?.code ||
              "проверьте набор и состояние выполнения"}
            .
          </p>
        )}
      {bundleUpdate?.status === "BLOCKED" &&
        bundleUpdate.error?.code &&
        bundleUpdate.error.code !== "INSTALLATION_RUN_ACTIVE" && (
          <p className="muted">Код: {bundleUpdate.error.code}</p>
        )}
      {bundleUpdate?.error?.code === "INSTALLATION_RUN_ACTIVE" && (
        <div role="alert">
          <p>
            Прежний запуск установки не подтверждён как завершённый. Проверка
            нового набора пока недоступна.
          </p>
          <p>
            Перейдите на страницу «Серверы», восстановите доступ к узлу
            выполнения и нажмите «Проверить прежний запуск».
          </p>
          <button className="outline" onClick={onServers}>
            Перейти к серверам
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
      {bundleUpdate?.status === "PUBLISHED_NOT_BOUND" && (
        <p role="alert">
          Набор опубликован, но проект не перепривязан. Проверьте проект и
          повторите операцию.
        </p>
      )}
      {bundleUpdate?.status === "BOUND_REFRESH_REQUIRED" && (

function ProjectExportDialog({
  parent,
  name,
  operation,
  busy,
  onParentChange,
  onNameChange,
  onChooseParent,
  onPreview,
  onCommit,
  onReopen,
  onClose,
}: {
  parent: string;
  name: string;
  operation: ProjectExportOperationResult | null;
  busy: boolean;

  onNameChange: (value: string) => void;

function reviewFindingMessage(code: string, fallback: string): string {
  if (code === "REFERENCE_IN_USE") {
    if (
      fallback.startsWith("Нельзя удалить экземпляр:") ||
      fallback.startsWith("Нельзя удалить группу endpoint:")
    )
      return fallback;
    return "Объект используется. Сначала удалите связанные ссылки.";
  }
  if (code === "INVALID_VALUE")
    return "Значение не соответствует ограничениям каталога.";
  return fallback;
}

function ReviewDialog({
  edit,
  error,
  busy,
  onClose,
  onReview,
  onSave,
  onDiscard,
}: {
  edit: EditResult | null;
  error: EditResult["error"] | null;
  busy: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onReview: () => void;
  onSave: () => void;
  onDiscard: () => void;
}) {
  const plan = edit?.plan;
  const conflict =
    error?.code === "EDIT_COMMAND_CONFLICT" ||
    plan?.finding?.code === "EDIT_COMMAND_CONFLICT";
  return (
    <div className="modal" role="presentation">
      <section
        className="card dialog review-dialog"
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby="review-title"
      >
        <h1 id="review-title">Изменения конфигурации</h1>
        {error && (
          <p className="field-error" role="alert">
            <code>{error.code}</code>{" "}
            {reviewFindingMessage(error.code, error.message)}
          </p>
        )}
        {plan ? (
          <>
            {plan.finding && (
              <p className="field-error" role="alert">
                <code>{plan.finding.code}</code>{" "}
                {reviewFindingMessage(
                  plan.finding.code,
                  plan.finding.safeMessage,
                )}
              </p>
            )}
            {plan.status === "NO_CHANGE" ? (
              <p role="status">
                Изменения не затрагивают файлы проекта — сохранять нечего.
                Пароль PKCS#12 хранится только в текущем сеансе и не
                записывается в проект.
              </p>
            ) : (
              <p>
                Локальная структурная проверка завершена. Документов:{" "}
                {plan.affectedDocuments?.length ?? 0}.
              </p>
            )}
            <ul>
              {plan.semanticChanges?.map((change, index) => (
                <li key={index}>{change.safeSummary}</li>
              ))}
            </ul>
            {plan.affectedDocuments && plan.affectedDocuments.length > 0 && (
              <>
                <h2>Затрагиваемые документы</h2>
                <ul>
                  {plan.affectedDocuments.map((document) => (
                    <li key={document.logicalPath}>
                      {document.logicalPath}: {document.before?.state} →{" "}
                      {document.after?.state}
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              </>
            )}
          </>
        ) : (
          <p>Проверка черновика ещё не вернула план.</p>
        )}
        <div className="actions">
          <button className="outline" onClick={onClose}>
            Вернуться к редактированию
          </button>
          <button className="outline" onClick={onDiscard} disabled={busy}>
            Отменить все изменения
          </button>
          {plan?.saveAllowed ? (
            <button onClick={onSave} disabled={busy}>
              Сохранить проект
            </button>
          ) : !conflict && plan?.status !== "NO_CHANGE" ? (
            <button onClick={onReview} disabled={busy}>
              {busy ? "Проверка…" : "Повторить проверку"}
            </button>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}
function Stat({ label, value }: { label: string; value: number | string }) {
  return (
    <article className="stat">
      <span>{label}</span>
      <strong>{value}</strong>
      {value === 0 && <small>Нет данных</small>}
    </article>
  );
}

import { useRef, useState } from "react";
import type {
  RuntimeSecretDescriptorOperation,
  RuntimeSecretValuesInput,
} from "./backend";

export function ApplicationSecretInputs({
  disabled,
  load,
  save,
}: {
  disabled: boolean;
  load: () => Promise<RuntimeSecretDescriptorOperation>;
  save: (input: RuntimeSecretValuesInput) => Promise<void>;
}) {
  const dialog = useRef<HTMLDialogElement>(null);
  const [operation, setOperation] =
    useState<RuntimeSecretDescriptorOperation>();
  const [values, setValues] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const close = () => {
    setValues({});
    setOperation(undefined);
    dialog.current?.close();
  };
  const open = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    setMessage("");
    try {
      const result = await load();
      if (result.status !== "READY") {
        setMessage(result.error?.message || "Требования к секретам недоступны");
        return;
      }
      if (!result.applicationInputs?.length) {
        setMessage("Секреты библиотек не требуются");
        return;
      }
      setValues({});
      setOperation(result);
      dialog.current?.showModal();
    } catch {
      setMessage("Не удалось получить требования к секретам");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };
  return (
    <section className="card">
      <button
        type="button"
        disabled={disabled || busy}
        onClick={() => void open()}
      >
        Секреты библиотек
      </button>
      {message && <p role="status">{message}</p>}
      <dialog
        ref={dialog}
        className="runtime-secret-dialog"
        aria-label="Секреты библиотек"
        onCancel={(event) => {
          event.preventDefault();
          close();
        }}
      >
        <form
          method="dialog"
          onSubmit={(event) => {
            event.preventDefault();
            if (
              !operation?.projectRevision ||
              !operation.descriptorSetFingerprint
            )
              return;
            setBusy(true);
            void save({
              projectRevision: operation.projectRevision,
              descriptorSetFingerprint: operation.descriptorSetFingerprint,
              serviceDeployment: "",
              values,
            })
              .then(() => {
                close();
                setMessage("Секреты сохранены только в сессии");
              })
              .catch(() => {
                setValues({});
                setMessage(
                  "Не удалось сохранить секреты; проверьте актуальность проекта и сессии",
                );
              })
              .finally(() => setBusy(false));
          }}
        >
          <h2>Секреты библиотек</h2>
          <p className="muted">
            Значения остаются только в памяти и передаются через runtime lease
            для одобренного плана.
          </p>
          {operation?.applicationInputs?.map((item) => (
            <label key={item.requirementRef}>
              {item.displayLabel}
              <input
                type="password"
                autoComplete="new-password"
                required
                disabled={disabled || busy}
                value={values[item.requirementRef] || ""}
                onChange={(event) =>
                  setValues((current) => ({
                    ...current,
                    [item.requirementRef]: event.target.value,
                  }))
                }
              />
            </label>
          ))}
          <button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={close}>
            Отмена
          </button>
          <button type="submit" disabled={disabled || busy}>
            Сохранить в сессии
          </button>
        </form>
      </dialog>
    </section>
  );
}

const operations: Record<
  PKIKind,
  {
    create: CertificateIntent["operation"];
    update: CertificateIntent["operation"];
    remove: CertificateIntent["operation"];

  authority: {

function rowsFor(
  kind: PKIKind,
  managed: OpenResult["managed"],
  intents: CertificateIntent[],
): Rows {
  const pki = managed?.pki;
  const source =
    kind === "authority"
      ? pki?.authorities
      : kind === "profile"
        ? pki?.profiles
        : kind === "tls"
          ? pki?.tlsProfiles
          : pki?.scopes;
  const rows: Rows = { ...(source || {}) };
  for (const intent of intents) {
    const operation = operations[kind];
    if (
      (intent.operation === operation.create ||
        intent.operation === operation.update) &&
      "entity" in intent
    )
      rows[intent.entityId] = intent.entity;
    if (intent.operation === operation.remove) delete rows[intent.entityId];
  }
  return rows;
}

const parseList = (value: string) =>

const asRecord = (value: unknown): PKIEntity =>
  value && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value)
    ? (value as PKIEntity)
    : {};
