              aria-label={labels[kind]}
              aria-current={selectedKind === kind ? "page" : undefined}
              onClick={() => setSelectedKind(kind)}
            >
              <span className="certificate-type-title">
                <span className="certificate-type-step">{index + 1}</span>
                <span>{labels[kind]}</span>
                <span className="certificate-type-count">
                  {Object.keys(allRows[kind]).length}
                </span>
              </span>
              <small>{dependencyHints[kind]}</small>
            </button>
          ))}
        </nav>
        <article
          className="card certificate-section"
          aria-labelledby="selected-certificate-section"
        >
          <div className="section-head">
            <div>
              <h2 id="selected-certificate-section">{labels[selectedKind]}</h2>
              <small>{sectionHint(selectedKind)}</small>
            </div>
            <button
              className="outline"
              disabled={blocked}
              onClick={() => setEditor({ kind: selectedKind })}
            >
              Добавить
            </button>
          </div>
          <CertificateRows
            kind={selectedKind}
            rows={allRows[selectedKind]}
            disabled={blocked}
            onEdit={(id) => setEditor({ kind: selectedKind, id })}
            onDelete={remove}
          />
          {selectedKind === "tls" && pkiPasswordPresent && (
            <p className="muted" role="status">
              Пароль PKCS#12 сохранён в текущем сеансе. В проект он не записывается.
            </p>
          )}
        </article>
      </div>
      <CoreVerification
        verification={verification || { status: "UNVERIFIED" }}
        view={verifiedPKI}
        disabled={
          busy ||
          commandCount > 0 ||
          verification?.status === "VERIFYING" ||
          !onVerify
        }
        onVerify={onVerify || (() => undefined)}
      />
      {editor && (
        <CertificateDialog
          key={`${editor.kind}:${editor.id || "new"}`}
          kind={editor.kind}
          entityId={editor.id}
          entity={editor.id ? allRows[editor.kind][editor.id] : undefined}
          authorityIds={Object.keys(allRows.authority).sort()}
          profileIds={Object.keys(allRows.profile).sort()}
          sourceOptions={sourceOptions}
          disabled={blocked}
          pkiPasswordPresent={pkiPasswordPresent}
          onSetPKIStorePassword={onSetPKIStorePassword}
          onClose={() => setEditor(null)}
          onSubmit={async (entityId, entity) => {
            const operation = editor.id
              ? operations[editor.kind].update
              : operations[editor.kind].create;
            if (
              await onAppend({
                operation: operation as CertificateIntent["operation"],
                entityId,
                entity,
              } as CertificateIntent)
            )
              setEditor(null);
          }}
        />
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

function CoreVerification({
  verification,
  view,
  disabled,
  onVerify,
}: {
  verification: VerificationStatus;
  view?: VerifiedPKIView;
  disabled: boolean;
  onVerify: () => void;
}) {
  const status =
    verification.status === "INVALID"
      ? "INVALID"
      : verification.status === "UNAVAILABLE"
        ? "UNAVAILABLE"
        : verification.status === "STALE"
          ? "STALE"
          : verification.status === "VERIFIED"
            ? view?.status === "CURRENT"
              ? "CURRENT"
              : "STALE"
            : verification.status === "VERIFYING"
              ? "NOT_VERIFIED"
              : view?.status || "NOT_VERIFIED";
  const findings = view?.findings || verification.findings || [];
  return (
    <article className="card certificate-verification">
      <div className="section-head">
        <div>
          <h2>Проверка Core</h2>
          <small>
            Имена и SAN отображаются только по актуальным данным проверки Core.
          </small>
        </div>
        <button disabled={disabled} onClick={onVerify}>
          {verification.status === "VERIFYING" ? "Проверка…" : "Проверить"}
        </button>
      </div>
      <p className="muted">
        Влияние виртуального IP поставщика определяет Core после сохранения и
        проверки. Этот экран не выпускает и не перевыпускает сертификаты.
      </p>
      {status === "CURRENT" && view?.identities?.length ? (
        <div className="verified-identities">
          {view.identities.map((identity) => (
            <section key={identity.id} className="verified-identity">
              <b>{identity.id}</b>
              <small>
                {identity.scope} · Профиль TLS: {identity.tlsProfileId}
              </small>
              <div>
                <span>DNS: </span>
                {identity.dnsNames.join(", ") || "—"}
              </div>
              <div>
                <span>IP: </span>
                {identity.ipAddresses.join(", ") || "—"}
              </div>
              <div>
                <span>Потребители: </span>
                {identity.consumers
                  .map(
                    (consumer) =>
                      `${consumer.deploymentId}/${consumer.memberId} @ ${consumer.hostId}`,
                  )
                  .join(", ") || "—"}
              </div>
            </section>
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : status === "CURRENT" ? (
        <p className="muted">
          Core подтвердил проект; потребителей сертификатов нет.
        </p>
      ) : (
        <p className={status === "INVALID" ? "field-error" : "muted"}>
          {verificationMessage(
            status,
            view?.error?.message || verification.error?.message,
          )}
        </p>
      )}
      {!!findings.length && (
        <ul className="verification-findings">
          {findings.map((finding, index) => (
            <li key={`${finding.code}:${finding.subjectId || index}`}>
              <b>{finding.code}</b>: {finding.summary}
              {finding.subjectId ? ` (${finding.subjectId})` : ""}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </article>
  );
}

function verificationMessage(status: string, error?: string) {
  switch (status) {
    case "INVALID":
      return "Core обнаружил ошибки проверки. Сохранённый проект не откатывается.";
    case "STALE":
      return "Проверка устарела: запустите проверку сохранённой ревизии снова.";
    case "UNAVAILABLE":
      return error || "Для проверки нужен готовый узел выполнения.";
    default:
      return error || "Проект ещё не проверен Core.";
  }
}

function sectionHint(kind: PKIKind) {
  if (kind === "authority") return "Только управляемый центр сертификации.";
  if (kind === "profile")
    return "Центр сертификации, назначения ключа, правила SAN и параметры владельца.";
  if (kind === "tls") return "Только ссылка на секрет, без самого пароля.";
  return "Источники: серверы, сервисы, их экземпляры и явные DNS/IP.";
}

function DraftActions({
  commandCount,
  blocked,
  onReview,
  onDiscard,
}: {
  commandCount: number;
  blocked: boolean;
  onReview: () => void;
  onDiscard: () => void;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="actions">
      <span className="muted">{commandCount} / 16 изменений</span>
      {commandCount > 0 && (
        <>
          <button className="outline" disabled={blocked} onClick={onDiscard}>
            Отменить изменения
          </button>
          <button disabled={blocked} onClick={onReview}>
            Просмотреть изменения
          </button>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function CertificateRows({
  kind,
  rows,
  disabled,
  onEdit,
  onDelete,
}: {
  kind: PKIKind;
  rows: Rows;
  disabled: boolean;
  onEdit: (id: string) => void;
  onDelete: (kind: PKIKind, id: string) => Promise<void>;
}) {
  const values = Object.entries(rows).sort(([left], [right]) =>
    left.localeCompare(right),
  );
  if (!values.length)
    return <p className="muted">Нет сохранённых или черновых записей.</p>;
  return (
    <div className="certificate-rows">
      {values.map(([id, entity]) => (
        <div className="certificate-row" key={id}>
          <div>
            <b>{id}</b>
            <small>{rowSummary(kind, entity)}</small>
          </div>
          <div className="actions">
            <button
              className="link"
              disabled={disabled}
              onClick={() => onEdit(id)}
            >
              Изменить
            </button>
            <button
              className="link danger"
              disabled={disabled}
              onClick={() => void onDelete(kind, id)}
            >
              Удалить
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

function rowSummary(kind: PKIKind, entity: PKIEntity) {
  if (kind === "authority") return String(entity.commonName || "MANAGED");
  if (kind === "profile") return `CA: ${String(entity.authorityRef || "—")}`;
  if (kind === "tls")
    return `Profile: ${String(entity.certificateProfileRef || "—")} · ${secretRefLabel(entity.storePasswordSecretRef)}`;
  return `Profile: ${String(entity.profile || "—")} · ${Object.keys(asRecord(entity.sources)).length} sources`;
}

function CertificateDialog({
  kind,
  entityId,
  entity,
  authorityIds,
  profileIds,
  sourceOptions,
  disabled,
  pkiPasswordPresent,
  onSetPKIStorePassword,
  onClose,
  onSubmit,
}: {
  kind: PKIKind;
  entityId?: string;
  entity?: PKIEntity;
  authorityIds: string[];
  profileIds: string[];
  sourceOptions: CertificateSourceOptions;
  disabled: boolean;
  pkiPasswordPresent: boolean;
  onSetPKIStorePassword?: (value: string) => Promise<SessionCredentialStatus>;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSubmit: (id: string, entity: PKIEntity) => Promise<void>;
}) {
  const existing = asRecord(entity);
  const [id, setID] = useState(entityId || "");
  const [displayName, setDisplayName] = useState(
    String(existing.displayName || ""),
  );
  const [commonName, setCommonName] = useState(
    String(existing.commonName || ""),
  );
  const [authorityRef, setAuthorityRef] = useState(
    String(existing.authorityRef || authorityIds[0] || ""),
  );
  const [profileRef, setProfileRef] = useState(
    String(
      existing.certificateProfileRef || existing.profile || profileIds[0] || "",
    ),
  );
  const [scope, setScope] = useState(String(existing.scope || ""));
  const [secretInput, setSecretInput] = useState("");
  const [keyAlgorithm, setKeyAlgorithm] = useState(
    String(existing.keyAlgorithm || ""),
  );
  const [keySize, setKeySize] = useState(
    existing.keySize === undefined ? "" : String(existing.keySize),
  );
  const [validityDays, setValidityDays] = useState(
    existing.validityDays === undefined ? "" : String(existing.validityDays),
  );
  const [usages, setUsages] = useState(stringList(existing.usages));
  const [usagesPresent, setUsagesPresent] = useState(
    Object.hasOwn(existing, "usages"),
  );
  const [sanPolicy, setSanPolicy] = useState(asRecord(existing.sanPolicy));
  const [subject, setSubject] = useState(asRecord(existing.subject));
  const sources = asRecord(existing.sources);
  const [hosts, setHosts] = useState(stringList(sources.hosts));
  const [deployments, setDeployments] = useState(
    stringList(sources.serviceDeployments),
  );
  const [members, setMembers] = useState(
    (Array.isArray(sources.members) ? sources.members : []).flatMap((item) => {
      const value = asRecord(item);
      const deploymentId = value.deploymentId;
      const memberId = value.memberId;
      return typeof deploymentId === "string" && typeof memberId === "string"
        ? [{ deploymentId, memberId }]
        : [];
    }),
  );
  const [dnsNames, setDnsNames] = useState(listText(sources.explicitDnsNames));
  const [ipAddresses, setIPAddresses] = useState(
    listText(sources.explicitIpAddresses),
  );
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const tlsSettingsUnchanged =
    kind === "tls" &&
    !!entityId &&
    Object.keys(existing).every((key) =>
      ["certificateProfileRef", "storePasswordSecretRef", "scope"].includes(key),
    ) &&
    String(existing.certificateProfileRef || "") === profileRef &&
    String(existing.storePasswordSecretRef || "") ===
      "runtime:pki-store-password" &&
    String(existing.scope || "") === scope;
  const submit = async (event: React.FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!id.trim()) return setError("Укажите ID записи.");
    if (kind === "tls" && secretInput.length > 0) {
      if (!onSetPKIStorePassword) {
        setError("Не удалось сохранить пароль в текущем сеансе.");
        return;
      }
      try {
        await onSetPKIStorePassword(secretInput);
        setSecretInput("");
      } catch (reason) {
        const code = reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : String(reason);
        setError(
          code === "PKI_STORE_PASSWORD_INPUT_INVALID"
            ? "Пароль не соответствует допустимым ограничениям."
            : code === "PKI_STORE_PASSWORD_UNAVAILABLE"
              ? "Сначала сохраните учётные данные для выбранного узла выполнения."
              : "Не удалось сохранить пароль в текущем сеансе.",
        );
        return;
      }
    }
    const result = entityFor(kind, {
      displayName,
      commonName,
      authorityRef,
      profileRef,
      scope,
      keyAlgorithm,
      keySize,
      validityDays,
      usages,
      usagesPresent,
      sanPolicy,
      subject,
      hosts,
      deployments,
      members,
      dnsNames,
      ipAddresses,
    });
    if (!result)
      return setError("Проверьте поля области применения сертификатов.");
    setError("");
    if (tlsSettingsUnchanged) {
      onClose();
      return;
    }
    await onSubmit(id.trim(), result);
  };
  return (
    <div className="modal" role="presentation">
      <form className="card dialog certificate-dialog" onSubmit={submit}>
        <h1>
          {entityId ? "Изменить" : "Добавить"}: {labels[kind]}
        </h1>
        <label>
          ID
          <input
            value={id}
            disabled={!!entityId || disabled}
            onChange={(event) => setID(event.target.value)}
            autoFocus
          />
        </label>
        {kind !== "tls" && (
          <OptionalText
            label="Отображаемое имя"
            value={displayName}
            onChange={setDisplayName}
          />
        )}
        {kind === "authority" && (
          <>
            <label>
              Общее имя (CN)
              <input
                value={commonName}
                onChange={(event) => setCommonName(event.target.value)}
                required
              />
            </label>
            <OptionalNumber
              label="Срок действия (дней)"
              value={validityDays}
              onChange={setValidityDays}
            />
          </>
        )}
        {kind === "profile" && (
          <ProfileFields
            authorityRef={authorityRef}
            authorityIds={authorityIds}
            onAuthorityRef={setAuthorityRef}
            keyAlgorithm={keyAlgorithm}
            onKeyAlgorithm={setKeyAlgorithm}
            keySize={keySize}
            onKeySize={setKeySize}
            validityDays={validityDays}
            onValidityDays={setValidityDays}
            usages={usages}
            onUsages={(value) => {
              setUsagesPresent(true);
              setUsages(value);
            }}
            sanPolicy={sanPolicy}
            onSanPolicy={setSanPolicy}
            subject={subject}
            onSubject={setSubject}
          />
        )}
        {kind === "tls" && (
          <>
            <ReferenceSelect
              label="Профиль сертификата"
              value={profileRef}
              values={profileIds}
              onChange={setProfileRef}
            />
            <label>
              Область применения
              <select
                value={scope}
                onChange={(event) => setScope(event.target.value)}
              >
                <option value="">Наследуется</option>
                <option value="HOST">Сервер</option>
                <option value="MEMBER">Экземпляр</option>
                <option value="DEPLOYMENT">Развёртывание</option>
              </select>
            </label>
            <label>
              Пароль хранилищ PKCS#12
              <input
                type="password"
                autoComplete="new-password"
                value={secretInput}
                onChange={(event) => setSecretInput(event.target.value)}
                placeholder={
                  pkiPasswordPresent
                    ? "Сохранён в текущем сеансе; введите новый для замены"
                    : "Введите пароль для хранилищ PKCS#12"
                }
                disabled={disabled}
              />
            </label>
            <p className="muted" role="status">
              {pkiPasswordPresent
                ? "Пароль хранится только в текущем сеансе. Для замены введите новый; проект содержит только фиксированную ссылку на секрет."
                : "Пароль сохранится только в текущем сеансе. Проект содержит только фиксированную ссылку на секрет."}
            </p>
          </>
        )}
        {kind === "scope" && (
          <ScopeFields
            profileRef={profileRef}
            profileIds={profileIds}
            onProfileRef={setProfileRef}
            scope={scope}
            onScope={setScope}
            hosts={hosts}
            onHosts={setHosts}
            deployments={deployments}
            onDeployments={setDeployments}
            members={members}
            onMembers={setMembers}
            sourceOptions={sourceOptions}
            dnsNames={dnsNames}
            onDNSNames={setDnsNames}
            ipAddresses={ipAddresses}
            onIPAddresses={setIPAddresses}
          />
        )}
        {error && <p className="field-error">{error}</p>}
        <div className="actions">
          <button type="button" className="outline" onClick={onClose}>
            Отмена
          </button>
          <button disabled={disabled || (tlsSettingsUnchanged && !secretInput)} type="submit">
            {tlsSettingsUnchanged && secretInput
              ? "Сохранить пароль в сеансе"
              : "Добавить в черновик"}
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}

function OptionalText({
  label,
  value,
  onChange,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <label>
      {label}
      <input
        value={value}
        onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.value)}
        placeholder="Наследуется"
      />
    </label>
  );
}
function OptionalNumber({
  label,
  value,
  onChange,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <label>
      {label}
      <input
        type="number"
        min="1"
        value={value}
        onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.value)}
        placeholder="Наследуется"
      />
    </label>
  );
}
function ReferenceSelect({
  label,
  value,
  values,
  onChange,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  values: string[];
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <label>
      {label}
      <select
        value={value}
        onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.value)}
        required
      >
        <option value="">Выберите</option>
        {values.map((item) => (
          <option key={item}>{item}</option>
        ))}
      </select>
    </label>
  );
}

function ProfileFields(props: {
  authorityRef: string;
  authorityIds: string[];
  onAuthorityRef: (value: string) => void;
  keyAlgorithm: string;
  onKeyAlgorithm: (value: string) => void;
  keySize: string;
  onKeySize: (value: string) => void;
  validityDays: string;
  onValidityDays: (value: string) => void;
  usages: string[];
  onUsages: (value: string[]) => void;
  sanPolicy: PKIEntity;
  onSanPolicy: (value: PKIEntity) => void;
  subject: PKIEntity;
  onSubject: (value: PKIEntity) => void;
}) {
  const policyLabels: Record<string, string> = {
    includeHostDns: "DNS-имена серверов",
    includeHostIp: "IP-адреса серверов",
    includeEndpointFqdns: "FQDN точек входа",
    includeEndpointWildcard: "Wildcard-имена точек входа",
    includeEndpointVip: "Виртуальные IP точек входа",
  };
  return (
    <>
      <ReferenceSelect
        label="Центр сертификации"
        value={props.authorityRef}
        values={props.authorityIds}
        onChange={props.onAuthorityRef}
      />
      <label>
        Алгоритм ключа
        <select
          value={props.keyAlgorithm}
          onChange={(event) => props.onKeyAlgorithm(event.target.value)}
        >
          <option value="">Наследуется</option>
          <option>RSA</option>
          <option>EC</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <OptionalNumber
        label="Размер ключа"
        value={props.keySize}
        onChange={props.onKeySize}
      />
      <OptionalNumber
        label="Срок действия (дней)"
        value={props.validityDays}
        onChange={props.onValidityDays}
      />
      <fieldset>
        <legend>Назначение сертификата</legend>
        {["serverAuth", "clientAuth"].map((usage) => (
          <label key={usage}>
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={props.usages.includes(usage)}
              onChange={(event) =>
                props.onUsages(
                  event.target.checked
                    ? [...props.usages, usage]
                    : props.usages.filter((item) => item !== usage),
                )
              }
            />
            {usage === "serverAuth"
              ? "Серверная аутентификация"
              : "Клиентская аутентификация"}
          </label>
        ))}
      </fieldset>
      <fieldset>
        <legend>Переопределение правил SAN</legend>
        {Object.keys(policyLabels).map((key) => (
          <label key={key}>
            {policyLabels[key]}
            <select
              aria-label={policyLabels[key]}
              value={
                typeof props.sanPolicy[key] === "boolean"
                  ? String(props.sanPolicy[key])
                  : ""
              }
              onChange={(event) => {
                const next = { ...props.sanPolicy };
                if (event.target.value === "") delete next[key];
                else next[key] = event.target.value === "true";
                props.onSanPolicy(next);
              }}
            >
              <option value="">Наследуется</option>
              <option value="true">Включено</option>
              <option value="false">Выключено</option>
            </select>
          </label>
        ))}
      </fieldset>
      <fieldset>
        <legend>Переопределение полей субъекта</legend>
        {["C", "ST", "L", "O", "OU"].map((key) => (
          <label key={key}>
            {key}
            <input
              value={String(props.subject[key] || "")}
              onChange={(event) =>
                props.onSubject({ ...props.subject, [key]: event.target.value })
              }
            />
          </label>
        ))}
      </fieldset>
    </>
  );
}

function ScopeFields(props: {
  profileRef: string;
  profileIds: string[];
  onProfileRef: (value: string) => void;
  scope: string;
  onScope: (value: string) => void;
  hosts: string[];
  onHosts: (value: string[]) => void;
  deployments: string[];
  onDeployments: (value: string[]) => void;
  members: Array<{ deploymentId: string; memberId: string }>;
  onMembers: (value: Array<{ deploymentId: string; memberId: string }>) => void;
  sourceOptions: CertificateSourceOptions;
  dnsNames: string;
  onDNSNames: (value: string) => void;
  ipAddresses: string;
  onIPAddresses: (value: string) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <>
      <ReferenceSelect
        label="Профиль сертификата"
        value={props.profileRef}
        values={props.profileIds}
        onChange={props.onProfileRef}
      />
      <label>
        Область применения
        <select
          value={props.scope}
          onChange={(event) => props.onScope(event.target.value)}
        >
          <option value="">Наследуется</option>
          <option value="HOST">Сервер</option>
          <option value="MEMBER">Экземпляр</option>
          <option value="DEPLOYMENT">Развёртывание</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <ReferenceChoices
        label="Серверы"
        values={props.sourceOptions.hosts}
        selected={props.hosts}
        onChange={props.onHosts}
      />
      <ReferenceChoices
        label="Развёртывания"
        values={props.sourceOptions.deployments}
        selected={props.deployments}
        onChange={props.onDeployments}
      />
      <MemberChoices
        values={props.sourceOptions.members}
        selected={props.members}
        onChange={props.onMembers}
      />
      <OptionalText
        label="Явные DNS-имена"
        value={props.dnsNames}
        onChange={props.onDNSNames}
      />
      <OptionalText
        label="Явные IP-адреса"
        value={props.ipAddresses}
        onChange={props.onIPAddresses}
      />
    </>
  );
}

function ReferenceChoices({
  label,
  values,
  selected,
  onChange,
}: {
  label: string;
  values: string[];
  selected: string[];
  onChange: (value: string[]) => void;
}) {
  const options = [...new Set([...values, ...selected])].sort();
  return (
    <fieldset>
      <legend>{label}</legend>
      {!options.length && (
        <small>Нет доступных записей в текущем черновике.</small>
      )}
      {options.map((value) => (
        <label key={value}>
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            checked={selected.includes(value)}
            onChange={(event) =>
              onChange(
                event.target.checked
                  ? [...selected, value]
                  : selected.filter((item) => item !== value),
              )
            }
          />
          {value}
        </label>
      ))}
    </fieldset>
  );
}

function MemberChoices({
  values,
  selected,
  onChange,
}: {
  values: Array<{ deploymentId: string; memberId: string }>;
  selected: Array<{ deploymentId: string; memberId: string }>;
  onChange: (value: Array<{ deploymentId: string; memberId: string }>) => void;
}) {
  const key = (value: { deploymentId: string; memberId: string }) =>
    `${value.deploymentId}\u0000${value.memberId}`;
  const options = [
    ...new Map(
      [...values, ...selected].map((value) => [key(value), value]),
    ).values(),
  ];
  return (
    <fieldset>
      <legend>Экземпляры</legend>
      {!options.length && (
        <small>В текущем черновике нет размещённых экземпляров.</small>
      )}
      {options.map((value) => (
        <label key={key(value)}>
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            checked={selected.some((item) => key(item) === key(value))}
            onChange={(event) =>
              onChange(
                event.target.checked
                  ? [...selected, value]
                  : selected.filter((item) => key(item) !== key(value)),
              )
            }
          />
          {value.deploymentId}/{value.memberId}
        </label>
      ))}
    </fieldset>
  );
}

function entityFor(
  kind: PKIKind,
  input: {
    displayName: string;
    commonName: string;
    authorityRef: string;
    profileRef: string;
    scope: string;
    keyAlgorithm: string;
    keySize: string;
    validityDays: string;
    usages: string[];
    usagesPresent: boolean;
    sanPolicy: PKIEntity;
    subject: PKIEntity;
    hosts: string[];
    deployments: string[];
    members: Array<{ deploymentId: string; memberId: string }>;
    dnsNames: string;
    ipAddresses: string;
  },
): PKIEntity | null {
  const optional = (value: string) => value.trim() || undefined;
  const number = (value: string) => (value.trim() ? Number(value) : undefined);
  if (kind === "authority")
    return {
      mode: "MANAGED",
      commonName: input.commonName.trim(),
      ...(optional(input.displayName) && {
        displayName: optional(input.displayName),
      }),
      ...(number(input.validityDays) !== undefined && {
        validityDays: number(input.validityDays),
      }),
    };
  if (kind === "profile") {
    const subject = Object.fromEntries(
      Object.entries(input.subject).filter(([, value]) => String(value).trim()),
    );
    return {
      authorityRef: input.authorityRef,
      sanPolicy: input.sanPolicy,
      ...(optional(input.displayName) && {
        displayName: optional(input.displayName),
      }),
      ...(optional(input.keyAlgorithm) && {
        keyAlgorithm: optional(input.keyAlgorithm),
      }),
      ...(number(input.keySize) !== undefined && {
        keySize: number(input.keySize),
      }),
      ...(number(input.validityDays) !== undefined && {
        validityDays: number(input.validityDays),
      }),
      ...(input.usagesPresent && { usages: input.usages }),
      ...(Object.keys(subject).length && { subject }),
    };
  }
  if (kind === "tls")
    return {
      certificateProfileRef: input.profileRef,
      storePasswordSecretRef: "runtime:pki-store-password",
      ...(optional(input.scope) && { scope: optional(input.scope) }),
    };
  const sources: PKIEntity = {};
  const add = (key: string, values: string[]) => {
    if (values.length) sources[key] = values;
  };
  add("hosts", input.hosts);
  add("serviceDeployments", input.deployments);
  if (input.members.length) sources.members = input.members;
  add("explicitDnsNames", parseList(input.dnsNames));
  add("explicitIpAddresses", parseList(input.ipAddresses));
  return {
    profile: input.profileRef,
    sources,
    ...(optional(input.displayName) && {
      displayName: optional(input.displayName),
    }),
    ...(optional(input.scope) && { scope: optional(input.scope) }),
  };
}

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import type { EndpointPreview, OpenResult, VerificationStatus } from "./backend";
import type { DeploymentIntent } from "./TopologyPage";

export type EndpointIntent =
  | {
      operation: "CreateEndpointGroup";
      endpointGroupId: string;
      endpointGroup: { address: { domain: string; wildcard: boolean } };
    }
  | {
      operation: "UpdateEndpointGroup";
      endpointGroupId: string;
      endpointGroup: { address: { domain: string; wildcard: boolean } };
    }
  | { operation: "DeleteEndpointGroup"; endpointGroupId: string }
  | {
      operation: "SetServiceEndpointGroup";
      deploymentId: string;
      endpointGroupId: string;
    }
  | { operation: "ClearServiceEndpointGroup"; deploymentId: string };

export type ProviderIntent =
  | {
      operation: "ReconcileEndpointProvider";
      deploymentId: string;
      endpointGroupId: string;
      virtualRouterId: number;
      virtualAddresses: Array<{ address: string; interface: string }>;
    }
  | { operation: "ClearEndpointProvider"; deploymentId: string };

type EntryPointsIntent = EndpointIntent | ProviderIntent;

type Group = {
  id: string;
  domain: string;
  wildcard: boolean;
  state?: "new" | "deleting";
};
type Deployment = {
  id: string;
  serviceType: string;
  mode: string;
  endpointGroup?: string;
  endpointGroupRef?: string;
  virtualRouterId?: number;
  virtualAddresses?: Array<{ address: string; interface: string }>;
  providerEditState?: "NONE" | "EDITABLE" | "INCOMPLETE" | "UNSUPPORTED";
  state?: "new" | "deleting";
};
const idPattern = /^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:[-_.][a-z0-9]+)*$/;

function finalGroups(
  managed: OpenResult["managed"],
  intents: EndpointIntent[],
) {
  const values = new Map<string, Group>();
  for (const [id, group] of Object.entries(managed?.endpointGroups || {}))
    values.set(id, { id, domain: group.domain, wildcard: group.wildcard });
  for (const intent of intents) {
    if (intent.operation === "CreateEndpointGroup")
      values.set(intent.endpointGroupId, {
        id: intent.endpointGroupId,
        ...intent.endpointGroup.address,
        state: "new",
      });
    if (intent.operation === "UpdateEndpointGroup") {
      const current = values.get(intent.endpointGroupId);
      if (current)
        values.set(intent.endpointGroupId, {
          ...current,
          ...intent.endpointGroup.address,
        });
    }
    if (intent.operation === "DeleteEndpointGroup") {
      const current = values.get(intent.endpointGroupId);
      if (current)
        values.set(intent.endpointGroupId, { ...current, state: "deleting" });
    }
  }
  return [...values.values()].sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id));
}

function finalDeployments(
  managed: OpenResult["managed"],
  deploymentIntents: DeploymentIntent[],
  intents: EndpointIntent[],
  providerIntents: ProviderIntent[],
) {
  const values = new Map<string, Deployment>();
  for (const [id, item] of Object.entries(managed?.deployments || {}))
    values.set(id, {
      id,
      serviceType: item.serviceType,
      mode: item.mode,
      endpointGroup: item.endpointGroup,
      endpointGroupRef: item.endpointGroupRef,
      virtualRouterId: item.virtualRouterId,
      virtualAddresses: item.virtualAddresses,
      providerEditState: item.providerEditState,
    });
  for (const intent of deploymentIntents) {
    if (intent.operation === "CreateServiceDeployment")
      values.set(intent.deploymentId, {
        id: intent.deploymentId,
        serviceType: intent.serviceType,
        mode: intent.mode,
        state: "new",
      });
    if (intent.operation === "DeleteServiceDeployment") {
      const current = values.get(intent.deploymentId);
      if (current)
        values.set(intent.deploymentId, { ...current, state: "deleting" });
    }
  }
  for (const intent of intents) {
    if (intent.operation === "SetServiceEndpointGroup") {
      const current = values.get(intent.deploymentId);
      if (current)
        values.set(intent.deploymentId, {
          ...current,
          endpointGroup: intent.endpointGroupId,
        });
    }
    if (intent.operation === "ClearServiceEndpointGroup") {
      const current = values.get(intent.deploymentId);
      if (current)
        values.set(intent.deploymentId, {
          ...current,
          endpointGroup: undefined,
        });
    }
  }
  for (const intent of providerIntents) {
    const current = values.get(intent.deploymentId);
    if (!current) continue;
    if (intent.operation === "ReconcileEndpointProvider")
      values.set(intent.deploymentId, {
        ...current,
        endpointGroupRef: intent.endpointGroupId,
        virtualRouterId: intent.virtualRouterId,
        virtualAddresses: intent.virtualAddresses,
        providerEditState: "EDITABLE",
      });
    if (intent.operation === "ClearEndpointProvider")
      values.set(intent.deploymentId, {
        ...current,
        endpointGroupRef: undefined,
        virtualRouterId: undefined,
        virtualAddresses: undefined,
        providerEditState: "NONE",
      });
  }
  return [...values.values()].sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id));
}

export function EntryPointsView({
  managed,

  intents,
  providerIntents,
  deploymentIntents,
  preview,
  verificationStatus,
  busy,
  disabled,
  commandCount,
  onAppend,
}: {
  managed: OpenResult["managed"];
  catalog: OpenResult["catalog"];
  intents: EndpointIntent[];
  providerIntents: ProviderIntent[];
  deploymentIntents: DeploymentIntent[];
  preview?: EndpointPreview;
  verificationStatus: VerificationStatus["status"];
  busy: boolean;
  disabled: boolean;
  commandCount: number;
  onAppend: (intent: EntryPointsIntent) => Promise<boolean>;
}) {
  const [dialog, setDialog] = useState<{
    mode: "add" | "edit";
    group?: Group;
  } | null>(null);
  const [providerDialog, setProviderDialog] = useState<Deployment | null>(null);
  const groups = useMemo(
    () => finalGroups(managed, intents),
    [managed, intents],
  );
  const deployments = useMemo(
    () =>
      finalDeployments(managed, deploymentIntents, intents, providerIntents),
    [managed, deploymentIntents, intents, providerIntents],
  );
  const catalogReady = catalog?.status === "READY";
  const limit = commandCount >= 16;
  const groupLocked = (id: string) =>
    intents.some(
      (item) => "endpointGroupId" in item && item.endpointGroupId === id,
    );
  const deploymentLocked = (id: string) =>
    intents.some((item) =>
      item.operation === "SetServiceEndpointGroup" ||
      item.operation === "ClearServiceEndpointGroup"
        ? item.deploymentId === id
        : false,
    );
  const eligible = (serviceType: string) =>
    catalog?.services?.find((item) => item.id === serviceType)
      ?.endpointConsumer === true;
  const providerEligible = (serviceType: string) =>
    catalog?.services?.find((item) => item.id === serviceType)
      ?.endpointProvider === true;
  const providerLocked = (id: string) =>
    providerIntents.some((item) => item.deploymentId === id);
  const providerDeployments = deployments.filter((item) =>
    item.state === "deleting"
      ? false
      : catalogReady
        ? providerEligible(item.serviceType)
        : !!item.endpointGroupRef ||
          item.providerEditState === "INCOMPLETE" ||
          item.providerEditState === "UNSUPPORTED",
  );
  return (
    <>
      {preview?.status === "INVALID" && (
        <section className="entry-findings" role="alert">
          <strong>Адреса и provider/VIP не показаны: проверка Core выявила ошибки.</strong>
          {preview.findings?.map((finding) => (
            <p key={`${finding.code}-${finding.subjectId || ""}`}>
              {finding.code}: {finding.summary}
            </p>
          ))}
        </section>
      )}
      {providerIntents.length > 0 && (
        <p className="entry-draft-notice" role="status">
          Конфигурация provider изменена в черновике; влияние на PKI/SAN определяет только Core.
        </p>
      )}
      {!preview && verificationStatus !== "VERIFIED" && (
        <p className="entry-draft-notice" role="status">
          {verificationStatus === "UNAVAILABLE"
            ? "Core сейчас недоступен; проект не изменён."
            : "Актуальные данные Core пока не получены; сохраните проект и выполните проверку."}
        </p>
      )}
      <section className="title topology-title">
        <div>
          <h1>Точки входа</h1>
          <p>
            Группы адресов, назначения потребителей и параметры provider/VIP.
          </p>
          {commandCount > 0 && (
            <p className="muted">
              Черновик: {commandCount} из 16 · осталось {Math.max(0, 16 - commandCount)}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={() => setDialog({ mode: "add" })}
          disabled={busy || disabled || limit}
        >
          Добавить группу
        </button>
      </section>
      <div className="entry-grid">
        <section className="card entry-panel">
          <h2 className="entry-panel-title">

            <span>Группы endpoint</span>
          </h2>
          {groups.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="muted">Групп пока нет.</p>
          ) : (
            <div className="entry-list">
              {groups.map((group) => (
                <div key={group.id} className="entry-row">
                  <div>
                    <b>{group.id}</b>
                    <span>
                      {group.domain}
                      {group.wildcard ? " · wildcard" : ""}
                    </span>
                    {group.state && (
                      <small
                        className={`entry-state-chip ${group.state === "new" ? "entry-state-chip--info" : "entry-state-chip--warning"}`}
                      >

                          {group.state === "new" ? "+" : "!"}
                        </span>
                        {group.state === "new" ? "Новая" : "Будет удалена"}
                      </small>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div className="actions">
                    <button
                      className="outline"
                      onClick={() => setDialog({ mode: "edit", group })}
                      disabled={
                        busy ||
                        disabled ||
                        limit ||
                        !!group.state ||
                        groupLocked(group.id)
                      }
                    >
                      Изменить
                    </button>
                    <button
                      className="outline danger"
                      onClick={() =>
                        onAppend({
                          operation: "DeleteEndpointGroup",

                        })
                      }
                      disabled={
                        busy ||
                        disabled ||
                        limit ||
                        !!group.state ||
                        groupLocked(group.id)
                      }
                    >

            </div>

        <section className="card entry-panel entry-consumers">

            <div className="entry-list">

                .map((deployment) => {
                  const canSet =
                    catalogReady && eligible(deployment.serviceType);
                  const choices = groups.filter(
                    (group) => !group.state || group.id === deployment.endpointGroup,
                  );
                  const assignmentStatus = !canSet
                    ? {
                        tone: "neutral",
                        symbol: "·",
                        label: catalogReady
                          ? "Не поддерживает consumer"
                          : "Каталог недоступен",
                      }
                    : deployment.endpointGroup
                      ? {

                  return (

                          ))}
                        </select>
                        {deployment.endpointGroup && (

                            className="outline"
                            onClick={() =>

                                operation: "ClearServiceEndpointGroup",
                                deploymentId: deployment.id,

                            disabled={

        <section className="card entry-panel">

          </h2>
          {providerDeployments.length === 0 ? (

              {providerDeployments.map((deployment) => {
                const supported = providerEligible(deployment.serviceType);
                const readOnly = !catalogReady || !supported;
                const canClear =

                const providerStatus =

                          : "Provider не настроен"}
                      </span>
                      <small
                        className={`entry-state-chip entry-state-chip--${providerStatus.tone}`}
                      >
                        <span aria-hidden="true">{providerStatus.symbol}</span>
                        {providerStatus.label}
                      </small>
                      {deployment.virtualAddresses?.map((address) => (
                        <small key={`${address.address}-${address.interface}`}>
                          {address.address} · {address.interface}
                        </small>
                      ))}
                      {deployment.providerEditState === "INCOMPLETE" && (
                        <small>
                          Неполная конфигурация: завершите или очистите.
                        </small>
                      )}
                      {deployment.providerEditState === "UNSUPPORTED" && (
                        <small>
                          Legacy-конфигурация вне безопасных границ редактора.
                        </small>
                      )}
                      {!catalogReady && (
                        <small>
                          Каталог недоступен: редактирование выключено.
                        </small>
                      )}
                      {catalogReady && !supported && (
                        <small>Сервис не поддерживает endpoint provider.</small>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <div className="actions">
                      <button
                        className="outline"
                        onClick={() => setProviderDialog(deployment)}
                        disabled={
                          busy ||
                          disabled ||
                          limit ||
                          readOnly ||
                          providerLocked(deployment.id)
                        }
                      >
                        {deployment.providerEditState === "UNSUPPORTED"
                          ? "Заменить"
                          : "Настроить"}
                      </button>
                      <button
                        className="outline danger"
                        onClick={() =>
                          void onAppend({
                            operation: "ClearEndpointProvider",
                            deploymentId: deployment.id,
                          })
                        }
                        disabled={busy || disabled || limit || !canClear}
                        title="Удаляет provider tuple из черновика. После сохранения Core потребует complete tuple или удаления deployment."
                      >
                        Очистить
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}
        </section>
      </div>
      {dialog && (
        <EndpointGroupDialog
          group={dialog.group}
          busy={busy}
          existing={new Set(groups.map((item) => item.id))}
          onClose={() => setDialog(null)}
          onAppend={async (intent) => {
            const accepted = await onAppend(intent);
            if (accepted) setDialog(null);
            return accepted;
          }}
        />
      )}
      {providerDialog && (
        <ProviderDialog
          deployment={providerDialog}
          groups={groups.filter((group) => !group.state)}
          busy={busy}
          onClose={() => setProviderDialog(null)}
          onAppend={async (intent) => {
            const accepted = await onAppend(intent);
            if (accepted) setProviderDialog(null);
            return accepted;
          }}
        />
      )}
    </>
  );
}

function EntryPointIcon({
  kind,
}: {
  kind: "groups" | "consumers" | "provider";
}) {
  return (
    <svg
      className="entry-panel-icon"
      viewBox="0 0 20 20"
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth="1.5"
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      {kind === "groups" ? (
        <>
          <circle cx="4" cy="10" r="2" />
          <circle cx="15.5" cy="4.5" r="2" />
          <circle cx="15.5" cy="15.5" r="2" />

function EndpointGroupDialog({
  group,
  existing,
  busy,
  onClose,
  onAppend,
}: {
  group?: Group;
  existing: Set<string>;
  busy: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onAppend: (intent: EndpointIntent) => Promise<boolean>;
}) {
  const [id, setID] = useState(group?.id || "");
  const [domain, setDomain] = useState(group?.domain || "");
  const [wildcard, setWildcard] = useState(group?.wildcard || false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const submit = async () => {
    const normalizedID = id.trim();
    const normalizedDomain = domain.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!group && (!idPattern.test(normalizedID) || existing.has(normalizedID)))
      return setError("Введите уникальный ID группы.");
    if (
      !normalizedDomain ||
      normalizedDomain.length > 253 ||
      !normalizedDomain.includes(".")
    )
      return setError("Введите корректный домен.");
    const intent: EndpointIntent = group
      ? {
          operation: "UpdateEndpointGroup",
          endpointGroupId: group.id,
          endpointGroup: { address: { domain: normalizedDomain, wildcard } },
        }
      : {
          operation: "CreateEndpointGroup",
          endpointGroupId: normalizedID,
          endpointGroup: { address: { domain: normalizedDomain, wildcard } },
        };
    await onAppend(intent);
  };
  return (
    <div className="modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true">
      <section className="card dialog">
        <h2>{group ? "Изменить группу" : "Добавить группу"}</h2>
        {!group && (
          <label>
            ID
            <input
              value={id}
              onChange={(event) => setID(event.target.value)}
              maxLength={128}
            />
          </label>
        )}
        <label>
          Домен
          <input
            value={domain}
            onChange={(event) => setDomain(event.target.value)}
            maxLength={253}
          />
        </label>
        <label className="checkbox">
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            checked={wildcard}
            onChange={(event) => setWildcard(event.target.checked)}
          />
          Wildcard
        </label>
        {error && <p className="field-error">{error}</p>}
        <div className="actions">
          <button className="outline" onClick={onClose} disabled={busy}>
            Отмена
          </button>
          <button onClick={() => void submit()} disabled={busy}>
            {group ? "Сохранить" : "Добавить"}
          </button>
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

function ProviderDialog({
  deployment,
  groups,
  busy,
  onClose,
  onAppend,
}: {
  deployment: Deployment;
  groups: Group[];
  busy: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onAppend: (intent: ProviderIntent) => Promise<boolean>;
}) {
  const [endpointGroupId, setEndpointGroupID] = useState(
    deployment.endpointGroupRef || "",
  );
  const [vrid, setVRID] = useState(
    deployment.virtualRouterId ? String(deployment.virtualRouterId) : "",
  );
  const [addresses, setAddresses] = useState(
    deployment.providerEditState === "UNSUPPORTED"
      ? [{ address: "", interface: "" }]
      : deployment.virtualAddresses?.length
        ? deployment.virtualAddresses
        : [{ address: "", interface: "" }],
  );
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const submit = async () => {
    const normalized = addresses.map((item) => ({
      address: item.address.trim(),
      interface: item.interface.trim(),
    }));
    const parsedVRID = Number(vrid);
    const ipv4 =
      /^(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|1?\d?\d)(?:\.(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|1?\d?\d)){3}$/;
    if (
      !endpointGroupId ||
      !Number.isInteger(parsedVRID) ||
      parsedVRID < 1 ||
      parsedVRID > 255
    )
      return setError("Выберите группу и укажите VRID от 1 до 255.");
    if (
      normalized.length === 0 ||
      normalized.length > 64 ||
      normalized.some(
        (item) =>
          !ipv4.test(item.address) ||
          !item.interface ||
          item.interface.length > 128,
      ) ||
      new Set(
        normalized.map((item) => `${item.address}\\u0000${item.interface}`),
      ).size !== normalized.length
    )
      return setError(
        "Добавьте до 64 уникальных IPv4-адресов с interface длиной не более 128 символов.",
      );
    await onAppend({
      operation: "ReconcileEndpointProvider",
      deploymentId: deployment.id,
      endpointGroupId,
      virtualRouterId: parsedVRID,
      virtualAddresses: normalized,
    });
  };
  return (
    <div
      className="modal"
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-label="Настроить provider"
    >
      <section className="card dialog provider-dialog">
        <h2>Provider: {deployment.id}</h2>
        <p className="muted">
          Настройка сохраняется в общий черновик и будет проверена Core только
          после сохранения.
        </p>
        <label>
          Endpoint group
          <select
            value={endpointGroupId}
            onChange={(event) => setEndpointGroupID(event.target.value)}
          >
            <option value="">Выберите группу</option>
            {groups.map((group) => (
              <option key={group.id} value={group.id}>
                {group.id}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>
        <label>
          VRID
          <input
            value={vrid}
            inputMode="numeric"
            onChange={(event) => setVRID(event.target.value)}
          />
        </label>
        <h3>Virtual IP addresses</h3>
        <div className="provider-addresses">
          {addresses.map((item, index) => (
            <div className="provider-address" key={index}>
              <input
                aria-label={`IPv4 ${index + 1}`}
                value={item.address}
                placeholder="192.0.2.42"
                onChange={(event) =>
                  setAddresses((current) =>
                    current.map((row, rowIndex) =>
                      rowIndex === index
                        ? { ...row, address: event.target.value }
                        : row,
                    ),
                  )
                }
              />
              <input
                aria-label={`Interface ${index + 1}`}
                value={item.interface}
                placeholder="eth0"
                maxLength={128}
                onChange={(event) =>
                  setAddresses((current) =>
                    current.map((row, rowIndex) =>
                      rowIndex === index
                        ? { ...row, interface: event.target.value }
                        : row,
                    ),
                  )
                }
              />
              <button
                className="outline danger"
                aria-label={`Удалить адрес ${index + 1}`}
                onClick={() =>
                  setAddresses((current) =>
                    current.filter((_, rowIndex) => rowIndex !== index),
                  )
                }
                disabled={addresses.length === 1}
              >
                Удалить
              </button>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        <button
          className="outline"
          onClick={() =>
            setAddresses((current) =>
              current.length < 64
                ? [...current, { address: "", interface: "" }]
                : current,
            )
          }
          disabled={addresses.length >= 64}
        >
          Добавить адрес
        </button>
        {error && <p className="field-error">{error}</p>}
        <div className="actions">
          <button className="outline" onClick={onClose} disabled={busy}>
            Отмена
          </button>
          <button onClick={() => void submit()} disabled={busy}>
            Применить к черновику
          </button>
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

export type ServicePriorityInput = {
  serviceType: string;
  priority: number | null;
};

export type ServiceDeploymentInput = {
  deploymentId: string;
  serviceType: string;
};

export function deploymentOrderFromPriorities(
  deployments: ServiceDeploymentInput[],
  priorities: ServicePriorityInput[],
): { order: string[]; missingTypes: string[] } {
  const byType = new Map(
    priorities.map((item, index) => [item.serviceType, { ...item, index }]),
  );
  const missingTypes = [
    ...new Set(
      deployments
        .filter(
          (item) =>
            !byType.has(item.serviceType) ||
            byType.get(item.serviceType)?.priority == null,
        )
        .map((item) => item.serviceType),
    ),
  ].sort();
  if (missingTypes.length) return { order: [], missingTypes };
  return {
    order: [...deployments]
      .sort((left, right) => {
        const leftPriority = byType.get(left.serviceType)!;
        const rightPriority = byType.get(right.serviceType)!;
        return (
          leftPriority.priority! - rightPriority.priority! ||
          leftPriority.index - rightPriority.index ||
          (left.deploymentId < right.deploymentId
            ? -1
            : left.deploymentId > right.deploymentId
              ? 1
              : 0)
        );
      })
      .map((item) => item.deploymentId),
    missingTypes: [],
  };
}

        onKeyDown={(event) => {
          const index = tabLabels.findIndex((item) => item.id === tab);
          const next =
            event.key === "ArrowRight"
