export type ConfigurationIntent =
  | {
      operation: "SetServiceConfigurationValue";
      deploymentId: string;
      scope: "DEPLOYMENT" | "MEMBER";
      memberId?: string;
      setting: string;
      value: ConfigurationValue;
    }
  | {
      operation: "RemoveServiceConfigurationOverride";
      deploymentId: string;
      scope: "DEPLOYMENT" | "MEMBER";
      memberId?: string;
      setting: string;
    };

type CatalogService = NonNullable<OpenResult["catalog"]>["services"] extends
  Array<infer Service> | undefined
  ? Service
  : never;
type CatalogSetting = CatalogService["configurationSettings"][number];
type Row = {
  deploymentId: string;
  serviceType: string;
  mode: string;
  state?: "new" | "deleting";
};
type Value = string | number | boolean;
type RuntimeSecretReference = { passwordSecretRef: string; username?: string };
type ConfigurationValue = Value | RuntimeSecretReference;
type Scope = "DEPLOYMENT" | "MEMBER";
type MemberRow = {
  deploymentId: string;
  memberId: string;
  hostId: string;
  roles: string[];
  configuration: Array<{
    setting: string;
    overridePresent: boolean;
    state: string;
    value?: ConfigurationValue;
  }>;
};

const supportedShapes = new Set([
  "BOOLEAN",
  "INTEGER",
  "NUMBER",
  "ENUM",
  "BOUNDED_STRING",
  "DNS_DOMAIN",
]);

const dnsDomainPattern =
  /^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?(\.[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?)*\.[a-z]{2,63}$/;

function invalidText(setting: CatalogSetting, raw: string) {
  return setting.editorShape === "DNS_DOMAIN" && !dnsDomainPattern.test(raw);
}

function rowsFor(
  managed: OpenResult["managed"],
  intents: DeploymentIntent[],
): Row[] {
  const rows = new Map<string, Row>();
  for (const deployment of Object.values(managed?.deployments || {}))
    rows.set(deployment.deploymentId, {
      deploymentId: deployment.deploymentId,
      serviceType: deployment.serviceType,
      mode: deployment.mode,
    });
  for (const intent of intents) {
    if (intent.operation === "CreateServiceDeployment") {
      rows.set(intent.deploymentId, {
        deploymentId: intent.deploymentId,
        serviceType: intent.serviceType,
        mode: intent.mode,
        state: "new",
      });
      continue;
    }
    const row = rows.get(intent.deploymentId);
    if (row) rows.set(intent.deploymentId, { ...row, state: "deleting" });
  }
  return [...rows.values()].sort((left, right) =>
    left.deploymentId.localeCompare(right.deploymentId),
  );
}

function catalogService(
  catalog: OpenResult["catalog"],
  serviceType: string,
): CatalogService | undefined {
  return catalog?.services?.find((service) => service.id === serviceType);
}

function settingValue(
  overrides: Array<{
    setting: string;
    overridePresent: boolean;
    state: string;
    value?: ConfigurationValue;
  }>,
  deploymentId: string,
  scope: Scope,
  memberId: string,
  setting: string,
  intents: ConfigurationIntent[],
): { overridePresent: boolean; state: string; value?: ConfigurationValue } {
  const saved = overrides.find((entry) => entry.setting === setting);
  let result: {
    overridePresent: boolean;
    state: string;
    value?: ConfigurationValue;
  } = {
    overridePresent: saved?.overridePresent || false,
    state: saved?.state || "EDITABLE",
    value: saved?.value,
  };
  for (const intent of intents) {
    if (
      intent.deploymentId !== deploymentId ||
      intent.scope !== scope ||
      (scope === "MEMBER" && intent.memberId !== memberId) ||
      intent.setting !== setting
    )
      continue;
    result =
      intent.operation === "SetServiceConfigurationValue"
        ? { overridePresent: true, state: "EDITABLE", value: intent.value }
        : { overridePresent: false, state: "EDITABLE", value: undefined };
  }
  return result;
}

function isEditable(setting: CatalogSetting, catalogReady: boolean) {
  return (
    catalogReady &&
    setting.kind === "MANAGED" &&
    (supportedShapes.has(setting.editorShape) ||
      (setting.editorShape === "TLS_PROFILE" &&
        setting.referenceKind === "TLS_PROFILE") ||
      (setting.editorShape === "SERVICE_DEPLOYMENT" &&
        setting.referenceKind === "SERVICE_DEPLOYMENT"))
  );
}

function finalMembers(
  managed: OpenResult["managed"],
  intents: PlacementIntent[],
  deploymentId: string,
): MemberRow[] {
  const rows = new Map<string, MemberRow>();
  for (const member of managed?.memberPlacements || []) {
    if (member.deploymentId !== deploymentId) continue;
    rows.set(member.memberId, {
      ...member,
      configuration: member.configuration || [],
    });
  }
  for (const intent of intents) {
    if (intent.deploymentId !== deploymentId) continue;
    if (intent.operation === "ReconcileDeploymentPlacement") {
      rows.clear();
      for (const member of intent.members)
        rows.set(member.memberId, {
          ...member,
          deploymentId,
          roles: member.roles || [],
          configuration: [],
        });
    }
    if (intent.operation === "ReconcileHostScopedDeploymentPlacement")
      rows.clear();
  }
  return [...rows.values()].sort((left, right) =>
    left.memberId.localeCompare(right.memberId),
  );
}

function finalTLSProfileIDs(
  managed: OpenResult["managed"],
  intents: CertificateIntent[],
) {
  const ids = new Set(Object.keys(managed?.pki?.tlsProfiles || {}));
  for (const intent of intents) {
    if (
      intent.operation === "CreateTLSProfile" ||
      intent.operation === "UpdateTLSProfile"
    )
      ids.add(intent.entityId);
    if (intent.operation === "DeleteTLSProfile") ids.delete(intent.entityId);
  }
  return [...ids].sort();
}

function finalDeploymentIDs(
  managed: OpenResult["managed"],
  intents: DeploymentIntent[],
) {
  const ids = new Set(Object.keys(managed?.deployments || {}));
  for (const intent of intents) {
    if (intent.operation === "CreateServiceDeployment")
      ids.add(intent.deploymentId);
    else ids.delete(intent.deploymentId);
  }
  return [...ids].sort((left, right) => left.localeCompare(right));
}

function inputValue(value: ConfigurationValue | undefined, shape: string) {
  if (typeof value === "object") return "";
  if (shape === "BOOLEAN") return value === true ? "true" : "false";
  return value === undefined ? "" : String(value);
}

function valueFor(setting: CatalogSetting, raw: string): Value | undefined {
  if (setting.editorShape === "BOOLEAN") return raw === "true";
  if (setting.editorShape === "INTEGER" || setting.editorShape === "NUMBER") {
    if (!raw.trim()) return undefined;
    const value = Number(raw);
    return Number.isFinite(value) ? value : undefined;
  }
  return raw;
}

function settingTitle(setting: CatalogSetting) {
  return setting.label || setting.id;
}

function previewValue(value: unknown): string | null {
  if (typeof value === "string") {
    if (
      value.length > 4096 ||
      /[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/u.test(value) ||
      ["{{", "}}", "{%", "%}", "{#", "#}"].some((marker) =>
        value.includes(marker),
      )
    )
      return null;
    return value;
  }
  if (typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value)) return String(value);
  if (typeof value === "boolean") return value ? "Да" : "Нет";
  return null;
}

function displayedInputValue(
  setting: CatalogSetting,
  current: {
    overridePresent: boolean;
    state: string;
    value?: ConfigurationValue;
  },
  coreValue?: { state: string; value?: string | number | boolean },
  deploymentOverride?: {
    overridePresent: boolean;
    state: string;
    value?: ConfigurationValue;
  },
): string {
  const ordinary = (value: unknown): string => {
    if (previewValue(value) === null) return "";
    if (
      typeof value === "string" ||
      typeof value === "number" ||
      typeof value === "boolean"
    )
      return inputValue(value, setting.editorShape);
    return "";
  };
  if (current.overridePresent) return ordinary(current.value);
  // A current Core result takes precedence even when it says that the value
  // cannot be resolved; falling back to a literal would mislabel it as exact.
  if (coreValue)
    return coreValue.state === "RESOLVED" ? ordinary(coreValue.value) : "";
  if (deploymentOverride?.overridePresent)
    return ordinary(deploymentOverride.value);
  return setting.staticDefaultState === "LITERAL"
    ? ordinary(setting.staticDefaultValue)
    : "";
}

function SettingPreview({
  setting,
  current,
  deploymentOverride,
  coreValue,
}: {
  setting: CatalogSetting;
  current: {
    overridePresent: boolean;
    state: string;
    value?: ConfigurationValue;
  };
  deploymentOverride?: {
    overridePresent: boolean;
    state: string;
    value?: ConfigurationValue;
  };
  coreValue?: {
    state: string;
    source: string;
    value?: string | number | boolean;
  };
}) {
  if (setting.editorShape === "RUNTIME_SECRET_REFERENCE_OBJECT")
    return (
      <small className="muted">
        {current.overridePresent || deploymentOverride?.overridePresent
          ? "Ссылка на секрет задана. Наличие значения в текущей сессии здесь не подтверждается."
          : "Ссылка на секрет не задана. Настройте её через «Секреты»."}
      </small>
    );
  if (setting.kind !== "MANAGED" || setting.editorShape === "UNSUPPORTED")
    return (
      <small className="muted">
        {current.overridePresent || deploymentOverride?.overridePresent
          ? "Переопределение задано"
          : "Точное значение недоступно"}
        . Значение этого параметра недоступно для просмотра.
      </small>
    );
  const own =
    current.overridePresent && current.state === "EDITABLE"
      ? previewValue(current.value)
      : null;
  const inherited =
    deploymentOverride?.overridePresent &&
    deploymentOverride.state === "EDITABLE"
      ? previewValue(deploymentOverride.value)
      : null;
  const fallback =
    setting.staticDefaultState === "LITERAL"
      ? previewValue(setting.staticDefaultValue)
      : null;
  const resolved =
    coreValue?.state === "RESOLVED" ? previewValue(coreValue.value) : null;
  const coreSource =
    coreValue?.source === "MEMBER_OVERRIDE"
      ? "Переопределено для ноды"
      : coreValue?.source === "DEPLOYMENT_OVERRIDE"
        ? "Переопределено для сервиса"
        : coreValue?.source === "ROLE_DEFAULT"
          ? "По умолчанию"
          : "Разрешено Core";
  return (
    <small className="muted" aria-live="polite">
      {resolved !== null
        ? `${coreSource}: ${resolved}`
        : coreValue?.state === "DEFERRED"
          ? "Вычисляется при выполнении"
          : own !== null
            ? `Переопределено ${deploymentOverride ? "для ноды" : "для сервиса"}: ${own}`
            : current.overridePresent
              ? "Переопределено; итоговое значение вычисляется при выполнении"
              : inherited !== null
                ? `Задано для сервиса: ${inherited}; итоговое значение ожидает Core`
                : deploymentOverride?.overridePresent
                  ? "Задано для сервиса; итоговое значение ожидает Core"
                  : fallback !== null
                    ? `По умолчанию: ${fallback}`
                    : setting.staticDefaultState === "DEFERRED"
                      ? "Вычисляется при выполнении"
                      : "Значение по умолчанию пока недоступно"}
    </small>
  );
}

          [
            "SERVICE_PASSWORD",
            "SERVICE_ADMIN_TOKEN",
            "SERVICE_UNSEAL_SHARES",
          ].includes(item.purpose) &&
          item.serviceDeployment === selected.deploymentId,
      );
      if (operation.status !== "READY" || !descriptors.length) {
        setSecretError(
          operation.error?.message ||
            "Для этого deployment нет доступных требований к секретам.",
        );
        return;
      }
      setSecretOperation({ ...operation, descriptors });
    } catch {
      setSecretError("Не удалось безопасно получить требования к секретам.");
    } finally {
      setSecretBusy(false);
    }
  };
  const submitSecrets = async (event: React.FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (
      !selected ||
      !secretOperation ||
      !onSetPendingDeploymentRuntimeSecretValues
    )
      return;
    const descriptors = (secretOperation.descriptors || []).filter(
      (item) => item.purpose === "SERVICE_PASSWORD",
    );
    if (descriptors.length === 0) {
      closeSecrets();
      return;
    }
    const values: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const descriptor of descriptors)
      values[descriptor.requirementRef] =
        secretValues[descriptor.requirementRef] || "";
    if (Object.values(values).some((value) => !value)) {
      setSecretError("Заполните все обязательные значения.");
      return;
    }
    setSecretBusy(true);
    setSecretError("");
    try {
      const referencesAdded = descriptors.filter(
        (descriptor) => !descriptor.referenceConfigured && descriptor.setting,
      );
      if (
        referencesAdded.some((descriptor) => {
          const setting = settings.find(
            (item) => item.id === descriptor.setting,
          );
          return (
            setting?.runtimeSecretUsernameRequired &&
            !/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,62}$/.test(
              secretUsernames[descriptor.requirementRef] || "",
            )
          );
        })
      ) {
        setSecretError(
          "Укажите допустимое имя пользователя для этого секрета.",
        );
        return;
      }
      for (const descriptor of referencesAdded) {
        const setting = settings.find((item) => item.id === descriptor.setting);
        const username = secretUsernames[descriptor.requirementRef] || "";
        const appended = await onAppend({
          operation: "SetServiceConfigurationValue",
          deploymentId: selected.deploymentId,
          scope: "DEPLOYMENT",
          setting: descriptor.setting!,
          value: setting?.runtimeSecretUsernameRequired
            ? {
                username,
                passwordSecretRef: `runtime:${descriptor.requirementRef}`,
              }
            : { passwordSecretRef: `runtime:${descriptor.requirementRef}` },
        });
        if (!appended) {
          setSecretError(
            "Ссылка на секрет не добавлена в черновик. Значение не сохранено.",
          );
          return;
        }
      }
      if (referencesAdded.length) {
        setSecretValues({});
        setSecretError(
          "Ссылки добавлены в черновик. Сохраните проект и затем введите значения ещё раз.",
        );
        return;
      }
      await onSetPendingDeploymentRuntimeSecretValues({
        serviceDeployment: selected.deploymentId,
        values,
      });
      setSecretStatusVersion((current) => current + 1);
      closeSecrets();
    } catch {
      setSecretValues({});
      setSecretError(
        "Значения не приняты: обновите требования и повторите ввод.",
      );
    } finally {
      setSecretBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const chooseSecretFile = async (
    purpose: "SERVICE_ADMIN_TOKEN" | "SERVICE_UNSEAL_SHARES",
  ) => {
    if (!selected || !onChoosePendingDeploymentRuntimeSecretFile) return;
    setSecretBusy(true);

      setSecretStatusVersion((current) => current + 1);
    } catch {
      setSecretError(
        "Файл не принят. Проверьте формат/пароль и повторите выбор.",
      );
    } finally {
      setInputEncryptionPassword("");
      setSecretBusy(false);
    }

    <section className="services-workspace">
      {servicePicker}
      <section className="services-detail-empty" aria-live="polite">
        <h2 ref={detailHeading} tabIndex={-1}>
          {view === "detail" ? "Сервис не найден" : "Выберите сервис"}
        </h2>
        <p className="muted">
          {view === "detail"
            ? "Выбранный deployment больше недоступен. Выберите сервис из списка."
            : "Настройки выбранного сервиса появятся здесь; список останется доступен слева."}
        </p>
      <SessionActions
        commandCount={commandCount}
        busy={busy}
        onReview={onReview}
        onDiscard={onDiscard}
      />
      </section>
    </section>
  );
}

function SavedOverrides({
  overrides,
}: {
  overrides: Array<{
    setting: string;
    overridePresent: boolean;
    state: string;
  }>;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="services-saved-overrides">
      <p className="muted">Сохранённые переопределения (только просмотр):</p>
      <ul>
        {overrides.map((override) => (
          <li key={override.setting}>
            <code>{override.setting}</code> ·{" "}
            {override.overridePresent
              ? "переопределение сохранено"
              : "переопределения нет"}{" "}
            ·{" "}
            {override.state === "EDITABLE"
              ? "доступно для изменения"
              : "только просмотр"}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}

function MemberSettings({
  deploymentId,
  member,
  settings,
  deploymentOverrides,
  effectivePreview,
  catalogReady,
  tlsProfileIDs,
  deploymentIDs,
  intents,
  busy,
  structuralDisabled,
  commandCount,
  deleting,
  onManageCertificates,
  onAppend,
  onAmend,
}: {
  deploymentId: string;
  member: MemberRow;
  settings: CatalogSetting[];
  deploymentOverrides: MemberRow["configuration"];
  effectivePreview?: Record<
    string,
    { state: string; source: string; value?: string | number | boolean }
  >;
  catalogReady: boolean;
  tlsProfileIDs: string[];
  deploymentIDs: string[];
  intents: ConfigurationIntent[];
  busy: boolean;
  structuralDisabled: boolean;
  commandCount: number;
  deleting: boolean;
  onManageCertificates: () => void;
  onAppend: (intent: ConfigurationIntent) => Promise<boolean>;
  onAmend: (
    previous: ConfigurationIntent,
    replacement: ConfigurationIntent | null,
  ) => Promise<boolean>;
}) {
  const [drafts, setDrafts] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const memberSettings = settings.filter((setting) =>
    setting.scopes.includes("member"),
  );
  if (!memberSettings.length)
    return (
      <p className="muted">
        Каталог не объявляет параметров отдельного экземпляра.
      </p>
    );
  return (
    <>
      <p className="muted">
        Сервер: {member.hostId} · Роли: {member.roles.join(", ") || "не заданы"}
      </p>
      <div className="services-setting-list">
        {memberSettings.map((setting) => {
          const current = settingValue(
            member.configuration,
            deploymentId,
            "MEMBER",
            member.memberId,
            setting.id,
            intents,
          );
          const deploymentOverride = settingValue(
            deploymentOverrides,
            deploymentId,
            "DEPLOYMENT",
            "",
            setting.id,
            intents,
          );
          const pending = intents.find(
            (intent) =>
              intent.deploymentId === deploymentId &&
              intent.scope === "MEMBER" &&
              intent.memberId === member.memberId &&
              intent.setting === setting.id,
          );
          const deploymentPending = intents.some(
            (intent) =>
              intent.deploymentId === deploymentId &&
              intent.scope === "DEPLOYMENT" &&
              intent.setting === setting.id,
          );
          const editable = isEditable(setting, catalogReady) && !deleting;
          const disabled =
            busy ||
            structuralDisabled ||
            !editable ||
            (commandCount >= 16 && !pending);
          const savedOverride = member.configuration.some(
            (entry) => entry.setting === setting.id && entry.overridePresent,
          );
          const draftKey = `${deploymentId}\u0000${member.memberId}\u0000${setting.id}`;
          const baseRaw = displayedInputValue(
            setting,
            current,
            pending || deploymentPending
              ? undefined
              : effectivePreview?.[setting.id],
            deploymentOverride,
          );
          const draftRaw = drafts[draftKey];
          const raw = draftRaw ?? baseRaw;
          const draftChanged = draftRaw !== undefined && draftRaw !== baseRaw;
          const value = valueFor(setting, raw);
          const invalidNumber =
            (setting.editorShape === "INTEGER" ||
              setting.editorShape === "NUMBER") &&
            raw.trim() !== "" &&
            value === undefined;
          const invalidTextValue = invalidText(setting, raw);
          return (
            <div className="services-setting" key={setting.id}>
              <div>
                <strong>{settingTitle(setting)}</strong>
                <small>{setting.id}</small>
                {setting.description && (
                  <p className="muted">{setting.description}</p>
                )}
                <SettingPreview
                  setting={setting}
                  current={current}
                  deploymentOverride={deploymentOverride}
                  coreValue={
                    pending || deploymentPending
                      ? undefined
                      : effectivePreview?.[setting.id]
                  }
                />
              </div>
              {editable ? (
                <div className="services-control">
                  {setting.editorShape === "BOOLEAN" ? (
                    <label className="services-checkbox">
                      <input
                        aria-label={`${member.memberId}: ${settingTitle(setting)}`}
                        type="checkbox"
                        checked={raw === "true"}
                        disabled={disabled}
                        onChange={(event) =>
                          setDrafts((current) => ({
                            ...current,
                            [draftKey]: String(event.target.checked),
                          }))
                        }
                      />
                      Включено
                    </label>
                  ) : setting.editorShape === "TLS_PROFILE" ? (
                    <>
                      <select
                        aria-label={`${member.memberId}: ${settingTitle(setting)}`}
                        value={raw}
                        disabled={disabled || !tlsProfileIDs.length}
                        onChange={(event) =>
                          setDrafts((current) => ({
                            ...current,
                            [draftKey]: event.target.value,
                          }))
                        }
                      >
                        <option value="">Выберите профиль TLS</option>
                        {raw && !tlsProfileIDs.includes(raw) && (
                          <option value={raw} disabled>
                            {raw} · нет в управляемом списке
                          </option>
                        )}
                        {tlsProfileIDs.map((id) => (
                          <option key={id} value={id}>
                            {id}
                          </option>
                        ))}
                      </select>
                      {!tlsProfileIDs.length && (
                        <small className="muted">
                          Нет доступного управляемого профиля TLS.
                        </small>
                      )}
                      <button
                        className="outline"
                        disabled={busy || structuralDisabled}
                        onClick={onManageCertificates}
                      >
                        Настроить сертификаты
                      </button>
                    </>
                  ) : setting.editorShape === "SERVICE_DEPLOYMENT" ? (
                    <>
                      <select
                        aria-label={`${member.memberId}: ${settingTitle(setting)}`}
                        value={raw}
                        disabled={disabled || !deploymentIDs.length}
                        onChange={(event) =>
                          setDrafts((current) => ({
                            ...current,
                            [draftKey]: event.target.value,
                          }))
                        }
                      >
                        <option value="">Выберите экземпляр сервиса</option>
                        {deploymentIDs.map((id) => (
                          <option key={id} value={id}>
                            {id}
                          </option>
                        ))}
                      </select>
                      {!deploymentIDs.length && (
                        <small className="muted">
                          Нет доступного управляемого экземпляра сервиса.
                        </small>
                      )}
                    </>
                  ) : setting.editorShape === "ENUM" ? (
                    <select
                      aria-label={`${member.memberId}: ${settingTitle(setting)}`}
                      value={raw}
                      disabled={disabled}
                      onChange={(event) =>
                        setDrafts((current) => ({
                          ...current,
                          [draftKey]: event.target.value,
                        }))
                      }
                    >
                      <option value="">Выберите значение</option>
                      {(setting.enum || [])
                        .filter(
                          (item): item is string => typeof item === "string",
                        )
                        .map((item) => (
                          <option key={item} value={item}>
                            {item}
                          </option>
                        ))}
                    </select>
                  ) : (
                    <input
                      aria-label={`${member.memberId}: ${settingTitle(setting)}`}
                      type={
                        setting.editorShape === "INTEGER" ||
                        setting.editorShape === "NUMBER"
                          ? "number"
                          : "text"
                      }
                      value={raw}
                      min={setting.minimum}
                      max={setting.maximum}
                      minLength={setting.minLength}
                      maxLength={setting.maxLength}
                      pattern={
                        setting.editorShape === "DNS_DOMAIN"
                          ? dnsDomainPattern.source
                          : undefined
                      }
                      disabled={disabled}
                      onChange={(event) =>
                        setDrafts((current) => ({
                          ...current,
                          [draftKey]: event.target.value,
                        }))
                      }
                    />
                  )}
                  {invalidNumber && (
                    <small className="field-error">Введите число.</small>
                  )}
                  {invalidTextValue && (
                    <small className="field-error">
                      Введите доменное имя в нижнем регистре, например
                      scada.local.
                    </small>
                  )}
                  <div className="actions">
                    <button
                      disabled={
                        disabled ||
                        !draftChanged ||
                        value === undefined ||
                        invalidNumber ||
                        invalidTextValue
                      }
                      onClick={async () => {
                        const next: ConfigurationIntent = {
                          operation: "SetServiceConfigurationValue",
                          deploymentId,
                          scope: "MEMBER",
                          memberId: member.memberId,
                          setting: setting.id,
                          value: value as Value,
                        };
                        return pending
                          ? onAmend(pending, next)
                          : onAppend(next);
                      }}
                    >
                      Применить
                    </button>
                    <button
                      className="outline"
                      disabled={
                        disabled ||
                        (!savedOverride && !pending && !draftChanged) ||
                        (!!pending &&
                          pending.operation ===
                            "RemoveServiceConfigurationOverride")
                      }
                      onClick={async () => {
                        if (!savedOverride && !pending) {
                          setDrafts((old) => {
                            const next = { ...old };
                            delete next[draftKey];
                            return next;
                          });
                          return;
                        }
                        const next: ConfigurationIntent = {
                          operation: "RemoveServiceConfigurationOverride",
                          deploymentId,
                          scope: "MEMBER",
                          memberId: member.memberId,
                          setting: setting.id,
                        };
                        const accepted = pending
                          ? await onAmend(pending, savedOverride ? next : null)
                          : await onAppend(next);
                        if (accepted)
                          setDrafts((old) => {
                            const updated = { ...old };
                            delete updated[draftKey];
                            return updated;
                          });
                      }}
                    >
                      Сбросить
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <p className="muted">
                  Этот параметр доступен только для просмотра в текущем
                  интерфейсе.
                </p>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

function SessionActions({
  commandCount,
  busy,
  onReview,
  onDiscard,
}: {
  commandCount: number;
  busy: boolean;
  onReview: () => void;
  onDiscard: () => void;
}) {
  if (!commandCount) return null;
  return (
    <div className="actions services-session-actions">
      <span className="muted">Изменений в черновике: {commandCount} из 16</span>
      <button className="outline" disabled={busy} onClick={onDiscard}>
        Отменить черновик
      </button>
      <button disabled={busy} onClick={onReview}>
        Проверить и сохранить
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import type { EndpointPreview, OpenResult } from "./backend";
import {
  type EndpointIntent,
  type ProviderIntent,
  EntryPointsView,
} from "./EntryPointsView";
import type { ServerIntent } from "./ServersPage";

export type { EndpointIntent } from "./EntryPointsView";
export type { ProviderIntent } from "./EntryPointsView";

export type DeploymentIntent =
  | {
      operation: "CreateServiceDeployment";
      deploymentId: string;
      serviceType: string;
      mode: string;
    }
  | {
      operation: "DeleteServiceDeployment";
      deploymentId: string;
    };

export type PlacementIntent =
  | {
      operation: "ReconcileDeploymentPlacement";
      deploymentId: string;
      members: Array<{ memberId: string; hostId: string; roles?: string[] }>;
    }
  | {
      operation: "ReconcileHostScopedDeploymentPlacement";
      deploymentId: string;
      hosts: Array<{ hostId: string; roles?: string[]; priority: number }>;
    };
export type TopologyIntent =
  DeploymentIntent | PlacementIntent | EndpointIntent | ProviderIntent;

type CatalogService = NonNullable<OpenResult["catalog"]>["services"] extends
  Array<infer Service> | undefined
  ? Service
  : never;
type CatalogMode = CatalogService["modes"][number];

type DeploymentRow = {
  deploymentId: string;
  serviceType: string;
  mode: string;
  state?: "new" | "deleting";
};

function deploymentRows(
  managed: OpenResult["managed"],
  intents: TopologyIntent[],
): DeploymentRow[] {
  const result = new Map<string, DeploymentRow>();
  for (const [deploymentId, deployment] of Object.entries(
    managed?.deployments || {},
  )) {
    result.set(deploymentId, {
      deploymentId,
      serviceType: deployment.serviceType,
      mode: deployment.mode,
    });
  }
  for (const intent of intents) {
    if (intent.operation === "CreateServiceDeployment") {
      result.set(intent.deploymentId, {
        deploymentId: intent.deploymentId,
        serviceType: intent.serviceType,
        mode: intent.mode,
        state: "new",
      });
      continue;
    }
    if (intent.operation !== "DeleteServiceDeployment") continue;
    const existing = result.get(intent.deploymentId);
    if (existing)
      result.set(intent.deploymentId, { ...existing, state: "deleting" });
  }
  return [...result.values()].sort((left, right) =>
    left.deploymentId.localeCompare(right.deploymentId),
  );
}

type ServerRow = { hostId: string; label: string; state?: "new" | "deleting" };
type MemberRow = { memberId: string; hostId: string; roles: string[] };
type HostRow = { hostId: string; roles: string[]; priority: number };
type Placement =
  | { kind: "MEMBER_SCOPED"; members: MemberRow[] }
  | { kind: "HOST_SCOPED"; hosts: HostRow[] };

function finalServers(
  managed: OpenResult["managed"],
  intents: ServerIntent[],
): ServerRow[] {
  const rows = new Map<string, ServerRow>();
  for (const [hostId, host] of Object.entries(managed?.servers || {}))
    rows.set(hostId, {
      hostId,
      label: host.address ? `${hostId} · ${host.address}` : hostId,
    });
  for (const intent of intents) {
    const existing = rows.get(intent.hostId);
    if (intent.operation === "CreateServer")
      rows.set(intent.hostId, {
        hostId: intent.hostId,
        label: intent.address
          ? `${intent.hostId} · ${String(intent.address)}`
          : intent.hostId,
        state: "new",
      });
    else if (intent.operation === "DeleteServer" && existing)
      rows.set(intent.hostId, { ...existing, state: "deleting" });
  }
  return [...rows.values()].sort((a, b) => a.hostId.localeCompare(b.hostId));
}

function finalPlacements(
  managed: OpenResult["managed"],
  intents: TopologyIntent[],
): Map<string, Placement> {
  const result = new Map<string, Placement>();
  for (const item of managed?.memberPlacements || []) {
    const current = result.get(item.deploymentId);
    const members = current?.kind === "MEMBER_SCOPED" ? current.members : [];
    result.set(item.deploymentId, {
      kind: "MEMBER_SCOPED",
      members: [
        ...members,
        {
          memberId: item.memberId,
          hostId: item.hostId,
          roles: item.roles || [],
        },
      ],
    });
  }
  for (const item of managed?.hostPlacements || []) {
    const current = result.get(item.deploymentId);
    const hosts = current?.kind === "HOST_SCOPED" ? current.hosts : [];
    result.set(item.deploymentId, {
      kind: "HOST_SCOPED",
      hosts: [
        ...hosts,
        {
          hostId: item.hostId,
          roles: item.roles || [],
          // A legacy project has no host priority.  Keep that absence visible
          // as an invalid form field: v1alpha9 requires an explicit choice.
          priority: item.priority ?? 0,
        },
      ],
    });
  }
  for (const intent of intents) {
    if (intent.operation === "ReconcileDeploymentPlacement")
      result.set(intent.deploymentId, {
        kind: "MEMBER_SCOPED",
        members: intent.members.map((item) => ({
          ...item,
          roles: item.roles || [],
        })),
      });
    if (intent.operation === "ReconcileHostScopedDeploymentPlacement")
      result.set(intent.deploymentId, {
        kind: "HOST_SCOPED",
        hosts: intent.hosts.map((item) => ({
          ...item,
          roles: item.roles || [],
        })),
      });
  }
  return result;
}

function catalogService(
  catalog: OpenResult["catalog"],
  serviceType: string,
): CatalogService | undefined {
  return catalog?.services?.find((service) => service.id === serviceType);
}

function catalogMode(
  service: CatalogService | undefined,
  mode: string,
): CatalogMode | undefined {
  return service?.modes.find((item) => item.id === mode);
}

function serviceLabel(service: CatalogService | undefined, id: string) {
  return service
    ? `${service.displayName} (${id})`
    : `Неизвестный сохранённый тип (${id})`;
}

function modeLabel(mode: CatalogMode | undefined, id: string) {
  return mode
    ? mode.displayName
    : `Неизвестный сохранённый режим (${id})`;
}

function TopologyStateChip({
  state,
  compact = false,
}: {
  state?: "new" | "deleting";
  compact?: boolean;
}) {
  const tone =
    state === "new" ? "info" : state === "deleting" ? "danger" : "success";
  const symbol =
    state === "new" ? "·" : state === "deleting" ? "×" : "✓";
  const label =
    state === "new"
      ? compact
        ? "Новый"
        : "Новый черновик"
      : state === "deleting"
        ? "Будет удалён"
        : "Сохранён";
  return (
    <span className={`status-chip status-chip--${tone}`}>
      <span className="status-chip-symbol" aria-hidden="true">
        {symbol}
      </span>
      {label}
    </span>
  );
}

export function TopologyPage({
  managed,
  catalog,
  intents,
  serverIntents,
  busy,
  structuralDisabled,
  commandCount,
  onAppend,
  onReview,
  onDiscard,
  activeTab,
  onActiveTabChange,
  selectedDeploymentId,
  onSelectedDeploymentChange,
  selectedHostId,
  onSelectedHostChange,
  onConfigureDeployment,
  onConfigureMember,
  preview,
  verificationStatus,
}: {
  managed: OpenResult["managed"];
  catalog: OpenResult["catalog"];
  intents: TopologyIntent[];
  serverIntents: ServerIntent[];
  busy: boolean;
  structuralDisabled: boolean;
  commandCount: number;
  onAppend: (intent: TopologyIntent) => Promise<boolean>;
  onReview: () => void;
  onDiscard: () => void;
  activeTab: "services" | "servers" | "entryPoints";
  onActiveTabChange: (tab: "services" | "servers" | "entryPoints") => void;
  selectedDeploymentId: string;
  onSelectedDeploymentChange: (id: string) => void;
  selectedHostId: string;
  onSelectedHostChange: (id: string) => void;
  onConfigureDeployment: (deploymentId: string) => void;
  onConfigureMember: (deploymentId: string, memberId: string) => void;
  preview?: EndpointPreview;
  verificationStatus: NonNullable<OpenResult["verification"]>["status"];
}) {
  const [dialog, setDialog] = useState<"add" | "delete" | "placement" | null>(
    null,
  );
  const [placementHostContext, setPlacementHostContext] = useState("");
  const [placementDeploymentId, setPlacementDeploymentId] = useState("");
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState("");
  const rows = useMemo(
    () => deploymentRows(managed, intents),
    [managed, intents],
  );
  const servers = useMemo(
    () => finalServers(managed, serverIntents),
    [managed, serverIntents],
  );
  const placements = useMemo(
    () => finalPlacements(managed, intents),
    [managed, intents],
  );
  const normalizedFilter = filter.trim().toLocaleLowerCase("ru");
  const filteredRows = rows.filter((row) => {
    const service = catalogService(catalog, row.serviceType);
    return `${row.deploymentId} ${row.serviceType} ${service?.displayName || ""}`
      .toLocaleLowerCase("ru")
      .includes(normalizedFilter);
  });
  const selected = rows.find(
    (row) => row.deploymentId === selectedDeploymentId,
  );
  const selectedVisible = filteredRows.some(
    (row) => row.deploymentId === selectedDeploymentId,
  );
  const selectedService = selected
    ? catalogService(catalog, selected.serviceType)
    : undefined;
  const selectedMode = selected
    ? catalogMode(selectedService, selected.mode)
    : undefined;
  const selectedPlacement = selected
    ? placements.get(selected.deploymentId)
    : undefined;
  const catalogReady = catalog?.status === "READY";
  const commandLimitReached = commandCount >= 16;
  const crudDisabled = busy || structuralDisabled;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (
      selectedDeploymentId &&
      rows.some((row) => row.deploymentId === selectedDeploymentId)
    )
      return;
    onSelectedDeploymentChange(rows[0]?.deploymentId || "");
  }, [rows, selectedDeploymentId, onSelectedDeploymentChange]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedHostId && servers.some((row) => row.hostId === selectedHostId))
      return;
    onSelectedHostChange(servers[0]?.hostId || "");
  }, [servers, selectedHostId, onSelectedHostChange]);

  const placementLocked =
    !!selected &&
    intents.some(
      (intent) =>
        (intent.operation === "ReconcileDeploymentPlacement" ||
          intent.operation === "ReconcileHostScopedDeploymentPlacement") &&
        intent.deploymentId === selected.deploymentId,
    );
  const placementTarget = rows.find(
    (row) => row.deploymentId === placementDeploymentId,
  );

  return (
    <>
      <section className="title topology-title">
        <div>
          <h1>Топология</h1>
          <p>Экземпляры сервисов и их размещение в проекте.</p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={() => setDialog("add")}
          disabled={crudDisabled || !catalogReady || commandLimitReached}
          title={
            commandLimitReached
              ? "Достигнут общий лимит 16 изменений. Сохраните или отмените черновик."
              : undefined
          }
        >
          Добавить экземпляр
        </button>
      </section>

      <nav className="topology-tabs" aria-label="Представления топологии">
        <button
          className={activeTab === "services" ? "active" : "outline"}
          aria-selected={activeTab === "services"}
          onClick={() => onActiveTabChange("services")}
        >
          По сервисам
        </button>
        <button
          className={activeTab === "servers" ? "active" : "outline"}
          aria-selected={activeTab === "servers"}
          onClick={() => onActiveTabChange("servers")}
        >
          По серверам
        </button>
        <button
          className={activeTab === "entryPoints" ? "active" : "outline"}
          aria-selected={activeTab === "entryPoints"}
          onClick={() => onActiveTabChange("entryPoints")}
        >
          Точки входа
        </button>
      </nav>

      {!catalogReady && (
        <section className="card topology-warning" role="status">
          <b>Каталог недоступен: новые экземпляры нельзя добавить.</b>
          <p>
            Сохранённые экземпляры остаются видимыми, защищённое удаление доступно.
            {catalog?.error?.message ? ` ${catalog.error.message}` : ""}
          </p>
        </section>
      )}

      {activeTab === "entryPoints" ? (
        <EntryPointsView
          managed={managed}
          catalog={catalog}
          intents={intents.filter(
            (intent): intent is EndpointIntent =>
              intent.operation === "CreateEndpointGroup" ||
              intent.operation === "UpdateEndpointGroup" ||
              intent.operation === "DeleteEndpointGroup" ||
              intent.operation === "SetServiceEndpointGroup" ||
              intent.operation === "ClearServiceEndpointGroup",
          )}
          providerIntents={intents.filter(
            (intent): intent is ProviderIntent =>
              intent.operation === "ReconcileEndpointProvider" ||
              intent.operation === "ClearEndpointProvider",
          )}
          deploymentIntents={intents.filter(
            (intent): intent is DeploymentIntent =>
              intent.operation === "CreateServiceDeployment" ||
              intent.operation === "DeleteServiceDeployment",
          )}
          preview={preview}
          verificationStatus={verificationStatus}
          busy={busy}
          disabled={crudDisabled}
          commandCount={commandCount}
          onAppend={onAppend}
        />
      ) : activeTab === "services" ? (
        <div className="topology-grid">
          <section className="card topology-list">
            <h2>Экземпляры сервисов</h2>
            <label>
              Поиск
              <input
                value={filter}
                onChange={(event) => setFilter(event.target.value)}
                placeholder="ID или сервис"
              />
            </label>
            <div className="topology-list-scroll">
              {filteredRows.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="muted">
                  {rows.length === 0
                    ? "Экземпляров сервисов пока нет."
                    : "По фильтру ничего не найдено."}
                </p>
              ) : (
                filteredRows.map((row) => {
                  const service = catalogService(catalog, row.serviceType);
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={row.deploymentId}
                      className={`topology-row ${selectedDeploymentId === row.deploymentId ? "selected" : ""} ${row.state ? `draft-${row.state}` : ""}`}
                      onClick={() =>
                        onSelectedDeploymentChange(row.deploymentId)
                      }
                    >
                      <TopologyInstanceIcon />
                      <span className="topology-instance-copy">
                        <span className="topology-instance-heading">
                          <b>{row.deploymentId}</b>
                          {row.state && (
                            <TopologyStateChip state={row.state} compact />
                          )}
                        </span>
                        <span>{service?.displayName || row.serviceType}</span>
                      </span>
                    </button>
                  );
                })
              )}
            </div>
          </section>

          <section className="card topology-detail">
            <h2>Выбранный экземпляр</h2>
            {!selected ? (
              <p className="muted">Выберите или добавьте экземпляр сервиса.</p>
            ) : !selectedVisible ? (
              <p className="muted">
                Выбранный экземпляр скрыт фильтром. Очистите поиск, чтобы
                открыть подробности.
              </p>
            ) : (
              <>
                <dl className="topology-selected-facts">
                  <dt>ID</dt>
                  <dd>{selected.deploymentId}</dd>
                  <dt>Сервис</dt>
                  <dd>{serviceLabel(selectedService, selected.serviceType)}</dd>
                  <dt>Режим</dt>
                  <dd title={selected.mode}>
                    {modeLabel(selectedMode, selected.mode)}
                  </dd>
                  <dt>Размещение</dt>
                  <dd>
                    {selectedMode?.placementKind === "MEMBER_SCOPED"
                      ? "По экземплярам"
                      : selectedMode?.placementKind === "HOST_SCOPED"
                        ? "По серверам"
                        : "Недоступно без каталога"}
                  </dd>
                  <dt>Состояние</dt>
                  <dd>
                    <TopologyStateChip state={selected.state} />
                  </dd>
                </dl>
                <h3>Размещение на серверах</h3>
                {!selectedPlacement ? (
                  <p className="muted">Размещение ещё не задано.</p>
                ) : selectedPlacement.kind === "MEMBER_SCOPED" ? (
                  <div className="topology-placement-list">
                    {selectedPlacement.members.map((member) => (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className="topology-assignment topology-member-assignment"
                        key={member.memberId}
                        onClick={() =>
                          onConfigureMember(selected.deploymentId, member.memberId)
                        }
                        disabled={selected.state === "deleting"}
                        aria-label={`Настроить участника ${member.memberId} на сервере ${member.hostId}`}
                        title="Открыть настройки этого участника"
                      >
                        <span className="topology-assignment-host">
                          <b>{member.hostId}</b>
                          <small>{member.memberId}</small>
                        </span>
                        <span className="topology-role-chip">
                          {member.roles.join(", ") || "Без роли"}
                        </span>
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="topology-placement-list">
                    {selectedPlacement.hosts.map((host) => (
                      <article className="topology-assignment" key={host.hostId}>
                        <span className="topology-assignment-host">
                          <b>{host.hostId}</b>
                          <small>Приоритет: {host.priority}</small>
                        </span>
                        <span className="topology-role-chip">
                          {host.roles.join(", ") || "Без роли"}
                        </span>
                      </article>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
                <div className="actions topology-actions">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => {
                      setPlacementHostContext("");
                      setPlacementDeploymentId(selected.deploymentId);
                      setDialog("placement");
                    }}
                    disabled={
                      crudDisabled ||
                      !!selected.state ||
                      placementLocked ||
                      commandLimitReached ||
                      (!catalogReady && !placements.has(selected.deploymentId))
                    }
                    title={
                      placementLocked
                        ? "Размещение этого экземпляра уже добавлено в текущий черновик."
                        : undefined
                    }
                  >
                    {placements.has(selected.deploymentId)
                      ? "Изменить размещение"
                      : "Добавить размещение"}
                  </button>
                  <button
                    className="outline"
                    onClick={() => onConfigureDeployment(selected.deploymentId)}
                    disabled={selected.state === "deleting"}
                    title={
                      selected.state === "deleting"
                        ? "Настройка недоступна для экземпляра, который будет удалён."
                        : "Открыть настройку сервиса."
                    }
                  >
                    Настроить экземпляр
                  </button>
                  <button
                    className="outline danger"
                    onClick={() => setDialog("delete")}
                    disabled={
                      crudDisabled || !!selected.state || commandLimitReached
                    }
                  >
                    Удалить экземпляр
                  </button>
                </div>
              </>
            )}
          </section>

          <section className="card topology-summary">
            <h2>Состояние топологии</h2>
            <dl>
              <dt>Экземпляры</dt>
              <dd>{rows.filter((row) => row.state !== "deleting").length}</dd>
              <dt>Черновик</dt>
              <dd>{commandCount} / 16 изменений</dd>
              <dt>Размещение</dt>
              <dd>Настраивается здесь</dd>
              <dt>Проверка Core</dt>
              <dd>Запускается отдельно после сохранения</dd>
            </dl>
            <p className="muted">
              Размещение и роли задаются в проекте; итоговую проверку выполняет Core после сохранения.
            </p>
          </section>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <ByServersView
          servers={servers}
          rows={rows}
          placements={placements}
          selectedHostId={selectedHostId}
          onSelectedHostChange={onSelectedHostChange}
          onSelectedDeploymentChange={onSelectedDeploymentChange}
          onConfigureDeployment={onConfigureDeployment}
          onConfigureMember={onConfigureMember}
          onEdit={(deploymentId, hostId) => {
            onSelectedDeploymentChange(deploymentId);
            setPlacementHostContext(hostId);
            setPlacementDeploymentId(deploymentId);
            setDialog("placement");
          }}
          disabled={crudDisabled || commandLimitReached}
          placementLocked={(deploymentId) =>
            intents.some(
              (intent) =>
                (intent.operation === "ReconcileDeploymentPlacement" ||
                  intent.operation ===
                    "ReconcileHostScopedDeploymentPlacement") &&
                intent.deploymentId === deploymentId,
            )
          }
        />
      )}

      {commandCount > 0 && (
        <section className="card draft-actions">
          <p>
            Общий черновик: {commandCount} / 16. Файлы изменятся только после
            локального Review и общего сохранения.
          </p>
          <button className="outline" onClick={onDiscard} disabled={busy}>
            Отменить все изменения
          </button>
          <button onClick={onReview} disabled={busy}>
            Просмотреть изменения
          </button>
        </section>
      )}

      {dialog === "add" && (
        <AddDeploymentDialog
          services={catalog?.services || []}
          existingIDs={new Set(rows.map((row) => row.deploymentId))}
          busy={busy}
          onClose={() => setDialog(null)}
          onAppend={async (intent) => {
            const accepted = await onAppend(intent);
            if (accepted) {
              onSelectedDeploymentChange(intent.deploymentId);
              setDialog(null);
            }
            return accepted;
          }}
        />
      )}

      {dialog === "delete" && selected && (
        <DeleteDeploymentDialog
          row={selected}
          busy={busy}
          onClose={() => setDialog(null)}
          onAppend={async (intent) => {
            const accepted = await onAppend(intent);
            if (accepted) setDialog(null);
            return accepted;
          }}
        />
      )}
      {dialog === "placement" && placementTarget && (
        <PlacementDialog
          row={placementTarget}
          mode={catalogMode(
            catalogService(catalog, placementTarget.serviceType),
            placementTarget.mode,
          )}
          placement={placements.get(placementTarget.deploymentId)}
          servers={servers}
          preferredHostId={placementHostContext}
          busy={busy}
          onClose={() => setDialog(null)}
          onAppend={async (intent) => {
            const accepted = await onAppend(intent);
            if (accepted) setDialog(null);
            return accepted;
          }}
        />
      )}
    </>
  );
}

function ByServersView({
  servers,
  rows,
  placements,
  selectedHostId,
  onSelectedHostChange,
  onSelectedDeploymentChange,
  onConfigureDeployment,
  onConfigureMember,
  onEdit,
  disabled,
  placementLocked,
}: {
  servers: ServerRow[];
  rows: DeploymentRow[];
  placements: Map<string, Placement>;
  selectedHostId: string;
  onSelectedHostChange: (id: string) => void;
  onSelectedDeploymentChange: (id: string) => void;
  onConfigureDeployment: (deploymentId: string) => void;
  onConfigureMember: (deploymentId: string, memberId: string) => void;
  onEdit: (deploymentId: string, hostId: string) => void;
  disabled: boolean;
  placementLocked: (deploymentId: string) => boolean;
}) {
  const selected = servers.find((server) => server.hostId === selectedHostId);
  const assignments = rows.flatMap((deployment) => {
    const placement = placements.get(deployment.deploymentId);
    if (placement?.kind === "MEMBER_SCOPED")
      return placement.members
        .filter((member) => member.hostId === selectedHostId)
        .map((member) => ({
          deployment,
          key: `member:${member.memberId}`,
          memberId: member.memberId,
          text: `${member.memberId}${member.roles.length ? ` · ${member.roles.join(", ")}` : ""}`,
        }));
    if (placement?.kind === "HOST_SCOPED")
      return placement.hosts
        .filter((host) => host.hostId === selectedHostId)
        .map((host) => ({
          deployment,
          key: `host:${host.hostId}`,
          memberId: "",
          text: host.roles.join(", ") || "без ролей",
        }));
    return [];
  });
  return (
    <div className="topology-grid topology-servers-grid">
      <section className="card topology-list">
        <h2>Серверы</h2>
        <div className="topology-list-scroll">
          {servers.map((server) => (
            <button
              key={server.hostId}
              className={`topology-row ${server.hostId === selectedHostId ? "selected" : ""} ${server.state ? `draft-${server.state}` : ""}`}
              onClick={() => onSelectedHostChange(server.hostId)}
            >
              <TopologyServerIcon />
              <span className="topology-instance-copy">
                <span className="topology-instance-heading">
                  <b>{server.hostId}</b>
                  {server.state && (
                    <TopologyStateChip state={server.state} compact />
                  )}
                </span>
                <span>{server.label}</span>
              </span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </section>
      <section className="card topology-detail">
        <h2>Размещение на сервере</h2>
        {!selected ? (
          <p className="muted">Добавьте сервер или выберите его в списке.</p>
        ) : selected.state === "deleting" ? (
          <p className="muted">
            Сервер будет удалён и не предлагается для нового размещения.
          </p>
        ) : (
          <>
            <div className="topology-list-scroll">
              {assignments.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="muted">На этом сервере пока нет размещений.</p>
              ) : (
                assignments.map(({ deployment, key, memberId, text }) => (
                  <article
                    className="topology-assignment"
                    key={`${deployment.deploymentId}:${key}`}
                  >
                    <div className="topology-assignment-info">
                      <b>{deployment.deploymentId}</b>
                      <span>{text}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="topology-assignment-actions">
                      <button
                        aria-label={`Изменить размещение ${deployment.deploymentId} на сервере ${selected.hostId}`}
                        onClick={() => {
                          onSelectedDeploymentChange(deployment.deploymentId);
                          onEdit(deployment.deploymentId, selected.hostId);
                        }}
                        disabled={
                          disabled ||
                          !!deployment.state ||
                          placementLocked(deployment.deploymentId)
                        }
                      >
                        Изменить
                      </button>
                      <button
                        className="outline"
                        aria-label={memberId
                          ? `Настроить участника ${memberId} на сервере ${selected.hostId}`
                          : `Настроить сервис ${deployment.deploymentId}`}
                        onClick={() => memberId
                          ? onConfigureMember(deployment.deploymentId, memberId)
                          : onConfigureDeployment(deployment.deploymentId)}
                        disabled={deployment.state === "deleting"}
                      >
                        {memberId ? "Настроить участника" : "Настроить сервис"}
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </article>
                ))
              )}
            </div>
            <label className="topology-add-placement">
              Добавить размещение
              <select
                aria-label="Deployment для размещения"
                defaultValue=""
                onChange={(event) => {
                  const deploymentId = event.target.value;
                  if (deploymentId) {
                    onSelectedDeploymentChange(deploymentId);
                    onEdit(deploymentId, selected.hostId);
                    event.currentTarget.value = "";
                  }
                }}
                disabled={disabled}
              >
                <option value="">Выберите экземпляр сервиса</option>
                {rows
                  .filter(
                    (row) => !row.state && !placements.has(row.deploymentId),
                  )
                  .map((deployment) => (
                    <option
                      key={deployment.deploymentId}
                      value={deployment.deploymentId}
                    >
                      {deployment.deploymentId}
                    </option>
                  ))}
              </select>
            </label>
          </>
        )}
      </section>
      <section className="card topology-summary">
        <h2>Сводка</h2>
        <dl>
          <dt>Сервер</dt>
          <dd>{selected?.hostId || "—"}</dd>
          <dt>Адрес</dt>
          <dd>{selected?.label.split(" · ").slice(1).join(" · ") || "—"}</dd>
          <dt>Размещений</dt>
          <dd>{assignments.length}</dd>
          <dt>Проверка Core</dt>
          <dd>После сохранения</dd>
        </dl>
        <p className="muted">
          Настраивайте размещение и параметры сервиса или участника в центральном
          списке.
        </p>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

function normalizedMemberBase(serviceType: string, suffixLength: number) {
  const normalized = serviceType
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[_.]/g, "-")
    .replace(/-+/g, "-")
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "");
  return normalized.slice(0, Math.max(0, 63 - suffixLength));
}

function candidateMemberId(serviceType: string, members: MemberRow[]) {
  const used = new Set(members.map((member) => member.memberId));
  for (let n = 1; n < 10000; n += 1) {
    const suffix = `-${n}`;
    const base = normalizedMemberBase(serviceType, suffix.length);
    if (!base) return "";
    const candidate = `${base}${suffix}`;
    if (!used.has(candidate)) return candidate;
  }
  return "";
}

function PlacementDialog({
  row,
  mode,
  placement,
  servers,
  preferredHostId,
  busy,
  onClose,
  onAppend,
}: {
  row: DeploymentRow;
  mode: CatalogMode | undefined;
  placement: Placement | undefined;
  servers: ServerRow[];
  preferredHostId: string;
  busy: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onAppend: (intent: PlacementIntent) => Promise<boolean>;
}) {
  const kind = mode?.placementKind as
    "MEMBER_SCOPED" | "HOST_SCOPED" | undefined;
  const [members, setMembers] = useState<MemberRow[]>(
    placement?.kind === "MEMBER_SCOPED" ? placement.members : [],
  );
  const [hosts, setHosts] = useState<HostRow[]>(
    placement?.kind === "HOST_SCOPED" ? placement.hosts : [],
  );
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const selectable = servers.filter((server) => server.state !== "deleting");
  const roleOptions = mode?.roles || [];
  const addMember = () => {
    const hostId =
      preferredHostId &&
      selectable.some((server) => server.hostId === preferredHostId)
        ? preferredHostId
        : selectable[0]?.hostId || "";
    setMembers((current) => [
      ...current,
      {
        memberId: candidateMemberId(row.serviceType, current),
        hostId,
        roles: [],
      },
    ]);
  };
  const submit = async (event: React.FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!kind) {
      setError("Для непустого размещения требуется READY catalog.");
      return;
    }
    if (kind === "MEMBER_SCOPED") {
      const ids = new Set<string>();
      if (
        members.some(
          (member) =>
            !/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,62}$/.test(member.memberId) ||
            !member.hostId ||
            ids.has(member.memberId) ||
            (ids.add(member.memberId), false),
        )
      ) {
        setError("Укажите уникальный ID экземпляра и сервер для каждой строки.");
        return;
      }
      if (
        !(await onAppend({
          operation: "ReconcileDeploymentPlacement",
          deploymentId: row.deploymentId,
          members,
        }))
      )
        setError("Размещение не добавлено в общий черновик.");
      return;
    }
    const seen = new Set<string>();
    if (
      hosts.some(
        (host) =>
          !host.hostId ||
          !Number.isInteger(host.priority) ||
          host.priority < 1 ||
          host.priority > 254 ||
          seen.has(host.hostId) ||
          (seen.add(host.hostId), false),
      )
    ) {
      setError(
        "Укажите уникальные серверы и приоритет каждого от 1 до 254.",
      );
      return;
    }
    if (
      !(await onAppend({
        operation: "ReconcileHostScopedDeploymentPlacement",
        deploymentId: row.deploymentId,
        hosts,
      }))
    )
      setError("Размещение не добавлено в общий черновик.");
  };
  if (!kind)
    return (
      <div className="modal">
        <section className="card dialog">
          <h1>Размещение недоступно</h1>
          <p>Для нового размещения требуется READY catalog.</p>
          {placement && (
            <button
              onClick={async () => {
                const accepted = await onAppend(
                  placement.kind === "MEMBER_SCOPED"
                    ? {
                        operation: "ReconcileDeploymentPlacement",
                        deploymentId: row.deploymentId,
                        members: [],
                      }
                    : {
                        operation: "ReconcileHostScopedDeploymentPlacement",
                        deploymentId: row.deploymentId,
                        hosts: [],
                      },
                );
                if (!accepted)
                  setError("Очистка размещения не добавлена в общий черновик.");
              }}
              disabled={busy}
            >
              Очистить существующее размещение
            </button>
          )}
          {error && (
            <p className="field-error" role="alert">
              {error}
            </p>
          )}
          <button className="outline" onClick={onClose}>
            Закрыть
          </button>
        </section>
      </div>
    );
  return (
    <div className="modal" role="presentation">
      <form className="card dialog topology-dialog" onSubmit={submit}>
        <h1>Размещение: {row.deploymentId}</h1>
        <p className="muted">
          {kind === "MEMBER_SCOPED" ? "Экземпляры и роли" : "Серверы и роли"}.
          Применение заменяет всё размещение выбранного сервиса.
        </p>
        {kind === "MEMBER_SCOPED" ? (
          <>
            <div className="placement-rows">
              {members.map((member, index) => (
                <div
                  className="placement-row"
                  key={`${member.memberId}-${index}`}
                >
                  <input
                    aria-label={`Member ID ${index + 1}`}
                    value={member.memberId}
                    placeholder={`${row.serviceType}-1`}
                    onChange={(event) =>
                      setMembers((current) =>
                        current.map((value, i) =>
                          i === index
                            ? { ...value, memberId: event.target.value }
                            : value,
                        ),
                      )
                    }
                  />
                  <select
                    aria-label={`Сервер ${index + 1}`}
                    value={member.hostId}
                    onChange={(event) =>
                      setMembers((current) =>
                        current.map((value, i) =>
                          i === index
                            ? { ...value, hostId: event.target.value }
                            : value,
                        ),
                      )
                    }
                  >
                    {selectable.map((server) => (
                      <option key={server.hostId} value={server.hostId}>
                        {server.hostId}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                  <RoleSelector
                    roles={roleOptions}
                    value={member.roles}
                    onChange={(roles) =>
                      setMembers((current) =>
                        current.map((value, i) =>
                          i === index ? { ...value, roles } : value,
                        ),
                      )
                    }
                  />
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="outline"
                    onClick={() =>
                      setMembers((current) =>
                        current.filter((_, i) => i !== index),
                      )
                    }
                  >
                    Удалить
                  </button>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="outline"
              onClick={addMember}
              disabled={!selectable.length}
            >
              Добавить узел сервиса
            </button>
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            <div className="placement-rows">
              {hosts.map((host, index) => (
                <div className="placement-row" key={`${host.hostId}-${index}`}>
                  <select
                    aria-label={`Сервер ${index + 1}`}
                    value={host.hostId}
                    onChange={(event) =>
                      setHosts((current) =>
                        current.map((value, i) =>
                          i === index
                            ? { ...value, hostId: event.target.value }
                            : value,
                        ),
                      )
                    }
                  >
                    {selectable.map((server) => (
                      <option key={server.hostId} value={server.hostId}>
                        {server.hostId}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                  <RoleSelector
                    roles={roleOptions}
                    value={host.roles}
                    onChange={(roles) =>
                      setHosts((current) =>
                        current.map((value, i) =>
                          i === index ? { ...value, roles } : value,
                        ),
                      )
                    }
                  />
                  <input
                    aria-label={`Приоритет ${index + 1}`}
                    type="number"
                    min={1}
                    max={254}
                    required
                    value={host.priority}
                    onChange={(event) =>
                      setHosts((current) =>
                        current.map((value, i) =>
                          i === index
                            ? { ...value, priority: Number(event.target.value) }
                            : value,
                        ),
                      )
                    }
                  />
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="outline"
                    onClick={() =>
                      setHosts((current) =>
                        current.filter((_, i) => i !== index),
                      )
                    }
                  >
                    Удалить
                  </button>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="outline"
              onClick={() =>
                setHosts((current) => [
                  ...current,
                  {
                    hostId: preferredHostId || selectable[0]?.hostId || "",
                    roles: [],
                    priority: 0,
                  },
                ])
              }
              disabled={!selectable.length}
            >
              Добавить сервер
            </button>
          </>
        )}
        {error && (
          <p className="field-error" role="alert">
            {error}
          </p>
        )}
        <div className="actions">
          <button
            type="button"
            className="outline"
            onClick={onClose}
            disabled={busy}
          >
            Отмена
          </button>
          <button type="submit" disabled={busy}>
            Применить
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}

function RoleSelector({
  roles,
  value,
  onChange,
}: {
  roles: string[];
  value: string[];
  onChange: (roles: string[]) => void;
}) {
  if (!roles.length) return <span className="muted">Без ролей</span>;
  return (
    <label className="role-selector">
      Роли
      <select
        multiple
        value={value}
        onChange={(event) =>
          onChange(
            [...event.currentTarget.selectedOptions].map(
              (option) => option.value,
            ),
          )
        }
      >
        {roles.map((role) => (
          <option key={role} value={role}>
            {role}
          </option>
        ))}
      </select>
    </label>
  );
}

function AddDeploymentDialog({
  services,
  existingIDs,
  busy,
  onClose,
  onAppend,
}: {
  services: CatalogService[];
  existingIDs: Set<string>;
  busy: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onAppend: (
    intent: DeploymentIntent & { operation: "CreateServiceDeployment" },
  ) => Promise<boolean>;
}) {
  const [deploymentID, setDeploymentID] = useState("");
  const [serviceType, setServiceType] = useState(services[0]?.id || "");
  const selectedService = services.find(
    (service) => service.id === serviceType,
  );
  const [mode, setMode] = useState(selectedService?.modes[0]?.id || "");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const selectedMode = selectedService?.modes.find((item) => item.id === mode);

  const selectService = (id: string) => {
    setServiceType(id);
    const next = services.find((service) => service.id === id);
    setMode(next?.modes[0]?.id || "");
    setError("");
  };

  const submit = async (event: React.FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const id = deploymentID.trim();
    if (!/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,62}$/.test(id)) {
      setError("ID: 1–63 символа, строчные латинские буквы, цифры и дефис.");
      return;
    }
    if (existingIDs.has(id)) {
      setError(
        "Deployment с таким ID уже есть в сохранённом состоянии или черновике.",
      );
      return;
    }
    if (!serviceType || !mode) {
      setError("Выберите сервис и режим.");
      return;
    }
    const accepted = await onAppend({
      operation: "CreateServiceDeployment",
      deploymentId: id,
      serviceType,
      mode,
    });
    if (!accepted) setError("Изменение не добавлено в общий черновик.");
  };

  return (
    <div className="modal" role="presentation">
      <form className="card dialog topology-dialog" onSubmit={submit}>
        <h1>Добавить экземпляр сервиса</h1>
        <label>
          Технический ID экземпляра сервиса
          <input
            value={deploymentID}
            onChange={(event) => {
              setDeploymentID(event.target.value);
              setError("");
            }}
            required
            autoFocus
          />
        </label>
        <small className="muted">ID стабилен и не переименовывается.</small>
        <label>
          Сервис
          <select
            value={serviceType}
            onChange={(event) => selectService(event.target.value)}
          >
            {services.map((service) => (
              <option key={service.id} value={service.id}>
                {service.displayName} ({service.id})
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>
        <label>
          Режим
          <select
            value={mode}
            onChange={(event) => setMode(event.target.value)}
          >
            {selectedService?.modes.map((item) => (
              <option key={item.id} value={item.id}>
                {item.displayName} ({item.id})
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>
        {selectedMode && (
          <p className="topology-guidance">
            Размещение: <b>{selectedMode.placementKind === "MEMBER_SCOPED" ? "По экземплярам" : selectedMode.placementKind === "HOST_SCOPED" ? "По серверам" : "Неизвестный тип"}</b>
          </p>
        )}
        {error && (
          <p className="field-error" role="alert">
            {error}
          </p>
        )}
        <p className="muted">
          Размещение, группы точек входа и настройки сервиса здесь не создаются.
        </p>
        <div className=
@@END

          <button
            type="button"
            className="outline"

function DeleteDeploymentDialog({
  row,
  busy,
  onClose,
  onAppend,
}: {
  row: DeploymentRow;
  busy: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onAppend: (
    intent: DeploymentIntent & { operation: "DeleteServiceDeployment" },
  ) => Promise<boolean>;
}) {

        className="card dialog"
        role="dialog"

        aria-labelledby="delete-deployment-title"

        <p>
          <b>{row.deploymentId}</b> будет удалён только после просмотра изменений
          и общего сохранения. Размещение и связанные ссылки автоматически
          не удаляются.
        </p>
        {error && (
          <p className="field-error" role="alert">
            {error}
          </p>

            className="danger-button outline"

                operation: "DeleteServiceDeployment",

          >
            Удалить экземпляр
          </button>
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}
