const LOGS_PAGE_SIZE = 512;
const LOGS_VISIBLE_COLUMNS_KEY = "platform-installer.logs.visible-columns";

type EventColumn = {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  value: (event: InstallationEventView) => string;
};

const eventColumns: EventColumn[] = [
  { key: "sequence", label: "№", value: (event) => String(event.sequence) },
  {
    key: "timestamp",
    label: "Время",
    value: (event) => eventTimestampLabel(event.timestamp),
  },
  {
    key: "eventType",
    label: "Тип события",
    value: (event) => eventTypeLabel(event.eventType),
  },
  {
    key: "status",
    label: "Статус",
    value: (event) => eventStatusLabel(event.status),
  },
  {
    key: "safeMessage",
    label: "Сообщение",
    value: (event) => event.safeMessage,
  },
  { key: "phaseId", label: "Этап", value: (event) => event.phaseId || "—" },
  {
    key: "actionId",
    label: "Действие",
    value: (event) => event.actionId || "—",
  },
  {
    key: "serviceDeployment",
    label: "Развёртывание сервиса",
    value: (event) => event.serviceDeployment || "—",
  },
  { key: "host", label: "Узел", value: (event) => event.host || "—" },
  {
    key: "taskRole",
    label: "Роль задачи",
    value: (event) => event.task?.role || "—",
  },
  {
    key: "taskName",
    label: "Задача",
    value: (event) =>
      taskNameWithoutRole(event) || (event.task ? "Скрыто" : "—"),
  },
  {
    key: "taskUUID",
    label: "ID задачи",
    value: (event) => event.task?.uuid || "—",
  },
  {
    key: "elapsed",
    label: "Длительность",
    value: (event) =>
      event.elapsedMilliseconds === undefined
        ? "—"
        : `${event.elapsedMilliseconds} мс`,
  },
  {
    key: "errorCode",
    label: "Код ошибки",
    value: (event) => event.errorCode || "—",
  },
  {
    key: "errorSummary",
    label: "Описание ошибки",
    value: (event) => event.errorSummary || "—",
  },
  {
    key: "redacted",
    label: "Редакция данных",
    value: (event) => (event.redacted ? "Применена" : "Нет"),
  },
  { key: "runId", label: "ID запуска", value: (event) => event.runId },
];

const defaultVisibleColumns = [
  "timestamp",
  "eventType",
  "safeMessage",
  "serviceDeployment",
  "host",
  "status",
];

function initialVisibleColumns(): string[] {
  try {
    const saved = window.sessionStorage.getItem(LOGS_VISIBLE_COLUMNS_KEY);
    if (saved !== null) {
      const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(saved);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
        const selected = new Set(
          parsed.filter((key): key is string => typeof key === "string"),
        );
        return eventColumns
          .filter((column) => selected.has(column.key))
          .map((column) => column.key);
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // Storage may be unavailable in restricted WebView contexts.
  }
  return defaultVisibleColumns;
}

function eventTypeLabel(value: string): string {
  const labels: Record<string, string> = {
    RUN_STARTED: "Запуск начат",
    PHASE_STARTED: "Этап начат",
    ACTION_STARTED: "Действие начато",
    TASK_STARTED: "Задача начата",
    TASK_COMPLETED: "Задача завершена",
    ACTION_COMPLETED: "Действие завершено",
    PHASE_COMPLETED: "Этап завершён",
    RUN_COMPLETED: "Запуск завершён",
    DIAGNOSTIC: "Диагностика",
  };
  return labels[value] || value;
}

function eventStatusLabel(value: string): string {
  const labels: Record<string, string> = {
    PENDING: "Ожидает",
    RUNNING: "Выполняется",
    SUCCESS: "Успешно",
    CHANGED: "Изменено",
    SKIPPED: "Пропущено",
    FAILED: "Ошибка",
    CANCELLED: "Отменено",
    INTERRUPTED: "Прервано",
  };
  return labels[value] || value;
}

function EventLog({
  events,
  runId,
}: {
  events: InstallationEventView[];
  runId?: string;
}) {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [page, setPage] = useState(0);
  const [selectedSequence, setSelectedSequence] = useState<number>();
  const [visibleColumns, setVisibleColumns] = useState<string[]>(
    initialVisibleColumns,
  );
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      window.sessionStorage.setItem(
        LOGS_VISIBLE_COLUMNS_KEY,
        JSON.stringify(visibleColumns),
      );
    } catch {
      // Keep the selection in component state if storage is unavailable.
    }
  }, [visibleColumns]);
  useEffect(() => {
    setPage(0);
    setSelectedSequence(undefined);
  }, [runId]);
  const orderedEvents = useMemo(
    () => [...events].sort((a, b) => b.sequence - a.sequence),
    [events],
  );
  const filteredEvents = useMemo(() => {
    const needle = query.trim().toLocaleLowerCase("ru");
    if (!needle) return orderedEvents;
    return orderedEvents.filter((event) =>
      eventColumns.some((column) =>
        column.value(event).toLocaleLowerCase("ru").includes(needle),
      ),
    );
  }, [orderedEvents, query]);
  const pageCount = Math.max(
    1,
    Math.ceil(filteredEvents.length / LOGS_PAGE_SIZE),
  );
  const currentPage = Math.min(page, pageCount - 1);
  const pageEvents = filteredEvents.slice(
    currentPage * LOGS_PAGE_SIZE,
    (currentPage + 1) * LOGS_PAGE_SIZE,
  );
  const selectedEvent =
    filteredEvents.find((event) => event.sequence === selectedSequence) ||
    filteredEvents[0];
  const visible = eventColumns.filter((column) =>
    visibleColumns.includes(column.key),
  );

  return (
    <>
      <div className="event-log-toolbar">
        <label className="event-log-search">
          Поиск по событиям
          <input
            value={query}
            onChange={(event) => {
              setQuery(event.target.value);
              setPage(0);
            }}
            placeholder="Сообщение, задача, узел…"
          />
        </label>
        <details className="event-log-columns">
          <summary>
            Колонки ({visible.length} из {eventColumns.length})
          </summary>
          <fieldset>
            <legend>Показывать колонки</legend>
            {eventColumns.map((column) => (
              <label key={column.key}>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={visibleColumns.includes(column.key)}
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    setVisibleColumns((current) =>
                      event.target.checked
                        ? [...current, column.key]
                        : current.filter((key) => key !== column.key),
                    )
                  }
                />
                {column.label}
              </label>
            ))}
          </fieldset>
        </details>
      </div>
      <div className="event-log-layout">
        <section
          className="event-log-table-panel"
          aria-label="События текущего запуска"
        >
          <div className="event-log-table-scroll">
            <table className="event-log-table">
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  {visible.map((column) => (
                    <th key={column.key} scope="col">
                      {column.label}
                    </th>
                  ))}
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {pageEvents.map((event) => (
                  <tr
                    key={`${event.runId}-${event.sequence}`}
                    className={
                      selectedEvent?.sequence === event.sequence
                        ? "is-selected"
                        : ""
                    }
                    onClick={() => setSelectedSequence(event.sequence)}
                  >
                    {visible.map((column) => (
                      <td key={column.key} title={column.value(event)}>
                        {column.value(event)}
                      </td>
                    ))}
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
            {pageEvents.length === 0 && (
              <p className="event-log-empty">
                {events.length
                  ? "По заданным условиям события не найдены."
                  : "События появятся здесь после запуска плана."}
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
          <footer className="event-log-pagination">
            <span>
              {filteredEvents.length
                ? `Показаны ${currentPage * LOGS_PAGE_SIZE + 1}–${Math.min((currentPage + 1) * LOGS_PAGE_SIZE, filteredEvents.length)} из ${filteredEvents.length}`
                : "Нет событий"}
            </span>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setPage((value) => Math.max(0, value - 1))}
              disabled={currentPage === 0}
            >
              Назад
            </button>
            <span>
              Страница {currentPage + 1} из {pageCount}
            </span>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() =>
                setPage((value) => Math.min(pageCount - 1, value + 1))
              }
              disabled={currentPage >= pageCount - 1}
            >
              Далее
            </button>
          </footer>
        </section>
        <aside className="event-log-details" aria-label="Подробности события">
          <h2>Детали события</h2>
          {selectedEvent ? (
            <>
              <strong>
                {eventTypeLabel(selectedEvent.eventType)} ·{" "}
                {eventStatusLabel(selectedEvent.status)}
              </strong>
              <p>{selectedEvent.safeMessage}</p>
              <dl>
                <dt>Время</dt>
                <dd>{eventTimestampLabel(selectedEvent.timestamp)}</dd>
                <dt>Этап / действие</dt>
                <dd>
                  {[selectedEvent.phaseId, selectedEvent.actionId]
                    .filter(Boolean)
                    .join(" · ") || "—"}
                </dd>
                <dt>Развёртывание сервиса</dt>
                <dd>{selectedEvent.serviceDeployment || "—"}</dd>
                <dt>Узел</dt>
                <dd>{selectedEvent.host || "—"}</dd>
                <dt>Роль задачи</dt>
                <dd>{selectedEvent.task?.role || "—"}</dd>
                <dt>Задача</dt>
                <dd>
                  {taskNameWithoutRole(selectedEvent) ||
                    (selectedEvent.task ? "Скрыто" : "—")}
                </dd>
                <dt>ID задачи</dt>
                <dd>{selectedEvent.task?.uuid || "—"}</dd>
                <dt>Длительность</dt>
                <dd>
                  {selectedEvent.elapsedMilliseconds === undefined
                    ? "—"
                    : `${selectedEvent.elapsedMilliseconds} мс`}
                </dd>
                <dt>Ошибка</dt>
                <dd>
                  {[selectedEvent.errorCode, selectedEvent.errorSummary]
                    .filter(Boolean)
                    .join(" · ") || "—"}
                </dd>
                <dt>Редакция данных</dt>
                <dd>{selectedEvent.redacted ? "Применена" : "Нет"}</dd>
                <dt>ID запуска</dt>
                <dd>{selectedEvent.runId || runId || "—"}</dd>
              </dl>
            </>
          ) : (
            <p>Выберите событие, чтобы увидеть подробности.</p>
          )}
        </aside>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

type Props = {
  page: string;
  managed?: ManagedProjectView;
  projectSettingDraftValues?: Partial<Record<"platform_data_root_directory" | "platform_name_prefix", string>>;
  onAppendProjectSetting?: (intent: { operation: "SetProjectSetting"; setting: "platform_data_root_directory" | "platform_name_prefix"; value: string }) => Promise<boolean>;
  editError?: EditResult["error"] | null;
  events: InstallationEventView[];
  runId?: string;
  configVersion?: number;
  serverTypes: Array<{ id: string; displayName: string }>;
  configError: string | null;
  onNavigate?: (page: HelpPageId) => void;
};

function HelpPage({ onNavigate }: { onNavigate?: (page: HelpPageId) => void }) {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [categoryId, setCategoryId] = useState<string>();
  const [articleId, setArticleId] = useState<string>();
  const normalizedQuery = query.trim().toLocaleLowerCase("ru");
  const matches = useMemo(() => {
    const candidates = helpArticles.filter(
      (article) =>
        !categoryId || normalizedQuery || article.category === categoryId,
    );
    if (!normalizedQuery) return candidates;
    return candidates.filter((article) => {
      const category = helpCategories.find(
        (item) => item.id === article.category,
      );
      const searchable = [
        category?.title,
        article.title,
        article.summary,
        article.intro,
        article.warning,
        ...article.sections.flatMap((section) => [
          section.title,
          section.text,
          ...(section.steps || []),
        ]),
      ]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(" ")
        .toLocaleLowerCase("ru");
      return searchable.includes(normalizedQuery);
    });
  }, [categoryId, normalizedQuery]);
  const selectedArticle = matches.find((article) => article.id === articleId);
  const selectedCategory = helpCategories.find(
    (item) => item.id === categoryId,
  );

  const openCategory = (id: string) => {
    const firstArticle = helpArticles.find(
      (article) => article.category === id,
    );
    setQuery("");
    setCategoryId(id);
    setArticleId(firstArticle?.id);
  };
  const openArticle = (article: (typeof helpArticles)[number]) => {
    setCategoryId(article.category);
    setArticleId(article.id);
  };

  return (
    <section className="utility-page help-page" aria-labelledby="help-title">
      <header className="utility-page-title">
        <div>
          <h1 id="help-title">Справка</h1>
          <p>Инструкции по проекту, настройке и устранению ошибок.</p>
        </div>
      </header>
      <label className="help-search">
        <span className="visually-hidden">Поиск по справке</span>
        <input
          type="search"
          value={query}
          onChange={(event) => {
            setQuery(event.target.value);
            setArticleId(undefined);
          }}
          placeholder="Например: каталог недоступен"
        />
      </label>

      {selectedArticle ? (
        <div className="help-reading-layout">
          <aside className="help-article-list" aria-label="Статьи раздела">
            <div className="help-list-heading">
              <button
                type="button"
                className="help-back-link"
                onClick={() => {
                  setArticleId(undefined);
                  setCategoryId(undefined);
                }}
              >
                Все разделы
              </button>
              <h2>
                {normalizedQuery
                  ? "Результаты поиска"
                  : selectedCategory?.title}
              </h2>
            </div>
            {matches.map((article) => (
              <button
                type="button"
                key={article.id}
                className={`help-article-link${article.id === selectedArticle.id ? " is-selected" : ""}`}
                onClick={() => openArticle(article)}
              >
                {article.title}
              </button>
            ))}
          </aside>
          <article
            className="utility-card help-article"
            aria-labelledby="help-article-title"
          >
            <div className="help-breadcrumb">
              <button
                type="button"
                className="help-back-link"
                onClick={() => {
                  setArticleId(undefined);
                  setCategoryId(undefined);
                }}
              >
                Справка
              </button>
              <span aria-hidden="true">›</span>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="help-back-link"
                onClick={() => setArticleId(undefined)}
              >
                {selectedCategory?.title}
              </button>
            </div>
            <h2 id="help-article-title">{selectedArticle.title}</h2>
            <p className="help-article-intro">{selectedArticle.intro}</p>
            {selectedArticle.sections.map((section) => (
              <section className="help-article-section" key={section.title}>
                <h3>{section.title}</h3>
                {section.text && <p>{section.text}</p>}
                {section.steps && (
                  <ol>
                    {section.steps.map((step) => (
                      <li key={step}>{step}</li>
                    ))}
                  </ol>
                )}
              </section>
            ))}
            {selectedArticle.warning && (
              <p className="help-warning" role="note">
                {selectedArticle.warning}
              </p>
            )}
            {selectedArticle.targetPage && onNavigate && (
              <button
                type="button"
                className="help-open-page"
                onClick={() => onNavigate(selectedArticle.targetPage!)}
              >
                Открыть страницу «{helpPageLabels[selectedArticle.targetPage]}»
              </button>
            )}
          </article>
        </div>
      ) : normalizedQuery ? (
        <section
          className="help-search-results"
          aria-live="polite"
          aria-label="Результаты поиска"
        >
          <h2>Результаты поиска</h2>
          {matches.length ? (
            matches.map((article) => {
              const category = helpCategories.find(
                (item) => item.id === article.category,
              );
              return (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="help-search-result"
                  key={article.id}
                  onClick={() => openArticle(article)}
                >
                  <span>{category?.title}</span>
                  <strong>{article.title}</strong>
                  <small>{article.summary}</small>
                </button>
              );
            })
          ) : (
            <p role="status">По этому запросу статьи не найдены.</p>
          )}
        </section>
      ) : categoryId && selectedCategory ? (
        <section
          className="help-search-results"
          aria-labelledby="help-category-title"
        >
          <button
            type="button"
            className="help-back-link"
            onClick={() => setCategoryId(undefined)}
          >
            Все разделы
          </button>
          <h2 id="help-category-title">{selectedCategory.title}</h2>
          {matches.map((article) => (
            <button
              type="button"
              className="help-search-result"
              key={article.id}
              onClick={() => openArticle(article)}
            >
              <strong>{article.title}</strong>
              <small>{article.summary}</small>
            </button>
          ))}
        </section>
      ) : (
        <section
          className="help-category-grid"
          aria-labelledby="help-categories-title"
        >
          <h2 id="help-categories-title">Темы</h2>
          <div className="help-category-cards">
            {helpCategories.map((category) => (
              <button
                type="button"
                className="help-category-card"
                key={category.id}
                onClick={() => openCategory(category.id)}
              >
                <span className="help-category-card-heading">
                  <strong>{category.title}</strong>
                  <span aria-hidden="true">›</span>
                </span>
                <span className="help-category-description">
                  {category.description}
                </span>
                <small>
                  Статей: {helpArticles.filter((article) => article.category === category.id).length}
                </small>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </section>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

@@PORTABLE {"path":"frontend/src/browser_backend.ts","mode":420,"size":13171,"sha256":"6190933b8bde2ed09a540bc66c30fa8cbd9bab4a60453fa61d98988ce2e77495","index":0,"count":1,"encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":13171}
import type { InstallationEventView, ProjectBackend } from "./backend";

declare global {
  interface Window {
    __PI_BROWSER_READY__?: Promise<void>;
    __PI_BROWSER_LEASE__?: string;
  }
}

async function browserReady(): Promise<string> {
  if (!window.__PI_BROWSER_READY__) throw new Error("BROWSER_HOST_UNAVAILABLE");
  await window.__PI_BROWSER_READY__;
  const lease = window.__PI_BROWSER_LEASE__;
  if (!lease) throw new Error("BROWSER_TAB_LEASE_UNAVAILABLE");
  return lease;
}

async function invoke<T>(operation: string, args: unknown[] = []): Promise<T> {
  const lease = await browserReady();
  const response = await fetch(`/api/call/${encodeURIComponent(operation)}`, {
    method: "POST",
    credentials: "same-origin",
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      "X-Platform-UI-Lease": lease,
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(args),
  });
  const payload = (await response.json().catch(() => ({}))) as {
    result?: T;
    error?: { code?: string };
  };
  if (!response.ok)
    throw new Error(payload.error?.code || "BROWSER_API_REQUEST_FAILED");
  return payload.result as T;
}

function promptExecutionNodePath(purpose: string): string {
  return (
    window.prompt(
      `${purpose}\nУкажите абсолютный путь на Linux Execution Node.`,
    ) || ""
  ).trim();
}

function chooseBrowserFile(): Promise<File | null> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const input = document.createElement("input");
    input.type = "file";
    input.accept = ".json,.age,application/json";
    input.onchange = () => resolve(input.files?.[0] || null);
    input.addEventListener("cancel", () => resolve(null), { once: true });
    input.click();
  });
}

function toBase64(bytes: Uint8Array): string {
  let binary = "";
  const chunkSize = 0x8000;
  for (let offset = 0; offset < bytes.length; offset += chunkSize) {
    binary += String.fromCharCode(
      ...bytes.subarray(offset, offset + chunkSize),
    );
  }
  return btoa(binary);
}

async function choosePendingRuntimeSecretFile(
  input: Parameters<
    NonNullable<ProjectBackend["choosePendingDeploymentRuntimeSecretFile"]>
  >[0],
): Promise<string> {
  const file = await chooseBrowserFile();
  if (!file) return "CANCELLED";
  if (file.size === 0 || file.size > 131_072)
    throw new Error("SECRET_FILE_INVALID");
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(await file.arrayBuffer());
  try {
    return await invoke("choosePendingDeploymentRuntimeSecretFile", [
      input,
      toBase64(bytes),
    ]);
  } finally {
    bytes.fill(0);
  }
}

function sleep(milliseconds: number): Promise<void> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => window.setTimeout(resolve, milliseconds));
}

function subscribeEvents(
  handler: (value: {
    subscriptionId?: string;
    event?: InstallationEventView;
    errorCode?: string;
  }) => void,
): () => void {
  let stopped = false;
  let lastEventID = "";
  let controller: AbortController | undefined;
  const readStream = async (response: Response) => {
    if (!response.body) throw new Error("BROWSER_EVENT_STREAM_UNAVAILABLE");
    const reader = response.body.getReader();
    const decoder = new TextDecoder();
    let buffer = "";
    let frame: { id?: string; data: string[] } = { data: [] };
    const dispatch = () => {
      if (frame.id) lastEventID = frame.id;
      if (frame.data.length) {
        try {
          const message = JSON.parse(frame.data.join("\n")) as {
            name?: string;
            payload?: {
              subscriptionId?: string;
              event?: InstallationEventView;
              errorCode?: string;
            };
          };
          if (message.name === "installation-run-event" && message.payload)
            handler(message.payload);
        } catch {
          // Ignore malformed event frames; the next frame remains usable.
        }
      }
      frame = { data: [] };
    };
    while (!stopped) {
      const { value, done } = await reader.read();
      if (done) break;
      buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
      let boundary = buffer.indexOf("\n");
      while (boundary >= 0) {
        const line = buffer.slice(0, boundary).replace(/\r$/, "");
        buffer = buffer.slice(boundary + 1);
        if (line === "") dispatch();
        else if (!line.startsWith(":")) {
          const separator = line.indexOf(":");
          const field = separator < 0 ? line : line.slice(0, separator);
          const valueText =
            separator < 0 ? "" : line.slice(separator + 1).replace(/^ /, "");
          if (field === "id") frame.id = valueText;
          else if (field === "data") frame.data.push(valueText);
        }
        boundary = buffer.indexOf("\n");
      }
    }
    try {
      await reader.cancel();
    } catch {
      // Stream already closed.
    }
  };
  const connect = async () => {
    const lease = await browserReady();
    controller = new AbortController();
    const headers = new Headers({ "X-Platform-UI-Lease": lease });
    if (lastEventID) headers.set("Last-Event-ID", lastEventID);
    const response = await fetch("/api/events", {
      method: "GET",
      credentials: "same-origin",
      headers,
      signal: controller.signal,
    });
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error("BROWSER_EVENT_STREAM_UNAVAILABLE");
    await readStream(response);
  };
  void (async () => {
    let delay = 250;
    while (!stopped) {
      try {
        await connect();
        delay = 250;
      } catch {
        if (stopped) return;
      }
      if (!stopped) {
        await sleep(delay);
        delay = Math.min(delay * 2, 5000);
      }
    }
  })();
  return () => {
    stopped = true;
    controller?.abort();
  };
}

async function requestExit(): Promise<{
  status: "EXITING" | "EXIT_AFTER_RUN";
}> {
  const lease = await browserReady();
  const response = await fetch("/api/exit", {
    method: "POST",
    credentials: "same-origin",
    headers: { "X-Platform-UI-Lease": lease },
  });
  const result = (await response.json().catch(() => ({}))) as {
    status?: "EXITING" | "EXIT_AFTER_RUN";
    error?: { code?: string };
  };
  if (!response.ok)
    throw new Error(result.error?.code || "BROWSER_EXIT_FAILED");
  return { status: result.status || "EXITING" };
}

export function startBrowserActivityKeepAlive(): () => void {
  const touchInterval = 10_000;
  let lastTouch = 0;
  let timer = 0;
  let stopped = false;
  const touch = async () => {
    timer = 0;
    if (stopped || document.visibilityState !== "visible") return;
    lastTouch = Date.now();
    const lease = await browserReady().catch(() => "");
    if (!lease || stopped) return;
    void fetch("/api/heartbeat", {
      method: "POST",
      credentials: "same-origin",
      headers: { "X-Platform-UI-Lease": lease },
    }).catch(() => undefined);
  };
  const schedule = () => {
    if (stopped || timer) return;
    const delay = Math.max(0, touchInterval - (Date.now() - lastTouch));
    timer = window.setTimeout(() => void touch(), delay);
  };
  const activity = () => schedule();
  const visibility = () => {
    if (document.visibilityState === "visible") {
      lastTouch = 0;
      schedule();
    }
  };
  for (const eventName of [
    "pointerdown",
    "keydown",
    "input",
    "change",
    "focusin",
  ])
    document.addEventListener(eventName, activity, true);
  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", visibility);
  return () => {
    stopped = true;
    if (timer) window.clearTimeout(timer);
    for (const eventName of [
      "pointerdown",
      "keydown",
      "input",
      "change",
      "focusin",
    ])
      document.removeEventListener(eventName, activity, true);
    document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", visibility);
  };
}

@@PORTABLE {"path":"frontend/src/event-format.ts","mode":420,"size":754,"sha256":"fd64f4c499baef2986196d77180b668aeca5d49292d437e08bfe937979c508c3","index":0,"count":1,"encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":754}
import type { InstallationEventView } from "./backend";

export function eventTimestampLabel(timestamp: string): string {
  const date = new Date(timestamp);
  if (!Number.isFinite(date.getTime())) return "время неизвестно";
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ru-RU", {
    dateStyle: "short",
    timeStyle: "medium",
  }).format(date);
}

export function taskNameWithoutRole(
  event: InstallationEventView,
): string | undefined {
  const name = event.task?.name;
  const role = event.task?.role?.trim();
  if (!name || !role || !name.startsWith(role)) return name;

  const remainder = name.slice(role.length);
  const separator = remainder.match(/^\s*:\s*/);
  return separator ? remainder.slice(separator[0].length) || name : name;
}

export function executionNodeStatusLabel(status?: string): string {
  switch (status) {
    case "NOT_CONFIGURED": return "Не настроен";
    case "NOT_PREPARED":
    case "UNPREPARED": return "Не подготовлен";
    case "UNREACHABLE": return "Недоступен";
    case "PREPARATION_REQUIRED": return "Требуется подготовка";
    case "UPDATE_REQUIRED": return "Требуется обновление";
    case "INCOMPATIBLE": return "Несовместим";
    case "BROKEN": return "Ошибка узла";
    case "READY": return "Готов";

export function executionNodePreparationLabel(status?: string): string {
  switch (status) {
    case "CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED": return "Ожидает подтверждения";
    case "BLOCKED": return "Подготовка недоступна";
    case "PREPARED": return "Подготовлен";
    default: return executionNodeStatusLabel(status);
  }
}

type ExecutionNodeStatusInput = {
  status?: string;
  error?: { message?: string };
  findings?: Array<{ safeMessage: string }>;
  steps?: Array<{ mutates?: boolean }>;
};

export type ExecutionNodeCombinedStatus = {
  label: string;
  tone: "success" | "warning" | "danger" | "neutral";
  detail?: string;
};

export function executionNodeCombinedStatus(
  readiness?: ExecutionNodeStatusInput | null,
  preparation?: ExecutionNodeStatusInput | null,
): ExecutionNodeCombinedStatus {
  if (preparation?.status === "PREPARING") {
    return { label: "Выполняется подготовка", tone: "warning" };
  }
  if (preparation?.status === "PREPARED") {
    return { label: "Проверен: Подготовлен", tone: "success" };
  }
  if (preparation?.error) {
    return {
      label: "Ошибка подготовки",
      tone: "danger",
      detail: preparation.error.message,
    };
  }
  if (preparation?.status === "CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED") {
    if (preparation.steps?.some((step) => step.mutates)) {
      return {
        label: "Проверен: Требуется подготовка",
        tone: "warning",
        detail: "Ожидает подтверждения",
      };
    }
    if (!preparation.steps?.length) {
      return {
        label: "Проверен: Ожидает подтверждения",
        tone: "warning",
      };
    }
    return {
      label: "Проверен: Подготовлен",
      tone: "success",
      detail: "Ожидает подтверждения проверки",
    };
  }
  if (preparation?.status === "BLOCKED") {
    return {
      label: "Подготовка недоступна",
      tone: "danger",
      detail: preparation.findings?.map((finding) => finding.safeMessage).join(" · "),
    };
  }
  if (preparation?.status === "UNREACHABLE") {
    return { label: "Проверен: Недоступен", tone: "danger" };
  }
  if (preparation?.status === "INCOMPATIBLE") {
    return { label: "Проверен: Несовместим", tone: "danger" };
  }
  if (preparation?.status === "BROKEN") {
    return { label: "Проверен: Ошибка узла", tone: "danger" };
  }
  if (preparation?.status === "UPDATE_REQUIRED") {
    return { label: "Проверен: Требуется обновление", tone: "warning" };
  }
  if (
    preparation?.status === "PREPARATION_REQUIRED" ||
    preparation?.status === "UNPREPARED" ||
    preparation?.status === "NOT_PREPARED"
  ) {
    return { label: "Проверен: Требуется подготовка", tone: "warning" };
  }
  if (preparation?.status === "READY") {
    return { label: "Проверен: Подготовлен", tone: "success" };
  }
  if (readiness?.error) {
    return {
      label: "Проверка недоступна",
      tone: "danger",
      detail: readiness.error.message,
    };
  }
  if (!readiness) return { label: "Не проверен", tone: "neutral" };
  switch (readiness.status) {
    case "READY":
      return { label: "Проверен: Подготовлен", tone: "success" };
    case "UPDATE_REQUIRED":
      return { label: "Проверен: Требуется обновление", tone: "warning" };
    case "PREPARATION_REQUIRED":
    case "UNPREPARED":
    case "NOT_PREPARED":
      return { label: "Проверен: Требуется подготовка", tone: "warning" };
    case "UNREACHABLE":
      return { label: "Проверен: Недоступен", tone: "danger" };
    case "INCOMPATIBLE":
      return { label: "Проверен: Несовместим", tone: "danger" };
    case "BROKEN":
      return { label: "Проверен: Ошибка узла", tone: "danger" };
    case "NOT_CONFIGURED":
      return { label: "Не проверен: Узел не настроен", tone: "neutral" };
    default:
      return { label: "Состояние неизвестно", tone: "neutral" };
  }
}

@@PORTABLE {"path":"frontend/src/installationPresentation.ts","mode":420,"size":6225,"sha256":"655121561fe89d35c038775285573167a02bb3fb251fbf845d4be430061f1b2f","index":0,"count":1,"encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":6225}
import type {
  InstallationEventView,
  InstallationPlanView,
  InstallationRunOperation,
  InstallationState,
} from "./backend";

export type RunProgress = {
  runId: string;
  // Highest sequence observed, which can advance ahead of delivery order.
  lastSequence: number;
  // Highest sequence for which every preceding event has been observed.
  lastContiguousSequence: number;
  pendingSequences: number[];
  complete: boolean;
  actionIds: string[];
  completedActionIds: string[];
  actionOutcomes: Record<string, string>;
  actionOutcomeSequences: Record<string, number>;
  activeActionId?: string;
};

export function beginRunProgress(
  runId: string,
  plan?: InstallationPlanView,
): RunProgress {
  return {
    runId,
    lastSequence: 0,
    lastContiguousSequence: 0,
    pendingSequences: [],
    complete: true,
    actionIds: [
      ...new Set(
        plan?.phases.flatMap((phase) =>
          phase.actions.map((action) => action.id),
        ) || [],
      ),
    ],
    completedActionIds: [],
    actionOutcomes: {},
    actionOutcomeSequences: {},
  };
}

export function observeRunEvent(
  current: RunProgress,
  event: InstallationEventView,
): RunProgress {
  if (event.runId !== current.runId || event.sequence < 1) return current;
  const pending = new Set(current.pendingSequences);
  let contiguous = current.lastContiguousSequence;
  if (event.sequence > contiguous) pending.add(event.sequence);
  while (pending.delete(contiguous + 1)) contiguous += 1;
  const complete = pending.size === 0;
  const isNewest = event.sequence >= current.lastSequence;
  const knownAction =
    !!event.actionId && current.actionIds.includes(event.actionId);
  const outcomeRecorded =
    knownAction &&
    event.eventType === "ACTION_COMPLETED" &&
    [
      "SUCCESS",
      "CHANGED",
      "SKIPPED",
      "FAILED",
      "CANCELLED",
      "INTERRUPTED",
    ].includes(event.status);
  const shouldRecordOutcome =
    outcomeRecorded &&
    event.sequence > (current.actionOutcomeSequences[event.actionId!] || 0);
  const actionOutcomes = shouldRecordOutcome
    ? { ...current.actionOutcomes, [event.actionId!]: event.status }
    : current.actionOutcomes;
  const actionOutcomeSequences = shouldRecordOutcome
    ? { ...current.actionOutcomeSequences, [event.actionId!]: event.sequence }
    : current.actionOutcomeSequences;
  const completedActionIds = current.actionIds.filter((actionId) =>
    ["SUCCESS", "CHANGED", "SKIPPED"].includes(actionOutcomes[actionId]),
  );
  return {
    ...current,
    lastSequence: Math.max(current.lastSequence, event.sequence),
    lastContiguousSequence: contiguous,
    pendingSequences: [...pending],
    complete,
    completedActionIds,
    actionOutcomes,
    actionOutcomeSequences,
    activeActionId: !isNewest
      ? current.activeActionId
      : knownAction && event.eventType === "ACTION_STARTED"
        ? event.actionId
        : event.eventType === "ACTION_COMPLETED" &&
            event.actionId === current.activeActionId
          ? undefined
          : current.activeActionId,
  };
}

export function actionResultLabel(
  actionId: string,
  runState: string,
  progress?: RunProgress,
): string {
  const outcome = progress?.actionOutcomes[actionId];
  if (outcome === "SUCCESS" || outcome === "CHANGED") return "Успешно";
  if (outcome === "SKIPPED") return "Пропущено";
  if (outcome === "FAILED") return "Ошибка";
  if (outcome === "CANCELLED" || outcome === "INTERRUPTED") return "Прервано";
  if (!progress?.complete) return "Сведения неполные";
  return runState === "SUCCEEDED" ? "Событие не получено" : "Не подтверждено";
}

const terminalStates = new Set([
  "SUCCEEDED",
  "FAILED",
  "CANCELLED",
  "INTERRUPTED",
]);
const activeStates = new Set(["STARTING", "RUNNING", "CANCELLING"]);

export function installationDisplay(
  state?: InstallationState,
  run?: InstallationRunOperation,
  progress?: RunProgress,
): {
  label: string;
  detail: string;
  tone: "neutral" | "running" | "failed" | "succeeded";
  percent?: number;
  stage: "plan" | "execution" | "result";
} {
  const runState = run?.run?.state;
  if (runState === "SUCCEEDED") {
    return {
      label: "Установка выполнена",
      detail: "Все действия завершены",
      tone: "succeeded",
      percent: 100,
      stage: "result",
    };
  }
  if (runState && terminalStates.has(runState)) {
    const label =
      runState === "FAILED"
        ? "Ошибка установки"
        : runState === "CANCELLED"
          ? "Установка отменена"
          : "Установка прервана";
    return {
      label,
      detail: "Откройте результат запуска",
      tone: "failed",
      percent: confirmedPercent(progress),
      stage: "result",
    };
  }
  if (runState && activeStates.has(runState)) {
    return {
      label: runState === "CANCELLING" ? "Отмена установки" : "Идёт установка",
      detail: "Откройте ход выполнения",
      tone: "running",
      percent: confirmedPercent(progress),
      stage: "execution",
    };
  }
  if (run?.error) {
    return {
      label: "Запуск не начался",
      detail: "Требуется исправить ошибку",
      tone: "failed",
      stage: "plan",
    };
  }
  if (state?.status === "PLAN_APPROVED" || state?.status === "PLAN_REVIEW") {
    return {
      label: "Установка не начата",
      detail:
        state.status === "PLAN_APPROVED"
          ? "План одобрен"
          : "План ожидает одобрения",
      tone: "neutral",
      stage: "plan",
    };
  }
  return {
    label: "План не готов",
    detail: "Сформируйте свежий план",
    tone: "neutral",
    stage: "plan",
  };
}

function confirmedPercent(progress?: RunProgress): number | undefined {
  if (!progress || progress.actionIds.length === 0) return undefined;
  return Math.min(
    99,
    Math.floor(
      (progress.completedActionIds.length * 100) / progress.actionIds.length,
    ),
  );
}

// This will trigger any event listeners.

@@PORTABLE {"path":"internal/appconfig/config.go","mode":420,"size":6221,"sha256":"61703e3f6cc5753ef6d07c07d3b0ede7ac61605a7ae1549a7a77c4a644708061","index":0,"count":1,"encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":6221}
package appconfig

import (
	"errors"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"gopkg.in/yaml.v3"
)

const (
	SchemaVersion        = 2
	maxConfigBytes       = 64 * 1024
	maxServerTypes       = 64
	maxServicePriorities = 64
	maxDisplayNameLength = 128
)

var ServerTypeIDPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,62}$`)

type ServerType struct {
	ID          string `json:"id" yaml:"id"`
	DisplayName string `json:"displayName" yaml:"displayName"`
}

type ServiceExecutionPriority struct {
	ServiceType string `json:"serviceType" yaml:"serviceType"`
	Priority    *int   `json:"priority" yaml:"priority"`
}

type Config struct {
	SchemaVersion              int                        `json:"schemaVersion" yaml:"schemaVersion"`
	ServerTypes                []ServerType               `json:"serverTypes" yaml:"serverTypes"`
	ServiceExecutionPriorities []ServiceExecutionPriority `json:"serviceExecutionPriorities" yaml:"serviceExecutionPriorities"`
}

type Error struct {
	Code string
}

func (e *Error) Error() string { return e.Code }

func Load(path string) (Config, error) {
	file, err := openRegularFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return Config{}, err
	}
	defer file.Close()
	if info, err := file.Stat(); err != nil {
		return Config{}, &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_UNREADABLE"}
	} else if info.Size() > maxConfigBytes {
		return Config{}, &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_TOO_LARGE"}
	}

	decoder := yaml.NewDecoder(io.LimitReader(file, maxConfigBytes+1))
	decoder.KnownFields(true)
	var config Config
	if err := decoder.Decode(&config); err != nil {
		return Config{}, &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_INVALID"}
	}
	var extra any
	if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); err != io.EOF {
		return Config{}, &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_INVALID"}
	}
	if err := Validate(config); err != nil {
		return Config{}, err
	}
	return config, nil
}

func openRegularFile(path string) (*os.File, error) {
	absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_UNREADABLE"}
	}
	for component := absolute; ; component = filepath.Dir(component) {
		info, err := os.Lstat(component)
		if err != nil {
			if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
				return nil, &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_NOT_FOUND"}
			}
			return nil, &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_UNREADABLE"}
		}
		if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
			return nil, &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_UNSAFE_PATH"}
		}
		parent := filepath.Dir(component)
		if parent == component {
			break
		}
	}
	before, err := os.Lstat(absolute)
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
			return nil, &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_NOT_FOUND"}
		}
		return nil, &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_UNREADABLE"}
	}
	if before.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || !before.Mode().IsRegular() {
		return nil, &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_UNSAFE_PATH"}
	}
	file, err := os.Open(absolute)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_UNREADABLE"}
	}
	after, err := file.Stat()
	if err != nil || !after.Mode().IsRegular() || !os.SameFile(before, after) {
		file.Close()
		return nil, &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_UNSAFE_PATH"}
	}
	return file, nil
}

func Validate(config Config) error {
	if config.SchemaVersion == 1 {
		return &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_UPGRADE_REQUIRED"}
	}
	if config.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion {
		return &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED"}
	}
	if len(config.ServerTypes) == 0 || len(config.ServerTypes) > maxServerTypes {
		return &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_SERVER_TYPES_INVALID"}
	}
	if len(config.ServiceExecutionPriorities) == 0 || len(config.ServiceExecutionPriorities) > maxServicePriorities {
		return &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_SERVICE_PRIORITIES_INVALID"}
	}
	prioritySeen := make(map[string]bool, len(config.ServiceExecutionPriorities))
	for _, entry := range config.ServiceExecutionPriorities {
		if !ServerTypeIDPattern.MatchString(entry.ServiceType) || entry.Priority == nil || *entry.Priority < 0 {
			return &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_SERVICE_PRIORITY_INVALID"}
		}
		if prioritySeen[entry.ServiceType] {
			return &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_SERVICE_PRIORITY_DUPLICATE"}
		}
		prioritySeen[entry.ServiceType] = true
	}
	seen := make(map[string]bool, len(config.ServerTypes))
	for _, serverType := range config.ServerTypes {
		if !ServerTypeIDPattern.MatchString(serverType.ID) {
			return &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_SERVER_TYPE_ID_INVALID"}
		}
		name := strings.TrimSpace(serverType.DisplayName)
		if name == "" || !utf8.ValidString(name) || utf8.RuneCountInString(name) > maxDisplayNameLength {
			return &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_SERVER_TYPE_NAME_INVALID"}
		}
		key := strings.ToLower(serverType.ID)
		if seen[key] {
			return &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_SERVER_TYPE_DUPLICATE"}
		}
		seen[key] = true
	}
	return nil
}

func (c Config) HasServerType(id string) bool {
	for _, serverType := range c.ServerTypes {
		if serverType.ID == id {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func ResolveDevelopmentPath(workingDirectory, executable string) (string, error) {
	candidates := []string{}
	if executable != "" {
		candidates = append(candidates, filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(executable), "..", "..", "config", "application.yml")))
	}
	if isRepositoryDevelopmentRoot(workingDirectory) {
		candidates = append(candidates, filepath.Join(workingDirectory, "config", "application.yml"))
	}
	for _, candidate := range candidates {
		file, err := openRegularFile(candidate)
		if err == nil {
			file.Close()
			return candidate, nil
		}
		var typed *Error
		if errors.As(err, &typed) && typed.Code != "APPLICATION_CONFIG_NOT_FOUND" {
			return "", err
		}
	}
	return "", &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_NOT_FOUND"}
}

func isRepositoryDevelopmentRoot(root string) bool {
	file, err := openRegularFile(filepath.Join(root, "go.mod"))
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	defer file.Close()
	content, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, 4097))
	if err != nil || len(content) > 4096 {
		return false
	}
	for _, line := range strings.Split(string(content), "\n") {
		if strings.TrimSpace(line) == "module platform-installer" {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

// Package artifactsource selects where one compatible install requirement is
// satisfied. Repository checks are supplied by the actual install node.
package artifactsource

import (
	"context"
	"strings"
)

type Source string

const (
	Repository    Source = "REPOSITORY"
	OfflineBundle Source = "OFFLINE_BUNDLE"
	Blocked       Source = "BLOCKED"
)

type Requirement struct {
	ID           string `json:"id"`
	Name         string `json:"name"`
	Version      string `json:"version"`
	OS           string `json:"os"`
	Architecture string `json:"architecture"`
}

type Candidate struct {
	ID           string     `json:"id"`
	Name         string     `json:"name"`
	Version      string     `json:"version"`
	OS           string     `json:"os"`
	Architecture string     `json:"architecture"`
	Artifacts    []Artifact `json:"artifacts,omitempty"`
}

type Artifact struct {
	Ref    string `json:"ref"`
	SHA256 string `json:"sha256"`
	Size   int64  `json:"size"`
	Type   string `json:"type"`
}

type Result struct {
	APIVersion  string      `json:"apiVersion"`
	Kind        string      `json:"kind"`
	Requirement Requirement `json:"requirement"`
	TargetNode  string      `json:"targetNode"`
	Source      Source      `json:"source"`
	Version     string      `json:"version,omitempty"`
	ArtifactRef string      `json:"artifactRef,omitempty"`
	Artifacts   []Artifact  `json:"artifacts,omitempty"`
	Reason      string      `json:"reason"`
}

type Provider interface {
	FindCompatible(Requirement) (Candidate, bool, error)
}

// CandidatesProvider is a data-only bundle provider. It contains candidates
// already verified by the bundle importer; it does not select a source or
// inspect the target node.
type CandidatesProvider []Candidate

func (p CandidatesProvider) FindCompatible(requirement Requirement) (Candidate, bool, error) {
	for _, candidate := range p {
		if compatible(requirement, candidate) {
			return candidate, true, nil
		}
	}
	return Candidate{}, false, nil
}

type ProbeStatus string

const (
	AvailableCompatible   ProbeStatus = "AVAILABLE_COMPATIBLE"
	AvailableIncompatible ProbeStatus = "AVAILABLE_INCOMPATIBLE"
	NotFound              ProbeStatus = "NOT_FOUND"
	RepositoryUnavailable ProbeStatus = "REPOSITORY_UNAVAILABLE"
	ProbeFailed           ProbeStatus = "PROBE_FAILED"
)

type RepositoryProbeResult struct {
	TargetNode  string      `json:"targetNode"`
	Requirement Requirement `json:"requirement"`
	Status      ProbeStatus `json:"status"`
	Candidates  []Candidate `json:"candidates,omitempty"`
	Reason      string      `json:"reason"`
}

type RepositoryProbe interface {
	ProbeRepository(context.Context, Requirement) (RepositoryProbeResult, error)
}

// RuntimeProjection converts resolved decisions into the derived Ansible
// variable consumed by the shared service gate. It never writes project state.
func RuntimeProjection(targetNode string, results []Result) map[string]Result {
	projection := make(map[string]Result, len(results))
	for _, result := range results {
		if result.TargetNode != targetNode {
			continue
		}
		projection[result.Requirement.ID] = result
	}
	return projection
}

// Resolve applies the same policy to execution-node and target-node
// requirements. Each provider must query only the node it represents.
func Resolve(requirement Requirement, repository, bundle Provider) (Result, error) {
	return ResolveForNode("", requirement, repository, bundle)
}

// ResolveForNode returns the versioned contract consumed by Core service
// roles. Providers remain scoped to the target node supplied by the caller.
func ResolveForNode(targetNode string, requirement Requirement, repository, bundle Provider) (Result, error) {
	base := func(source Source, candidate Candidate, reason string) Result {
		return Result{APIVersion: "platform.installer/artifact-source/v1alpha1", Kind: "ResolvedArtifactSource", Requirement: requirement, TargetNode: targetNode, Source: source, Version: candidate.Version, ArtifactRef: candidate.ID, Artifacts: candidate.Artifacts, Reason: reason}
	}
	if candidate, ok, err := repository.FindCompatible(requirement); err != nil {
		if candidate, bundleOK, bundleErr := bundle.FindCompatible(requirement); bundleErr != nil {
			return Result{}, bundleErr
		} else if bundleOK {
			return base(OfflineBundle, candidate, "REPOSITORY_UNAVAILABLE"), nil
		}
		return base(Blocked, Candidate{}, "REPOSITORY_UNAVAILABLE"), err
	} else if ok && compatible(requirement, candidate) {
		return base(Repository, candidate, "REPOSITORY_COMPATIBLE"), nil
	}
	if candidate, ok, err := bundle.FindCompatible(requirement); err != nil {
		return Result{}, err
	} else if ok && compatible(requirement, candidate) {
		return base(OfflineBundle, candidate, "BUNDLE_COMPATIBLE"), nil
	}
	return base(Blocked, Candidate{}, "BUNDLE_MISSING_OR_INCOMPATIBLE"), nil
}

func compatible(requirement Requirement, candidate Candidate) bool {
	if candidate.Name != requirement.Name || candidate.OS != requirement.OS || candidate.Architecture != requirement.Architecture {
		return false
	}
	return versionMatches(requirement.Version, candidate.Version)
}

func versionMatches(required, actual string) bool {
	if required == "" {
		return true
	}
	requiredParts, actualParts := strings.Split(required, "."), strings.Split(actual, ".")
	if len(requiredParts) != len(actualParts) {
		return false
	}
	for i, part := range requiredParts {
		if part != "x" && part != "X" && part != actualParts[i] {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

	Findings               []map[string]any                       `json:"findings"`
	Raw                    json.RawMessage                        `json:"-"`
}

func DecodeSnapshot(data []byte) (*Snapshot, error) {
	if len(data) > 2*1024*1024 {
		return nil, errors.New("PROJECT_SNAPSHOT_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	}
	var snapshot Snapshot
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &snapshot); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := snapshot.validateApplications(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	snapshot.Raw = append(snapshot.Raw[:0], data...)
	return &snapshot, nil
}

type ApplicationOrigin struct {
	Resolution         string `json:"resolution"`
	Precision          string `json:"precision"`
	ApplicationPackage string `json:"applicationPackage"`
	LibraryPackage     string `json:"libraryPackage"`
	Host               string `json:"host"`
}

var applicationID = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:[-_.][a-z0-9]+)*$`)

func (s *Snapshot) validateApplications() error {
	if s.ApplicationLibraries == nil {
		return nil
	}
	a := s.ApplicationLibraries
	invalid := errors.New("APPLICATION_SNAPSHOT_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	if s.APIVersion != "platform.installer/project-snapshot/v2alpha1" || a.APIVersion != "platform.installer/application-libraries/v1alpha1" || (a.Status != "PASS" && a.Status != "BLOCKED") || a.Libraries == nil || len(a.Libraries) > 256 || len(a.Findings) > 1024 {
		return invalid
	}
	for id, library := range a.Libraries {
		if !validApplicationID(id) || library.LibraryRef == "" || len(library.LibraryRef) > 256 || library.Instances == nil || len(library.Instances) > 256 {
			return invalid
		}
		for id, instance := range library.Instances {
			if !validApplicationID(id) || !validApplicationID(instance.ApplicationName) || !validApplicationID(instance.SlotID) || instance.Placements == nil || len(instance.Placements) > 256 || len(instance.RuntimeSecretRequirements) > 256 {
				return invalid
			}
			for host, placement := range instance.Placements {
				if !validApplicationID(host) || placement.ServerID != host || !validApplicationID(placement.RuntimeRef) || placement.Origin.Host != host || placement.Origin.Resolution != "ANSIBLE" || placement.Origin.Precision != "RESOLUTION_SCOPE" {
					return invalid
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func validApplicationID(id string) bool { return len(id) <= 128 && applicationID.MatchString(id) }

package coreadapter

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"time"

type boundedBuffer struct {
	buffer    bytes.Buffer
	remaining int
}

func (b *boundedBuffer) Write(content []byte) (int, error) {
	written := len(content)
	if b.remaining > 0 {
		limit := len(content)
		if limit > b.remaining {
			limit = b.remaining
		}
		_, _ = b.buffer.Write(content[:limit])
		b.remaining -= limit
	}
	return written, nil
}

// CommandAdapter invokes the existing target-free UI-BE-02 Ansible entrypoint.
type CommandAdapter struct {
	Executable string
	WorkingDir string
	Playbook   string
	Catalog    string
	Env        []string
	Timeout    time.Duration
}

func (a *CommandAdapter) BuildSnapshot(ctx context.Context, projectRoot string, owned []string) (*Snapshot, error) {
	if a.Executable == "" || a.Playbook == "" || a.Catalog == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("core adapter is not configured")
	}
	timeout := a.Timeout
	if timeout <= 0 {
		timeout = 30 * time.Second
	}
	boundedContext, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, timeout)
	defer cancel()
	temporary, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "platform-installer-core-")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer os.RemoveAll(temporary)
	response := filepath.Join(temporary, "snapshot.json")
	variables := filepath.Join(temporary, "request.json")
	request := map[string]any{
		"platform_project_root":          projectRoot,
		"platform_service_catalog_path":  a.Catalog,
		"platform_installer_owned_paths": owned,
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(request)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(variables, encoded, 0o600); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	inventory := filepath.Join(projectRoot, "inventory", "hosts.yml")
	command := exec.CommandContext(boundedContext, a.Executable, "-i", inventory, a.Playbook, "-e", "@"+variables)
	command.Dir = a.WorkingDir
	command.Env = append(os.Environ(), a.Env...)
	command.Env = append(command.Env,
		"ANSIBLE_CALLBACKS_ENABLED=platform.core.project_snapshot_json",
		"PLATFORM_PROJECT_SNAPSHOT_OUTPUT="+response,
	)
	var diagnostics boundedBuffer
	diagnostics.remaining = 16384
	command.Stdout = io.Discard
	command.Stderr = &diagnostics
	err = command.Run()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("core snapshot command failed: %w", err)
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile(response)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("core snapshot response missing: %w", err)
	}
	var envelope map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &envelope); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("core snapshot response invalid: %w", err)
	}
	if _, blocked := envelope["adapterError"]; blocked {
		return nil, errors.New("core snapshot was blocked")
	}
	snapshot, err := DecodeSnapshot(data)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if snapshot.ProjectRevision == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("core snapshot response has no project revision")
	}
	return snapshot, nil
}

// projectSnapshotReader is intentionally narrower than the future editor
// backend: UI-01B can only obtain an authoritative read-only Core projection.
type projectSnapshotReader interface {
	BuildProjectSnapshot(context.Context, executionnode.Node, string, map[string]any) (*coreadapter.Snapshot, error)
}

type projectReader struct {
	transport      projectSnapshotReader
	node           executionnode.Node
	runtimeRelease map[string]any
}

type verificationSnapshot struct {
	Snapshot *coreadapter.Snapshot
	Runtime  executionnode.RuntimeEvidence
	NodeID   string
}

func (r projectReader) BuildVerificationSnapshot(ctx context.Context, root string) (verificationSnapshot, error) {
	transport, ok := r.transport.(interface {
		BuildProjectVerificationSnapshot(context.Context, executionnode.Node, string, map[string]any) (executionnode.ProjectVerificationSnapshot, error)
	})
	if !ok || r.node.ID == "" || len(r.runtimeRelease) == 0 {
		return verificationSnapshot{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_RUNTIME_IDENTITY_UNCONFIRMED")
	}
	result, err := transport.BuildProjectVerificationSnapshot(ctx, r.node, root, r.runtimeRelease)
	if err != nil {
		return verificationSnapshot{}, err
	}
	if !runtimeEvidenceMatchesExpected(result.Runtime, r.runtimeRelease) {
		return verificationSnapshot{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_RUNTIME_IDENTITY_MISMATCH")
	}
	return verificationSnapshot{Snapshot: result.Snapshot, Runtime: result.Runtime, NodeID: r.node.ID}, nil
}

func runtimeEvidenceMatchesExpected(actual executionnode.RuntimeEvidence, expected map[string]any) bool {
	for key, actualValue := range map[string]string{"bundleDigest": actual.BundleDigest, "coreVersion": actual.CoreVersion, "catalogDigest": actual.CatalogDigest} {
		requested, present := expected[key]
		if !present || requested != actualValue {
			return false
		}
	}
	planningProtocol, ok := expected["planningProtocol"].(string)
	return ok && planningProtocol != "" && actual.Protocol != "" && planningProtocol == actual.Protocol
}

func (r projectReader) BuildSnapshot(ctx context.Context, root string) (*coreadapter.Snapshot, error) {
	if r.transport == nil || r.node.ID == "" || len(r.runtimeRelease) == 0 {
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_NOT_CONFIGURED")
	}
	return r.transport.BuildProjectSnapshot(ctx, r.node, root, r.runtimeRelease)
}

type unavailableProjectReader struct{}

func (unavailableProjectReader) BuildSnapshot(context.Context, string) (*coreadapter.Snapshot, error) {
	return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_NOT_CONFIGURED")
}

func notVerified() ProjectVerification {
	return ProjectVerification{APIVersion: "platform.installer/project-verification/v1alpha1", Kind: "ProjectVerification", Status: "UNVERIFIED"}

func verificationAfterSave(previous ProjectVerification) ProjectVerification {
	if previous.Status != "VERIFIED" && previous.Status != "INVALID" && previous.Status != "STALE" {
		return notVerified()
	}
	return ProjectVerification{
		APIVersion:      "platform.installer/project-verification/v1alpha1",
		Kind:            "ProjectVerification",
		Status:          "STALE",
		ProjectIdentity: previous.ProjectIdentity,
		ProjectRevision: previous.ProjectRevision,
		ExecutionNodeID: previous.ExecutionNodeID,
		Runtime:         previous.Runtime,
		CheckedAt:       previous.CheckedAt,
	}
}

type AppOption func(*App)

func WithApplicationConfig(config appconfig.Config, err error) AppOption {
	return func(app *App) {
		app.config, app.configErr = config, err
		if err == nil {
			app.configErr = appconfig.Validate(config)
		}
	}
}

// WithExplicitExecutionNode supplies only a safe display identity for the
// existing startup-configured Execution Node. It never changes its transport.
func WithExplicitExecutionNode(id, address string) AppOption {
	return func(app *App) {
		if id == "" || address == "" {
			return
		}
		app.execution.external = &executionNodeCandidate{hostID: id, label: id + " · " + address}
	}
}

// WithTrustedExecutionNodeBinding supplies the private, startup-validated
// binding used by the existing read-only project reader. It is deliberately
// not derived from an E4 candidate or Wails input.
func WithTrustedExecutionNodeBinding(binding executionNodeBinding) AppOption {
	return func(app *App) {
		app.binding = &binding
	}
}

func WithAvailableExecutionBundle(root string) AppOption {
	return func(app *App) { app.availableBundleRoot = root }
}

func WithBundleCacheRoot(root string) AppOption {
	return func(app *App) { app.bundleCacheRoot = root }
}

func WithLocalRunRecordRoot(root string) AppOption {
	return func(app *App) { app.localRunRecordRoot = root }
}

type projectLifecycle interface {
	CreateProject(context.Context, projectlifecycle.CreateProjectRequest) (projectlifecycle.Result, error)
	OpenProject(context.Context, string) (projectlifecycle.Result, error)
	ResolveProjectCatalog(context.Context, string) (*projectlifecycle.ProjectCatalogView, error)
}

func NewApp(reader interface {
	BuildSnapshot(context.Context, string) (*coreadapter.Snapshot, error)
}, lifecycle projectLifecycle, options ...AppOption) *App {
	app := &App{reader: reader, lifecycle: lifecycle, projectRevision: installer.ProjectRevision, sessions: installer.NewEditSessionStore(), current: ProjectOpenResult{Status: "NO_PROJECT"}, configErr: errors.New("APPLICATION_CONFIG_NOT_FOUND"), secrets: runtimesecret.NewBroker(), execution: newExecutionNodeContextStore(nil, probeLocalExecutionNodeCandidate()), installationRuns: newInstallationRunRegistry(), approvedTargetHostKeys: map[string]approvedTargetHostKey{}, localRunRecordRoot: defaultLocalRunRecordRoot(), infrastructureVerificationRoot: defaultInfrastructureVerificationRoot(), events: noopEventPublisher{}}
	for _, option := range options {
		option(app)
	}
	app.configureTargetCredentialLease()
	app.configureTargetHostTrust()
	return app
}

func (a *App) GetApplicationConfig() ApplicationConfigResult {
	if a.configErr != nil {
		code := projectErrorCode(a.configErr)
		return ApplicationConfigResult{Status: "ERROR", Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: code, Message: projectErrorMessage(code)}}
	}
	config := a.config
	return ApplicationConfigResult{Status: "READY", Config: &config}
}

func (a *App) serverTypeDiagnostics(snapshot *coreadapter.Snapshot) []ApplicationDiagnostic {
	if snapshot == nil || a.configErr != nil {
		return nil
	}
	var diagnostics []ApplicationDiagnostic
	hostIDs := make([]string, 0, len(snapshot.Hosts))
	for hostID := range snapshot.Hosts {
		hostIDs = append(hostIDs, hostID)
	}
	sort.Strings(hostIDs)
	for _, hostID := range hostIDs {
		host := snapshot.Hosts[hostID]
		typeID, _ := host["type"].(string)
		if typeID == "" {
			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, ApplicationDiagnostic{Code: "LEGACY_SERVER_TYPE_MISSING", Severity: "WARNING", HostID: hostID, SafeMessage: "Server type is missing and must be selected before editing this server"})
		} else if !a.config.HasServerType(typeID) {
			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, ApplicationDiagnostic{Code: "UNKNOWN_CONFIGURED_SERVER_TYPE", Severity: "WARNING", HostID: hostID, SafeMessage: "Server type is not present in the current application configuration"})
		}
	}
	return diagnostics
}

func (a *App) managedServerTypeDiagnostics(view *installer.ManagedProjectView) []ApplicationDiagnostic {
	if view == nil || a.configErr != nil {
		return nil
	}
	hosts := managedSnapshotHosts(view)
	return a.serverTypeDiagnostics(&coreadapter.Snapshot{Hosts: hosts})
}

func (a *App) startup(ctx context.Context) { a.ctx = ctx }

func (a *App) shutdown(context.Context) {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	a.secrets.Close()
	a.pendingHostKey = nil
	a.invalidateDynamicBindingLocked()
	a.clearInstallationRunsLocked()
	a.execution.clear()
	a.continuation = nil
	a.clearProjectExportLocked()
}

func (a *App) ChooseProject() ProjectOpenResult {
	if a.ctx == nil {
		return a.failure("UI_NOT_READY")
	}
	root, err := a.openDirectory(a.ctx, DialogOptions{Title: "Открыть существующий проект"})
	if err != nil {
		return a.failure("PROJECT_SELECTION_FAILED")
	}
	if root == "" {
		return a.CurrentProject()
	}
	return a.OpenProject(root)
}

func (a *App) ChooseProjectParent() string {
	if a.ctx == nil {
		return ""
	}
	root, err := a.openDirectory(a.ctx, DialogOptions{Title: "Выбрать папку для нового проекта"})
	if err != nil {
		return ""
	}
	return root
}

// validates or publishes an export destination.

	if a.ctx == nil {
		return ""
	}
	root, err := a.openDirectory(a.ctx, DialogOptions{Title: "Выбрать папку для экспорта проекта"})
	if err != nil {
		return ""
	}
