type Component struct {
	Path   string `yaml:"path" json:"path"`
	SHA256 string `yaml:"sha256" json:"sha256"`
	Size   int64  `yaml:"size" json:"size"`
}

type ArtifactSource struct {
	ServiceType   string `yaml:"serviceType" json:"serviceType"`
	RequirementID string `yaml:"requirementId" json:"requirementId"`
	Name          string `yaml:"name" json:"name"`
	Version       string `yaml:"version" json:"version"`
	OS            string `yaml:"os" json:"os"`
	Architecture  string `yaml:"architecture" json:"architecture"`
	Digest        string `yaml:"digest" json:"digest"`
	Ref           string `yaml:"ref" json:"ref"`
	SHA256        string `yaml:"sha256" json:"sha256"`
	Size          int64  `yaml:"size" json:"size"`
	Type          string `yaml:"type" json:"type"`
}

type Verified struct {
	Root         string
	Manifest     Manifest
	Digest       string
	rootIdentity string
}

func ValidateRoot(root string) (Verified, error) {
	root, err := filepath.Abs(root)
	if err != nil {
		return Verified{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve bundle root: %w", err)
	}
	info, err := os.Stat(root)
	if err != nil || !info.IsDir() {
		return Verified{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_ROOT_INVALID")
	}
	rootIdentity, err := verifiedRootIdentity(root)
	if err != nil {
		return Verified{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_ROOT_INVALID")
	}
	manifestPath := filepath.Join(root, "manifest.yaml")
	data, err := os.ReadFile(manifestPath)
	if err != nil {
		return Verified{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_MANIFEST_MISSING")
	}
	var manifest Manifest
	if err := yaml.Unmarshal(data, &manifest); err != nil {
		return Verified{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_MANIFEST_INVALID")
	}
	if manifest.APIVersion != "platform.installer/execution-bundle/v1alpha1" || manifest.Kind != "ExecutionRuntimeBundle" || manifest.BundleVersion == "" || manifest.BootstrapProtocol != ProtocolVersion || manifest.CoreVersion == "" || !digestValid(manifest.CatalogDigest) || !digestValid(manifest.SchemaDigest) {
		return Verified{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_MANIFEST_INVALID")
	}
	if len(manifest.Platforms) == 0 || len(manifest.Components) == 0 {
		return Verified{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_CONTENT_MISSING")
	}
	for _, platform := range manifest.Platforms {
		if !safeToken(platform.OS) || !safeToken(platform.Version) || !safeToken(platform.Architecture) {
			return Verified{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_PLATFORM_INVALID")
		}
	}
	paths := make(map[string]bool, len(manifest.Components))
	components := append([]Component(nil), manifest.Components...)
	sort.Slice(components, func(i, j int) bool { return components[i].Path < components[j].Path })
	if !equalComponents(components, manifest.Components) {
		return Verified{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_MANIFEST_NOT_DETERMINISTIC")
	}
	for _, component := range manifest.Components {
		if !safeRelative(component.Path) || paths[component.Path] || !digestValid(component.SHA256) || component.Size < 0 {
			return Verified{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_COMPONENT_INVALID")
		}
		paths[component.Path] = true
		path := filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(component.Path))
		if !contained(root, path) {
			return Verified{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_COMPONENT_PATH_INVALID")
		}
		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
		if err != nil {
			return Verified{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_COMPONENT_MISSING")
		}
		if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
			return Verified{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_COMPONENT_UNSAFE")
		}
		if info.Size() != component.Size {
			return Verified{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_COMPONENT_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH")
		}
		digest, err := fileDigest(path)
		if err != nil || digest != component.SHA256 {
			return Verified{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_COMPONENT_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH")
		}
	}
	if err := validateArtifactSources(manifest.ArtifactSources, manifest.Components); err != nil {
		return Verified{}, err
	}
	return Verified{Root: root, Manifest: manifest, Digest: bytesDigest(data), rootIdentity: rootIdentity}, nil
}

func validateArtifactSources(sources []ArtifactSource, components []Component) error {
	if len(sources) > 256 {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_ARTIFACT_SOURCE_INVALID")
	}
	byPath := make(map[string]Component, len(components))
	for _, component := range components {
		byPath[component.Path] = component
	}
	ordered := append([]ArtifactSource(nil), sources...)
	sort.Slice(ordered, func(i, j int) bool {
		return artifactSourceKey(ordered[i]) < artifactSourceKey(ordered[j])
	})
	if len(sources) != 0 && !equalArtifactSources(ordered, sources) {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_MANIFEST_NOT_DETERMINISTIC")
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, source := range sources {
		if !safeToken(source.ServiceType) || !safeToken(source.RequirementID) || !safeToken(source.Name) || !safeToken(source.Version) || !safeToken(source.OS) || !safeToken(source.Architecture) || !safeRelative(source.Ref) || !strings.HasPrefix(source.Ref, "runtime/artifacts/") || !digestValid(source.Digest) || !digestValid(source.SHA256) || source.Size < 0 || (source.Type != "archive" && source.Type != "package" && source.Type != "file") {
			return errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_ARTIFACT_SOURCE_INVALID")
		}
		key := artifactSourceKey(source)
		component, found := byPath[source.Ref]
		if seen[key] || !found || source.Digest != source.SHA256 || component.SHA256 != source.SHA256 || component.Size != source.Size {
			return errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_ARTIFACT_SOURCE_INVALID")
		}
		seen[key] = true
	}
	return nil
}

func artifactSourceKey(value ArtifactSource) string {
	return strings.Join([]string{value.ServiceType, value.RequirementID, value.Name, value.Version, value.OS, value.Architecture, value.Digest, value.Ref, value.SHA256, fmt.Sprint(value.Size), value.Type}, "\x00")
}

func equalArtifactSources(left, right []ArtifactSource) bool {
	if len(left) != len(right) {
		return false
	}
	for index := range left {
		if left[index] != right[index] {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func fileDigest(path string) (string, error) {
	file, err := os.Open(path)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	defer file.Close()
	hash := sha256.New()
	if _, err = io.Copy(hash, file); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil)), nil
}
func bytesDigest(value []byte) string {
	sum := sha256.Sum256(value)
	return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}
func digestValid(value string) bool {
	if !strings.HasPrefix(value, "sha256:") || len(value) != 71 {
		return false
	}
	_, err := hex.DecodeString(value[7:])
	return err == nil
}
func safeToken(value string) bool {
	if value == "" || len(value) > 64 {
		return false
	}
	for _, char := range value {
		if !(char >= 'a' && char <= 'z' || char >= 'A' && char <= 'Z' || char >= '0' && char <= '9' || char == '.' || char == '_' || char == '-') {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}
func safeRelative(value string) bool {
	return value != "" && filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(value)) == value && !strings.HasPrefix(value, "/") && !strings.HasPrefix(value, "../") && !strings.Contains(value, "/../")
}
func contained(root, path string) bool {
	relative, err := filepath.Rel(root, path)
	return err == nil && relative != ".." && !strings.HasPrefix(relative, ".."+string(os.PathSeparator))
}
func equalComponents(left, right []Component) bool {
	if len(left) != len(right) {
		return false
	}
	for index := range left {
		if left[index] != right[index] {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

package executionnode

import (
	"context"

type AcquisitionEnvironment struct {
	OS               string
	Version          string
	Architecture     string
	RepositorySource string
	Trusted          bool
}

type RuntimeAcquisition struct {
	Environment   AcquisitionEnvironment
	BundleVersion string
	RuntimeInput  string
}

// AcquisitionSource owns repository-aware closure resolution. Its implementation
// is explicit and separate from Transport, so Prepare cannot reach it.
type AcquisitionSource interface {
	InspectAcquisitionSource(context.Context, Node) (AcquisitionEnvironment, error)
	AcquireRuntimeClosure(context.Context, Node, AcquisitionEnvironment, string) error
}

// BundleBuilder is intentionally capability-based. Production builders must
// implement RemoteBundleBuilder; the local Build capability remains only for
// isolated compatibility tests and is never selected by the CLI.
type BundleBuilder interface{}

type RemoteBundleBuilder interface {
	BuildOnExecutionNode(context.Context, Node, string, string, string) (string, error)
}

type AcquisitionService struct {
	source  AcquisitionSource
	builder BundleBuilder
	cache   executionbundle.Cache
}

func NewAcquisitionService(source AcquisitionSource, builder BundleBuilder, cache executionbundle.Cache) *AcquisitionService {
	return &AcquisitionService{source: source, builder: builder, cache: cache}
}

func (s *AcquisitionService) InspectAcquisitionSource(ctx context.Context, node Node) (AcquisitionEnvironment, error) {
	environment, err := s.source.InspectAcquisitionSource(ctx, node)
	if err != nil {
		return AcquisitionEnvironment{}, err
	}
	if !environment.Trusted || environment.RepositorySource == "" || environment.OS == "" || environment.Version == "" || environment.Architecture == "" {
		return AcquisitionEnvironment{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_ACQUISITION_SOURCE_UNTRUSTED")
	}
	return environment, nil
}

func (s *AcquisitionService) AcquireExecutionRuntime(ctx context.Context, node Node, bundleVersion string) (executionbundle.Verified, error) {
	environment, err := s.InspectAcquisitionSource(ctx, node)
	if err != nil {
		return executionbundle.Verified{}, err
	}
	if bundleVersion == "" {
		return executionbundle.Verified{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_ACQUISITION_VERSION_REQUIRED")
	}
	parent, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "platform-installer-acquire-")
	if err != nil {
		return executionbundle.Verified{}, err
	}
	defer os.RemoveAll(parent)
	input := filepath.Join(parent, "runtime-input")
	output := filepath.Join(parent, "bundle")
	if err := os.MkdirAll(input, 0o700); err != nil {
		return executionbundle.Verified{}, err
	}
	if err := s.source.AcquireRuntimeClosure(ctx, node, environment, input); err != nil {
		return executionbundle.Verified{}, fmt.Errorf("EXECUTION_RUNTIME_CLOSURE_FAILED: %w", err)
	}
	bundleRoot := output
	if remoteBuilder, ok := s.builder.(RemoteBundleBuilder); ok {
		bundleRoot, err = remoteBuilder.BuildOnExecutionNode(ctx, node, input, bundleVersion, "")
		if bundleRoot != "" {
			defer os.RemoveAll(bundleRoot)
		}
	} else {
		localBuilder, ok := s.builder.(interface {
			Build(context.Context, string, string, string, string) (executionbundle.Verified, error)
		})
		if !ok {
			return executionbundle.Verified{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_REMOTE_BUNDLE_BUILDER_REQUIRED")
		}
		_, err = localBuilder.Build(ctx, input, output, bundleVersion, "")
	}
	if err != nil {
		return executionbundle.Verified{}, fmt.Errorf("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_BUILD_FAILED: %w", err)
	}
	bundle, err := executionbundle.ValidateRoot(bundleRoot)
	if err != nil {
		return executionbundle.Verified{}, fmt.Errorf("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_BUILD_FAILED: %w", err)
	}
	published, err := s.cache.Publish(bundle.Root)
	if err != nil {
		return executionbundle.Verified{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_BUNDLE_PUBLICATION_FAILED")
	}
	return published, nil
}

func (t OpenSSHTransport) CredentialStartCapability(ctx context.Context, node Node) (CredentialStartCapability, error) {
	response, err := t.runtimeProtocol(ctx, node, map[string]any{"apiVersion": "platform.installer/execution-runtime/v1alpha1", "operation": "GetCapabilities"})
	if err != nil {
		return CredentialStartCapability{}, err
	}
	version, _ := response["apiVersion"].(string)
	allowed := []string{"apiVersion", "kind", "bootstrapProtocol", "coreVersion", "catalogDigest", "schemaDigest", "runtime", "supportedOperations", "executionStart", "targetCredentialLease", "projectSnapshotRequestVersions"}
	if version == "platform.installer/execution-capabilities/v1alpha3" || version == "platform.installer/execution-capabilities/v1alpha4" || version == "platform.installer/execution-capabilities/v1alpha5" || version == "platform.installer/execution-capabilities/v1alpha6" {
		allowed = append(allowed, "runtimeSecretDescriptors")

		allowed = append(allowed, "serviceConfigurationPreview")
	}
	if version == "platform.installer/execution-capabilities/v1alpha6" {
		allowed = append(allowed, "deploymentPlanRequestVersions")
	}
	if (version != "platform.installer/execution-capabilities/v1alpha2" && version != "platform.installer/execution-capabilities/v1alpha3" && version != "platform.installer/execution-capabilities/v1alpha4" && version != "platform.installer/execution-capabilities/v1alpha5" && version != "platform.installer/execution-capabilities/v1alpha6") || response["kind"] != "ExecutionCapabilities" || !closedKeys(response, allowed...) {
		return CredentialStartCapability{}, errors.New("TARGET_CREDENTIAL_LEASE_UNSUPPORTED")
	}
	start, startOK := response["executionStart"].(map[string]any)
	lease, leaseOK := response["targetCredentialLease"].(map[string]any)

		return CredentialStartCapability{}, errors.New("TARGET_CREDENTIAL_LEASE_UNSUPPORTED")
	}

			return CredentialStartCapability{}, errors.New("TARGET_CREDENTIAL_LEASE_UNSUPPORTED")

			return CredentialStartCapability{}, errors.New("TARGET_CREDENTIAL_LEASE_UNSUPPORTED")
		}

			return CredentialStartCapability{}, errors.New("TARGET_CREDENTIAL_LEASE_UNSUPPORTED")
		}
		maximum, ok := exactPositiveInt(lease["maxPayloadBytes"])
		if !ok || maximum > 1088*1024 {
			return CredentialStartCapability{}, errors.New("TARGET_CREDENTIAL_LEASE_UNSUPPORTED")
		}
		return CredentialStartCapability{APIVersion: version, MaxPayloadBytes: maximum, PayloadVersions: []string{credentialPayloadVersionV4}, TypedRuntimeInputs: true}, nil
	}

		return CredentialStartCapability{}, errors.New("TARGET_CREDENTIAL_LEASE_UNSUPPORTED")
	}
	versions, ok := decodeCredentialPayloadVersions(lease["payloadVersions"])
	if !ok {
		return CredentialStartCapability{}, errors.New("TARGET_CREDENTIAL_LEASE_UNSUPPORTED")
	}

func exactArrayOfStrings(raw any, expected string) bool {
	values, ok := raw.([]any)
	return ok && len(values) == 1 && values[0] == expected
}

func validServiceConfigurationPreviewCapability(raw any, operations any) bool {
	value, ok := raw.(map[string]any)
	if !ok || !closedKeys(value, "protocol", "maxResponseBytes") || value["protocol"] != "BuildServiceConfigurationPreview/v1alpha1" || !contains(operations, "BuildServiceConfigurationPreview") {
		return false
	}
	maximum, ok := exactPositiveInt(value["maxResponseBytes"])
	return ok && maximum == 1024*1024
}

func validRuntimeSecretDescriptorCapabilityV2(raw any, operations any) bool {
	value, ok := raw.(map[string]any)
	if !ok || !closedKeys(value, "protocol", "maxDescriptors", "maxHostsPerDescriptor", "maxResponseBytes") || value["protocol"] != "BuildRuntimeSecretDescriptors/v1alpha2" || !contains(operations, "BuildRuntimeSecretDescriptors") {
		return false
	}
	a, aok := exactPositiveInt(value["maxDescriptors"])
	b, bok := exactPositiveInt(value["maxHostsPerDescriptor"])
	c, cok := exactPositiveInt(value["maxResponseBytes"])
	return aok && bok && cok && a == 16 && b == 256 && c == 65536
}

func validRuntimeSecretDescriptorCapability(raw any, operations any) bool {
	value, ok := raw.(map[string]any)
	if !ok || !closedKeys(value, "protocol", "maxDescriptors", "maxHostsPerDescriptor", "maxResponseBytes") || value["protocol"] != "BuildRuntimeSecretDescriptors/v1alpha1" || !contains(operations, "BuildRuntimeSecretDescriptors") {
		return false
	}
	maxDescriptors, ok1 := exactPositiveInt(value["maxDescriptors"])
	maxHosts, ok2 := exactPositiveInt(value["maxHostsPerDescriptor"])
	maxResponse, ok3 := exactPositiveInt(value["maxResponseBytes"])
	return ok1 && ok2 && ok3 && maxDescriptors == 16 && maxHosts == 256 && maxResponse == 65536
}

func decodeCredentialPayloadVersions(raw any) ([]string, bool) {
	values, ok := raw.([]any)
	if !ok || len(values) < 1 || len(values) > 4 {
		return nil, false
	}
	result := make([]string, len(values))
	for index, value := range values {
		text, ok := value.(string)
		if !ok || (text != credentialPayloadVersion && text != credentialPayloadVersionV2 && text != credentialPayloadVersionV3 && text != credentialPayloadVersionV4) || (index > 0 && text <= result[index-1]) {
			return nil, false
		}
		result[index] = text
	}
	if result[0] != credentialPayloadVersion || (len(result) > 1 && result[1] != credentialPayloadVersionV2) || (len(result) > 2 && result[2] != credentialPayloadVersionV3) || (len(result) > 3 && result[3] != credentialPayloadVersionV4) {
		return nil, false
	}
	return result, true
}

func (c CredentialStartCapability) supportsPayloadVersion(version string) bool {
	for _, candidate := range c.PayloadVersions {
		if candidate == version {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func (t OpenSSHTransport) PutRuntimeSecretLease(ctx context.Context, node Node, request CredentialLeaseRequest, payload TargetCredentialLeasePayload, maxPayloadBytes int) (CredentialLeaseResponse, error) {
	if !validCredentialLeaseRequest(request) || maxPayloadBytes < 1 || maxPayloadBytes > 1088*1024 || (payload.Password == "") == (payload.PrivateKey == "") || payload.Username == "" || !validPKIStorePassword(payload.PKIStorePassword) || !validRuntimeSecretValues(payload.RuntimeSecretValues) || !validRuntimeSecretInputs(payload.RuntimeSecretInputs) {
		return CredentialLeaseResponse{}, errors.New("TARGET_CREDENTIAL_LEASE_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	version := credentialPayloadVersion
	body := map[string]any{"apiVersion": version, "kind": "TargetCredentialLeasePayload", "username": payload.Username, "password": nil, "privateKey": nil, "sudoPassword": nil}
	requestVersion := "platform.installer/runtime-secret-lease/v1alpha1"
	if payload.UseTypedRuntimeInputs || len(payload.RuntimeSecretInputs) > 0 {
		version = credentialPayloadVersionV4
		body["apiVersion"] = version
		body["pkiStorePassword"] = payload.PKIStorePassword
		body["runtimeSecretValues"] = payload.RuntimeSecretValues
		if payload.RuntimeSecretValues == nil {
			body["runtimeSecretValues"] = map[string]string{}
		}
		inputs := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(payload.RuntimeSecretInputs))
		for _, input := range payload.RuntimeSecretInputs {
			var value any
			if input.Purpose == "SERVICE_ADMIN_TOKEN" {
				value = input.Value
			} else {
				value = input.Shares
			}
			inputs = append(inputs, map[string]any{"requirementRef": input.RequirementRef, "purpose": input.Purpose, "serviceDeployment": input.ServiceDeployment, "operations": input.Operations, "value": value})
		}
		body["runtimeSecretInputs"] = inputs
		requestVersion = "platform.installer/runtime-secret-lease/v1alpha2"
	} else if payload.RuntimeSecretValues != nil {
		version = credentialPayloadVersionV3
		body["apiVersion"] = version
		body["pkiStorePassword"] = payload.PKIStorePassword
		body["runtimeSecretValues"] = payload.RuntimeSecretValues
	} else if payload.PKIStorePassword != "" {
		version = credentialPayloadVersionV2
		body["apiVersion"] = version
		body["pkiStorePassword"] = payload.PKIStorePassword
	}
	if (version == credentialPayloadVersionV3 || version == credentialPayloadVersionV4) && payload.PKIStorePassword == "" {
		body["pkiStorePassword"] = nil
	}
	if payload.Password != "" {
		body["password"] = payload.Password
	} else {
		body["privateKey"] = payload.PrivateKey
	}
	if payload.SudoPassword != "" {
		body["sudoPassword"] = payload.SudoPassword
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(body)
	if err != nil || len(encoded) > maxPayloadBytes {
		return CredentialLeaseResponse{}, errors.New("TARGET_CREDENTIAL_LEASE_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	response, err := t.runtimeProtocol(ctx, node, map[string]any{"apiVersion": requestVersion, "kind": "PutRuntimeSecretLeaseRequest", "requestId": request.RequestID, "startAttemptId": request.StartAttemptID, "projectIdentity": request.ProjectIdentity, "projectRevision": request.ProjectRevision, "planFingerprint": request.PlanFingerprint, "executionManifestDigest": request.ExecutionManifestDigest, "runtimeRelease": request.RuntimeRelease, "payload": body})
	if err != nil {
		return CredentialLeaseResponse{}, err
	}
	result := CredentialLeaseResponse{}
	for _, field := range []struct {
		raw any
		dst *string
	}{{response["requestId"], &result.RequestID}, {response["startAttemptId"], &result.StartAttemptID}, {response["status"], &result.Status}, {response["leaseId"], &result.LeaseID}, {response["stagedExpiresAt"], &result.StagedExpiresAt}} {
		value, ok := field.raw.(string)
		if !ok || value == "" || len(value) > 256 {
			return CredentialLeaseResponse{}, errors.New("TARGET_CREDENTIAL_LEASE_RESPONSE_INVALID")
		}
		*field.dst = value
	}
	if result.RequestID != request.RequestID || result.StartAttemptID != request.StartAttemptID || (result.Status != "STORED" && result.Status != "ALREADY_STORED") || !validLowerHex(result.LeaseID, 32) {
		return CredentialLeaseResponse{}, errors.New("TARGET_CREDENTIAL_LEASE_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	}
	return result, nil
}

func validPKIStorePassword(value string) bool {
	if value == "" {
		return true
	}
	return len([]byte(value)) <= 4096 && strings.ToValidUTF8(value, "") == value
}

func validRuntimeSecretValues(values map[string]string) bool {
	if values == nil {
		return true
	}
	if len(values) == 0 {
		return false
	}
	total := 0
	for reference, value := range values {
		if !runtimeSecretRequirementPattern.MatchString(reference) || strings.ToValidUTF8(value, "") != value {
			return false
		}
		size := len([]byte(value))
		if size < 1 || size > maxRuntimeSecretValueBytes {
			return false
		}
		total += size
		if total > maxRuntimeSecretTotalBytes {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func validRuntimeSecretInputs(values []RuntimeSecretInputPayload) bool {
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	total := 0
	for _, input := range values {
		if !runtimeSecretRequirementPattern.MatchString(input.RequirementRef) || !runtimeSecretDeploymentPattern.MatchString(input.ServiceDeployment) || len(input.ServiceDeployment) > 128 {
			return false
		}
		if seen[input.RequirementRef] {
			return false
		}
		seen[input.RequirementRef] = true
		switch input.Purpose {
		case "SERVICE_ADMIN_TOKEN":
			if len(input.Value) == 0 || len([]byte(input.Value)) > 4096 || strings.ToValidUTF8(input.Value, "") != input.Value || len(input.Shares) != 0 || len(input.Operations) != 2 || input.Operations[0] != "SERVICE_APPLY" || input.Operations[1] != "SERVICE_VERIFY" {
				return false
			}
			total += len([]byte(input.Value))
		case "SERVICE_UNSEAL_SHARES":
			if input.Value != "" || len(input.Shares) == 0 || len(input.Shares) > 255 || len(input.Operations) != 1 || input.Operations[0] != "SERVICE_APPLY" {
				return false
			}
			shareSeen := map[string]bool{}
			for _, share := range input.Shares {
				if len(share) == 0 || len([]byte(share)) > 128 || strings.ToValidUTF8(share, "") != share || shareSeen[share] {
					return false
				}
				shareSeen[share] = true
				total += len([]byte(share))
			}
		default:
			return false
		}
		if total > maxRuntimeSecretTotalBytes {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func (t OpenSSHTransport) StartExecutionV2(ctx context.Context, node Node, request ExecutionStartV2Request) (ExecutionStartV2Response, error) {
	if !validExecutionStartV2Request(request) {
		return ExecutionStartV2Response{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_START_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	body := map[string]any{"apiVersion": "platform.installer/execution-start/v1alpha2", "kind": "StartExecutionRequest", "startAttemptId": request.StartAttemptID, "projectIdentity": request.ProjectIdentity, "projectRevision": request.ProjectRevision, "planFingerprint": request.PlanFingerprint, "executionManifestDigest": request.ExecutionManifestDigest, "runtimeRelease": request.RuntimeRelease}
	if request.LeaseID != "" {
		body["leaseId"] = request.LeaseID
	}
	response, err := t.runtimeProtocol(ctx, node, body)
	if err != nil {
		return ExecutionStartV2Response{}, err
	}
	if !closedKeys(response, "apiVersion", "kind", "status", "startAttemptId", "runId") || response["apiVersion"] != "platform.installer/execution-start/v1alpha2" || response["kind"] != "StartExecutionResponse" {
		return ExecutionStartV2Response{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_START_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	}
	result := ExecutionStartV2Response{}
	result.Status, _ = response["status"].(string)
	result.StartAttemptID, _ = response["startAttemptId"].(string)
	result.RunID, _ = response["runId"].(string)
	if (result.Status != "STARTED" && result.Status != "ALREADY_STARTED") || result.StartAttemptID != request.StartAttemptID || !validRuntimeToken(result.RunID) {
		return ExecutionStartV2Response{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_START_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	}
	return result, nil
}

func validCredentialLeaseRequest(r CredentialLeaseRequest) bool {
	return validLowerHex(r.RequestID, 32) && validLowerHex(r.StartAttemptID, 32) && candidateIdentityPattern.MatchString(r.ProjectIdentity) && validSHA256(r.ProjectRevision) && validSHA256(r.PlanFingerprint) && validSHA256(r.ExecutionManifestDigest) && validRuntimeRelease(r.RuntimeRelease)
}
func validExecutionStartV2Request(r ExecutionStartV2Request) bool {
	return validLowerHex(r.StartAttemptID, 32) && candidateIdentityPattern.MatchString(r.ProjectIdentity) && validSHA256(r.ProjectRevision) && validSHA256(r.PlanFingerprint) && validSHA256(r.ExecutionManifestDigest) && (r.LeaseID == "" || validLowerHex(r.LeaseID, 32)) && validRuntimeRelease(r.RuntimeRelease)
}
func validRuntimeRelease(raw map[string]any) bool {
	if len(raw) != 4 {
		return false
	}
	core, coreOK := raw["coreVersion"].(string)
	protocol, protoOK := raw["planningProtocol"].(string)
	return coreOK && core != "" && len(core) <= 256 && protoOK && protocol != "" && len(protocol) <= 256 && validSHA256(stringValue(raw["bundleDigest"])) && validSHA256(stringValue(raw["catalogDigest"]))
}
func stringValue(v any) string { s, _ := v.(string); return s }
func closedKeys(value map[string]any, keys ...string) bool {
	if len(value) != len(keys) {
		return false
	}
	for _, key := range keys {
		if _, ok := value[key]; !ok {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}
func exactPositiveInt(value any) (int, bool) {
	number, ok := value.(float64)
	if !ok || number < 1 || number != float64(int(number)) || number > float64(^uint(0)>>1) {
		return 0, false
	}
	return int(number), true
}
func contains(value any, target string) bool {
	values, ok := value.([]any)
	if !ok {
		return false
	}
	for _, item := range values {
		text, ok := item.(string)
		if ok && strings.TrimSpace(text) == target {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

type EventMirror struct {
	mu     sync.Mutex
	runID  string
	path   string

func OpenEventMirror(runtimeRoot, runID, nodeFingerprint string) (*EventMirror, error) {
	destination, err := EventMirrorPath(runtimeRoot, runID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if !validSHA256Fingerprint(nodeFingerprint) {
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	root, _ := filepath.Abs(runtimeRoot)
	if err := ensureMirrorRoot(root); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := rejectSymlinkComponents(root); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	linkedRoot, linkRootErr := os.Lstat(root)
	if linkRootErr != nil || isUnsafeFilesystemLink(linkedRoot) || !linkedRoot.IsDir() {
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_PATH_UNSAFE")
	}
	rooted, err := os.OpenRoot(root)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_OPEN_FAILED")
	}
	openedRoot, openRootErr := rooted.Stat(".")
	if openRootErr != nil || !os.SameFile(linkedRoot, openedRoot) {
		_ = rooted.Close()
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_PATH_UNSAFE")
	}
	for _, directory := range []string{"executions", filepath.Join("executions", runID)} {
		if err := ensureRootedPrivateDirectory(rooted, directory); err != nil {
			_ = rooted.Close()
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	runDirectory := filepath.Join("executions", runID)
	linkedRun, linkRunErr := rooted.Lstat(runDirectory)
	runRoot, runRootErr := rooted.OpenRoot(runDirectory)
	if linkRunErr != nil || runRootErr != nil || isUnsafeFilesystemLink(linkedRun) || !linkedRun.IsDir() {
		if runRoot != nil {
			_ = runRoot.Close()
		}
		_ = rooted.Close()
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_PATH_UNSAFE")
	}
	openedRun, openRunErr := runRoot.Stat(".")
	if openRunErr != nil || !os.SameFile(linkedRun, openedRun) {
		_ = runRoot.Close()
		_ = rooted.Close()
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_PATH_UNSAFE")
	}
	_ = rooted.Close()
	lockFile, err := runRoot.OpenFile(".mirror.lock", os.O_CREATE|os.O_RDWR, 0o600)
	if err != nil {
		_ = runRoot.Close()
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_OPEN_FAILED")
	}
	linkedLock, linkLockErr := runRoot.Lstat(".mirror.lock")
	openedLock, openLockErr := lockFile.Stat()
	if linkLockErr != nil || openLockErr != nil || isUnsafeFilesystemLink(linkedLock) || !openedLock.Mode().IsRegular() || !os.SameFile(linkedLock, openedLock) || hardenMirrorHandle(lockFile) != nil {
		_ = lockFile.Close()
		_ = runRoot.Close()
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_PATH_UNSAFE")
	}
	unlock, lockErr := lockEventMirror(lockFile)
	if lockErr != nil {
		_ = lockFile.Close()
		_ = runRoot.Close()
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_IN_USE")
	}
	if err := bindEventMirror(runRoot, runID, nodeFingerprint); err != nil {
		_ = unlock()
		_ = lockFile.Close()
		_ = runRoot.Close()
		return nil, err
	}
	file, err := runRoot.OpenFile("events.jsonl", os.O_CREATE|os.O_RDWR, 0o600)
	if err != nil {
		_ = unlock()
		_ = lockFile.Close()
		_ = runRoot.Close()
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_OPEN_FAILED")
	}
	linkedInfo, linkErr := runRoot.Lstat("events.jsonl")
	openedInfo, openErr := file.Stat()
	if linkErr != nil || openErr != nil || isUnsafeFilesystemLink(linkedInfo) || !openedInfo.Mode().IsRegular() || !os.SameFile(linkedInfo, openedInfo) {
		_ = file.Close()
		_ = unlock()
		_ = lockFile.Close()
		_ = runRoot.Close()
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_PATH_UNSAFE")
	}
	if err := hardenMirrorHandle(file); err != nil {
		_ = file.Close()
		_ = unlock()
		_ = lockFile.Close()
		_ = runRoot.Close()
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_PERMISSIONS_FAILED")
	}
	mirror := &EventMirror{runID: runID, path: destination, file: file, lock: lockFile, root: runRoot, unlock: unlock, events: map[int][]byte{}}
	if err := mirror.recover(); err != nil {
		_ = unlock()
		_ = file.Close()
		_ = lockFile.Close()
		_ = runRoot.Close()
		return nil, err
	}
	return mirror, nil
}

type eventMirrorIdentity struct {
	APIVersion      string `json:"apiVersion"`
	RunID           string `json:"runId"`
	NodeFingerprint string `json:"nodeFingerprint"`
}

func bindEventMirror(root *os.Root, runID, nodeFingerprint string) error {
	expected := eventMirrorIdentity{APIVersion: "platform.installer/execution-mirror/v1alpha1", RunID: runID, NodeFingerprint: nodeFingerprint}
	encoded, _ := json.Marshal(expected)
	file, err := root.OpenFile("mirror.json", os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY, 0o600)
	if err == nil {
		defer file.Close()
		if hardenMirrorHandle(file) != nil {
			return errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_PERMISSIONS_FAILED")
		}
		if written, writeErr := file.Write(append(encoded, '\n')); writeErr != nil || written != len(encoded)+1 || file.Sync() != nil {
			return errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_WRITE_FAILED")
		}
		return nil
	}
	if !os.IsExist(err) {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_OPEN_FAILED")
	}
	file, err = root.Open("mirror.json")
	if err != nil {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_OPEN_FAILED")
	}
	defer file.Close()
	linked, linkErr := root.Lstat("mirror.json")
	opened, openErr := file.Stat()
	if linkErr != nil || openErr != nil || isUnsafeFilesystemLink(linked) || !opened.Mode().IsRegular() || !os.SameFile(linked, opened) || hardenMirrorHandle(file) != nil {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_PATH_UNSAFE")
	}
	data, readErr := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, maxMirrorMetadataBytes+1))
	if readErr != nil || len(data) > maxMirrorMetadataBytes {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_IDENTITY_INVALID")
	}
	actual := eventMirrorIdentity{}
	if json.Unmarshal(data, &actual) != nil || actual != expected || !bytes.Equal(bytes.TrimSpace(data), encoded) {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_NODE_CONFLICT")
	}
	return nil
}

func ensureMirrorRoot(root string) error {
	if _, err := os.Lstat(root); err == nil {
		return nil
	} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_PATH_INVALID")
	}
	parent := filepath.Dir(root)
	if parent == root || filepath.Base(root) == "." || filepath.Base(root) == string(filepath.Separator) {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_PATH_INVALID")
	}
	if err := rejectSymlinkComponents(parent); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	linkedParent, err := os.Lstat(parent)
	if err != nil || isUnsafeFilesystemLink(linkedParent) || !linkedParent.IsDir() {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_PATH_UNSAFE")
	}
	parentRoot, err := os.OpenRoot(parent)
	if err != nil {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_OPEN_FAILED")
	}
	defer parentRoot.Close()
	openedParent, err := parentRoot.Stat(".")
	if err != nil || !os.SameFile(linkedParent, openedParent) {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_PATH_UNSAFE")
	}
	name := filepath.Base(root)
	if err := parentRoot.Mkdir(name, 0o700); err != nil && !os.IsExist(err) {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_PATH_INVALID")
	}
	linkedRoot, linkErr := parentRoot.Lstat(name)
	openedRoot, openErr := parentRoot.OpenRoot(name)
	if linkErr != nil || openErr != nil || isUnsafeFilesystemLink(linkedRoot) || !linkedRoot.IsDir() {
		if openedRoot != nil {
			_ = openedRoot.Close()
		}
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_PATH_UNSAFE")
	}
	openedInfo, statErr := openedRoot.Stat(".")
	_ = openedRoot.Close()
	if statErr != nil || !os.SameFile(linkedRoot, openedInfo) {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_PATH_UNSAFE")
	}
	return nil
}

func EventMirrorPath(runtimeRoot, runID string) (string, error) {
	if runtimeRoot == "" || !validRuntimeToken(runID) {
		return "", errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	root, err := filepath.Abs(runtimeRoot)
	if err != nil {
		return "", errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_PATH_INVALID")
	}
	destination := filepath.Join(root, "executions", runID, "events.jsonl")
	if !containedPath(root, destination) {
		return "", errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_PATH_INVALID")
	}
	return destination, nil
}

func (m *EventMirror) Path() string { return m.path }

func (m *EventMirror) LastSequence() int {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	return m.last
}

func (m *EventMirror) knownEvents() map[int][]byte {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	result := make(map[int][]byte, len(m.events))
	for sequence, encoded := range m.events {
		result[sequence] = append([]byte(nil), encoded...)
	}
	return result
}

func (m *EventMirror) Append(event ExecutionEvent) (bool, error) {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	if m.closed {
		return false, errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_CLOSED")
	}
	if validateExecutionEvent(event, m.runID) != nil {
		return false, errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_EVENT_INVALID")
	}
	encoded, err := canonicalEvent(event)
	if err != nil || len(encoded)+1 > maxMirroredEventBytes {
		return false, errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_EVENT_INVALID")
	}
	if prior, ok := m.events[event.Sequence]; ok {
		if bytes.Equal(prior, encoded) {
			return false, nil
		}
		return false, errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_DUPLICATE_CONFLICT")
	}
	if m.last != 0 && event.Sequence != m.last+1 {
		return false, errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_SEQUENCE_GAP")
	}
	if m.bytes+int64(len(encoded)+1) > maxMirrorBytes {
		return false, errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_LIMIT")
	}
	if len(m.events) >= maxMirroredEvents {
		return false, errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_LIMIT")
	}
	line := append(encoded, '\n')
	if _, err := m.file.Seek(0, io.SeekEnd); err != nil {
		return false, errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_WRITE_FAILED")
	}
	written, err := m.file.Write(line)
	if err != nil || written != len(line) {
		return false, errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_WRITE_FAILED")
	}
	if err := m.file.Sync(); err != nil {
		return false, errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_SYNC_FAILED")
	}
	m.events[event.Sequence] = append([]byte(nil), encoded...)
	if m.first == 0 {
		m.first = event.Sequence
	}
	m.last = event.Sequence
	m.bytes += int64(len(line))
	return true, nil
}

func (m *EventMirror) Events(after int) []ExecutionEvent {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	result := make([]ExecutionEvent, 0)
	start := after + 1
	if start < m.first {
		start = m.first
	}
	for sequence := start; sequence <= m.last; sequence++ {
		var event ExecutionEvent
		if err := json.Unmarshal(m.events[sequence], &event); err == nil {
			result = append(result, event)
		}
	}
	return result
}

func (m *EventMirror) Reset() error {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	if m.closed {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_CLOSED")
	}
	if err := m.file.Truncate(0); err != nil {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_WRITE_FAILED")
	}
	if _, err := m.file.Seek(0, io.SeekStart); err != nil || m.file.Sync() != nil {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_SYNC_FAILED")
	}
	m.last = 0
	m.first = 0
	m.bytes = 0
	m.events = map[int][]byte{}
	return nil
}

func (m *EventMirror) Close() error {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	if m.closed {
		return nil
	}
	m.closed = true
	unlockErr := m.unlock()
	lockErr := m.lock.Close()
	fileErr := m.file.Close()
	rootErr := m.root.Close()
	if unlockErr != nil {
		return unlockErr
	}
	if lockErr != nil {
		return lockErr
	}
	if fileErr != nil {
		return fileErr
	}
	return rootErr
}

func (m *EventMirror) recover() error {
	info, err := m.file.Stat()
	if err != nil || info.Size() > maxMirrorBytes {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_LIMIT")
	}
	data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(m.file, maxMirrorBytes+1))
	if err != nil || int64(len(data)) > maxMirrorBytes {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_READ_FAILED")
	}
	if len(data) > 0 && data[len(data)-1] != '\n' {
		complete := bytes.LastIndexByte(data, '\n')
		truncateAt := int64(0)
		if complete >= 0 {
			truncateAt = int64(complete + 1)
		}
		if err := m.file.Truncate(truncateAt); err != nil || m.file.Sync() != nil {
			return errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_RECOVERY_FAILED")
		}
		data = data[:truncateAt]
	}
	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(bytes.NewReader(data))
	scanner.Buffer(make([]byte, 4096), maxMirroredEventBytes)
	for scanner.Scan() {
		encoded := append([]byte(nil), scanner.Bytes()...)
		var event ExecutionEvent
		if json.Unmarshal(encoded, &event) != nil || validateExecutionEvent(event, m.runID) != nil {
			return errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_CORRUPT")
		}
		canonical, err := canonicalEvent(event)
		if err != nil || !bytes.Equal(canonical, encoded) || m.last != 0 && event.Sequence != m.last+1 {
			return errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_CORRUPT")
		}
		m.events[event.Sequence] = canonical
		if len(m.events) > maxMirroredEvents {
			return errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_LIMIT")
		}
		if m.first == 0 {
			m.first = event.Sequence
		}
		m.last = event.Sequence
	}
	if err := scanner.Err(); err != nil {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_CORRUPT")
	}
	m.bytes = int64(len(data))
	_, err = m.file.Seek(0, io.SeekEnd)
	return err
}

func canonicalEvent(event ExecutionEvent) ([]byte, error) {
	if err := validateExecutionEvent(event, event.RunID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return json.Marshal(event)
}

func ensureRootedPrivateDirectory(root *os.Root, relative string) error {
	if err := root.Mkdir(relative, 0o700); err != nil && !os.IsExist(err) {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_PATH_INVALID")
	}
	info, err := root.Lstat(relative)
	if err != nil || isUnsafeFilesystemLink(info) || !info.IsDir() || !mirrorDirectoryPrivate(info) {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_PATH_UNSAFE")
	}
	directory, err := root.Open(relative)
	if err != nil {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_PATH_UNSAFE")
	}
	defer directory.Close()
	opened, err := directory.Stat()
	if err != nil || !os.SameFile(info, opened) || hardenMirrorHandle(directory) != nil {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_PERMISSIONS_FAILED")
	}
	return nil
}

func rejectSymlinkComponents(candidate string) error {
	clean := filepath.Clean(candidate)
	volume := filepath.VolumeName(clean)
	remainder := clean[len(volume):]
	current := volume + string(filepath.Separator)
	for _, part := range splitPath(remainder) {
		current = filepath.Join(current, part)
		info, err := os.Lstat(current)
		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
			return nil
		}
		if err != nil {
			return errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_PATH_INVALID")
		}
		if isUnsafeFilesystemLink(info) {
			return errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_PATH_UNSAFE")
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func splitPath(value string) []string {
	result := []string{}
	for _, part := range bytes.FieldsFunc([]byte(value), func(r rune) bool { return r == '/' || r == '\\' }) {
		result = append(result, string(part))
	}
	return result
}

func containedPath(root, candidate string) bool {
	relative, err := filepath.Rel(filepath.Clean(root), filepath.Clean(candidate))
	return err == nil && relative != ".." && !filepath.IsAbs(relative) && relative != "" && !startsWithParent(relative)
}

func startsWithParent(relative string) bool {
	return len(relative) >= 3 && relative[:3] == ".."+string(filepath.Separator)
}

const (
	lockfileFailImmediately = 0x00000001
	lockfileExclusiveLock   = 0x00000002
)

var (
	kernel32LockFileEx   = syscall.NewLazyDLL("kernel32.dll").NewProc("LockFileEx")
	kernel32UnlockFileEx = syscall.NewLazyDLL("kernel32.dll").NewProc("UnlockFileEx")
)

func lockEventMirror(file *os.File) (func() error, error) {
	overlapped := &syscall.Overlapped{}
	result, _, callErr := kernel32LockFileEx.Call(file.Fd(), lockfileExclusiveLock|lockfileFailImmediately, 0, 0xffffffff, 0xffffffff, uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(overlapped)))
	if result == 0 {
		return nil, callErr
	}
	return func() error {
		result, _, callErr := kernel32UnlockFileEx.Call(file.Fd(), 0, 0xffffffff, 0xffffffff, uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(overlapped)))
		if result == 0 {
			return callErr
		}
		return nil
	}, nil
}

package executionnode

import (

var (
	convertStringSecurityDescriptor = syscall.NewLazyDLL("advapi32.dll").NewProc("ConvertStringSecurityDescriptorToSecurityDescriptorW")
	setFileSecurity                 = syscall.NewLazyDLL("advapi32.dll").NewProc("SetFileSecurityW")
)

const protectedDACLInformation = 0x80000004

func isUnsafeFilesystemLink(info os.FileInfo) bool {
	if info == nil || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
		return true
	}
	data, ok := info.Sys().(*syscall.Win32FileAttributeData)
	return !ok || data.FileAttributes&syscall.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT != 0
}

func mirrorDirectoryPrivate(info os.FileInfo) bool {
	return info != nil
}

func hardenMirrorHandle(file *os.File) error {
	token, err := syscall.OpenCurrentProcessToken()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer token.Close()
	user, err := token.GetTokenUser()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	sid, err := user.User.Sid.String()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	sddl, err := syscall.UTF16PtrFromString("D:P(A;;FA;;;" + sid + ")(A;;FA;;;SY)(A;;FA;;;BA)")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var descriptor uintptr
	var size uint32
	result, _, callErr := convertStringSecurityDescriptor.Call(uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(sddl)), 1, uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&descriptor)), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&size)))
	if result == 0 {
		return callErr
	}
	if descriptor == 0 {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_DACL_INVALID")
	}
	defer syscall.LocalFree(syscall.Handle(descriptor))
	path, err := syscall.UTF16PtrFromString(filepath.Clean(file.Name()))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	result, _, callErr = setFileSecurity.Call(uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(path)), protectedDACLInformation, descriptor)
	if result == 0 {
		return callErr
	}
	opened, openErr := file.Stat()
	linked, linkErr := os.Lstat(file.Name())
	if openErr != nil || linkErr != nil || isUnsafeFilesystemLink(linked) || !os.SameFile(opened, linked) {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_MIRROR_DACL_TARGET_CHANGED")
	}
	return nil
}

// ExecutionError is a semantic application error.  Transport diagnostics are
// deliberately not used as an API and are never needed to make lifecycle
// decisions.
type ExecutionError struct {
	Code          string
	RunID         string
	Findings      []Finding
	notDispatched bool
}

func (e *ExecutionError) StartWasNotDispatched() bool { return e.notDispatched }

// StartNotDispatchedError proves that Start returned before the credentialed
// StartExecution request was handed to the transport. Callers may safely
// release a local PENDING reservation; transport errors after dispatch remain
// ambiguous and are deliberately not wrapped in this type.
type StartNotDispatchedError struct{ cause error }

func (e *StartNotDispatchedError) Error() string             { return e.cause.Error() }
func (e *StartNotDispatchedError) Unwrap() error             { return e.cause }
func (*StartNotDispatchedError) StartWasNotDispatched() bool { return true }

func (e *ExecutionError) Error() string {
	if e.RunID == "" {
		return e.Code
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s", e.Code, e.RunID)
}

}

// credential seam. A nil provider selects the non-credentialed v2 path.

	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	s.credentialProvider = provider
}

	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	s.targetTrustProvider, s.targetTrustStager = provider, stager
}

	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()

func (s *ExecutionService) CreateServicePlan(ctx context.Context, node Node, request ServicePlanRequest, projectRoot string, runtimeRelease map[string]any) (PlanRecord, error) {
	if request.Service == "" || request.Target.ID == "" || len(request.ArtifactTargets) == 0 {
		return PlanRecord{}, errors.New("SERVICE_PLAN_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	record, err := s.CreatePlanWithOrder(ctx, node, projectRoot, runtimeRelease, request.DeploymentOrder)
	if err != nil {
		return PlanRecord{}, err
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	s.serviceRequests[record.ID] = cloneServicePlanRequest(request)
	s.mu.Unlock()
	return record, nil
}

func (s *ExecutionService) CreatePlan(ctx context.Context, node Node, projectRoot string, runtimeRelease map[string]any) (PlanRecord, error) {
	return s.CreatePlanWithOrder(ctx, node, projectRoot, runtimeRelease, nil)
}

func (s *ExecutionService) CreatePlanWithOrder(ctx context.Context, node Node, projectRoot string, runtimeRelease map[string]any, deploymentOrder []string) (PlanRecord, error) {
	return s.createPlan(ctx, node, projectRoot, runtimeRelease, deploymentOrder, "", nil)
}

// Explicit modes share the ordinary approval/Start lifecycle. An older builder
// is never silently substituted for a mode-aware request.
func (s *ExecutionService) CreatePlanForMode(ctx context.Context, node Node, projectRoot string, runtimeRelease map[string]any, deploymentOrder []string, mode ExecutionMode, vaultSources map[string]string) (PlanRecord, error) {
	if !validModePlanInput(append([]string{}, deploymentOrder...), mode, vaultSources) {
		return PlanRecord{}, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	return s.createPlan(ctx, node, projectRoot, runtimeRelease, deploymentOrder, mode, vaultSources)
}

func (s *ExecutionService) buildPlan(ctx context.Context, node Node, root string, release map[string]any, order []string, mode ExecutionMode, sources map[string]string) (DeploymentPlan, error) {
	if mode == "" {
		return s.builder.BuildDeploymentPlan(ctx, node, root, release, slices.Clone(order))
	}
	builder, ok := s.builder.(ModePlanBuilder)
	if !ok {
		return DeploymentPlan{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_MODE_RUNTIME_UNSUPPORTED")
	}
	plan, err := builder.BuildDeploymentPlanForMode(ctx, node, root, release, append([]string{}, order...), mode, cloneVaultSources(sources))
	if err == nil && (plan.ExecutionMode != mode || plan.InfrastructureVerification == nil || !plan.InfrastructureVerification.Validate()) {
		return DeploymentPlan{}, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	}
	return plan, err
}

func cloneVaultSources(source map[string]string) map[string]string {
	result := make(map[string]string, len(source))
	for key, value := range source {
		result[key] = value
	}
	return result
}

func (s *ExecutionService) createPlan(ctx context.Context, node Node, projectRoot string, runtimeRelease map[string]any, deploymentOrder []string, mode ExecutionMode, vaultSources map[string]string) (PlanRecord, error) {
	if s == nil || s.builder == nil || projectRoot == "" {
		return PlanRecord{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_PLAN_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	plan, err := s.buildPlan(ctx, node, projectRoot, runtimeRelease, deploymentOrder, mode, vaultSources)
	if err != nil {
		return PlanRecord{}, err
	}
	if plan.ID == "" || plan.ProjectRevision == "" || plan.PlanFingerprint == "" || (plan.Status != "EXECUTABLE" && plan.Status != "BLOCKED") || (plan.Status == "EXECUTABLE" && plan.ProjectIdentity == "") {
		return PlanRecord{}, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_INVALID")
	}
	now := s.now().UTC()
	record := PlanRecord{mode: mode, vaultSources: cloneVaultSources(vaultSources), ID: plan.ID, Plan: cloneDeploymentPlan(plan), DeploymentOrder: slices.Clone(deploymentOrder), CreatedAt: now, ExpiresAt: now.Add(s.ttl)}
	s.mu.Lock()
	s.plans[record.ID] = record
	s.projectRoots[record.ID] = projectRoot
	s.mu.Unlock()
	return clonePlanRecord(record), nil
}

func (s *ExecutionService) GetPlan(id string) (PlanRecord, error) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	record, ok := s.plans[id]
	if !ok {
		return PlanRecord{}, &ExecutionError{Code: PlanExpired}
	}
	if !s.now().Before(record.ExpiresAt) {
		delete(s.plans, id)
		return PlanRecord{}, &ExecutionError{Code: PlanExpired}
	}
	return clonePlanRecord(record), nil
}

func (s *ExecutionService) ApprovePlan(id string, acknowledgements []string) error {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	record, ok := s.plans[id]
	if !ok || !s.now().Before(record.ExpiresAt) {
		delete(s.plans, id)
		return &ExecutionError{Code: PlanExpired}
	}
	if record.Consumed {
		return &ExecutionError{Code: ApprovalRequired}
	}
	if record.Plan.Status != "EXECUTABLE" {
		return &ExecutionError{Code: PlanBlocked, Findings: append([]Finding(nil), record.Plan.Findings...)}
	}
	if !sameStrings(record.Plan.Acknowledgements, acknowledgements) {
		return &ExecutionError{Code: AcknowledgementRequired}
	}
	record.Approved = true
	s.plans[id] = record
	return nil
}

func (s *ExecutionService) Start(ctx context.Context, node Node, planID string) (ExecutionRun, error) {
	return s.start(ctx, node, planID, nil)
}

func (s *ExecutionService) StartService(ctx context.Context, node Node, planID string) (ExecutionRun, error) {
	return s.start(ctx, node, planID, func(fresh DeploymentPlan, request ServicePlanRequest, runID string) error {
		s.mu.Lock()
		probe, stager := s.probe, s.projectionStager
		s.mu.Unlock()
		if probe == nil || stager == nil || len(fresh.ArtifactRequirements) == 0 {
			return errors.New("SERVICE_EXECUTION_INPUT_INVALID")
		}
		resolved, _, err := NewServiceExecutionService(probe, nil).Resolve(ctx, ServiceExecutionRequest{
			Service: request.Service, Operation: request.Operation, ProjectRoot: s.projectRoots[planID], Target: request.Target,
			ArtifactTargets: request.ArtifactTargets, Requirements: fresh.ArtifactRequirements, BundleCandidates: request.BundleCandidates,
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		for _, projection := range resolved {
			for _, result := range projection {
				if result.Source == artifactsource.Blocked {
					return errors.New(ServiceExecutionBlocked)
				}
			}
		}
		requirements, err := json.Marshal(fresh.ArtifactRequirements)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		sum := sha256.Sum256(requirements)
		return stager.StageRuntimeProjection(ctx, node, runID, fresh.ProjectIdentity, fresh.PlanFingerprint, "sha256:"+hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]), resolved, request.PKISecretFiles)
	})
}

func (s *ExecutionService) start(ctx context.Context, node Node, planID string, prepare func(DeploymentPlan, ServicePlanRequest, string) error) (result ExecutionRun, resultErr error) {
	s.startMu.Lock()
	defer s.startMu.Unlock()
	startRequestDispatched := false
	defer func() {
		if resultErr != nil && !startRequestDispatched {
			var executionErr *ExecutionError
			if errors.As(resultErr, &executionErr) {
				copy := *executionErr
				copy.notDispatched = true
				resultErr = &copy
			} else {
				resultErr = &StartNotDispatchedError{cause: resultErr}
			}
		}
	}()
	record, err := s.GetPlan(planID)
	if err != nil {
		return ExecutionRun{}, err
	}
	if !record.Approved || record.Consumed {
		return ExecutionRun{}, &ExecutionError{Code: ApprovalRequired}
	}
	if record.Plan.Status != "EXECUTABLE" {
		return ExecutionRun{}, &ExecutionError{Code: PlanBlocked, Findings: append([]Finding(nil), record.Plan.Findings...)}
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	prior := s.projects[record.Plan.ProjectIdentity]
	s.mu.Unlock()
	if prior != "" {
		// The local session is only a cache. A detached controller may have
		// become terminal since its last observer poll; only the authoritative
		// Execution Node may release this project's active-run guard.
		observed, observeErr := s.client.GetExecution(ctx, node, prior)
		if observeErr != nil {
			return ExecutionRun{}, observeErr
		}
		if observed.RunID != prior || observed.ProjectIdentity != record.Plan.ProjectIdentity {
			return ExecutionRun{}, &ExecutionError{Code: OwnershipMismatch, RunID: prior}
		}
		switch observed.State {
		case "SUCCEEDED", "FAILED", "CANCELLED", "INTERRUPTED":
			s.mu.Lock()
			if s.projects[record.Plan.ProjectIdentity] == prior {
				delete(s.projects, record.Plan.ProjectIdentity)
			}
			existing := s.sessions[prior]
			s.mu.Unlock()
			if existing != nil {
				existing.mu.Lock()
				existing.run = observed
				existing.mu.Unlock()
			}
		default:
			return ExecutionRun{}, &ExecutionError{Code: ActiveRunExists, RunID: prior}
		}
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	projectRoot := s.projectRoots[planID]
	s.mu.Unlock()
	if projectRoot == "" {
		return ExecutionRun{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_PLAN_PROJECT_ROOT_MISSING")
	}
	if len(record.Plan.RuntimeRelease) == 0 {
		return ExecutionRun{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_PLAN_RUNTIME_RELEASE_MISSING")
	}
	fresh, err := s.buildPlan(ctx, node, projectRoot, record.Plan.RuntimeRelease, record.DeploymentOrder, record.mode, record.vaultSources)
	if err != nil {
		return ExecutionRun{}, err
	}
	if fresh.Status != "EXECUTABLE" || fresh.ProjectIdentity != record.Plan.ProjectIdentity || fresh.ProjectRevision != record.Plan.ProjectRevision || fresh.PlanFingerprint != record.Plan.PlanFingerprint {
		s.invalidate(planID)
		return ExecutionRun{}, &ExecutionError{Code: PlanStale}
	}
	if fresh.stagingID == "" || fresh.executionManifestDigest == "" {
		return ExecutionRun{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_START_BINDING_MISSING")
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	trustProvider, trustStager := s.targetTrustProvider, s.targetTrustStager
	s.mu.Unlock()
	if len(planTargetHostIDs(fresh)) > 0 {
		if trustProvider == nil || trustStager == nil {
			return ExecutionRun{}, errors.New("TARGET_HOST_TRUST_REQUIRED")
		}
		approvals, trustErr := trustProvider(fresh)
		if trustErr != nil {
			return ExecutionRun{}, trustErr
		}
		if trustErr = trustStager.StageTargetHostTrust(ctx, node, fresh, approvals); trustErr != nil {
			return ExecutionRun{}, trustErr
		}
	}
	if prepare != nil {
		s.mu.Lock()
		request, ok := s.serviceRequests[planID]
		projectRoot := s.projectRoots[planID]
		s.mu.Unlock()
		if !ok || projectRoot == "" {
			return ExecutionRun{}, errors.New("SERVICE_PLAN_NOT_FOUND")
		}
		if err := prepare(fresh, request, fresh.stagingID); err != nil {
			return ExecutionRun{}, err
		}
	}
	client, ok := s.client.(CredentialedExecutionClient)
	if !ok {
		return ExecutionRun{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_START_V2_UNSUPPORTED")
	}
	capability, err := client.CredentialStartCapability(ctx, node)
	if err != nil {
		return ExecutionRun{}, err
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	pending, hasPending := s.pendingStarts[planID]
	provider := s.credentialProvider
	s.mu.Unlock()
	if !hasPending {
		requiresPKIStorePassword := planRequiresPKIStorePassword(fresh)
		runtimeSecretRequirements := planRuntimeSecretRequirements(fresh)
		typedRuntimeSecretRequirements := planRuntimeSecretInputRequirements(fresh)
		// The closed v4 payload carries pkiStorePassword too; v4 runtimes
		// deliberately advertise only v4, not the legacy payload versions.
		pkiPayloadSupported := capability.supportsPayloadVersion(credentialPayloadVersionV2) ||
			(capability.TypedRuntimeInputs && capability.supportsPayloadVersion(credentialPayloadVersionV4))
		if requiresPKIStorePassword && (!pkiPayloadSupported || capability.MaxPayloadBytes < 4096) {
			return ExecutionRun{}, errors.New("PKI_STORE_PASSWORD_RUNTIME_UNSUPPORTED")
		}
		if requiresPKIStorePassword && provider == nil {
			return ExecutionRun{}, errors.New("PKI_STORE_PASSWORD_UNAVAILABLE")
		}
		// v4 carries the same runtimeSecretValues object alongside typed inputs.
		// A v4-only runtime intentionally does not advertise legacy v3.
		runtimeValuesSupported := capability.supportsPayloadVersion(credentialPayloadVersionV3) ||
			(capability.TypedRuntimeInputs && capability.supportsPayloadVersion(credentialPayloadVersionV4))
		if len(runtimeSecretRequirements) > 0 && (!runtimeValuesSupported || provider == nil) {
			return ExecutionRun{}, errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_VALUES_UNAVAILABLE")
		}
		if len(typedRuntimeSecretRequirements) > 0 && (!capability.TypedRuntimeInputs || !capability.supportsPayloadVersion(credentialPayloadVersionV4) || provider == nil) {
			return ExecutionRun{}, errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_INPUTS_UNAVAILABLE")
		}
		attempt, err := newStartAttemptID()
		if err != nil {
			return ExecutionRun{}, err
		}
		pending = pendingStart{attemptID: attempt}
		if provider != nil {
			requestID, err := newStartAttemptID()
			if err != nil {
				return ExecutionRun{}, err
			}
			err = provider(TargetCredentialLeaseRequest{RequiresPKIStorePassword: requiresPKIStorePassword, RuntimeSecretRequirements: append([]string(nil), runtimeSecretRequirements...), RuntimeSecretInputs: append([]RuntimeSecretInputRequirement(nil), typedRuntimeSecretRequirements...)}, func(payload TargetCredentialLeasePayload) error {
				if requiresPKIStorePassword != (payload.PKIStorePassword != "") {
					return errors.New("PKI_STORE_PASSWORD_UNAVAILABLE")
				}
				if !sameRuntimeSecretRequirementSet(runtimeSecretRequirements, payload.RuntimeSecretValues) {
					return errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_VALUES_UNAVAILABLE")
				}
				if len(typedRuntimeSecretRequirements) > 0 && (!payload.UseTypedRuntimeInputs || !sameRuntimeSecretInputSet(typedRuntimeSecretRequirements, payload.RuntimeSecretInputs)) {
					return errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_INPUTS_UNAVAILABLE")
				}
				lease, leaseErr := client.PutRuntimeSecretLease(ctx, node, CredentialLeaseRequest{RequestID: requestID, StartAttemptID: attempt, ProjectIdentity: fresh.ProjectIdentity, ProjectRevision: fresh.ProjectRevision, PlanFingerprint: fresh.PlanFingerprint, ExecutionManifestDigest: fresh.executionManifestDigest, RuntimeRelease: fresh.RuntimeRelease}, payload, capability.MaxPayloadBytes)
				if leaseErr == nil {
					pending.leaseID = lease.LeaseID
				}
				return leaseErr
			})
			if err != nil {
				return ExecutionRun{}, err
			}
		}
		s.mu.Lock()
		s.pendingStarts[planID] = pending
		s.mu.Unlock()
	}
	// Set the boundary immediately before handing the request to the transport:
	// any error from this call may conceal a committed remote Start.
	startRequestDispatched = true
	response, err := client.StartExecutionV2(ctx, node, ExecutionStartV2Request{StartAttemptID: pending.attemptID, ProjectIdentity: fresh.ProjectIdentity, ProjectRevision: fresh.ProjectRevision, PlanFingerprint: fresh.PlanFingerprint, ExecutionManifestDigest: fresh.executionManifestDigest, RuntimeRelease: fresh.RuntimeRelease, LeaseID: pending.leaseID})
	if err != nil {
		return ExecutionRun{}, err
	}
	run := ExecutionRun{RunID: response.RunID, ProjectIdentity: fresh.ProjectIdentity, State: "STARTING"}
	s.mu.Lock()
	record.Consumed = true
	s.plans[planID] = record
	delete(s.pendingStarts, planID)
	if prior := s.projects[fresh.ProjectIdentity]; prior != "" && prior != run.RunID {
		s.mu.Unlock()
		return ExecutionRun{}, &ExecutionError{Code: ActiveRunExists, RunID: prior}
	}
	s.projects[fresh.ProjectIdentity] = run.RunID
	s.sessions[run.RunID] = &session{run: run, project: fresh.ProjectIdentity, lastSequence: run.Sequence, subs: map[uint64]*Subscription{}}
	s.mu.Unlock()
	return run, nil
}

func planTargetHostIDs(plan DeploymentPlan) []string {
	seen := make(map[string]bool)
	for _, phase := range plan.Phases {
		for _, action := range phase.Actions {
			for _, id := range action.Targets {
				seen[id] = true
			}
		}
	}
	result := make([]string, 0, len(seen))
	for id := range seen {
		result = append(result, id)
	}
	slices.Sort(result)
	return result
}

func planRequiresPKIStorePassword(plan DeploymentPlan) bool {
	for _, requirement := range plan.RequiredCredentials {
		if requirement.RequirementRef == "pki-store-password" && requirement.Purpose == "PKI_STORE_PASSWORD" {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func planRuntimeSecretRequirements(plan DeploymentPlan) []string {
	result := []string{}
	for _, requirement := range plan.RequiredCredentials {
		if RuntimeSecretValuePurpose(requirement.Purpose) && runtimeSecretRequirementPattern.MatchString(requirement.RequirementRef) {
			result = append(result, requirement.RequirementRef)
		}
	}
	slices.Sort(result)
	return result
}

// RuntimeSecretValuePurpose identifies values carried in the existing lease map.
func RuntimeSecretValuePurpose(purpose string) bool {
	return purpose == "SERVICE_PASSWORD" || purpose == "APPLICATION_SECRET" || purpose == "APPLICATION_VAULT_ADMIN_TOKEN"
}

func planRuntimeSecretInputRequirements(plan DeploymentPlan) []RuntimeSecretInputRequirement {
	result := []RuntimeSecretInputRequirement{}
	for _, requirement := range plan.RequiredCredentials {
		if requirement.Purpose == "SERVICE_ADMIN_TOKEN" || requirement.Purpose == "SERVICE_UNSEAL_SHARES" {
			result = append(result, RuntimeSecretInputRequirement{RequirementRef: requirement.RequirementRef, Purpose: requirement.Purpose})
		}
	}
	slices.SortFunc(result, func(a, b RuntimeSecretInputRequirement) int {
		return strings.Compare(a.RequirementRef, b.RequirementRef)
	})
	return result
}

func sameRuntimeSecretInputSet(required []RuntimeSecretInputRequirement, values []RuntimeSecretInputPayload) bool {
	allowed := make(map[string]string, len(required))
	for _, item := range required {
		allowed[item.RequirementRef] = item.Purpose
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, item := range values {
		if seen[item.RequirementRef] || allowed[item.RequirementRef] != item.Purpose {
			return false
		}
		seen[item.RequirementRef] = true
	}
	return true
}

func sameRuntimeSecretRequirementSet(required []string, values map[string]string) bool {
	if len(required) == 0 {
		return values == nil
	}
	if len(required) != len(values) {
		return false
	}
	for _, reference := range required {
		if _, ok := values[reference]; !ok {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func (s *ExecutionService) invalidate(id string) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	if p, ok := s.plans[id]; ok {
		p.Approved = false
		p.Consumed = true
		s.plans[id] = p
	}
	delete(s.pendingStarts, id)
	s.mu.Unlock()
}

func (s *ExecutionService) Sync(ctx context.Context, node Node, runID string) (ExecutionRun, []ExecutionEvent, error) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	current, ok := s.sessions[runID]
	s.mu.Unlock()
	if !ok {
		return ExecutionRun{}, nil, &ExecutionError{Code: RunNotFound, RunID: runID}
	}
	run, err := s.client.GetExecution(ctx, node, runID)
	if err != nil {
		return ExecutionRun{}, nil, err
	}
	current.mu.Lock()
	after := current.lastSequence
	current.mu.Unlock()
	events := []ExecutionEvent{}
	historyTruncated := false
	for {
		page, pageErr := s.client.GetEvents(ctx, node, runID, after, ExecutionEventPageLimit)
		if pageErr != nil {
			return run, nil, pageErr
		}
		if len(events)+len(page.Events) > maxObservedExecutionEvents {
			return run, nil, &ObserverError{Code: ObserverIntegrityFailure}
		}
		historyTruncated = historyTruncated || page.HistoryTruncated
		events = append(events, page.Events...)
		after = page.NextSequence
		if !page.HasMore {
			break
		}
	}
	current.mu.Lock()
	current.run = run
	for _, event := range events {
		if event.Sequence <= current.lastSequence {
			continue
		}
		current.lastSequence = event.Sequence
		for id, sub := range current.subs {
			select {
			case sub.c <- event:
			default:
				sub.Close()
				delete(current.subs, id)
			}
		}
	}
	current.mu.Unlock()
	if run.State == "SUCCEEDED" || run.State == "FAILED" || run.State == "CANCELLED" || run.State == "INTERRUPTED" {
		s.mu.Lock()
		if s.projects[current.project] == runID {
			delete(s.projects, current.project)
		}
		s.mu.Unlock()
	}
	if historyTruncated {
		return run, events, &ObserverError{Code: ObserverHistoryTruncated}
	}
	return run, events, nil
}

func (s *ExecutionService) Reconnect(ctx context.Context, node Node, runID string) (ExecutionRun, []ExecutionEvent, error) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	_, known := s.sessions[runID]
	s.mu.Unlock()
	if !known {
		run, err := s.client.GetExecution(ctx, node, runID)
		if err != nil {
			return ExecutionRun{}, nil, err
		}
		if run.RunID == "" {
			return ExecutionRun{}, nil, &ExecutionError{Code: RunNotFound, RunID: runID}
		}
		s.mu.Lock()
		s.sessions[runID] = &session{run: run, project: run.ProjectIdentity, lastSequence: run.Sequence, subs: map[uint64]*Subscription{}}
		if run.ProjectIdentity != "" {
			s.projects[run.ProjectIdentity] = runID
		}
		s.mu.Unlock()
	}
	return s.Sync(ctx, node, runID)
}

func (s *ExecutionService) Subscribe(runID string, capacity int) (*Subscription, error) {
	if capacity < 1 {
		return nil, errors.New("SUBSCRIBER_CAPACITY_INVALID")
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	current, ok := s.sessions[runID]
	s.mu.Unlock()
	if !ok {
		return nil, &ExecutionError{Code: RunNotFound, RunID: runID}
	}
	channel := make(chan ExecutionEvent, capacity)
	sub := &Subscription{C: channel, c: channel, done: make(chan struct{})}
	current.mu.Lock()
	subID := current.nextSub
	current.nextSub++
	current.subs[subID] = sub
	current.mu.Unlock()
	return sub, nil
}

func (s *ExecutionService) Unsubscribe(runID string, sub *Subscription) {
	if sub == nil {
		return
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	current := s.sessions[runID]
	s.mu.Unlock()
	if current != nil {
		current.mu.Lock()
		for id, candidate := range current.subs {
			if candidate == sub {
				delete(current.subs, id)
				break
			}
		}
		current.mu.Unlock()
	}
	sub.Close()
}

func (s *ExecutionService) Cancel(ctx context.Context, node Node, runID string) (ExecutionRun, error) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	current := s.sessions[runID]
	s.mu.Unlock()
	if current == nil {
		return ExecutionRun{}, &ExecutionError{Code: RunNotFound, RunID: runID}
	}
	return s.client.CancelExecution(ctx, node, runID)
}

func sameStrings(a, b []string) bool {
	if len(a) != len(b) {
		return false
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, v := range a {
		seen[v] = true
	}
	for _, v := range b {
		if !seen[v] {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}
func cloneDeploymentPlan(p DeploymentPlan) DeploymentPlan {
	if p.InfrastructureVerification != nil {
		value := *p.InfrastructureVerification
		value.Deployments = append([]InfrastructureDeploymentVerification{}, value.Deployments...)
		if value.Code != nil {
			v := *value.Code
			value.Code = &v
		}
		if value.InfrastructureFingerprint != nil {
			v := *value.InfrastructureFingerprint
			value.InfrastructureFingerprint = &v
		}
		if value.EvidenceRevision != nil {
			v := *value.EvidenceRevision
			value.EvidenceRevision = &v
		}
		p.InfrastructureVerification = &value
	}
	p.Acknowledgements = append([]string(nil), p.Acknowledgements...)
	p.AcknowledgementDetails = append([]PlanAcknowledgement(nil), p.AcknowledgementDetails...)
	p.Phases = clonePlanPhases(p.Phases)
	p.ArtifactRequirements = append([]artifactsource.Requirement(nil), p.ArtifactRequirements...)
	p.RequiredCredentials = cloneRequiredCredentials(p.RequiredCredentials)
	p.Findings = append([]Finding(nil), p.Findings...)
	if p.RuntimeRelease != nil {
		runtimeRelease := p.RuntimeRelease
		p.RuntimeRelease = map[string]any{}
		for k, v := range runtimeRelease {
			p.RuntimeRelease[k] = v
		}
	}
	return p
}

func cloneRequiredCredentials(values []RequiredCredential) []RequiredCredential {
	result := make([]RequiredCredential, len(values))
	for index, value := range values {
		result[index] = value
		result[index].Hosts = append([]string(nil), value.Hosts...)
	}
	return result
}

func clonePlanPhases(phases []DeploymentPlanPhase) []DeploymentPlanPhase {
	result := make([]DeploymentPlanPhase, len(phases))
	for index, phase := range phases {
		result[index] = phase
		result[index].Actions = make([]DeploymentPlanAction, len(phase.Actions))
		for actionIndex, action := range phase.Actions {
			result[index].Actions[actionIndex] = action
			result[index].Actions[actionIndex].Targets = append([]string(nil), action.Targets...)
			result[index].Actions[actionIndex].DependsOn = append([]string(nil), action.DependsOn...)
		}
	}
	return result
}
func cloneServicePlanRequest(r ServicePlanRequest) ServicePlanRequest {
	r.ArtifactTargets = append([]Node(nil), r.ArtifactTargets...)
	r.BundleCandidates = append([]artifactsource.Candidate(nil), r.BundleCandidates...)
	secretFiles := r.PKISecretFiles
	if secretFiles != nil {
		r.PKISecretFiles = make(map[string]string, len(r.PKISecretFiles))
		for reference, secretPath := range secretFiles {
			r.PKISecretFiles[reference] = secretPath
		}
	}
	return r
}
func clonePlanRecord(p PlanRecord) PlanRecord {
	p.Plan = cloneDeploymentPlan(p.Plan)
	p.vaultSources = cloneVaultSources(p.vaultSources)
	p.DeploymentOrder = slices.Clone(p.DeploymentOrder)
	return p
}
func newRunID() (string, error) {
	value := make([]byte, 16)
	if _, err := rand.Read(value); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return "installer-" + new(big.Int).SetBytes(value).String(), nil
}

func newStartAttemptID() (string, error) {
	value := make([]byte, 16)
	if _, err := rand.Read(value); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return hex.EncodeToString(value), nil
}

// NewRequestID returns one opaque bounded id for a request-owned remote
// staging operation. It has no run identity semantics.
func NewRequestID() (string, error) { return newStartAttemptID() }

type ExecutionMode string

const (
	FullProject              ExecutionMode = "FULL_PROJECT"
	ApplicationLibrariesOnly ExecutionMode = "APPLICATION_LIBRARIES_ONLY"
	InfrastructureVerifyOnly ExecutionMode = "INFRASTRUCTURE_VERIFY_ONLY"
)

func (m ExecutionMode) valid() bool {
	return m == FullProject || m == ApplicationLibrariesOnly || m == InfrastructureVerifyOnly
}

// InfrastructureVerification is an observation from Core, never Start authority.
type InfrastructureVerification struct {
	Status                    string                                 `json:"status"`
	Code                      *string                                `json:"code"`
	InfrastructureFingerprint *string                                `json:"infrastructureFingerprint"`
	EvidenceRevision          *string                                `json:"evidenceRevision"`
	Deployments               []InfrastructureDeploymentVerification `json:"deployments"`
}

type InfrastructureDeploymentVerification struct {
	DeploymentID   string `json:"deploymentId"`
	SourceRunID    string `json:"sourceRunId"`
	CoverageDigest string `json:"coverageDigest"`
	VerifiedAt     string `json:"verifiedAt"`
}

func (v InfrastructureVerification) Validate() bool {
	if v.Status != "PASS" && v.Status != "BLOCKED" && v.Status != "UNKNOWN" {
		return false
	}
	if v.Deployments == nil || len(v.Deployments) > 256 {
		return false
	}
	if v.Code != nil && *v.Code != "INFRA_VERIFY_MISSING" && *v.Code != "INFRA_VERIFY_STALE" && *v.Code != "INFRA_EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE" {
		return false
	}
	for _, digest := range []*string{v.InfrastructureFingerprint, v.EvidenceRevision} {
		if digest != nil && !validSHA256(*digest) {
			return false
		}
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, d := range v.Deployments {
		if len(d.DeploymentID) > 128 || !runtimeSecretDeploymentPattern.MatchString(d.DeploymentID) || seen[d.DeploymentID] || !validRuntimeToken(d.SourceRunID) || !validSHA256(d.CoverageDigest) || len(d.VerifiedAt) > 40 {
			return false
		}
		if _, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, d.VerifiedAt); err != nil {
			return false
		}
		seen[d.DeploymentID] = true
	}
	return true
}

func decodeInfrastructureVerification(raw any) (*InfrastructureVerification, error) {
	fields, ok := raw.(map[string]any)
	if !ok || len(fields) != 5 || !closedKeys(fields, "status", "code", "infrastructureFingerprint", "evidenceRevision", "deployments") {
		return nil, errors.New("INFRASTRUCTURE_VERIFICATION_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	}
	data, err := json.Marshal(raw)
	if err != nil || len(data) > 128*1024 {
		return nil, errors.New("INFRASTRUCTURE_VERIFICATION_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	var result InfrastructureVerification
	if decoder.Decode(&result) != nil || decoder.Decode(new(any)) != io.EOF || !result.Validate() {
		return nil, errors.New("INFRASTRUCTURE_VERIFICATION_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	}
	return &result, nil
}

func b0PlanCapabilitySupported(c map[string]any) bool {
	if !closedKeys(c, "apiVersion", "kind", "bootstrapProtocol", "coreVersion", "catalogDigest", "schemaDigest", "runtime", "supportedOperations", "executionStart", "targetCredentialLease", "runtimeSecretDescriptors", "serviceConfigurationPreview", "deploymentPlanRequestVersions", "projectSnapshotRequestVersions", "applicationExecution", "infrastructureVerification") {
		return false
	}
	v, ok := c["infrastructureVerification"].(map[string]any)
	return c["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/execution-capabilities/v1alpha8" && c["kind"] == "ExecutionCapabilities" && contains(c["supportedOperations"], "BuildDeploymentPlan") && contains(c["deploymentPlanRequestVersions"], "platform.installer/execution-runtime/v1alpha4") && ok && closedKeys(v, "protocol", "executionModes", "requiredPlanRequestVersion", "manifestContract", "planContract") && v["protocol"] == "InfrastructureVerification/v1alpha1" && v["requiredPlanRequestVersion"] == "platform.installer/execution-runtime/v1alpha4" && v["manifestContract"] == "platform.installer/execution-manifest/v1alpha3" && v["planContract"] == "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha5" && validExecutionModes(v["executionModes"])
}

// ReadApplicationLibraries uses the existing target-free snapshot path. It
// does not resolve YAML locally or manufacture an empty success on old Core.
func (t OpenSSHTransport) ReadApplicationLibraries(ctx context.Context, node Node, root string, release map[string]any) (*coreadapter.ApplicationLibraries, error) {
	snapshot, err := t.BuildProjectSnapshot(ctx, node, root, release)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if snapshot.ApplicationLibraries == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("APPLICATION_SNAPSHOT_RUNTIME_UNSUPPORTED")
	}
	return snapshot.ApplicationLibraries, nil
}

// BuildDeploymentPlanForMode reuses ordinary staging and the fixed Core operation.
// Unsupported runtimes fail before staging; there is no full-project fallback.
func (t OpenSSHTransport) BuildDeploymentPlanForMode(ctx context.Context, node Node, projectRoot string, release map[string]any, order []string, mode ExecutionMode, vaultSources map[string]string) (DeploymentPlan, error) {
	if projectRoot == "" || len(release) == 0 || !validModePlanInput(order, mode, vaultSources) {
		return DeploymentPlan{}, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	c, err := t.runtimeProtocol(ctx, node, map[string]any{"apiVersion": "platform.installer/execution-runtime/v1alpha4", "operation": "GetCapabilities"})
	if err != nil {
		return DeploymentPlan{}, err
	}
	if !b0PlanCapabilitySupported(c) {
		return DeploymentPlan{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_MODE_RUNTIME_UNSUPPORTED")
	}
	if vaultSources == nil {
		vaultSources = map[string]string{}
	}
	return t.buildDeploymentPlanRequest(ctx, node, projectRoot, map[string]any{"apiVersion": "platform.installer/execution-runtime/v1alpha4", "runtimeRelease": release, "deploymentOrder": order, "executionMode": string(mode), "applicationVaultSources": vaultSources})
}

func validExecutionModes(raw any) bool {
	values, ok := raw.([]any)
	return ok && len(values) == 3 && values[0] == string(FullProject) && values[1] == string(ApplicationLibrariesOnly) && values[2] == string(InfrastructureVerifyOnly)
}

func validModePlanInput(order []string, mode ExecutionMode, sources map[string]string) bool {
	if order == nil || len(order) > 256 || !mode.valid() || len(sources) > 16 {
		return false
	}
	for id, source := range sources {
		if len(id) > 128 || !runtimeSecretDeploymentPattern.MatchString(id) || (source != "RUNTIME_INPUT" && source != "CURRENT_RUN_BOOTSTRAP") {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

// This adapter is deliberately semantic: all remote paths and shell programs
// are fixed here, while credentials stay behind a runtime-only resolver.
