@@PORTABLE {"path":"internal/installer/application_library_save.go","mode":420,"size":16564,"sha256":"495fd3a0e6f411f86a8084063df5f15ecf626f01f80f3bda0d78580201fae51b","index":0,"count":1,"encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":16564}
package installer

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
)

var libraryInputID = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:[-_.][a-z0-9]+)*$`)
var exactLibraryRef = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*@[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$`)
var applicationSettingKeys = []string{"image", "command", "user", "restart", "parameters", "environment", "ports", "endpoint", "accounts", "provisioner", "readiness", "config_files"}

func applicationEditOperation(op string) bool {
	switch op {
	case "CreateApplicationLibraryDeployment", "UpdateApplicationLibraryDeployment", "DeleteApplicationLibraryDeployment", "SetApplicationLibrarySlot", "RemoveApplicationLibrarySlot", "SetApplicationLibraryPlacement", "RemoveApplicationLibraryPlacement", "SetApplicationLibraryOverride", "RemoveApplicationLibraryOverride":
		return true
	}
	return false
}

func validLibraryInputID(s string) bool { return len(s) <= 128 && libraryInputID.MatchString(s) }

func validateApplicationEdit(c EditCommand) error {
	invalid := blocked("INVALID_EDIT_COMMAND", "Application library edit is invalid", "command")
	if c.APIVersion != EditCommandAPIVersionV11 || c.Kind != "EditCommand" || !validSHA256(c.BaseProjectRevision) || !validLibraryInputID(c.DeploymentID) {
		return invalid
	}
	fields := []string{"deploymentId"}
	switch c.Operation {
	case "CreateApplicationLibraryDeployment", "UpdateApplicationLibraryDeployment":
		fields = append(fields, "entity")
		if c.Entity == nil || !applicationKeys(c.Entity, "libraryRef", "runtimeRef", "bindings", "resources", "shared_secrets", "vault_ref", "applications") {
			return invalid
		}
		if c.Operation == "CreateApplicationLibraryDeployment" {
			if _, ok := c.Entity["libraryRef"]; !ok {
				return invalid
			}
			if _, ok := c.Entity["runtimeRef"]; !ok {
				return invalid
			}
		}
		for key, value := range c.Entity {
			if key == "libraryRef" {
				s, ok := value.(string)
				if !ok || !exactLibraryRef.MatchString(s) || len(s) > 160 {
					return invalid
				}
			} else if key == "runtimeRef" {
				s, ok := value.(string)
				if !ok || !validLibraryInputID(s) {
					return invalid
				}
			} else if asMap(value) == nil {
				return invalid
			}
			if key == "applications" {
				for _, slot := range asMap(value) {
					if !validLibrarySlot(asMap(slot)) {
						return invalid
					}
				}
			}
		}
	case "SetApplicationLibrarySlot", "RemoveApplicationLibrarySlot":
		fields = append(fields, "entityId")
		if !validLibraryInputID(c.EntityID) {
			return invalid
		}
		if c.Operation == "SetApplicationLibrarySlot" {
			fields = append(fields, "entity")
			if !validLibrarySlot(c.Entity) {
				return invalid
			}
		}
	case "SetApplicationLibraryPlacement", "RemoveApplicationLibraryPlacement":
		fields = append(fields, "hostId")
		if !identifierPattern.MatchString(c.HostID) {
			return invalid
		}
		if c.Operation == "SetApplicationLibraryPlacement" {
			fields = append(fields, "placement")
			if c.Placement == nil || !applicationKeys(c.Placement, "overrides") {
				return invalid
			}
		}
	case "SetApplicationLibraryOverride", "RemoveApplicationLibraryOverride":
		fields = append(fields, "entityId", "hostId", "property", "setting")
		if c.EntityID != "" && !validLibraryInputID(c.EntityID) || c.HostID != "" && !identifierPattern.MatchString(c.HostID) || c.EntityID != "" && c.HostID != "" {
			return invalid
		}
		// Application overrides belong to a slot; host overrides are the fixed
		// membership parameters/ports projection. There is no effective-value edit.
		if c.EntityID == "" && c.HostID == "" {
			return invalid
		}
		if c.HostID != "" && c.Property != "parameters" && c.Property != "ports" {
			return invalid
		}
		if c.Property != "" && c.Property != "parameters" && c.Property != "environment" && c.Property != "ports" && c.Property != "endpoint" {
			return invalid
		}
		if !configurationSettingPattern.MatchString(c.Setting) {
			return invalid
		}
		if c.Property == "" && !applicationKeys(map[string]any{c.Setting: nil}, applicationSettingKeys...) {
			return invalid
		}
		if c.Operation == "SetApplicationLibraryOverride" {
			fields = append(fields, "value")
			if c.Value == nil {
				return invalid
			}
		}
	case "DeleteApplicationLibraryDeployment":
	default:
		return invalid
	}
	if err := validateCommandFields(c, fields...); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, value := range []any{c.Entity, c.Placement} {
		if err := safeApplicationInput(value, 0); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if err := boundedApplicationInput(c.Value, 0); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if c.Property == "" && c.Setting == "accounts" {
		if err := safeApplicationInput(map[string]any{"accounts": c.Value}, 0); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	data, err := json.Marshal(c)
	if err != nil || len(data) > 64*1024 {
		return invalid
	}
	return nil
}

func applicationKeys(m map[string]any, keys ...string) bool {
	for k := range m {
		found := false
		for _, allowed := range keys {
			if k == allowed {
				found = true
				break
			}
		}
		if !found {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func validLibrarySlot(m map[string]any) bool {
	if m == nil || !applicationKeys(m, "overrides", "accounts", "credentials") {
		return false
	}
	for key, value := range m {
		obj := asMap(value)
		if obj == nil {
			return false
		}
		if key == "overrides" && !applicationKeys(obj, applicationSettingKeys...) {
			return false
		}
		if key == "credentials" {
			if !applicationKeys(obj, "vault_binding") {
				return false
			}
			if raw, exists := obj["vault_binding"]; exists {
				binding, ok := raw.(string)
				if !ok || !validLibraryInputID(binding) {
					return false
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return true
}

// Bound authored input without classifying arbitrary parameter names as secrets.
// Declared credential descriptors retain their separate runtime reference rules.
func safeApplicationInput(v any, depth int) error {
	if depth > 16 {
		return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "Application input nesting exceeds its limit", "command")
	}
	switch value := v.(type) {
	case map[string]any:
		if len(value) > 128 {
			return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "Application input exceeds its limit", "command")
		}
		for key, item := range value {
			if key == "shared_secrets" {
				if asMap(item) == nil {
					return blocked("SECRET_REFERENCE_INVALID", "Shared secret descriptors must be a map", "command")
				}
				for _, raw := range asMap(item) {
					if !validApplicationCredential(raw, false) {
						return blocked("SECRET_REFERENCE_INVALID", "Shared secret source is invalid", "command")
					}
				}
			}
			if key == "accounts" {
				for _, account := range asMap(item) {
					fields := asMap(account)
					if fields == nil {
						return blocked("SECRET_REFERENCE_INVALID", "Account descriptor must be a map", "command")
					}
					if raw, exists := fields["credentials"]; exists && (asMap(raw) == nil || !applicationKeys(asMap(raw), "username", "password")) {
						return blocked("SECRET_REFERENCE_INVALID", "Account credentials are invalid", "command")
					}
					for name, raw := range asMap(fields["credentials"]) {
						if !validApplicationCredential(raw, name == "username") {
							return blocked("SECRET_REFERENCE_INVALID", "Credential source is invalid", "command")
						}
					}
				}
			}
			next := safeApplicationInput
			if key == "environment" || key == "parameters" || key == "grants" || key == "endpoint" || key == "config_files" {
				next = boundedApplicationInput
			}
			if err := next(item, depth+1); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
	case []any:
		if len(value) > 256 {
			return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "Application list exceeds its limit", "command")
		}
		for _, item := range value {
			if err := safeApplicationInput(item, depth+1); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
	case string:
		if strings.Contains(value, "PRIVATE KEY-----") {
			return blocked("SECRET_VALUE_NOT_ALLOWED", "Secret material is not accepted", "command")
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// Match the closed source shapes in settings.schema.json, only at declared
// credential locations. Core still owns semantic resolution of these references.
func validApplicationCredential(raw any, allowLiteral bool) bool {
	descriptor := asMap(raw)
	if len(descriptor) != 1 || !applicationKeys(descriptor, "source") {
		return false
	}
	source := asMap(descriptor["source"])
	required := []string{"kind"}
	switch source["kind"] {
	case "generated":
	case "runtime_secret_ref":
		required = append(required, "ref")
	case "vault_ref":
		required = append(required, "binding", "mount", "document", "field")
	case "pki_credential":
		required = append(required, "binding", "credential")
	case "literal":
		if !allowLiteral {
			return false
		}
		required = append(required, "value")
	default:
		return false
	}
	if len(source) != len(required) || !applicationKeys(source, required...) {
		return false
	}
	for _, key := range required {
		value, ok := source[key].(string)
		if !ok || value == "" {
			return false
		}
		if key == "ref" {
			if len(value) > 128 || !(validLibraryInputID(value) || applicationTemplateRef.MatchString(value)) {
				return false
			}
		} else if key == "binding" || key == "mount" || key == "field" || key == "credential" {
			if !validLibraryInputID(value) {
				return false
			}
		}
	}
	return true
}

var applicationTemplateRef = regexp.MustCompile(`.*\{\{.+\}\}.*`)

func boundedApplicationInput(v any, depth int) error {
	if depth > 16 {
		return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "Application input nesting exceeds its limit", "command")
	}
	switch x := v.(type) {
	case map[string]any:
		if len(x) > 128 {
			return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "Application input exceeds its limit", "command")
		}
		for _, item := range x {
			if err := boundedApplicationInput(item, depth+1); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
	case []any:
		if len(x) > 256 {
			return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "Application list exceeds its limit", "command")
		}
		for _, item := range x {
			if err := boundedApplicationInput(item, depth+1); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
	case string:
		if strings.Contains(x, "PRIVATE KEY-----") {
			return blocked("SECRET_VALUE_NOT_ALLOWED", "Private key material is not accepted", "command")
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func applicationMap(parent map[string]any, key string) (map[string]any, error) {
	if value, exists := parent[key]; exists {
		if m := asMap(value); m != nil {
			return m, nil
		}
		return nil, managedReadError("Application input root is malformed", key)
	}
	m := map[string]any{}
	parent[key] = m
	return m, nil
}

func (c *structuralCandidate) reduceApplicationEdit(cmd EditCommand) error {
	state, _, _, err := c.desired()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	libraries, err := applicationMap(state, "applicationLibraryDeployments")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	owner := asMap(libraries[cmd.DeploymentID])
	switch cmd.Operation {
	case "CreateApplicationLibraryDeployment":
		if owner != nil {
			return blocked("EDIT_COMMAND_CONFLICT", "Library deployment already exists", "command.deploymentId")
		}
		libraries[cmd.DeploymentID] = deepCopy(cmd.Entity)
	case "UpdateApplicationLibraryDeployment":
		if owner == nil {
			return referenceNotFound("deploymentId")
		}
		for key, value := range cmd.Entity {
			owner[key] = deepCopy(value)
		}
	case "DeleteApplicationLibraryDeployment":
		if owner == nil {
			return referenceNotFound("deploymentId")
		}
		delete(libraries, cmd.DeploymentID)
	default:
		if owner == nil {
			return referenceNotFound("deploymentId")
		}
		logical := desiredDocument
		if cmd.HostID != "" {
			inventory, e := c.inventory()
			if e != nil {
				return e
			}
			if inventory.targets[cmd.HostID] == nil {
				return referenceNotFound("hostId")
			}
			if _, e := c.hostDocument(cmd.HostID, true); e != nil {
				return e
			}
			logical = managedHostDocument(cmd.HostID)
			members, e := applicationMap(c.documents[logical], "platform_application_libraries")
			if e != nil {
				return e
			}
			if cmd.Operation == "SetApplicationLibraryPlacement" {
				members[cmd.DeploymentID] = deepCopy(cmd.Placement)
				c.dirty[logical] = true
				return nil
			}
			if cmd.Operation == "RemoveApplicationLibraryPlacement" {
				delete(members, cmd.DeploymentID)
				c.dirty[logical] = true
				return nil
			}
			owner = asMap(members[cmd.DeploymentID])
			if owner == nil {
				return referenceNotFound("placement")
			}
		} else {
			if cmd.Operation == "RemoveApplicationLibraryOverride" && asMap(owner["applications"]) == nil {
				return nil
			}
			slots, e := applicationMap(owner, "applications")
			if e != nil {
				return e
			}
			if cmd.Operation == "SetApplicationLibrarySlot" {
				current := asMap(slots[cmd.EntityID])
				if current == nil {
					current = map[string]any{}
					slots[cmd.EntityID] = current
				}
				for key, v := range cmd.Entity {
					current[key] = deepCopy(v)
				}
				c.dirty[logical] = true
				return nil
			}
			if cmd.Operation == "RemoveApplicationLibrarySlot" {
				delete(slots, cmd.EntityID)
				c.dirty[logical] = true
				return nil
			}
			owner = asMap(slots[cmd.EntityID])
			if owner == nil {
				if cmd.Operation == "RemoveApplicationLibraryOverride" {
					return nil
				}
				owner = map[string]any{}
				slots[cmd.EntityID] = owner
			}
		}
		if cmd.Operation == "RemoveApplicationLibraryOverride" && asMap(owner["overrides"]) == nil {
			return nil
		}
		overrides, e := applicationMap(owner, "overrides")
		if e != nil {
			return e
		}
		if cmd.Property != "" {
			if cmd.Operation == "RemoveApplicationLibraryOverride" && asMap(overrides[cmd.Property]) == nil {
				return nil
			}
			overrides, e = applicationMap(overrides, cmd.Property)
			if e != nil {
				return e
			}
		}
		if cmd.Operation == "RemoveApplicationLibraryOverride" {
			delete(overrides, cmd.Setting)
		} else {
			overrides[cmd.Setting] = deepCopy(cmd.Value)
		}
		c.dirty[logical] = true
		return nil
	}
	c.documents[desiredDocument]["platform_desired_state_contract"] = "platform.installer/project-desired-state/v3alpha1"
	c.dirty[desiredDocument] = true
	return nil
}

func (c *structuralCandidate) validateApplicationReferences() error {
	state, deployments, _, err := c.desired()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	libraries := asMap(state["applicationLibraryDeployments"])
	if len(libraries) > 128 {
		return managedReadError("Too many library deployments", desiredDocument)
	}
	for _, raw := range libraries {
		library := asMap(raw)
		ref, _ := library["runtimeRef"].(string)
		if library == nil || deployments[ref] == nil {
			return referenceNotFound("runtimeRef")
		}
		for _, rawBinding := range asMap(library["bindings"]) {
			ref, _ := asMap(rawBinding)["deploymentRef"].(string)
			if ref != "" && deployments[ref] == nil {
				return referenceNotFound("bindings")
			}
		}
	}
	inventory, err := c.inventory()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for logical, doc := range c.documents {
		if !strings.HasPrefix(logical, "inventory/host_vars/") {
			continue
		}
		for id := range asMap(doc["platform_application_libraries"]) {
			if libraries[id] == nil || inventory.targets[hostIDFromManagedDocument(logical)] == nil {
				return referenceInUse("applicationLibraryPlacement")
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// Paths describe authored writes, not resolved application settings.
func applicationWritePaths(c EditCommand) []string {
	root := "library/" + c.DeploymentID
	if c.HostID != "" {
		root = "host/" + c.HostID + "/library/" + c.DeploymentID
	}
	switch c.Operation {
	case "CreateApplicationLibraryDeployment":
		// Creation may be followed by slot and placement edits in the same session.
		paths := []string{root + "/@create"}
		for key := range c.Entity {
			paths = append(paths, root+"/"+key)
		}
		return paths
	case "UpdateApplicationLibraryDeployment":
		var paths []string
		for key := range c.Entity {
			paths = append(paths, root+"/"+key)
		}
		return paths
	case "DeleteApplicationLibraryDeployment", "RemoveApplicationLibraryPlacement":
		return []string{root}
	case "SetApplicationLibraryPlacement":
		var paths []string
		for key := range c.Placement {
			paths = append(paths, root+"/"+key)
		}
		return paths
	case "RemoveApplicationLibrarySlot":
		return []string{root + "/applications/" + c.EntityID}
	case "SetApplicationLibrarySlot":
		var paths []string
		for key := range c.Entity {
			paths = append(paths, root+"/applications/"+c.EntityID+"/"+key)
		}
		return paths
	default:
		if c.EntityID != "" {
			root += "/applications/" + c.EntityID
		}
		root += "/overrides"
		if c.Property != "" {
			root += "/" + c.Property
		}
		return []string{root + "/" + c.Setting}
	}
}

package installer

import (

const maxApplicationPackageFiles = 512
const maxApplicationPackageFileBytes = 1024 * 1024

var packageVersion = regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$`)
var packageComponent = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$`)
var packageEnvName = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$`)

// Fixed data-only destinations. Neither the caller nor a manifest can add
// tasks, plugins, hooks, roles from another package, or executable files.
func safeApplicationPackagePath(logical string) bool {
	if !safeExportLogicalPath(logical) {
		return false
	}
	p := strings.Split(logical, "/")
	if len(p) < 4 || (p[0] != "application-packages" && p[0] != "library-packages") || !validLibraryInputID(p[1]) || !packageVersion.MatchString(p[2]) {
		return false
	}
	for _, s := range p {
		if !packageComponent.MatchString(s) || s == "." || s == ".." || strings.HasSuffix(s, ".") || reservedExportDirectoryName(s) {
			return false
		}
	}
	kind := strings.TrimSuffix(p[0], "-packages")
	short := strings.Join(p[3:], "/")
	if short == kind+".yml" {
		return true
	}
	if kind == "library" && short == "files/.env" {
		return true
	}
	role := "roles/" + kind + "_" + p[1] + "/"
	if short == role+"defaults/main.yml" {
		return true
	}
	if !strings.HasPrefix(short, role+"templates/") && !strings.HasPrefix(short, "configuration/") && !strings.HasPrefix(short, "assets/") {
		return false
	}
	switch strings.ToLower(path.Ext(short)) {
	case ".j2", ".yml", ".yaml", ".json", ".conf", ".cfg", ".hcl", ".txt", ".properties", ".xml", ".crt", ".pem":
		return true
	}
	return false
}

// ApplicationPackagePathAllowed exposes the existing data-only package path
// contract to the guarded project transport; it does not authorize execution.
func ApplicationPackagePathAllowed(logical string) bool {
	return safeApplicationPackagePath(logical)
}

func applicationPackageDocuments(root string) ([]exportRecord, error) {
	directory, err := openExportSourceDirectory(root)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer directory.close()
	result := exportObservation{}
	seen, folded := map[string]bool{}, map[string]bool{}
	for _, name := range []string{"application-packages", "library-packages"} {
		child, err := directory.openDirectory([]string{name})
		if isExportNotExist(err) {
			continue
		}
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		err = collectExportDirectory(child, name, &result, seen, folded)
		child.close()
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	if len(result.documents) > maxApplicationPackageFiles {
		return nil, errors.New("APPLICATION_PACKAGE_LIMIT")
	}
	for _, r := range result.documents {
		if r.Size > maxApplicationPackageFileBytes {
			return nil, errors.New("APPLICATION_PACKAGE_LIMIT")
		}
	}
	return result.documents, nil
}

type applicationPackageManifest struct {
	APIVersion string            `yaml:"apiVersion"`
	Kind       string            `yaml:"kind"`
	Name       string            `yaml:"name"`
	Version    string            `yaml:"version"`
	Files      []string          `yaml:"files"`
	Render     map[string]string `yaml:"render,omitempty"`
}

func checkPackageManifest(records []exportRecord, kind, name, version string) (string, error) {
	invalid := errors.New("APPLICATION_PACKAGE_INVALID")
	prefix := kind + "-packages/" + name + "/" + version + "/"
	byPath := map[string][]byte{}
	for _, r := range records {
		byPath[strings.TrimPrefix(r.LogicalPath, prefix)] = r.content
	}
	var m applicationPackageManifest
	d := yaml.NewDecoder(strings.NewReader(string(byPath[kind+".yml"])))
	d.KnownFields(true)
	if d.Decode(&m) != nil || d.Decode(new(any)) != io.EOF || m.APIVersion != "platform.installer/application-package/v1alpha1" || m.Kind != strings.ToUpper(kind[:1])+kind[1:]+"Package" || m.Name != name || m.Version != version || len(m.Files) < 1 || len(m.Files) > maxApplicationPackageFiles-1 {
		return "", invalid
	}
	listed := map[string]bool{kind + ".yml": true}
	for _, file := range m.Files {
		if listed[strings.ToLower(file)] || !safeApplicationPackagePath(prefix+file) {
			return "", invalid
		}
		listed[strings.ToLower(file)] = true
		if _, ok := byPath[file]; !ok {
			return "", invalid
		}
	}
	if len(listed) != len(byPath) || !listed["roles/"+kind+"_"+name+"/defaults/main.yml"] {
		return "", invalid
	}
	for key, value := range m.Render {
		if key != "compose_template" && key != "agent_template" && key != "base_compose_template" && key != "base_compose_filename" && key != "base_service" {
			return "", invalid
		}
		if strings.HasSuffix(key, "template") && (!listed[strings.ToLower(value)] || !strings.HasSuffix(value, ".j2")) {
			return "", invalid
		}
	}
	// Identity/default namespace is checked locally; resolution and semantic
	// schema validation remain optional target-free Core Project Verify.
	var defaults map[string]any
	if yaml.Unmarshal(byPath["roles/"+kind+"_"+name+"/defaults/main.yml"], &defaults) != nil || len(defaults) != 1 {
		return "", invalid
	}
	definition := asMap(defaults["platform_"+kind+"_definition"])
	if definition["name"] != name || definition["version"] != version || safeApplicationInput(defaults, 0) != nil {
		return "", invalid
	}
	paths := make([]string, 0, len(byPath))
	for p := range byPath {
		paths = append(paths, p)
	}
	sort.Strings(paths)
	rows := make([][]string, 0, len(paths))
	for _, p := range paths {
		content := byPath[p]
		if len(content) > maxApplicationPackageFileBytes || strings.Contains(string(content), "PRIVATE KEY-----") {
			return "", invalid
		}
		if p == "files/.env" {
			keys := map[string]bool{}
			for _, line := range strings.Split(string(content), "\n") {
				line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
				if line == "" || strings.HasPrefix(line, "#") {
					continue
				}
				name, _, found := strings.Cut(line, "=")
				if !found || !packageEnvName.MatchString(name) || keys[name] || name == "SERVER_ID" {
					return "", invalid
				}
				keys[name] = true
			}
		}
		rows = append(rows, []string{p, strings.TrimPrefix(digestBytes(content), "sha256:")})
	}
	data, _ := json.Marshal(rows)
	return digestBytes(data), nil
}

func validateExportPackages(records []exportRecord) error {
	groups := map[string][]exportRecord{}
	for _, r := range records {
		if strings.HasPrefix(r.LogicalPath, "application-packages/") || strings.HasPrefix(r.LogicalPath, "library-packages/") {
			p := strings.Split(r.LogicalPath, "/")
			if len(p) < 4 {
				return errors.New("APPLICATION_PACKAGE_INVALID")
			}
			key := strings.Join(p[:3], "/")
			groups[key] = append(groups[key], r)
		}
	}
	for key, files := range groups {
		p := strings.Split(key, "/")
		if _, err := checkPackageManifest(files, strings.TrimSuffix(p[0], "-packages"), p[1], p[2]); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// Import retains the reviewed package bytes in the existing opaque plan store
// and publishes them through the same revision-guarded/recoverable transaction.
// Existing versions are immutable: changing a package requires a new version.
func (b *Backend) PlanApplicationPackageImport(ctx context.Context, projectRoot, sourceRoot, revision, kind, name, version, expectedDigest string) (*StructuralEditPlan, error) {
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	invalid := blocked("APPLICATION_PACKAGE_INVALID", "Package metadata, paths or content are invalid", "package")
	if (kind != "application" && kind != "library") || !validLibraryInputID(name) || !packageVersion.MatchString(version) || !validSHA256(expectedDigest) {
		return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, invalid), nil
	}
	root, err := cleanRoot(projectRoot)
	if err != nil {
		return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, err), nil
	}
	current, err := ProjectRevision(root)
	if err != nil || current != revision {
		return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, blocked("PROJECT_CHANGED", "Project changed before package review", "project")), nil
	}
	if _, err := loadStructuralCandidate(root, projectlifecycle.ClassificationManaged); err != nil {
		return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, err), nil
	}
	source, err := openExportSourceDirectory(sourceRoot)
	if err != nil {
		return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, invalid), nil
	}
	defer source.close()
	prefix := kind + "-packages/" + name + "/" + version
	versionRoot, pathErr := safeProjectPath(root, prefix, true)
	if pathErr != nil {
		return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, pathErr), nil
	}
	if _, statErr := os.Lstat(versionRoot); !errors.Is(statErr, os.ErrNotExist) {
		return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, blocked("APPLICATION_PACKAGE_EXISTS", "Package version already exists", "package")), nil
	}
	observation := exportObservation{}
	if err := collectExportDirectory(source, prefix, &observation, map[string]bool{}, map[string]bool{}); err != nil || len(observation.documents) > maxApplicationPackageFiles {
		return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, invalid), nil
	}
	digest, err := checkPackageManifest(observation.documents, kind, name, version)
	if err != nil || digest != expectedDigest {
		return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, invalid), nil
	}
	existing, err := applicationPackageDocuments(root)
	if err != nil {
		return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, invalid), nil
	}
	total := observation.total
	for _, record := range existing {
		total += record.Size
	}
	if len(existing)+len(observation.documents) > maxApplicationPackageFiles || total > maxExportTotalBytes {
		return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, blocked("APPLICATION_PACKAGE_LIMIT", "Combined project package closure exceeds its limit", "package")), nil
	}
	documents := make([]storedDocument, 0, len(observation.documents))
	for _, r := range observation.documents {
		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		destination, err := safeProjectPath(root, r.LogicalPath, true)
		if err != nil {
			return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, err), nil
		}
		if _, statErr := os.Lstat(destination); !errors.Is(statErr, os.ErrNotExist) {
			return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, blocked("APPLICATION_PACKAGE_EXISTS", "Package version already exists", "package")), nil
		}
		documents = append(documents, storedDocument{LogicalPath: r.LogicalPath, After: r.content, Existed: false})
	}
	if latest, err := ProjectRevision(root); err != nil || latest != revision {
		return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, blocked("PROJECT_CHANGED", "Project changed during package review", "project")), nil
	}
	return b.storeStructuralPlan(root, revision, []SemanticChange{{Operation: "ImportApplicationPackage", EntityID: name + "@" + version, SafeSummary: "Import reviewed data-only package"}}, documents)
}

// ArtifactLockUpdateRequest is the intentionally narrow, explicit authority
// for rebinding a managed project to an already verified immutable bundle.
// It is not an EditCommand and is never used by the ordinary ProjectWriter.
type ArtifactLockUpdateRequest struct {
	ProjectRoot       string
	ExpectedOldDigest string
	NewDigest         string
	NewBundleRoot     string
}

type ArtifactLockUpdateResult struct {
	PreviousDigest     string
	NewDigest          string
	NewProjectRevision string
}

// RuntimeLockSetUpdateRequest is the deliberately narrow, explicit authority
// for an immutable runtime release whose catalog lock also changed. Normal
// project writers never receive this authority.
type RuntimeLockSetUpdateRequest struct {
	ProjectRoot               string
	ExpectedProjectRevision   string
	ExpectedOldArtifactDigest string
	ExpectedOldCatalogDigest  string
	NewDigest                 string
	NewBundleRoot             string
}

type RuntimeLockSetUpdateResult struct {
	PreviousArtifactDigest string
	PreviousCatalogDigest  string
	NewArtifactDigest      string
	NewCatalogDigest       string
	NewProjectRevision     string
}

// RuntimeLockSet is the narrow read-only view required by controlled runtime
// promotion. It exposes neither desired topology nor catalog content.
type RuntimeLockSet struct {
	ArtifactDigest string
	CatalogDigest  string
}

// ReadRuntimeLockSet reads only the two immutable compatibility locks from a
// managed project. It does not require the old runtime to remain in the local
// cache, which is essential after immutable cache publication prunes it.
func ReadRuntimeLockSet(projectRoot string) (RuntimeLockSet, error) {
	root, err := cleanRoot(projectRoot)
	if err != nil {
		return RuntimeLockSet{}, err
	}
	path, err := safeProjectPath(root, "project.yml", false)
	if err != nil {
		return RuntimeLockSet{}, err
	}
	content, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return RuntimeLockSet{}, err
	}
	return readRuntimeLockSet(content)
}

// UpdateRuntimeLockSet atomically moves both lock fields to the complete pair
// derived from a verified immutable bundle. The expected raw project revision
// makes this a compare-and-swap for the whole canonical project, not merely a
// digest replacement.
func (b *Backend) UpdateRuntimeLockSet(ctx context.Context, request RuntimeLockSetUpdateRequest) (RuntimeLockSetUpdateResult, error) {
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return RuntimeLockSetUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	if !validDigest(request.ExpectedProjectRevision) || !validDigest(request.ExpectedOldArtifactDigest) || !validDigest(request.ExpectedOldCatalogDigest) || !validDigest(request.NewDigest) || request.NewBundleRoot == "" || request.ExpectedOldArtifactDigest == request.NewDigest {
		return RuntimeLockSetUpdateResult{}, blocked("RUNTIME_LOCK_SET_UPDATE_INVALID", "Runtime lock-set update input is invalid", "project.yml")
	}
	root, err := cleanRoot(request.ProjectRoot)
	if err != nil {
		return RuntimeLockSetUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	release, err := acquireWriterLock(ctx, root, b.lockWait)
	if err != nil {
		return RuntimeLockSetUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	defer release()
	if err := recoverTransactions(root); err != nil {
		return RuntimeLockSetUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	currentRevision, err := ProjectRevision(root)
	if err != nil {
		return RuntimeLockSetUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	if currentRevision != request.ExpectedProjectRevision {
		return RuntimeLockSetUpdateResult{}, blocked("PROJECT_CHANGED", "Project changed before runtime lock update", "project.yml")
	}
	candidate, err := projectlifecycle.ResolveRuntimeLockUpgradeCandidate(ctx, root, request.NewBundleRoot, request.NewDigest)
	if err != nil {
		return RuntimeLockSetUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	path, err := safeProjectPath(root, "project.yml", false)
	if err != nil {
		return RuntimeLockSetUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	before, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return RuntimeLockSetUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	after, err := replaceRuntimeLockSet(before, request.ExpectedOldArtifactDigest, request.ExpectedOldCatalogDigest, candidate)
	if err != nil {
		return RuntimeLockSetUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	identifier, err := artifactLockTransactionID()
	if err != nil {
		return RuntimeLockSetUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	if err := b.commitDocuments(root, identifier, []storedDocument{{LogicalPath: "project.yml", Before: before, After: after, Existed: true}}); err != nil {
		return RuntimeLockSetUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	reopened, err := projectlifecycle.NewService(map[string]string{"runtime-lock-set-update": request.NewBundleRoot}).OpenProject(ctx, root)
	if err != nil || reopened.Project == nil || reopened.Project.Source.BundleDigest != candidate.ArtifactDigest || reopened.Catalog == nil || reopened.Catalog.Status != "READY" {
		return RuntimeLockSetUpdateResult{}, errors.New("RUNTIME_LOCK_SET_UPDATE_REOPEN_FAILED")
	}
	revision, err := ProjectRevision(root)
	if err != nil {
		return RuntimeLockSetUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	return RuntimeLockSetUpdateResult{PreviousArtifactDigest: request.ExpectedOldArtifactDigest, PreviousCatalogDigest: request.ExpectedOldCatalogDigest, NewArtifactDigest: candidate.ArtifactDigest, NewCatalogDigest: candidate.CatalogDigest, NewProjectRevision: revision}, nil
}

// UpdateArtifactLock validates a compatible immutable bundle, then changes
// only artifactLock.digest through the existing guarded writer transaction.
func (b *Backend) UpdateArtifactLock(ctx context.Context, request ArtifactLockUpdateRequest) (ArtifactLockUpdateResult, error) {
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return ArtifactLockUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	if !validDigest(request.ExpectedOldDigest) || !validDigest(request.NewDigest) || request.ExpectedOldDigest == request.NewDigest || request.NewBundleRoot == "" {
		return ArtifactLockUpdateResult{}, blocked("ARTIFACT_LOCK_UPDATE_INVALID", "Artifact lock update input is invalid", "artifactLock")
	}
	root, err := cleanRoot(request.ProjectRoot)
	if err != nil {
		return ArtifactLockUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	release, err := acquireWriterLock(ctx, root, b.lockWait)
	if err != nil {
		return ArtifactLockUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	defer release()
	if err := recoverTransactions(root); err != nil {
		return ArtifactLockUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	if err := projectlifecycle.ValidateArtifactLockCandidate(ctx, root, request.NewBundleRoot, request.NewDigest); err != nil {
		return ArtifactLockUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	path, err := safeProjectPath(root, "project.yml", false)
	if err != nil {
		return ArtifactLockUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	before, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return ArtifactLockUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	after, err := replaceArtifactLockDigest(before, request.ExpectedOldDigest, request.NewDigest)
	if err != nil {
		return ArtifactLockUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	identifier, err := artifactLockTransactionID()
	if err != nil {
		return ArtifactLockUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	if err := b.commitDocuments(root, identifier, []storedDocument{{LogicalPath: "project.yml", Before: before, After: after, Existed: true}}); err != nil {
		return ArtifactLockUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	reopened, err := projectlifecycle.NewService(map[string]string{"artifact-lock-update": request.NewBundleRoot}).OpenProject(ctx, root)
	if err != nil || reopened.Project == nil || reopened.Project.Source.BundleDigest != request.NewDigest || reopened.Catalog == nil || reopened.Catalog.Status != "READY" {
		return ArtifactLockUpdateResult{}, errors.New("ARTIFACT_LOCK_UPDATE_REOPEN_FAILED")
	}
	revision, err := ProjectRevision(root)
	if err != nil {
		return ArtifactLockUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	return ArtifactLockUpdateResult{PreviousDigest: request.ExpectedOldDigest, NewDigest: request.NewDigest, NewProjectRevision: revision}, nil
}

func artifactLockTransactionID() (string, error) {
	value := make([]byte, 16)
	if _, err := rand.Read(value); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return hex.EncodeToString(value), nil
}

// replaceArtifactLockDigest accepts only the canonical scalar form emitted for
// managed projects. It validates the YAML shape first, then replaces that one
// scalar in-place so all unrelated project.yml bytes remain untouched.
func replaceArtifactLockDigest(before []byte, expectedOldDigest, newDigest string) ([]byte, error) {
	var document yaml.Node
	if err := yaml.Unmarshal(before, &document); err != nil || len(document.Content) != 1 || document.Content[0].Kind != yaml.MappingNode {
		return nil, blocked("ARTIFACT_LOCK_UPDATE_INVALID", "Managed project manifest cannot be safely updated", "artifactLock")
	}
	artifactLock, found, duplicate := yamlMappingValue(document.Content[0], "artifactLock")
	if !found || duplicate || artifactLock.Kind != yaml.MappingNode {
		return nil, blocked("ARTIFACT_LOCK_UPDATE_INVALID", "Managed project artifact lock is invalid", "artifactLock")
	}
	digest, found, duplicate := yamlMappingValue(artifactLock, "digest")
	if !found || duplicate || digest.Kind != yaml.ScalarNode || digest.Tag != "!!str" || digest.Value != expectedOldDigest {
		return nil, blocked("ARTIFACT_LOCK_CHANGED", "Artifact lock changed before update", "artifactLock.digest")
	}
	start, end, ok := yamlSourceLine(before, digest.Line)
	if !ok {
		return nil, blocked("ARTIFACT_LOCK_UPDATE_INVALID", "Managed project artifact lock is not in canonical form", "artifactLock.digest")
	}
	line := string(before[start:end])
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimSuffix(line, "\r"))
	if trimmed != "digest: "+expectedOldDigest || strings.Count(line, expectedOldDigest) != 1 {
		return nil, blocked("ARTIFACT_LOCK_UPDATE_INVALID", "Managed project artifact lock is not in canonical form", "artifactLock.digest")
	}
	offset := bytes.Index(before[start:end], []byte(expectedOldDigest))
	if offset < 0 {
		return nil, blocked("ARTIFACT_LOCK_UPDATE_INVALID", "Managed project artifact lock is not in canonical form", "artifactLock.digest")
	}
	position := start + offset
	after := make([]byte, 0, len(before)-len(expectedOldDigest)+len(newDigest))
	after = append(after, before[:position]...)
	after = append(after, newDigest...)
	after = append(after, before[position+len(expectedOldDigest):]...)
	return after, nil
}

type runtimeCatalogLock struct {
	APIVersion string                                                `yaml:"apiVersion"`
	Digest     string                                                `yaml:"digest"`
	Services   map[string]projectlifecycle.RuntimeCatalogServiceLock `yaml:"services"`
}

func replaceRuntimeLockSet(before []byte, expectedArtifactDigest, expectedCatalogDigest string, candidate projectlifecycle.RuntimeLockUpgradeCandidate) ([]byte, error) {
	locks, err := readRuntimeLockSet(before)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if locks.CatalogDigest != expectedCatalogDigest || locks.ArtifactDigest != expectedArtifactDigest {
		return nil, blocked("RUNTIME_LOCK_CHANGED", "Runtime lock changed before update", "project.yml")
	}
	var document yaml.Node
	if err := yaml.Unmarshal(before, &document); err != nil || len(document.Content) != 1 || document.Content[0].Kind != yaml.MappingNode {
		return nil, blocked("RUNTIME_LOCK_SET_UPDATE_INVALID", "Managed project manifest cannot be safely updated", "project.yml")
	}
	mapping := document.Content[0]
	catalogKey, catalogLock, catalogFound, catalogDuplicate := yamlMappingPair(mapping, "catalogLock")
	artifactKey, artifactLock, artifactFound, artifactDuplicate := yamlMappingPair(mapping, "artifactLock")
	if !catalogFound || catalogDuplicate || !artifactFound || artifactDuplicate || catalogLock.Kind != yaml.MappingNode || artifactLock.Kind != yaml.MappingNode || catalogKey.Line < 1 || artifactKey.Line <= catalogKey.Line {
		return nil, blocked("RUNTIME_LOCK_SET_UPDATE_INVALID", "Managed project lock layout is invalid", "project.yml")
	}
	catalogStart, _, ok := yamlSourceLine(before, catalogKey.Line)
	artifactStart, _, okArtifact := yamlSourceLine(before, artifactKey.Line)
	if !ok || !okArtifact || catalogStart >= artifactStart {
		return nil, blocked("RUNTIME_LOCK_SET_UPDATE_INVALID", "Managed project lock layout is not canonical", "project.yml")
	}
	encoded, err := yaml.Marshal(runtimeCatalogLock{APIVersion: "platform.installer/catalog/v1alpha1", Digest: candidate.CatalogDigest, Services: candidate.CatalogServices})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	block := "catalogLock:\n" + indentYAML(encoded, "    ")
	withCatalog := append(append(append([]byte{}, before[:catalogStart]...), []byte(block)...), before[artifactStart:]...)
	return replaceArtifactLockDigest(withCatalog, expectedArtifactDigest, candidate.ArtifactDigest)
}

func readRuntimeLockSet(content []byte) (RuntimeLockSet, error) {
	var document yaml.Node
	if err := yaml.Unmarshal(content, &document); err != nil || len(document.Content) != 1 || document.Content[0].Kind != yaml.MappingNode {
		return RuntimeLockSet{}, blocked("RUNTIME_LOCK_SET_UPDATE_INVALID", "Managed project manifest cannot be safely read", "project.yml")
	}
	mapping := document.Content[0]
	_, catalogLock, catalogFound, catalogDuplicate := yamlMappingPair(mapping, "catalogLock")
	_, artifactLock, artifactFound, artifactDuplicate := yamlMappingPair(mapping, "artifactLock")
	if !catalogFound || catalogDuplicate || !artifactFound || artifactDuplicate || catalogLock.Kind != yaml.MappingNode || artifactLock.Kind != yaml.MappingNode {
		return RuntimeLockSet{}, blocked("RUNTIME_LOCK_SET_UPDATE_INVALID", "Managed project lock layout is invalid", "project.yml")
	}
	catalogDigest, catalogFound, catalogDuplicate := yamlMappingValue(catalogLock, "digest")
	artifactDigest, artifactFound, artifactDuplicate := yamlMappingValue(artifactLock, "digest")
	if !catalogFound || catalogDuplicate || catalogDigest.Kind != yaml.ScalarNode || catalogDigest.Tag != "!!str" || !validDigest(catalogDigest.Value) || !artifactFound || artifactDuplicate || artifactDigest.Kind != yaml.ScalarNode || artifactDigest.Tag != "!!str" || !validDigest(artifactDigest.Value) {
		return RuntimeLockSet{}, blocked("RUNTIME_LOCK_SET_UPDATE_INVALID", "Managed project lock layout is invalid", "project.yml")
	}
	return RuntimeLockSet{ArtifactDigest: artifactDigest.Value, CatalogDigest: catalogDigest.Value}, nil
}

func yamlMappingPair(mapping *yaml.Node, name string) (*yaml.Node, *yaml.Node, bool, bool) {
	var key, value *yaml.Node
	for index := 0; index+1 < len(mapping.Content); index += 2 {
		candidateKey := mapping.Content[index]
		if candidateKey.Kind != yaml.ScalarNode || candidateKey.Value != name {
			continue
		}
		if value != nil {
			return nil, nil, true, true
		}
		key, value = candidateKey, mapping.Content[index+1]
	}
	return key, value, value != nil, false
}

func indentYAML(value []byte, prefix string) string {
	trimmed := strings.TrimSuffix(string(value), "\n")
	if trimmed == "" {
		return ""
	}
	return prefix + strings.ReplaceAll(trimmed, "\n", "\n"+prefix) + "\n"
}

func yamlMappingValue(mapping *yaml.Node, name string) (*yaml.Node, bool, bool) {
	var value *yaml.Node
	for index := 0; index+1 < len(mapping.Content); index += 2 {
		key := mapping.Content[index]
		if key.Kind != yaml.ScalarNode || key.Value != name {
			continue
		}
		if value != nil {
			return nil, true, true
		}
		value = mapping.Content[index+1]
	}
	return value, value != nil, false
}

func yamlSourceLine(content []byte, lineNumber int) (int, int, bool) {
	if lineNumber < 1 {
		return 0, 0, false
	}
	start := 0
	for line := 1; line < lineNumber; line++ {
		next := bytes.IndexByte(content[start:], '\n')
		if next < 0 {
			return 0, 0, false
		}
		start += next + 1
	}
	end := len(content)
	if next := bytes.IndexByte(content[start:], '\n'); next >= 0 {
		end = start + next
	}
	return start, end, true
}

type Backend struct {
	core            coreadapter.Adapter
	plans           PlanStore
	now             func() time.Time
	planTTL         time.Duration
	lockWait        time.Duration
	replace         replaceFunc
	serverTypes     map[string]bool
	catalogResolver func(context.Context, string) (*projectlifecycle.ProjectCatalogView, error)
}

type Option func(*Backend)

func WithPlanStore(store PlanStore) Option { return func(backend *Backend) { backend.plans = store } }
func WithPlanTTL(ttl time.Duration) Option { return func(backend *Backend) { backend.planTTL = ttl } }
func WithServerTypes(values []string) Option {
	return func(backend *Backend) {
		backend.serverTypes = make(map[string]bool, len(values))
		for _, value := range values {
			backend.serverTypes[value] = true
		}
	}
}
func WithProjectCatalogResolver(resolver func(context.Context, string) (*projectlifecycle.ProjectCatalogView, error)) Option {
	return func(backend *Backend) { backend.catalogResolver = resolver }
}
func withReplace(function replaceFunc) Option {
	return func(backend *Backend) { backend.replace = function }
}

func NewBackend(adapter coreadapter.Adapter, options ...Option) *Backend {
	backend := &Backend{core: adapter, now: time.Now, planTTL: 5 * time.Minute,
		lockWait: 5 * time.Second, replace: atomicReplace}
	for _, option := range options {
		option(backend)
	}
	if backend.plans == nil {
		backend.plans = NewMemoryPlanStore(backend.planTTL)
	}
	return backend
}

func (b *Backend) validateCommand(command EditCommand) error {
	return b.validateCommandWithInternalBatch(command, false)
}

func (b *Backend) validateCommandWithInternalBatch(command EditCommand, allowBatch bool) error {
	if err := validateCommandWithInternalBatch(command, allowBatch); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return b.validateConfiguredTypes(command)
}

func (b *Backend) validateConfiguredTypes(command EditCommand) error {
	if command.Operation == "Batch" {
		for _, child := range command.Commands {
			child.APIVersion = command.APIVersion
			child.Kind = command.Kind
			child.BaseProjectRevision = command.BaseProjectRevision
			if err := b.validateConfiguredTypes(child); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		return nil
	}
	if (command.APIVersion == EditCommandAPIVersionV3 || command.APIVersion == EditCommandAPIVersionV4 || isEditCommandV5OrLater(command.APIVersion)) && (command.Operation == "CreateServer" || command.Operation == "UpdateServer" && command.ServerType != "") {
		if len(b.serverTypes) == 0 {
			return blocked("APPLICATION_CONFIG_UNAVAILABLE", "Application configuration is unavailable", "command.type")
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func blockedPlan(command EditCommand, revision string, err error) *EditPlan {
	finding := Finding{APIVersion: "platform.installer/finding/v1alpha1", Kind: "Finding",
		Code: "EDIT_PLAN_FAILED", Status: "BLOCKED", Category: "project-writer", Field: "command",
		SafeMessage: "Edit plan could not be created"}
	if typed, ok := err.(*writerError); ok {
		finding = typed.finding()
	}
	version := EditPlanAPIVersion
	if isEditCommandV2OrLater(command.APIVersion) {
		version = EditPlanAPIVersionV2
	}
	return &EditPlan{APIVersion: version, Kind: "EditPlan", Status: "BLOCKED",
		BaseProjectRevision: revision, CommandSummary: commandSummary(command),
		SemanticChanges: []SemanticChange{}, AffectedEntities: []string{},
		AffectedDocuments: []DocumentChange{}, Impacts: []string{},
		Validation: Validation{Status: "BLOCKED", Findings: []Finding{finding}},
		ReviewDiff: "", CommitAllowed: false, ApplyRequired: false}
}

func planVersion(command EditCommand) string {
	if isEditCommandV2OrLater(command.APIVersion) {
		return EditPlanAPIVersionV2
	}
	return EditPlanAPIVersion
}

func blockedCorePlan(command EditCommand, revision string, snapshot *coreadapter.Snapshot) *EditPlan {
	plan := blockedPlan(command, revision,
		blocked("VALIDATION_BLOCKED", "Authoritative Core validation is blocked", "project"))
	if snapshot == nil || len(snapshot.Findings) == 0 {
		return plan
	}
	findings := make([]Finding, 0, len(snapshot.Findings))
	for _, item := range snapshot.Findings {
		finding := Finding{APIVersion: "platform.installer/finding/v1alpha1", Kind: "Finding",
			Status: "BLOCKED", Category: "core-validation", Field: "project",
			Code: "CORE_VALIDATION_BLOCKED", SafeMessage: "Core validation blocked the proposed project"}
		if value, ok := item["code"].(string); ok && value != "" {
			finding.Code = value
		}
		if value, ok := item["field"].(string); ok && value != "" {
			finding.Field = value
		}
		if value, ok := item["category"].(string); ok && value != "" {
			finding.Category = value
		}
		if value, ok := item["safeMessage"].(string); ok && value != "" {
			finding.SafeMessage = value
		}
		findings = append(findings, finding)
	}
	plan.Validation.Findings = findings
	return plan
}

func documentOwnership(snapshot *coreadapter.Snapshot) map[string]string {
	result := make(map[string]string, len(snapshot.Documents))
	for _, document := range snapshot.Documents {
		result[document.LogicalPath] = document.Ownership
	}
	return result
}

func boundedDiff(logical string, before, after []byte) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("--- %s (%s)\n+++ %s (%s)\n@@ Installer-owned document changed; values are shown by semantic changes @@\n",
		logical, digestBytes(before), logical, digestBytes(after))
}

func affectedEntities(changes []SemanticChange) []string {
	set := make(map[string]bool)
	for _, change := range changes {
		if change.EntityID != "" {
			set[change.EntityID] = true
		}
	}
	result := make([]string, 0, len(set))
	for item := range set {
		result = append(result, item)
	}
	sort.Strings(result)
	return result
}

func coreDerivedImpacts(before, after *coreadapter.Snapshot) []string {
	candidates := []struct {
		name        string
		beforeValue any
		afterValue  any
	}{
		{"CONFIGURATION_CHANGED", before.EffectiveConfiguration, after.EffectiveConfiguration},
		{"TOPOLOGY_CHANGED", before.Topology, after.Topology},
		{"ENDPOINT_CHANGED", before.Endpoints, after.Endpoints},
		{"INTEGRATION_CHANGED", before.Integrations, after.Integrations},
		{"PKI_INPUT_CHANGED", before.PKI, after.PKI},
	}
	result := make([]string, 0, len(candidates))
	for _, candidate := range candidates {
		if !semanticEqual(candidate.beforeValue, candidate.afterValue) {
			result = append(result, candidate.name)
		}
	}
	return result
}

func mergeImpacts(groups ...[]string) []string {
	set := make(map[string]bool)
	for _, group := range groups {
		for _, item := range group {
			set[item] = true
		}
	}
	result := make([]string, 0, len(set))
	for item := range set {
		result = append(result, item)
	}
	sort.Strings(result)
	return result
}

func (b *Backend) PlanEdit(ctx context.Context, projectRoot string, command EditCommand) (*EditPlan, error) {
	return b.planEdit(ctx, projectRoot, command, false)
}

func (b *Backend) planEdit(ctx context.Context, projectRoot string, command EditCommand, allowV2Batch bool) (*EditPlan, error) {
	started := b.now()
	root, err := cleanRoot(projectRoot)
	if err != nil {
		return blockedPlan(command, command.BaseProjectRevision, err), nil
	}
	if err := b.validateCommandWithInternalBatch(command, allowV2Batch); err != nil {
		return blockedPlan(command, command.BaseProjectRevision, err), nil
	}
	owned, err := discoverOwnedPaths(root)
	if err != nil {
		return blockedPlan(command, command.BaseProjectRevision, err), nil
	}
	coreStarted := b.now()
	snapshot, err := b.core.BuildSnapshot(ctx, root, owned)
	initialSnapshotDuration := b.now().Sub(coreStarted)
	if err != nil {
		return blockedPlan(command, command.BaseProjectRevision,
			blocked("CORE_SNAPSHOT_FAILED", "Authoritative project snapshot could not be built", "project")), nil
	}
	if command.BaseProjectRevision != snapshot.ProjectRevision {
		return blockedPlan(command, snapshot.ProjectRevision,
			blocked("PROJECT_CHANGED", "Project changed before planning", "baseProjectRevision")), nil
	}
	if snapshot.Status != "PASS" {
		return blockedCorePlan(command, snapshot.ProjectRevision, snapshot), nil
	}
	candidates := make(map[string]map[string]any)
	originals := make(map[string][]byte)
	expectations, changes, impacts, err := applyCommand(command, root, snapshot, candidates, originals)
	if err != nil {
		return blockedPlan(command, snapshot.ProjectRevision, err), nil
	}
	if len(expectations) == 0 {
		return &EditPlan{APIVersion: planVersion(command), Kind: "EditPlan", Status: "NO_CHANGE",
			BaseProjectRevision: snapshot.ProjectRevision, CommandSummary: commandSummary(command),
			SemanticChanges: []SemanticChange{}, AffectedEntities: []string{},
			AffectedDocuments: []DocumentChange{}, Impacts: []string{},
			Validation: Validation{Status: "PASS", Findings: []Finding{}}, ReviewDiff: "",
			CommitAllowed: false, ApplyRequired: false,
			Timing: PlanTiming{Application: b.now().Sub(started) - initialSnapshotDuration,
				InitialSnapshot: initialSnapshotDuration}}, nil
	}
	ownership := documentOwnership(snapshot)
	storedDocuments := make([]storedDocument, 0, len(candidates))
	documentChanges := make([]DocumentChange, 0, len(candidates))
	diffParts := make([]string, 0, len(candidates))
	paths := make([]string, 0, len(candidates))
	for logical := range candidates {
		paths = append(paths, logical)
	}
	sort.Strings(paths)
	for _, logical := range paths {
		if ownership[logical] != "INSTALLER_OWNED" {
			return blockedPlan(command, snapshot.ProjectRevision,
				blocked("WRITE_NOT_ALLOWED", "Edit requires a non-Installer-owned document", "document")), nil
		}
		after, serializationErr := deterministicYAML(candidates[logical])
		if serializationErr != nil {
			return blockedPlan(command, snapshot.ProjectRevision,
				blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "Edit value cannot be serialized safely", "command.value")), nil
		}
		before := originals[logical]
		if bytes.Equal(before, after) {
			continue
		}
		storedDocuments = append(storedDocuments, storedDocument{LogicalPath: logical,
			Before: append([]byte(nil), before...), After: after, Existed: true})
		change := DocumentChange{LogicalPath: logical, BeforeDigest: digestBytes(before), AfterDigest: digestBytes(after)}
		if isEditCommandV2OrLater(command.APIVersion) {
			change.Before = &DocumentState{State: "PRESENT", Digest: digestBytes(before)}
			change.After = &DocumentState{State: "PRESENT", Digest: digestBytes(after)}
			change.BeforeDigest, change.AfterDigest = "", ""
		}
		documentChanges = append(documentChanges, change)
		diffParts = append(diffParts, boundedDiff(logical, before, after))
	}
	if len(storedDocuments) == 0 {
		return &EditPlan{APIVersion: planVersion(command), Kind: "EditPlan", Status: "NO_CHANGE",
			BaseProjectRevision: snapshot.ProjectRevision, CommandSummary: commandSummary(command),
			SemanticChanges: []SemanticChange{}, AffectedEntities: []string{},
			AffectedDocuments: []DocumentChange{}, Impacts: []string{},
			Validation: Validation{Status: "PASS", Findings: []Finding{}}, ReviewDiff: "",
			CommitAllowed: false, ApplyRequired: false,
			Timing: PlanTiming{Application: b.now().Sub(started) - initialSnapshotDuration,
				InitialSnapshot: initialSnapshotDuration}}, nil
	}
	stagedRoot, cleanup, err := copyProject(root)
	if err != nil {
		return blockedPlan(command, snapshot.ProjectRevision, err), nil
	}
	defer cleanup()
	for _, document := range storedDocuments {
		path, pathErr := safeProjectPath(stagedRoot, document.LogicalPath, false)
		if pathErr != nil {
			return blockedPlan(command, snapshot.ProjectRevision, pathErr), nil
		}
		if writeErr := os.WriteFile(path, document.After, 0o600); writeErr != nil {
			return blockedPlan(command, snapshot.ProjectRevision,
				blocked("STAGING_FAILED", "Staged managed document could not be written", "document")), nil
		}
	}
	stagedOwned, err := discoverOwnedPaths(stagedRoot)
	if err != nil {
		return blockedPlan(command, snapshot.ProjectRevision, err), nil
	}
	stagedCoreStarted := b.now()
	staged, err := b.core.BuildSnapshot(ctx, stagedRoot, stagedOwned)
	stagedSnapshotDuration := b.now().Sub(stagedCoreStarted)
	if err != nil || staged.Status != "PASS" {
		if err != nil {
			return blockedPlan(command, snapshot.ProjectRevision,
				blocked("CORE_SNAPSHOT_FAILED", "Staged authoritative snapshot could not be built", "project")), nil
		}
		return blockedCorePlan(command, snapshot.ProjectRevision, staged), nil
	}
	if serverReferenceInUse(staged, expectations) {
		return blockedPlan(command, snapshot.ProjectRevision,
			blocked("REFERENCE_IN_USE", "Server is still referenced by the canonical project", "command.hostId")), nil
	}
	if !proveSnapshot(staged, expectations) {
		return blockedPlan(command, snapshot.ProjectRevision,
			blocked("EDIT_SHADOWED", "Authoritative Core resolution did not make the requested edit effective", "command")), nil
	}
	impacts = mergeImpacts(impacts, coreDerivedImpacts(snapshot, staged))
	plan := EditPlan{APIVersion: planVersion(command), Kind: "EditPlan", Status: "READY",
		BaseProjectRevision: snapshot.ProjectRevision, CommandSummary: commandSummary(command),
		SemanticChanges: changes, AffectedEntities: affectedEntities(changes),
		AffectedDocuments: documentChanges, Impacts: impacts,
		Validation:                  Validation{Status: "PASS", Findings: []Finding{}},
		ExpectedEffectiveState:      expectedState(expectations),
		ExpectedSnapshotFingerprint: staged.SnapshotFingerprint,
		ReviewDiff:                  strings.Join(diffParts, ""), CommitAllowed: true, ApplyRequired: true,
		ExpiresAt: b.now().Add(b.planTTL)}
	identifier, err := b.plans.Put(storedPlan{Created: b.now(), ProjectRoot: root,
		Public: plan, Documents: storedDocuments})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("store edit plan: %w", err)
	}
	plan.PlanID = identifier
	plan.Timing = PlanTiming{Application: b.now().Sub(started) - initialSnapshotDuration - stagedSnapshotDuration,
		InitialSnapshot: initialSnapshotDuration, StagedSnapshot: stagedSnapshotDuration}
	return &plan, nil
}

func (b *Backend) planCommands(ctx context.Context, projectRoot, classification, revision string, commands []EditCommand) (*EditPlan, error) {
	if len(commands) == 0 {
		return blockedPlan(EditCommand{}, revision, blocked("EDIT_SESSION_EMPTY", "Edit session contains no commands", "session")), nil
	}
	if isEmptyManagedClassification(classification) {
		return b.planFirstWrite(ctx, projectRoot, revision, commands)
	}
	if len(commands) > 16 {
		return blockedPlan(commands[0], revision, blocked("EDIT_SESSION_COMMANDS_UNSUPPORTED", "This edit set must be split until full-model reconciliation is available", "session")), nil
	}
	command := commands[0]
	if len(commands) > 1 {
		command = EditCommand{APIVersion: commands[0].APIVersion, Kind: "EditCommand", BaseProjectRevision: revision, Operation: "Batch", Commands: commands}
	}
	return b.planEdit(ctx, projectRoot, command, true)
}

func (b *Backend) DiscardEditPlan(planID string) EditCommitResult {
	return EditCommitResult{APIVersion: EditResultAPIVersion, Kind: "EditCommitResult",
		Status: "DISCARDED", Changed: false, Discarded: b.plans.Discard(planID)}
}

func runtimePath(root string, elements ...string) string {
	items := append([]string{root, ".runtime"}, elements...)
	return filepath.Join(items...)
}

var identifierPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,62}$`)
var configurationSettingPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}$`)
var virtualAddressInterfacePattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]+$`)
var serverAddressPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,252}$`)
var desiredHostnamePattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9.-]*[A-Za-z0-9])?$`)
var extensionKeyPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^x-[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$`)
var secretKeyPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)password|passphrase|private.?key|pgpass|token|secret|credential`)
var runtimeRefPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^runtime:[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}$`)
var projectNamePrefixPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,23}$`)
var projectDataRootPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^/(?:[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,95}/)*[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,95}$`)

func validProjectSetting(setting, value string) bool {
	switch setting {
	case "platform_name_prefix":
		return value == "" || projectNamePrefixPattern.MatchString(value)
	case "platform_data_root_directory":
		if len(value) > 240 || !projectDataRootPattern.MatchString(value) {
			return false
		}
		parts := strings.Split(value, "/")
		for _, part := range parts {
			if part == "." || part == ".." {
				return false
			}
		}
		switch parts[1] {
		case "bin", "boot", "dev", "etc", "home", "lib", "lib64", "proc", "root", "run", "sbin", "sys", "tmp", "usr":
			return false
		case "var":
			return value == "/var/lib" || strings.HasPrefix(value, "/var/lib/")
		}
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

type expectation struct {
	Operation string
	First     string
	Second    string
	Value     any
}

func deepCopy(value any) any {
	switch typed := value.(type) {
	case map[string]any:
		result := make(map[string]any, len(typed))
		for key, item := range typed {
			result[key] = deepCopy(item)
		}
		return result
	case []any:
		result := make([]any, len(typed))
		for index, item := range typed {
			result[index] = deepCopy(item)
		}
		return result
	default:
		return typed
	}
}

func asMap(value any) map[string]any {
	result, _ := value.(map[string]any)
	return result
}

func asSlice(value any) []any {
	result, _ := value.([]any)
	return result
}

func semanticEqual(left, right any) bool {
	leftJSON, leftErr := json.Marshal(left)
	rightJSON, rightErr := json.Marshal(right)
	return leftErr == nil && rightErr == nil && string(leftJSON) == string(rightJSON)
}

func safeValue(value any, key string) error {
	if key != "" && secretKeyPattern.MatchString(key) {
		lower := strings.ToLower(key)
		if strings.HasSuffix(lower, "secretref") || strings.HasSuffix(lower, "credentialref") {
			text, ok := value.(string)
			if !ok || !runtimeRefPattern.MatchString(text) {
				return blocked("SECRET_REFERENCE_INVALID", "Only opaque runtime secret references are accepted", "command.value")
			}
		} else {
			return blocked("SECRET_VALUE_NOT_ALLOWED", "Plaintext secret fields are not accepted", "command.value")
		}
	}
	switch typed := value.(type) {
	case string:
		upper := strings.ToUpper(typed)
		if strings.Contains(upper, "PRIVATE KEY-----") || strings.HasPrefix(upper, "PGPASS=") {
			return blocked("SECRET_VALUE_NOT_ALLOWED", "Secret material is not accepted", "command.value")
		}
	case map[string]any:
		for child, item := range typed {
			if err := safeValue(item, child); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
	case []any:
		for _, item := range typed {
			if err := safeValue(item, ""); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func validateCommand(command EditCommand) error {
	return validateCommandWithInternalBatch(command, false)
}

	if version == EditCommandAPIVersionV11 {

	return version == EditCommandAPIVersionV2 || version == EditCommandAPIVersionV3 || version == EditCommandAPIVersionV4 || version == EditCommandAPIVersionV5 || version == EditCommandAPIVersionV6 || version == EditCommandAPIVersionV7 || version == EditCommandAPIVersionV8 || version == EditCommandAPIVersionV9 || version == EditCommandAPIVersionV10
