		}
	case "ReconcileEndpointProvider":
		if (command.APIVersion != EditCommandAPIVersionV6 && command.APIVersion != EditCommandAPIVersionV7 && command.APIVersion != EditCommandAPIVersionV8 && command.APIVersion != EditCommandAPIVersionV9 && command.APIVersion != EditCommandAPIVersionV10) || !identifierPattern.MatchString(command.DeploymentID) || !identifierPattern.MatchString(command.EndpointGroupID) || command.VirtualRouterID < 1 || command.VirtualRouterID > 255 || len(command.VirtualAddresses) == 0 || len(command.VirtualAddresses) > 64 {
			return blocked("INVALID_EDIT_COMMAND", "Provider reconcile requires a complete bounded provider tuple", "command")
		}
		seen := make(map[string]bool, len(command.VirtualAddresses))
		for _, address := range command.VirtualAddresses {
			ip, err := netip.ParseAddr(address.Address)
			if err != nil || !ip.Is4() || address.Interface == "" || len(address.Interface) > 128 || !virtualAddressInterfacePattern.MatchString(address.Interface) || len(address.unknownFields) != 0 {
				return blocked("INVALID_EDIT_COMMAND", "Provider virtual address is invalid", "command.virtualAddresses")
			}
			key := address.Address + "\x00" + address.Interface
			if seen[key] {
				return blocked("INVALID_EDIT_COMMAND", "Provider virtual address is duplicated", "command.virtualAddresses")
			}
			seen[key] = true
		}
	case "ClearEndpointProvider":
		if (command.APIVersion != EditCommandAPIVersionV6 && command.APIVersion != EditCommandAPIVersionV7 && command.APIVersion != EditCommandAPIVersionV8 && command.APIVersion != EditCommandAPIVersionV9 && command.APIVersion != EditCommandAPIVersionV10) || !identifierPattern.MatchString(command.DeploymentID) {
			return blocked("INVALID_EDIT_COMMAND", "Provider clear requires a deployment identifier", "command.deploymentId")
		}
	case "AssignServiceToHost", "RemoveServiceFromHost":
		if !identifierPattern.MatchString(command.HostID) || !identifierPattern.MatchString(command.DeploymentID) {
			return blocked("INVALID_EDIT_COMMAND", "Placement edit requires host and deployment identifiers", "command")
		}
	case "SetPlacementProperty":
		if !identifierPattern.MatchString(command.HostID) || !identifierPattern.MatchString(command.DeploymentID) || command.Property == "" {
			return blocked("INVALID_EDIT_COMMAND", "Placement property edit requires host, deployment, and property identifiers", "command")
		}
	}
	// A trusted closed runtime-reference object is inspected by its own fields.
	// Its setting ID can legitimately contain words such as "credential" and
	// must not be mistaken for a plaintext credential field.
	settingKey := command.Setting
	if object, ok := command.Value.(map[string]any); ok && safeRuntimeSecretReferenceObject(object) {
		settingKey = ""
	}
	if err := safeValue(command.Value, settingKey); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := safeValue(command.Value, command.Property); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, value := range []any{command.Deployment, command.EndpointGroup, command.Placement, command.Backend, command.Entity, command.Members, command.Hosts, command.VirtualAddresses} {
		if err := safeValue(value, ""); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func configurationPrimitive(value any) bool {
	switch typed := value.(type) {
	case string, bool, int, int64, uint64:
		return true
	case float64:
		return !math.IsNaN(typed) && !math.IsInf(typed, 0)
	case map[string]any:
		return safeRuntimeSecretReferenceObject(typed)
	default:
		return false
	}
}

// safeRuntimeSecretReferenceObject is intentionally only an early admission
// bound. Review still requires the exact trusted catalog descriptor before
// this closed object can reach a candidate or writer.
func safeRuntimeSecretReferenceObject(value map[string]any) bool {
	if len(value) < 1 || len(value) > 2 {
		return false
	}
	reference, referenceOK := value["passwordSecretRef"].(string)
	if !referenceOK || !runtimeRefPattern.MatchString(reference) {
		return false
	}
	if username, present := value["username"]; present {
		text, ok := username.(string)
		if !ok || !regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,62}$`).MatchString(text) {
			return false
		}
	}
	for key := range value {
		if key != "username" && key != "passwordSecretRef" {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func validEndpointGroup(value map[string]any) bool {
	address := asMap(value["address"])
	if address == nil || len(address) != 2 {
		return false
	}
	domain, domainOK := address["domain"].(string)
	_, wildcardOK := address["wildcard"].(bool)
	if !domainOK || domain == "" || !wildcardOK {
		return false
	}
	for key := range value {
		if key != "address" && !extensionKeyPattern.MatchString(key) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func validateCommandFields(command EditCommand, allowed ...string) error {
	if len(command.unknownFields) != 0 {
		return blocked("INVALID_EDIT_COMMAND", "Edit command contains an unknown field", "command."+command.unknownFields[0])
	}
	data, err := json.Marshal(command)
	if err != nil {
		return blocked("INVALID_EDIT_COMMAND", "Edit command cannot be encoded", "command")
	}
	var object map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &object); err != nil {
		return blocked("INVALID_EDIT_COMMAND", "Edit command cannot be decoded", "command")
	}
	permitted := map[string]bool{"apiVersion": true, "kind": true, "baseProjectRevision": true, "operation": true}
	for _, field := range allowed {
		permitted[field] = true
	}
	for field := range command.presentFields {
		if !permitted[field] {
			return blocked("INVALID_EDIT_COMMAND", "Edit command contains fields from another operation", "command."+field)
		}
	}
	for field := range object {
		if !permitted[field] {
			return blocked("INVALID_EDIT_COMMAND", "Edit command contains fields from another operation", "command."+field)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func validServerAddress(value string) bool {
	return serverAddressPattern.MatchString(value)
}

func commandSummary(command EditCommand) SemanticChange {
	entity := command.DeploymentID
	if entity == "" {
		entity = command.EndpointGroupID
	}
	if command.HostID != "" {
		entity = command.HostID + "/" + command.DeploymentID
	}
	property := command.Setting
	if property == "" {
		property = command.Property
	}
	return SemanticChange{Operation: command.Operation, EntityID: entity, Property: property,
		SafeSummary: command.Operation + " " + entity}
}

func loadOwnedDocument(root, logical string) (map[string]any, []byte, error) {
	path, err := safeProjectPath(root, logical, false)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	content, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	document, err := parseManagedYAML(content)
	return document, content, err
}

func desiredState(candidates map[string]map[string]any, originals map[string][]byte, root string) (map[string]any, error) {
	document := candidates[desiredDocument]
	if document == nil {
		loaded, content, err := loadOwnedDocument(root, desiredDocument)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		document = loaded
		candidates[desiredDocument] = document
		originals[desiredDocument] = content
	}
	state := asMap(document["platform_desired_state"])
	if state == nil {
		return nil, blocked("WRITE_OWNERSHIP_REQUIRED", "Installer-owned desired-state root is missing", "platform_desired_state")
	}
	return state, nil
}

func hostPlacements(candidates map[string]map[string]any, originals map[string][]byte, root, hostID string) (map[string]any, error) {
	if !identifierPattern.MatchString(hostID) {
		return nil, blocked("INVALID_EDIT_COMMAND", "Host identifier is invalid", "command.hostId")
	}
	logical := managedHostDocument(hostID)
	document := candidates[logical]
	if document == nil {
		loaded, content, err := loadOwnedDocument(root, logical)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		document = loaded
		candidates[logical] = document
		originals[logical] = content
	}
	placements := asMap(document["platform_deployments"])
	if placements == nil {
		return nil, blocked("WRITE_OWNERSHIP_REQUIRED", "Installer-owned placement root is missing", "platform_deployments")
	}
	return placements, nil
}

func deployment(state map[string]any, deploymentID string) (map[string]any, error) {
	if !identifierPattern.MatchString(deploymentID) {
		return nil, blocked("INVALID_EDIT_COMMAND", "Deployment identifier is invalid", "command.deploymentId")
	}
	value := asMap(asMap(state["serviceDeployments"])[deploymentID])
	if value == nil {
		return nil, blocked("INVALID_EDIT_COMMAND", "Service deployment does not exist", "command.deploymentId")
	}
	return value, nil
}

func catalogSetting(snapshot *coreadapter.Snapshot, serviceType, setting string) bool {
	definition := snapshot.ServiceCatalog[serviceType]
	configuration := asMap(definition["configuration"])
	settings := asMap(configuration["settings"])
	_, found := settings[setting]
	return found
}

func catalogMode(snapshot *coreadapter.Snapshot, serviceType, mode string) bool {
	definition := snapshot.ServiceCatalog[serviceType]
	for _, candidate := range asSlice(definition["modes"]) {
		if candidate == mode {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func applyOne(command EditCommand, root string, snapshot *coreadapter.Snapshot,
	candidates map[string]map[string]any, originals map[string][]byte) (expectation, []string, error) {
	operation := command.Operation
	if operation == "CreateServer" || operation == "UpdateServer" || operation == "DeleteServer" {
		return applyServerCommand(command, root, snapshot, candidates, originals)
	}
	if strings.Contains(operation, "ServiceDeployment") || strings.Contains(operation, "Configuration") ||
		strings.Contains(operation, "EndpointGroup") || strings.Contains(operation, "HAProxy") {
		state, err := desiredState(candidates, originals, root)
		if err != nil {
			return expectation{}, nil, err
		}
		deployments := asMap(state["serviceDeployments"])
		groups := asMap(state["endpointGroups"])
		switch operation {
		case "SetServiceConfigurationValue":
			item, err := deployment(state, command.DeploymentID)
			if err != nil {
				return expectation{}, nil, err
			}
			serviceType, _ := item["serviceType"].(string)
			if !catalogSetting(snapshot, serviceType, command.Setting) {
				return expectation{}, nil, blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "Configuration setting is not declared by the catalog", "command.setting")
			}
			configuration := asMap(item["configuration"])
			if configuration == nil {
				configuration = make(map[string]any)
				item["configuration"] = configuration
			}
			if semanticEqual(configuration[command.Setting], command.Value) {
				return expectation{}, nil, nil
			}
			configuration[command.Setting] = deepCopy(command.Value)
			return expectation{operation, command.DeploymentID, command.Setting, command.Value}, []string{"CONFIGURATION_CHANGED"}, nil
		case "RemoveServiceConfigurationOverride":
			item, err := deployment(state, command.DeploymentID)
			if err != nil {
				return expectation{}, nil, err
			}
			serviceType, _ := item["serviceType"].(string)
			if !catalogSetting(snapshot, serviceType, command.Setting) {
				return expectation{}, nil, blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "Configuration setting is not declared by the catalog", "command.setting")
			}
			configuration := asMap(item["configuration"])
			if configuration == nil || configuration[command.Setting] == nil {
				return expectation{}, nil, nil
			}
			delete(configuration, command.Setting)
			return expectation{operation, command.DeploymentID, command.Setting, nil}, []string{"CONFIGURATION_CHANGED"}, nil
		case "CreateServiceDeployment":
			if !identifierPattern.MatchString(command.DeploymentID) || deployments[command.DeploymentID] != nil {
				return expectation{}, nil, blocked("INVALID_EDIT_COMMAND", "Deployment identifier is invalid or already exists", "command.deploymentId")
			}
			value := map[string]any{"serviceType": command.ServiceType, "mode": command.Mode}
			if command.APIVersion == EditCommandAPIVersion {
				value = deepCopy(command.Deployment).(map[string]any)
			}
			serviceType, _ := value["serviceType"].(string)
			mode, _ := value["mode"].(string)
			if !catalogMode(snapshot, serviceType, mode) {
				return expectation{}, nil, blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "Service type or mode is not declared by the catalog", "command.deployment")
			}
			deployments[command.DeploymentID] = value
			return expectation{operation, command.DeploymentID, "", value}, []string{"TOPOLOGY_CHANGED"}, nil
		case "DeleteServiceDeployment":
			if _, err := deployment(state, command.DeploymentID); err != nil {
				return expectation{}, nil, err
			}
			delete(deployments, command.DeploymentID)
			return expectation{operation, command.DeploymentID, "", nil}, []string{"TOPOLOGY_CHANGED"}, nil
		case "SetServiceEndpointGroup", "ClearServiceEndpointGroup":
			item, err := deployment(state, command.DeploymentID)
			if err != nil {
				return expectation{}, nil, err
			}
			if operation == "SetServiceEndpointGroup" {
				if groups[command.EndpointGroupID] == nil {
					return expectation{}, nil, blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "Endpoint group does not exist", "command.endpointGroupId")
				}
				if item["endpointGroup"] == command.EndpointGroupID {
					return expectation{}, nil, nil
				}
				item["endpointGroup"] = command.EndpointGroupID
			} else {
				if item["endpointGroup"] == nil {
					return expectation{}, nil, nil
				}
				delete(item, "endpointGroup")
			}
			return expectation{operation, command.DeploymentID, "endpointGroup", command.EndpointGroupID}, []string{"ENDPOINT_CHANGED", "PKI_INPUT_CHANGED"}, nil
		case "SetHAProxyIntegration", "ClearHAProxyIntegration":
			item, err := deployment(state, command.DeploymentID)
			if err != nil {
				return expectation{}, nil, err
			}
			var value any
			if operation == "SetHAProxyIntegration" {
				if _, err := deployment(state, command.HAProxyDeploymentID); err != nil {
					return expectation{}, nil, blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "HAProxy deployment reference does not exist", "command.haproxyDeploymentId")
				}
				relation := map[string]any{"deploymentRef": command.HAProxyDeploymentID}
				if command.Backend != nil {
					relation["backend"] = deepCopy(command.Backend)
				}
				if semanticEqual(item["haproxy"], relation) {
					return expectation{}, nil, nil
				}
				item["haproxy"] = relation
				value = relation
			} else {
				if item["haproxy"] == nil {
					return expectation{}, nil, nil
				}
				delete(item, "haproxy")
			}
			return expectation{operation, command.DeploymentID, "haproxy", value}, []string{"INTEGRATION_CHANGED"}, nil
		case "CreateEndpointGroup", "UpdateEndpointGroup", "DeleteEndpointGroup":
			if !identifierPattern.MatchString(command.EndpointGroupID) {
				return expectation{}, nil, blocked("INVALID_EDIT_COMMAND", "Endpoint group identifier is invalid", "command.endpointGroupId")
			}
			if operation == "CreateEndpointGroup" {
				if groups[command.EndpointGroupID] != nil {
					return expectation{}, nil, blocked("INVALID_EDIT_COMMAND", "Endpoint group already exists", "command.endpointGroupId")
				}
				groups[command.EndpointGroupID] = deepCopy(command.EndpointGroup)
			} else if operation == "UpdateEndpointGroup" {
				if groups[command.EndpointGroupID] == nil {
					return expectation{}, nil, blocked("INVALID_EDIT_COMMAND", "Endpoint group does not exist", "command.endpointGroupId")
				}
				if semanticEqual(groups[command.EndpointGroupID], command.EndpointGroup) {
					return expectation{}, nil, nil
				}
				groups[command.EndpointGroupID] = deepCopy(command.EndpointGroup)
			} else {
				for _, raw := range deployments {
					item := asMap(raw)
					if item["endpointGroup"] == command.EndpointGroupID || item["endpointGroupRef"] == command.EndpointGroupID {
						return expectation{}, nil, blocked("REFERENCE_IN_USE", "Endpoint group is still referenced", "command.endpointGroupId")
					}
				}
				delete(groups, command.EndpointGroupID)
			}
			return expectation{operation, command.EndpointGroupID, "", deepCopy(command.EndpointGroup)}, []string{"ENDPOINT_CHANGED", "PKI_INPUT_CHANGED"}, nil
		}
	}
	if operation == "AssignServiceToHost" || operation == "RemoveServiceFromHost" || operation == "SetPlacementProperty" {
		stagedDeployments := asMap(asMap(candidates[desiredDocument]["platform_desired_state"])["serviceDeployments"])
		if snapshot.Hosts[command.HostID] == nil ||
			(snapshot.ServiceDeployments[command.DeploymentID] == nil && stagedDeployments[command.DeploymentID] == nil) {
			return expectation{}, nil, blocked("INVALID_EDIT_COMMAND", "Host or deployment does not exist", "command")
		}
		placements, err := hostPlacements(candidates, originals, root, command.HostID)
		if err != nil {
			return expectation{}, nil, err
		}
		if operation == "AssignServiceToHost" {
			if semanticEqual(placements[command.DeploymentID], command.Placement) {
				return expectation{}, nil, nil
			}
			placements[command.DeploymentID] = deepCopy(command.Placement)
			return expectation{operation, command.HostID, command.DeploymentID, deepCopy(command.Placement)}, []string{"TOPOLOGY_CHANGED"}, nil
		}
		if operation == "RemoveServiceFromHost" {
			if placements[command.DeploymentID] == nil {
				return expectation{}, nil, nil
			}
			delete(placements, command.DeploymentID)
			return expectation{operation, command.HostID, command.DeploymentID, nil}, []string{"TOPOLOGY_CHANGED"}, nil
		}
		placement := asMap(placements[command.DeploymentID])
		if placement == nil || placement[command.Property] == nil {
			return expectation{}, nil, blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "Placement property is not already declared", "command.property")
		}
		if semanticEqual(placement[command.Property], command.Value) {
			return expectation{}, nil, nil
		}
		placement[command.Property] = deepCopy(command.Value)
		return expectation{operation, command.HostID, command.DeploymentID,
			map[string]any{"property": command.Property, "value": deepCopy(command.Value)}}, []string{"TOPOLOGY_CHANGED"}, nil
	}
	return expectation{}, nil, blocked("INVALID_EDIT_COMMAND", "Edit operation is unsupported", "command.operation")
}

func applyCommand(command EditCommand, root string, snapshot *coreadapter.Snapshot,
	candidates map[string]map[string]any, originals map[string][]byte) ([]expectation, []SemanticChange, []string, error) {
	commands := []EditCommand{command}
	if command.Operation == "Batch" {
		commands = append([]EditCommand(nil), command.Commands...)
		for index := range commands {
			commands[index].APIVersion = command.APIVersion
			commands[index].Kind = command.Kind
			commands[index].BaseProjectRevision = command.BaseProjectRevision
		}
	}
	var expectations []expectation
	serverFinal := make(map[string]expectation)
	deletedServers := make(map[string]bool)
	var changes []SemanticChange
	impactSet := make(map[string]bool)
	for _, child := range commands {
		if child.Operation == "CreateServer" && deletedServers[child.HostID] {
			return nil, nil, nil, blocked("SERVER_RECREATE_IN_SESSION_UNSUPPORTED", "Delete and recreate of one server in a session is not supported", "command.hostId")
		}
		expected, impacts, err := applyOne(child, root, snapshot, candidates, originals)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, nil, nil, err
		}
		if expected.Operation == "" {
			continue
		}
		if expected.Operation == "ServerFinal" {
			serverFinal[expected.First] = expected
			if child.Operation == "DeleteServer" {
				deletedServers[child.HostID] = true
			}
		} else {
			expectations = append(expectations, expected)
		}
		changes = append(changes, commandSummary(child))
		for _, impact := range impacts {
			impactSet[impact] = true
		}
	}
	serverIDs := make([]string, 0, len(serverFinal))
	for hostID := range serverFinal {
		serverIDs = append(serverIDs, hostID)
	}
	sort.Strings(serverIDs)
	for _, hostID := range serverIDs {
		expectations = append(expectations, serverFinal[hostID])
	}
	impacts := make([]string, 0, len(impactSet))
	for impact := range impactSet {
		impacts = append(impacts, impact)
	}
	sort.Strings(impacts)
	return expectations, changes, impacts, nil
}

func snapshotValue(snapshot *coreadapter.Snapshot, path ...string) any {
	var current any
	switch path[0] {
	case "effectiveConfiguration":
		current = snapshot.EffectiveConfiguration
	case "endpointGroups":
		current = snapshot.EndpointGroups
	case "hosts":
		current = snapshot.Hosts
	default:
		return nil
	}
	for _, key := range path[1:] {
		mapping, ok := current.(map[string]any)
		if !ok {
			return nil
		}
		current = mapping[key]
	}
	return current
}

func proveSnapshot(snapshot *coreadapter.Snapshot, expectations []expectation) bool {
	for _, expected := range expectations {
		deployment := snapshot.ServiceDeployments[expected.First]
		switch expected.Operation {
		case "ServerFinal":
			value := asMap(expected.Value)
			host := snapshot.Hosts[expected.First]
			if value == nil {
				return false
			}
			if value["exists"] == false {
				if host != nil {
					return false
				}
				continue
			}
			if host == nil || host["ansibleHost"] != value["address"] || host["type"] != value["type"] || host["desiredHostname"] != value["desiredHostname"] {
				return false
			}
			if value["portPresent"] == true && !samePort(host["ansiblePort"], value["port"]) {
				return false
			}
		case "SetServiceConfigurationValue":
			actual := asMap(snapshotValue(snapshot, "effectiveConfiguration", "services", expected.First, "configuration", expected.Second))
			if actual == nil || !semanticEqual(actual["value"], expected.Value) || actual["source"] != "DEPLOYMENT_OVERRIDE" {
				return false
			}
		case "RemoveServiceConfigurationOverride":
			actual := asMap(snapshotValue(snapshot, "effectiveConfiguration", "services", expected.First, "configuration", expected.Second))
			if actual != nil && actual["source"] == "DEPLOYMENT_OVERRIDE" {
				return false
			}
		case "CreateServiceDeployment":
			if !semanticEqual(deployment, expected.Value) {
				return false
			}
		case "DeleteServiceDeployment":
			if deployment != nil {
				return false
			}
		case "SetServiceEndpointGroup":
			if deployment == nil || deployment["endpointGroup"] != expected.Value {
				return false
			}
		case "ClearServiceEndpointGroup":
			if deployment != nil && deployment["endpointGroup"] != nil {
				return false
			}
		case "SetHAProxyIntegration":
			if deployment == nil || !semanticEqual(deployment["haproxy"], expected.Value) {
				return false
			}
		case "ClearHAProxyIntegration":
			if deployment != nil && deployment["haproxy"] != nil {
				return false
			}
		case "CreateEndpointGroup", "UpdateEndpointGroup":
			if !semanticEqual(snapshot.EndpointGroups[expected.First], expected.Value) {
				return false
			}
		case "DeleteEndpointGroup":
			if snapshot.EndpointGroups[expected.First] != nil {
				return false
			}
		case "AssignServiceToHost":
			placements := asMap(snapshot.Hosts[expected.First]["platformDeployments"])
			if !semanticEqual(placements[expected.Second], expected.Value) {
				return false
			}
		case "RemoveServiceFromHost":
			placements := asMap(snapshot.Hosts[expected.First]["platformDeployments"])
			if placements[expected.Second] != nil {
				return false
			}
		case "SetPlacementProperty":
			placements := asMap(snapshot.Hosts[expected.First]["platformDeployments"])
			placement := asMap(placements[expected.Second])
			value := asMap(expected.Value)
			if placement == nil || !semanticEqual(placement[value["property"].(string)], value["value"]) {
				return false
			}
		}
	}
	return true
}

func samePort(left, right any) bool {
	leftNumber, leftOK := left.(float64)
	rightNumber, rightOK := right.(int)
	if leftOK && rightOK {
		return leftNumber == float64(rightNumber)
	}
	return semanticEqual(left, right)
}

func expectedState(expectations []expectation) []map[string]any {
	result := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(expectations))
	for _, item := range expectations {
		result = append(result, map[string]any{"operation": item.Operation, "entityId": item.First,
			"property": item.Second, "value": deepCopy(item.Value)})
	}
	return result
}

func decodeJSONValue(data []byte) (any, error) {
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(strings.NewReader(string(data)))
	decoder.UseNumber()
	var value any
	if err := decoder.Decode(&value); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode value: %w", err)
	}
	return value, nil
}

// ValidateExportDirectoryName admits exactly one portable export destination
// leaf. It intentionally does not reuse the project display-name validator.
func ValidateExportDirectoryName(value string) (string, error) {
	if value == "" || !utf8.ValidString(value) || len(value) > maxExportDirectoryNameBytes || value == "." || value == ".." || filepath.IsAbs(value) || filepath.VolumeName(value) != "" || strings.ContainsAny(value, `/\\:`) {
		return "", errors.New("EXPORT_DESTINATION_INVALID")
	}
	if strings.HasSuffix(value, ".") || strings.HasSuffix(value, " ") || reservedExportDirectoryName(value) {
		return "", errors.New("EXPORT_DESTINATION_INVALID")
	}
	for _, character := range value {
		if unicode.IsControl(character) {
			return "", errors.New("EXPORT_DESTINATION_INVALID")
		}
	}
	return value, nil
}

func reservedExportDirectoryName(value string) bool {
	base := strings.ToUpper(value)
	if index := strings.IndexByte(base, '.'); index >= 0 {
		base = base[:index]
	}
	if base == "CON" || base == "PRN" || base == "AUX" || base == "NUL" {
		return true
	}
	if len(base) == 4 && (strings.HasPrefix(base, "COM") || strings.HasPrefix(base, "LPT")) {
		return base[3] >= '1' && base[3] <= '9'
	}
	return false
}

package installer

import (

// The only export mutation is the copied manifest's display name. Source
// records are borrowed read-only; publication validates the derived bytes.
func namedExportObservation(source exportObservation, name string) (exportObservation, error) {
	output := source
	output.documents = append([]exportRecord(nil), source.documents...)
	for i := range output.documents {
		record := &output.documents[i]
		if record.LogicalPath != "project.yml" {
			continue
		}
		content, err := exportManifestName(record.content, name)
		if err != nil {
			return exportObservation{}, err
		}
		size := int64(len(content))
		if size > maxExportFileBytes || output.total-record.Size > maxExportTotalBytes-size {
			return exportObservation{}, errors.New("EXPORT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED")
		}
		output.total += size - record.Size
		record.content, record.Size, record.Digest = content, size, digestBytes(content)
	}
	output.revision = exportContentRevision(output.documents)
	return output, nil
}

func exportManifestName(content []byte, name string) ([]byte, error) {
	invalid := errors.New("EXPORT_SOURCE_UNSAFE")
	if name == "" || strings.TrimSpace(name) != name {
		return nil, errors.New("EXPORT_DESTINATION_INVALID")
	}
	decoder := yaml.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(content))
	var document, extra yaml.Node
	if err := decoder.Decode(&document); err != nil || len(document.Content) != 1 || document.Content[0].Kind != yaml.MappingNode || !exportRenameYAMLSafe(&document) {
		return nil, invalid
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); err != io.EOF {
		return nil, invalid
	}
	root := document.Content[0]
	metadata, present, _ := yamlMappingValue(root, "metadata")
	if !present {
		metadata = &yaml.Node{Kind: yaml.MappingNode, Tag: "!!map"}
		root.Content = append(root.Content, &yaml.Node{Kind: yaml.ScalarNode, Tag: "!!str", Value: "metadata"}, metadata)
	}
	if metadata.Kind != yaml.MappingNode || metadata.Tag != "!!map" {
		return nil, invalid
	}
	value, present, _ := yamlMappingValue(metadata, "name")
	if present {
		if value.Kind != yaml.ScalarNode || value.Tag != "!!str" {
			return nil, invalid
		}
		value.Value = name
	} else {
		metadata.Content = append(metadata.Content, &yaml.Node{Kind: yaml.ScalarNode, Tag: "!!str", Value: "name"}, &yaml.Node{Kind: yaml.ScalarNode, Tag: "!!str", Value: name})
	}
	result, err := yaml.Marshal(&document)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, invalid
	}
	return result, nil
}

func exportRenameYAMLSafe(node *yaml.Node) bool {
	if node.Anchor != "" || node.Kind == yaml.AliasNode || node.Tag == "!!merge" {
		return false
	}
	if node.Kind == yaml.MappingNode {
		seen := make(map[string]bool)
		for i := 0; i < len(node.Content); i += 2 {
			key := node.Content[i]
			if key.Kind != yaml.ScalarNode || key.Tag != "!!str" || seen[key.Value] {
				return false
			}
			seen[key.Value] = true
		}
	}
	for _, child := range node.Content {
		if !exportRenameYAMLSafe(child) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

// readF1OwnedDocument is intentionally limited to the fixed Installer-owned
// managed documents consumed by the F1 local projection. Its platform reader
// binds every traversal step and the final bytes to opened no-follow handles.
func readF1OwnedDocument(root, logical string) ([]byte, error) {
	if !safeF1OwnedLogicalPath(logical) {
		return nil, errors.New("managed logical path is invalid")
	}
	return readF1OwnedFile(root, strings.Split(logical, "/"), maxManagedDocumentBytes)
}

func safeF1OwnedLogicalPath(logical string) bool {
	if logical == "" || strings.Contains(logical, "\\") || path.Clean(logical) != logical || strings.HasPrefix(logical, "/") {
		return false
	}
	for _, part := range strings.Split(logical, "/") {
		if part == "" || part == "." || part == ".." {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

@@PORTABLE {"path":"internal/installer/f1_owned_read_unix.go","mode":420,"size":1602,"sha256":"80bd1eaf2260420eefef4e44fa086dacb46f05c1899bf2aecd146d257ccf5d20","index":0,"count":1,"encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":1602}

package installer

import (
	"errors"
	"io"
	"os"

	"golang.org/x/sys/unix"
)

func readF1OwnedFile(root string, parts []string, limit int64) ([]byte, error) {
	rootFD, err := unix.Open(root, unix.O_RDONLY|unix.O_DIRECTORY|unix.O_NOFOLLOW|unix.O_CLOEXEC, 0)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer unix.Close(rootFD)
	directory := rootFD
	for _, part := range parts[:len(parts)-1] {
		child, openErr := unix.Openat(directory, part, unix.O_RDONLY|unix.O_DIRECTORY|unix.O_NOFOLLOW|unix.O_CLOEXEC, 0)
		if openErr != nil {
			if directory != rootFD {
				_ = unix.Close(directory)
			}
			if errors.Is(openErr, unix.ENOENT) {
				return nil, os.ErrNotExist
			}
			return nil, openErr
		}
		if directory != rootFD {
			_ = unix.Close(directory)
		}
		directory = child
	}
	if directory != rootFD {
		defer unix.Close(directory)
	}
	fd, err := unix.Openat(directory, parts[len(parts)-1], unix.O_RDONLY|unix.O_NOFOLLOW|unix.O_CLOEXEC, 0)
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, unix.ENOENT) {
			return nil, os.ErrNotExist
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	file := os.NewFile(uintptr(fd), parts[len(parts)-1])
	if file == nil {
		_ = unix.Close(fd)
		return nil, errors.New("managed file open failed")
	}
	defer file.Close()
	var stat unix.Stat_t
	if err := unix.Fstat(fd, &stat); err != nil || stat.Mode&unix.S_IFMT != unix.S_IFREG || stat.Size > limit {
		return nil, errors.New("managed file is unsafe")
	}
	data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, limit+1))
	if err != nil || int64(len(data)) != stat.Size {
		return nil, errors.New("managed file read failed")
	}
	return data, nil
}

package installer

import (
	"errors"
	"io"
	"os"
	"unsafe"

	"golang.org/x/sys/windows"
)

func readF1OwnedFile(root string, parts []string, limit int64) ([]byte, error) {
	pointer, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(root)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	rootHandle, err := windows.CreateFile(pointer, windows.FILE_GENERIC_READ, windows.FILE_SHARE_READ|windows.FILE_SHARE_WRITE|windows.FILE_SHARE_DELETE, nil, windows.OPEN_EXISTING, windows.FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS|windows.FILE_FLAG_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT, 0)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer windows.CloseHandle(rootHandle)
	if err := verifyF1WindowsHandle(rootHandle, true); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	directory := rootHandle
	for _, part := range parts[:len(parts)-1] {
		child, openErr := openF1WindowsRelative(directory, part, true)
		if openErr != nil {
			if openErr == windows.ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND || openErr == windows.ERROR_PATH_NOT_FOUND || errors.Is(openErr, windows.ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND) || errors.Is(openErr, windows.ERROR_PATH_NOT_FOUND) {
				return nil, os.ErrNotExist
			}
			return nil, openErr
		}
		if directory != rootHandle {
			_ = windows.CloseHandle(directory)
		}
		directory = child
	}
	if directory != rootHandle {
		defer windows.CloseHandle(directory)
	}
	handle, err := openF1WindowsRelative(directory, parts[len(parts)-1], false)
	if err != nil {
		if err == windows.ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND || err == windows.ERROR_PATH_NOT_FOUND || errors.Is(err, windows.ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND) || errors.Is(err, windows.ERROR_PATH_NOT_FOUND) {
			return nil, os.ErrNotExist
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	file := os.NewFile(uintptr(handle), parts[len(parts)-1])
	if file == nil {
		_ = windows.CloseHandle(handle)
		return nil, errors.New("managed file open failed")
	}
	defer file.Close()
	info, err := file.Stat()
	if err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Size() > limit {
		return nil, errors.New("managed file is unsafe")
	}
	data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, limit+1))
	if err != nil || int64(len(data)) != info.Size() {
		return nil, errors.New("managed file read failed")
	}
	return data, nil
}

func openF1WindowsRelative(root windows.Handle, name string, directory bool) (windows.Handle, error) {
	nameValue, err := windows.NewNTUnicodeString(name)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	options := uint32(windows.FILE_SYNCHRONOUS_IO_NONALERT | windows.FILE_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT)
	if directory {
		options |= windows.FILE_DIRECTORY_FILE
	} else {
		options |= windows.FILE_NON_DIRECTORY_FILE
	}
	object := windows.OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES{Length: uint32(unsafe.Sizeof(windows.OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES{})), RootDirectory: root, ObjectName: nameValue, Attributes: windows.OBJ_CASE_INSENSITIVE | windows.OBJ_DONT_REPARSE}
	var handle windows.Handle
	var status windows.IO_STATUS_BLOCK
	if err := windows.NtCreateFile(&handle, windows.FILE_GENERIC_READ, &object, &status, nil, 0, windows.FILE_SHARE_READ|windows.FILE_SHARE_WRITE|windows.FILE_SHARE_DELETE, windows.FILE_OPEN, options, 0, 0); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	if err := verifyF1WindowsHandle(handle, directory); err != nil {
		_ = windows.CloseHandle(handle)
		return 0, err
	}
	return handle, nil
}

func verifyF1WindowsHandle(handle windows.Handle, directory bool) error {
	var info windows.ByHandleFileInformation
	if err := windows.GetFileInformationByHandle(handle, &info); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if info.FileAttributes&windows.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT != 0 || (info.FileAttributes&windows.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY != 0) != directory {
		return errors.New("managed file is unsafe")
	}
	return nil
}

var managedConfigHeader = []byte("# Managed by Platform Installer.\n# This is standard Ansible configuration; formatting may be normalized.\n")
var firstSaveAnsibleConfig = append(append([]byte(nil), managedConfigHeader...), []byte("[defaults]\ninventory = ./inventory/hosts.yml\nretry_files_enabled = False\nhost_key_checking = True\ninterpreter_python = auto_silent\nhash_behaviour = merge\n")...)

type firstSaveServer struct {
	id              string
	typeID          string
	desiredHostname string
	address         string
	port            int
	portSet         bool
}

func firstSaveInventory(servers []firstSaveServer) []byte {
	hosts := make(map[string]any, len(servers))
	targets := make(map[string]any, len(servers))
	for _, server := range servers {
		value := map[string]any{"ansible_host": server.address}
		platformHost := map[string]any{}
		if server.typeID != "" {
			platformHost["type"] = server.typeID
		}
		if server.desiredHostname != "" {
			platformHost["desiredHostname"] = server.desiredHostname
		}
		if len(platformHost) > 0 {
			value["platform_host"] = platformHost
		}
		if server.portSet {
			value["ansible_port"] = server.port
		}
		hosts[server.id] = value
		targets[server.id] = map[string]any{}
	}
	value, err := deterministicYAML(map[string]any{"all": map[string]any{
		"hosts": hosts, "children": map[string]any{"platform_targets": map[string]any{"hosts": targets}},
	}})
	if err != nil {
		panic("first-save inventory is not serializable")
	}
	return value
}

func (b *Backend) planFirstWrite(ctx context.Context, root, revision string, commands []EditCommand) (*EditPlan, error) {
	skeleton := EditCommand{APIVersion: EditCommandAPIVersionV4, Kind: "EditCommand", BaseProjectRevision: revision, Operation: "Batch", Commands: commands}
	if !projectlifecycle.FirstSaveEligible(root) {
		return blockedPlan(skeleton, revision, blocked("WRITE_OWNERSHIP_REQUIRED", "First save requires a valid empty managed project", "project")), nil
	}
	_, currentRevision, err := collectProjectDocuments(root)
	if err != nil {
		return blockedPlan(skeleton, revision, err), nil
	}
	if currentRevision != revision {
		return blockedPlan(skeleton, currentRevision, blocked("PROJECT_CHANGED", "Project changed before planning", "baseProjectRevision")), nil
	}
	seen := make(map[string]bool)
	servers := make([]firstSaveServer, 0, len(commands))
	changes := make([]SemanticChange, 0, len(commands))
	for _, command := range commands {
		if command.Operation != "CreateServer" {
			return blockedPlan(skeleton, revision, blocked("FIRST_SAVE_COMMAND_UNSUPPORTED", "First save currently accepts only server creation intents", "command.operation")), nil
		}
		if err := b.validateCommand(command); err != nil {
			return blockedPlan(skeleton, revision, err), nil
		}
		if seen[command.HostID] {
			return blockedPlan(skeleton, revision, blocked("INVALID_EDIT_COMMAND", "Server identifier is duplicated", "command.hostId")), nil
		}
		seen[command.HostID] = true
		servers = append(servers, firstSaveServer{id: command.HostID, typeID: command.ServerType, desiredHostname: command.DesiredHostname, address: command.Address, port: command.SSHPort, portSet: command.SSHPort != 0 || command.presentFields["sshPort"]})
		changes = append(changes, SemanticChange{Operation: "CreateServer", EntityID: command.HostID, SafeSummary: "CreateServer " + command.HostID})
	}
	if len(servers) == 0 {
		return blockedPlan(skeleton, revision, blocked("EDIT_SESSION_EMPTY", "First save requires at least one server", "session")), nil
	}
	desired, err := deterministicYAML(map[string]any{"platform_desired_state": map[string]any{"serviceDeployments": map[string]any{}}})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	documents := []storedDocument{
		{LogicalPath: "ansible.cfg", After: append([]byte(nil), firstSaveAnsibleConfig...), Existed: false},
		{LogicalPath: "inventory/hosts.yml", After: firstSaveInventory(servers), Existed: false},
		{LogicalPath: desiredDocument, After: desired, Existed: false},
	}
	stagedRoot, cleanup, err := copyProject(root)
	if err != nil {
		return blockedPlan(skeleton, revision, err), nil
	}
	defer cleanup()
	for _, document := range documents {
		path, pathErr := safeProjectPath(stagedRoot, document.LogicalPath, true)
		if pathErr != nil {
			return blockedPlan(skeleton, revision, pathErr), nil
		}
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
			return blockedPlan(skeleton, revision, blocked("STAGING_FAILED", "Candidate parent could not be created", "document")), nil
		}
		if err := os.WriteFile(path, document.After, 0o644); err != nil {
			return blockedPlan(skeleton, revision, blocked("STAGING_FAILED", "Candidate document could not be created", "document")), nil
		}
	}
	owned, err := discoverOwnedPaths(stagedRoot)
	if err != nil {
		return blockedPlan(skeleton, revision, err), nil
	}
	staged, err := b.core.BuildSnapshot(ctx, stagedRoot, owned)
	if err != nil {
		return blockedPlan(skeleton, revision, blocked("CORE_SNAPSHOT_FAILED", "Candidate snapshot could not be built", "project")), nil
	}
	if staged.Status != "PASS" {
		return blockedCorePlan(skeleton, revision, staged), nil
	}
	for _, server := range servers {
		host := staged.Hosts[server.id]
		if host == nil || (server.typeID != "" && host["type"] != server.typeID) || (server.desiredHostname != "" && host["desiredHostname"] != server.desiredHostname) || (server.portSet && !samePort(host["ansiblePort"], server.port)) {
			return blockedPlan(skeleton, revision, blocked("EDIT_SHADOWED", "Core snapshot did not contain the created server", "command.hostId")), nil
		}
	}
	documentChanges := make([]DocumentChange, 0, len(documents))
	var diffs []string
	for _, document := range documents {
		digest := digestBytes(document.After)
		documentChanges = append(documentChanges, DocumentChange{LogicalPath: document.LogicalPath,
			Before: &DocumentState{State: "ABSENT"}, After: &DocumentState{State: "PRESENT", Digest: digest}})
		diffs = append(diffs, boundedDiff(document.LogicalPath, nil, document.After))
	}
	plan := EditPlan{APIVersion: EditPlanAPIVersionV2, Kind: "EditPlan", Status: "READY", BaseProjectRevision: revision,
		CommandSummary:  SemanticChange{Operation: "FirstSave", SafeSummary: "Create first managed Ansible project inputs"},
		SemanticChanges: changes, AffectedEntities: affectedEntities(changes), AffectedDocuments: documentChanges,
		Impacts: []string{"TOPOLOGY_CHANGED"}, Validation: Validation{Status: "PASS", Findings: []Finding{}},
		ExpectedSnapshotFingerprint: staged.SnapshotFingerprint, ReviewDiff: strings.Join(diffs, ""), CommitAllowed: true, ApplyRequired: true,
		ExpiresAt: b.now().Add(b.planTTL)}
	identifier, err := b.plans.Put(storedPlan{Created: b.now(), ProjectRoot: root, Public: plan, Documents: documents})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	plan.PlanID = identifier
	return &plan, nil
}

func isEmptyManagedClassification(value string) bool {
	return value == projectlifecycle.ClassificationEmpty

func absentDocument(document DocumentChange) bool {
	return document.Before != nil && document.Before.State == "ABSENT" && document.Before.Digest == "" && document.BeforeDigest == ""
}

func presentBeforeDigest(document DocumentChange) string {
	if document.Before != nil && document.Before.State == "PRESENT" {
		return document.Before.Digest
	}
	return document.BeforeDigest
}

const (
	maxManagedDocumentBytes  int64 = 4 * 1024 * 1024
	maxManagedAggregateBytes int64 = 64 * 1024 * 1024
	maxManagedHostDocuments        = 4096
	maxManagedEntities             = 4096
	maxManagedPlacements           = 16384
	maxManagedRoles                = 128
)

// ReadManagedProjectView reads only directly Installer-owned canonical fields.
// It does not implement Ansible precedence, service validation or derived
// provider/VIP semantics.
func ReadManagedProjectView(projectRoot string) (*ManagedProjectView, error) {
	return ReadManagedProjectViewWithCatalog(projectRoot, nil)
}

// ReadManagedProjectViewWithCatalog joins direct owned values only with the
// exact READY catalog selected by the caller. Without it the projection keeps
// stable setting identities and presence, but never exposes raw values.
func ReadManagedProjectViewWithCatalog(projectRoot string, catalog *projectlifecycle.ProjectCatalogView) (*ManagedProjectView, error) {
	root, err := cleanRoot(projectRoot)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	read := managedReadBudget{}
	document, _, err := read.ownedDocument(root, managedInventoryDocument)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	all := asMap(document["all"])
	hosts := asMap(all["hosts"])
	targets := asMap(asMap(asMap(all["children"])["platform_targets"])["hosts"])
	if all == nil || hosts == nil || targets == nil {
		return nil, blocked("MANAGED_DOCUMENT_INVALID", "Managed inventory roots are missing or malformed", managedInventoryDocument)
	}
	view := &ManagedProjectView{Servers: make(map[string]ManagedServer), Deployments: make(map[string]ManagedDeployment), EndpointGroups: make(map[string]ManagedEndpointGroup), MemberPlacements: []ManagedMemberPlacement{}, HostPlacements: []ManagedHostPlacement{}, PKI: ManagedPKI{Authorities: map[string]map[string]any{}, Profiles: map[string]map[string]any{}, TLSProfiles: map[string]map[string]any{}, Scopes: map[string]map[string]any{}}}
	for hostID := range targets {
		if len(view.Servers) >= maxManagedEntities || !identifierPattern.MatchString(hostID) {
			return nil, managedReadError("Managed server collection is invalid or exceeds its limit", managedInventoryDocument)
		}
		host := asMap(hosts[hostID])
		if host == nil {
			return nil, blocked("MANAGED_DOCUMENT_INVALID", "Managed target is missing its canonical host record", managedInventoryDocument)
		}
		platformHost := asMap(host["platform_host"])
		server := ManagedServer{HostID: hostID}
		server.Address, _ = host["ansible_host"].(string)
		server.Type, _ = platformHost["type"].(string)
		server.DesiredHostname, _ = platformHost["desiredHostname"].(string)
		if raw, found := host["ansible_port"]; found {
			port, ok := yamlInteger(raw)
			if !ok || port < 1 || port > 65535 {
				return nil, blocked("MANAGED_DOCUMENT_INVALID", "Managed server SSH port is invalid", managedInventoryDocument)
			}
			server.SSHPort = &port
		}
		view.Servers[hostID] = server
	}
	if err := readManagedDesiredState(root, &read, view, catalog); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := readManagedHostPlacements(root, &read, view, catalog); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	sortManagedView(view)
	view.ProjectRevision, err = ProjectRevision(root)
	return view, err
}

type managedReadBudget struct{ total int64 }

func (budget *managedReadBudget) ownedDocument(root, logical string) (map[string]any, []byte, error) {
	content, err := readF1OwnedDocument(root, logical)
	if err != nil || int64(len(content)) > maxManagedDocumentBytes || budget.total+int64(len(content)) > maxManagedAggregateBytes {
		return nil, nil, managedReadError("Managed document is unsafe, malformed, or exceeds the read limit", logical)
	}
	budget.total += int64(len(content))
	document, err := parseManagedYAML(content)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	return document, content, nil
}

func (budget *managedReadBudget) ownedDocumentOptional(root, logical string) (map[string]any, bool, error) {
	document, _, exists, err := budget.ownedDocumentOptionalBytes(root, logical)
	return document, exists, err
}

func (budget *managedReadBudget) ownedDocumentOptionalBytes(root, logical string) (map[string]any, []byte, bool, error) {
	content, err := readF1OwnedDocument(root, logical)
	if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) || os.IsNotExist(err) {
		return nil, nil, false, nil
	}
	// This is only an absence classification after the authoritative
	// handle-bound read failed. It never authorizes a later pathname read.
	if err != nil {
		if _, statErr := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(logical))); errors.Is(statErr, os.ErrNotExist) {
			return nil, nil, false, nil
		}
	}
	if err != nil || int64(len(content)) > maxManagedDocumentBytes || budget.total+int64(len(content)) > maxManagedAggregateBytes {
		return nil, nil, false, managedReadError("Managed document is unsafe, malformed, or exceeds the read limit", logical)
	}
	budget.total += int64(len(content))
	document, err := parseManagedYAML(content)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, false, err
	}
	return document, content, true, nil
}

func managedReadError(message, field string) error {
	return blocked("MANAGED_DOCUMENT_INVALID", message, field)
}

func readManagedDesiredState(root string, budget *managedReadBudget, view *ManagedProjectView, catalog *projectlifecycle.ProjectCatalogView) error {
	document, _, err := budget.ownedDocument(root, desiredDocument)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	state := asMap(document["platform_desired_state"])
	view.ApplicationLibraries = map[string]map[string]any{}
	view.ApplicationPlacements = map[string]map[string]any{}
	for id, raw := range asMap(state["applicationLibraryDeployments"]) {
		value := asMap(raw)
		if !validLibraryInputID(id) || value == nil || safeApplicationInput(value, 0) != nil {
			return managedReadError("Managed application library input is unsafe", desiredDocument)
		}
		view.ApplicationLibraries[id] = asMap(deepCopy(value))
	}
	view.DataRootDirectory = "/var/lib"
	if raw, found := document["platform_data_root_directory"]; found {
		value, ok := raw.(string)
		if !ok || !validProjectSetting("platform_data_root_directory", value) {
			return managedReadError("Managed service data root is invalid", desiredDocument)
		}
		view.DataRootDirectory = value
	}
	if raw, found := document["platform_name_prefix"]; found {
		value, ok := raw.(string)
		if !ok || !validProjectSetting("platform_name_prefix", value) {
			return managedReadError("Managed resource name prefix is invalid", desiredDocument)
		}
		view.NamePrefix = value
	}
	deployments := asMap(state["serviceDeployments"])
	groups := asMap(state["endpointGroups"])
	if state == nil || deployments == nil {
		return managedReadError("Managed desired-state roots are missing or malformed", desiredDocument)
	}
	if groups == nil {
		groups = map[string]any{}
	}
	for id, raw := range deployments {
		if len(view.Deployments) >= maxManagedEntities || !identifierPattern.MatchString(id) {
			return managedReadError("Managed deployment collection is invalid or exceeds its limit", desiredDocument)
		}
		deployment := asMap(raw)
		serviceType, serviceOK := deployment["serviceType"].(string)
		mode, modeOK := deployment["mode"].(string)
		endpointGroup, endpointOK := optionalString(deployment, "endpointGroup")
		if deployment == nil || !serviceOK || !validDesiredStateIdentifier(serviceType) || !modeOK || !validDesiredStateIdentifier(mode) || !endpointOK || (endpointGroup != "" && !identifierPattern.MatchString(endpointGroup)) {
			return managedReadError("Managed deployment is malformed", desiredDocument)
		}
		provider, providerErr := managedProviderProjection(deployment)
		if providerErr != nil {
			return providerErr
		}
		configuration, configurationErr := managedConfigurationProjection(deployment, serviceType, catalog, desiredDocument)
		if configurationErr != nil {
			return configurationErr
		}
		view.Deployments[id] = ManagedDeployment{DeploymentID: id, ServiceType: serviceType, Mode: mode, EndpointGroup: endpointGroup,
			EndpointGroupRef: provider.endpointGroupRef, VirtualRouterID: provider.virtualRouterID,
			VirtualAddresses: provider.virtualAddresses, ProviderEditState: provider.editState, Configuration: configuration}
	}
	for id, raw := range groups {
		if len(view.EndpointGroups) >= maxManagedEntities || !identifierPattern.MatchString(id) {
			return managedReadError("Managed endpoint-group collection is invalid or exceeds its limit", desiredDocument)
		}
		group := asMap(raw)
		address := asMap(group["address"])
		domain, domainOK := address["domain"].(string)
		wildcard, wildcardOK := address["wildcard"].(bool)
		if group == nil || address == nil || !domainOK || domain == "" || !wildcardOK {
			return managedReadError("Managed endpoint group is malformed", desiredDocument)
		}
		view.EndpointGroups[id] = ManagedEndpointGroup{EndpointGroupID: id, Domain: domain, Wildcard: wildcard}
	}
	for _, entry := range []struct {
		key       string
		target    map[string]map[string]any
		operation string
	}{{"certificateAuthorities", view.PKI.Authorities, "CreateCertificateAuthority"}, {"certificateProfiles", view.PKI.Profiles, "CreateCertificateProfile"}, {"tlsProfiles", view.PKI.TLSProfiles, "CreateTLSProfile"}, {"certificateScopes", view.PKI.Scopes, "CreateCertificateScope"}} {
		rawValues := state[entry.key]
		if rawValues == nil {
			continue
		}
		values := asMap(rawValues)
		if values == nil || len(values) > maxManagedEntities {
			return managedReadError("Managed PKI collection is malformed or exceeds its limit", desiredDocument)
		}
		for id, raw := range values {
			entity := asMap(raw)
			if !validDesiredStateIdentifier(id) || validPKIEntity(entry.operation, entity) != nil {
				return managedReadError("Managed PKI entity is malformed", desiredDocument)
			}
			entry.target[id] = deepCopy(entity).(map[string]any)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

type managedProviderView struct {
	endpointGroupRef string
	virtualRouterID  *int
	virtualAddresses []VirtualAddress
	editState        string
}

func managedProviderProjection(deployment map[string]any) (managedProviderView, error) {
	result := managedProviderView{virtualAddresses: []VirtualAddress{}, editState: "NONE"}
	refRaw, hasRef := deployment["endpointGroupRef"]
	routerRaw, hasRouter := deployment["virtualRouterId"]
	addressesRaw, hasAddresses := deployment["virtualAddresses"]
	if !hasRef && !hasRouter && !hasAddresses {
		return result, nil
	}
	if hasRef {
		ref, ok := refRaw.(string)
		if !ok {
			return result, managedReadError("Managed provider endpoint-group reference is malformed", desiredDocument)
		}
		result.endpointGroupRef = ref
	}
	if hasRouter {
		routerID, ok := yamlInteger(routerRaw)
		if !ok {
			return result, managedReadError("Managed provider virtual router ID is malformed", desiredDocument)
		}
		result.virtualRouterID = &routerID
	}
	if hasAddresses {
		values := asSlice(addressesRaw)
		if values == nil || len(values) > maxManagedEntities {
			return result, managedReadError("Managed provider address collection is malformed or exceeds its limit", desiredDocument)
		}
		result.virtualAddresses = make([]VirtualAddress, 0, len(values))
		for _, raw := range values {
			value := asMap(raw)
			address, addressOK := value["address"].(string)
			iface, interfaceOK := value["interface"].(string)
			if value == nil || len(value) != 2 || !addressOK || !interfaceOK {
				return result, managedReadError("Managed provider virtual address is malformed", desiredDocument)
			}
			result.virtualAddresses = append(result.virtualAddresses, VirtualAddress{Address: address, Interface: iface})
		}
	}

	unsupported := len(result.virtualAddresses) > 64
	complete := hasRef && hasRouter && hasAddresses && result.endpointGroupRef != "" && result.virtualRouterID != nil && *result.virtualRouterID >= 1 && *result.virtualRouterID <= 255 && len(result.virtualAddresses) != 0
	if result.endpointGroupRef != "" && !identifierPattern.MatchString(result.endpointGroupRef) {
		unsupported = true
	}
	for _, value := range result.virtualAddresses {
		address, addressErr := netip.ParseAddr(value.Address)
		if addressErr != nil || !address.Is4() || value.Interface == "" || !virtualAddressInterfacePattern.MatchString(value.Interface) {
			complete = false
		}
		if len(value.Interface) > 128 {
			unsupported = true
		}
	}
	if unsupported {
		result.editState = "UNSUPPORTED"
		return result, nil
	}
	if complete {
		result.editState = "EDITABLE"
		return result, nil
	}
	result.editState = "INCOMPLETE"
	return result, nil
}

func readManagedHostPlacements(root string, budget *managedReadBudget, view *ManagedProjectView, catalog *projectlifecycle.ProjectCatalogView) error {
	hostIDs := make([]string, 0, len(view.Servers))
	for hostID := range view.Servers {
		hostIDs = append(hostIDs, hostID)
	}
	sort.Strings(hostIDs)
	if len(hostIDs) > maxManagedHostDocuments {
		return managedReadError("Managed host document collection exceeds its limit", "inventory/host_vars")
	}
	for _, hostID := range hostIDs {
		logical := managedHostDocument(hostID)
		document, exists, documentErr := budget.ownedDocumentOptional(root, logical)
		if documentErr != nil {
			// A server without an owned host-vars document has no direct placement.
			// Do not inspect an unbound pathname merely to distinguish absence.
			return documentErr
		}
		if !exists {
			continue
		}
		if placements := asMap(document["platform_application_libraries"]); placements != nil {
			if safeApplicationInput(placements, 0) != nil {
				return managedReadError("Managed application placement is unsafe", logical)
			}
			view.ApplicationPlacements[hostID] = asMap(deepCopy(placements))
		}
		placements := asMap(document["platform_deployments"])
		if placements == nil {
			return managedReadError("Managed placement root is missing or malformed", logical)
		}
		for deploymentID, raw := range placements {
			if !identifierPattern.MatchString(deploymentID) {
				return managedReadError("Managed placement deployment identifier is invalid", logical)
			}
			placement := asMap(raw)
			if placement == nil {
				return managedReadError("Managed placement is malformed", logical)
			}
			members, hasMembers := placement["members"]
			_, hasRoles := placement["roles"]
			if hasMembers && hasRoles {
				return managedReadError("Managed placement ambiguously mixes member and host forms", logical)
			}
			if hasMembers {
				memberMap := asMap(members)
				if memberMap == nil {
					return managedReadError("Managed member placement is malformed", logical)
				}
				for memberID, memberRaw := range memberMap {
					member := asMap(memberRaw)
					roles, rolesErr := managedRoles(member["roles"], logical)
					if rolesErr != nil || !identifierPattern.MatchString(memberID) || len(view.MemberPlacements)+len(view.HostPlacements) >= maxManagedPlacements {
						return managedReadError("Managed member placement is invalid or exceeds its limit", logical)
					}
					deployment := view.Deployments[deploymentID]
					configuration, configurationErr := managedConfigurationProjection(member, deployment.ServiceType, catalog, logical)
					if configurationErr != nil {
						return configurationErr
					}
					view.MemberPlacements = append(view.MemberPlacements, ManagedMemberPlacement{DeploymentID: deploymentID, MemberID: memberID, HostID: hostID, Roles: roles, Configuration: configuration})
				}
				continue
			}
			roles, rolesErr := managedRoles(placement["roles"], logical)
			if rolesErr != nil || len(view.MemberPlacements)+len(view.HostPlacements) >= maxManagedPlacements {
				return managedReadError("Managed host placement is invalid or exceeds its limit", logical)
			}
			var priority *int
			if rawPriority, present := placement["priority"]; present {
				value, valid := yamlInteger(rawPriority)
				if !valid || value < 1 || value > 254 {
					return managedReadError("Managed host placement priority is invalid", logical)
				}
				priority = &value
			}
			view.HostPlacements = append(view.HostPlacements, ManagedHostPlacement{DeploymentID: deploymentID, HostID: hostID, Roles: roles, Priority: priority})
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func managedConfigurationProjection(owner map[string]any, serviceType string, catalog *projectlifecycle.ProjectCatalogView, field string) ([]ManagedConfigurationOverride, error) {
	raw, present := owner["configuration"]
	if !present {
		return []ManagedConfigurationOverride{}, nil
	}
	configuration := asMap(raw)
	if configuration == nil || len(configuration) > maxManagedEntities {
		return nil, managedReadError("Managed configuration is malformed or exceeds its limit", field)
	}
	result := make([]ManagedConfigurationOverride, 0, len(configuration))
	for settingID, value := range configuration {
		if len(settingID) > 128 || !configurationSettingPattern.MatchString(settingID) {
			return nil, managedReadError("Managed configuration setting identifier is invalid", field)
		}
		entry := ManagedConfigurationOverride{Setting: settingID, OverridePresent: true, State: "UNKNOWN"}
		if catalog != nil && catalog.Status == "READY" {
			descriptor, found := catalogConfigurationSetting(catalog, serviceType, settingID)
			if !found || descriptor.Kind != "MANAGED" || descriptor.EditorShape == "UNSUPPORTED" {
				entry.State = "UNSUPPORTED"
			} else {
				if err := validateConfigurationValue(descriptor, value); err != nil {
					return nil, managedReadError("Managed configuration value does not match its catalog descriptor", field)
				}
				entry.State, entry.Value = "EDITABLE", deepCopy(value)
			}
		}
		result = append(result, entry)
	}
	sort.Slice(result, func(left, right int) bool { return result[left].Setting < result[right].Setting })
	return result, nil
}

func optionalString(value map[string]any, key string) (string, bool) {
	raw, found := value[key]
	if !found {
		return "", true
	}
	text, ok := raw.(string)
	return text, ok
}

func managedRoles(raw any, field string) ([]string, error) {
	if raw == nil {
		return []string{}, nil
	}
	values := asSlice(raw)
	if values == nil || len(values) > maxManagedRoles {
		return nil, managedReadError("Managed placement roles are malformed or exceed their limit", field)
	}
	seen := make(map[string]bool, len(values))
	roles := make([]string, 0, len(values))
	for _, rawRole := range values {
		role, ok := rawRole.(string)
		if !ok || !identifierPattern.MatchString(role) || seen[role] {
			return nil, managedReadError("Managed placement roles are invalid", field)
		}
		seen[role] = true
		roles = append(roles, role)
	}
	sort.Strings(roles)
	return roles, nil
}

func sortManagedView(view *ManagedProjectView) {
	sort.Slice(view.MemberPlacements, func(left, right int) bool {
		leftValue, rightValue := view.MemberPlacements[left], view.MemberPlacements[right]
		return leftValue.DeploymentID+"\x00"+leftValue.MemberID+"\x00"+leftValue.HostID < rightValue.DeploymentID+"\x00"+rightValue.MemberID+"\x00"+rightValue.HostID
	})
	sort.Slice(view.HostPlacements, func(left, right int) bool {
		leftValue, rightValue := view.HostPlacements[left], view.HostPlacements[right]
		return leftValue.DeploymentID+"\x00"+leftValue.HostID < rightValue.DeploymentID+"\x00"+rightValue.HostID
	})
}

func yamlInteger(value any) (int, bool) {
	switch typed := value.(type) {
	case int:
		return typed, true
	case int64:
		return int(typed), int64(int(typed)) == typed
	case uint64:
		return int(typed), uint64(int(typed)) == typed
	default:
		return 0, false
	}
}

func blockedStructuralPlan(revision string, err error) *StructuralEditPlan {
	plan := &StructuralEditPlan{APIVersion: StructuralPlanAPIVersion, Kind: "StructuralEditPlan", Status: "BLOCKED",
		BaseProjectRevision: revision, SemanticChanges: []SemanticChange{}, AffectedEntities: []string{},
		AffectedDocuments: []DocumentChange{}, SaveAllowed: false}
	if typed, ok := err.(*writerError); ok {
		finding := typed.finding()
		plan.Finding = &finding
	}
	return plan
}

// PlanStructuralSave builds a bounded local preview for server and topology intents and
// stores its candidate bytes in the existing opaque plan store.
func (b *Backend) PlanStructuralSave(ctx context.Context, projectRoot, classification, revision string, commands []EditCommand) (*StructuralEditPlan, error) {
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if len(commands) == 0 {
		return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, blocked("EDIT_SESSION_EMPTY", "Edit session contains no commands", "session")), nil
	}
	if len(commands) > 16 {
		return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, blocked("EDIT_SESSION_COMMANDS_UNSUPPORTED", "This edit set must be split", "session")), nil
	}
	for _, command := range commands {
		if command.Operation != "CreateServer" && command.Operation != "UpdateServer" && command.Operation != "DeleteServer" && !topologyOperation(command.Operation) {
			return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, blocked("EDIT_OPERATION_NOT_AVAILABLE", "Edit operation is not available in this editor", "command.operation")), nil
		}
		if err := b.validateCommand(command); err != nil {
			return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, err), nil
		}
	}
	root, err := cleanRoot(projectRoot)
	if err != nil {
		return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, err), nil
	}
	return b.planStructuralCandidate(ctx, root, classification, revision, commands)
}

func (b *Backend) storeStructuralPlan(root, revision string, changes []SemanticChange, documents []storedDocument) (*StructuralEditPlan, error) {
	if len(documents) == 0 {
		return &StructuralEditPlan{APIVersion: StructuralPlanAPIVersion, Kind: "StructuralEditPlan", Status: "NO_CHANGE", BaseProjectRevision: revision,
			SemanticChanges: []SemanticChange{}, AffectedEntities: []string{}, AffectedDocuments: []DocumentChange{}, SaveAllowed: false}, nil
	}
	documentChanges := make([]DocumentChange, 0, len(documents))
	diffs := make([]string, 0, len(documents))
	for _, document := range documents {
		before := &DocumentState{State: "ABSENT"}
		if document.Existed {
			before = &DocumentState{State: "PRESENT", Digest: digestBytes(document.Before)}
		}
		documentChanges = append(documentChanges, DocumentChange{LogicalPath: document.LogicalPath, Before: before,
			After: &DocumentState{State: "PRESENT", Digest: digestBytes(document.After)}})
		diffs = append(diffs, boundedDiff(document.LogicalPath, document.Before, document.After))
	}
	plan := StructuralEditPlan{APIVersion: StructuralPlanAPIVersion, Kind: "StructuralEditPlan", Status: "READY", BaseProjectRevision: revision,
		SemanticChanges: changes, AffectedEntities: affectedEntities(changes), AffectedDocuments: documentChanges,
		ReviewDiff: strings.Join(diffs, ""), SaveAllowed: true, ExpiresAt: b.now().Add(b.planTTL)}
	internal := EditPlan{APIVersion: EditPlanAPIVersionV2, Kind: "EditPlan", Status: "READY", BaseProjectRevision: revision,
		AffectedDocuments: documentChanges, CommitAllowed: true, ApplyRequired: true}
	id, err := b.plans.Put(storedPlan{Created: b.now(), ProjectRoot: root, Public: internal, LocalOnly: true, Documents: documents})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	plan.PlanID = id
	return &plan, nil
}

func (b *Backend) CommitStructuralSave(ctx context.Context, planID string) StructuralSaveResult {
	result := b.CommitEditPlanV2(ctx, planID)
	return StructuralSaveResult{APIVersion: StructuralResultAPIVersion, Kind: "StructuralSaveResult", Status: result.Status,
		Changed: result.Changed, Finding: result.Finding, OldProjectRevision: result.OldProjectRevision,
		NewProjectRevision: result.NewProjectRevision, AffectedDocuments: result.AffectedDocuments, Timing: result.Timing, Managed: result.Managed}
}

package installer

import (
	"errors"
	"os"

	"golang.org/x/sys/unix"
)

func enumerateManagedHostDirectories(root string, limit int) ([]string, error) {
	rootFD, err := unix.Open(root, unix.O_RDONLY|unix.O_DIRECTORY|unix.O_NOFOLLOW|unix.O_CLOEXEC, 0)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer unix.Close(rootFD)
	inventoryFD, err := unix.Openat(rootFD, "inventory", unix.O_RDONLY|unix.O_DIRECTORY|unix.O_NOFOLLOW|unix.O_CLOEXEC, 0)
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, unix.ENOENT) {
			return []string{}, nil
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	defer unix.Close(inventoryFD)
	hostVarsFD, err := unix.Openat(inventoryFD, "host_vars", unix.O_RDONLY|unix.O_DIRECTORY|unix.O_NOFOLLOW|unix.O_CLOEXEC, 0)
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, unix.ENOENT) {
			return []string{}, nil
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	file := os.NewFile(uintptr(hostVarsFD), "host_vars")
	if file == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("managed host directory open failed")
	}
	// file owns hostVarsFD from this point.
	hostVarsFD = -1
	defer file.Close()
	entries, err := file.ReadDir(limit + 1)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if len(entries) > limit {
		return nil, errors.New("managed host directory limit exceeded")
	}
	names := make([]string, 0, len(entries))
	for _, entry := range entries {
		child, openErr := unix.Openat(int(file.Fd()), entry.Name(), unix.O_RDONLY|unix.O_DIRECTORY|unix.O_NOFOLLOW|unix.O_CLOEXEC, 0)
		if openErr != nil {
			return nil, openErr
		}
		_ = unix.Close(child)
		names = append(names, entry.Name())
	}
	return names, nil
}

func enumerateManagedHostDirectories(root string, limit int) ([]string, error) {

		return nil, err

		if errors.Is(err, windows.ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND) || errors.Is(err, windows.ERROR_PATH_NOT_FOUND) || managedDirectoryAbsent(root, "inventory") {
			return []string{}, nil
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	defer windows.CloseHandle(inventory)
	hostVars, err := openF1WindowsRelative(inventory, "host_vars", true)
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, windows.ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND) || errors.Is(err, windows.ERROR_PATH_NOT_FOUND) || managedDirectoryAbsent(root, "inventory", "host_vars") {
			return []string{}, nil

		return nil, err
	}

	if file == nil {
		_ = windows.CloseHandle(hostVars)
		return nil, errors.New("managed host directory open failed")
	}
	// file owns hostVars from this point.
	hostVars = 0
	defer file.Close()
	entries, err := file.ReadDir(limit + 1)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if len(entries) > limit {
		return nil, errors.New("managed host directory limit exceeded")
	}
	names := make([]string, 0, len(entries))
	for _, entry := range entries {
		child, openErr := openF1WindowsRelative(windows.Handle(file.Fd()), entry.Name(), true)
		if openErr != nil {
			return nil, openErr
		}
		_ = windows.CloseHandle(child)
		names = append(names, entry.Name())
	}
	return names, nil
}

// A pathname check is used only to classify an already-failed handle-relative
// open as absence. It never authorizes a subsequent read from that pathname.
func managedDirectoryAbsent(root string, parts ...string) bool {
	_, err := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(append([]string{root}, parts...)...))
	return errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist)
}

func pathEntryUnsafe(info os.FileInfo) bool {
	if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
		return true
	}
