// Catalog identifiers follow the published service-manifest/v1alpha1
// identifier grammar. This deliberately differs from the narrower deployment
// ID grammar used by Installer edit commands.
var catalogIdentifierPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:[-_.][a-z0-9]+)*$`)
var catalogRoleVariablePattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$`)
var catalogSettingIDPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}$`)
var catalogSecretInputRefPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$`)

func readCatalog(verified executionbundle.Verified) (catalog, error) {
	var value catalog
	data, err := executionbundle.ReadVerifiedCatalog(verified)
	if err != nil || duplicateYAMLKeys(data) || yaml.Unmarshal(data, &value) != nil || value.APIVersion != "platform.installer/catalog/v1alpha1" || value.Kind != "ServiceCatalog" || !validDigest(value.Digest) || len(value.Definitions) == 0 || len(value.Definitions) > 4096 {
		return catalog{}, errors.New("catalog invalid")
	}
	for id, definition := range value.Definitions {
		if !catalogIdentifierPattern.MatchString(id) || id != definition.Metadata.ID || definition.Metadata.Version == "" || definition.Metadata.DisplayName == "" || len(definition.Metadata.DisplayName) > 256 || len(definition.Metadata.Description) > 4096 || len(definition.Metadata.Category) > 128 || len(definition.Metadata.UI.Icon) > 256 || len(definition.Metadata.UI.DocumentationTopic) > 256 || !validDigest(definition.Digest) || len(definition.Modes) == 0 || len(definition.Modes) > 256 || len(definition.Configuration.Settings) > 4096 || !validEndpointCapability(definition.EndpointConsumer) || !validEndpointCapability(definition.EndpointProvider) || !validCatalogSecretInputs(definition.SecretInputs) || !validCatalogSecretOutputs(definition.SecretOutputs) {
			return catalog{}, errors.New("catalog definition invalid")
		}
		for modeID, mode := range definition.Modes {
			if !catalogIdentifierPattern.MatchString(modeID) || mode.DisplayName == "" || len(mode.DisplayName) > 256 || len(mode.Description) > 4096 || len(mode.MemberRoles) > 128 || mode.Placement.MinMembers < 0 || (mode.Placement.MaxMembers != nil && *mode.Placement.MaxMembers < mode.Placement.MinMembers) || !validCatalogRoles(mode.MemberRoles) || !validRoleCardinality(mode.Placement.RoleCardinality) || !validModeRequiredRuntimeSecretSettings(mode.XRequiredRuntimeSecretSettings, definition.Configuration.Settings) {
				return catalog{}, errors.New("catalog mode invalid")
			}
		}
		for settingID, setting := range definition.Configuration.Settings {
			if !validCatalogSetting(settingID, setting) {
				return catalog{}, errors.New("catalog configuration setting invalid")
			}
		}
	}
	return value, nil
}

func validCatalogSecretInputs(raw map[string]any) bool {
	if raw == nil {
		return true
	}
	if len(raw) != 2 || raw["apiVersion"] != "ServiceSecretInputs/v1alpha1" {
		return false
	}
	inputs, ok := raw["inputs"].([]any)
	if !ok || len(inputs) == 0 || len(inputs) > 16 {
		return false
	}
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(inputs))
	for _, entry := range inputs {
		item, ok := entry.(map[string]any)
		if !ok || len(item) != 5 {
			return false
		}
		reference, refOK := item["requirementRef"].(string)
		purpose, purposeOK := item["purpose"].(string)
		label, labelOK := item["displayLabel"].(string)
		requiredWhen, whenOK := item["requiredWhen"].(string)
		operations, opsOK := item["operations"].([]any)
		if !refOK || !catalogSecretInputRefPattern.MatchString(reference) || !purposeOK || !labelOK || label == "" || len([]byte(label)) > 256 || !whenOK || !opsOK {
			return false
		}
		if _, duplicate := seen[reference]; duplicate {
			return false
		}
		seen[reference] = struct{}{}
		switch purpose {
		case "SERVICE_ADMIN_TOKEN":
			if requiredWhen != "INITIALIZED" || !exactCatalogOperations(operations, "SERVICE_APPLY", "SERVICE_VERIFY") {
				return false
			}
		case "SERVICE_UNSEAL_SHARES":
			if requiredWhen != "SEALED" || !exactCatalogOperations(operations, "SERVICE_APPLY") {
				return false
			}
		default:
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func validCatalogSecretOutputs(raw map[string]any) bool {
	if raw == nil {
		return true
	}
	if len(raw) != 2 || raw["protocol"] != "SecretOutputDelivery/v1alpha1" {
		return false
	}
	entries, ok := raw["entries"].([]any)
	return ok && len(entries) == 2 && entries[0] == "admin-token" && entries[1] == "unseal-shares"
}

func projectCatalogSecretOutputEntries(raw map[string]any) []string {
	if raw == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return []string{"admin-token", "unseal-shares"}
}

func exactCatalogOperations(values []any, expected ...string) bool {
	if len(values) != len(expected) {
		return false
	}
	for index, item := range values {
		if item != expected[index] {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func projectCatalogSecretInputs(raw map[string]any) []ProjectCatalogSecretInput {
	if raw == nil {
		return nil
	}
	items, _ := raw["inputs"].([]any)
	result := make([]ProjectCatalogSecretInput, 0, len(items))
	for _, entry := range items {
		item, _ := entry.(map[string]any)
		input := ProjectCatalogSecretInput{RequirementRef: item["requirementRef"].(string), Purpose: item["purpose"].(string), DisplayLabel: item["displayLabel"].(string), RequiredWhen: item["requiredWhen"].(string)}
		operations, _ := item["operations"].([]any)
		for _, operation := range operations {
			input.Operations = append(input.Operations, operation.(string))
		}
		result = append(result, input)
	}
	sort.Slice(result, func(i, j int) bool { return result[i].RequirementRef < result[j].RequirementRef })
	return result
}

// validModeRequiredRuntimeSecretSettings admits only an explicit, bounded
// subset of the existing trusted runtime-secret setting descriptors.  The
// catalog is rejected rather than allowing the UI to guess which inputs are
// needed for a selected mode.
func validModeRequiredRuntimeSecretSettings(ids []string, settings map[string]catalogSetting) bool {
	if len(ids) > 16 {
		return false
	}
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(ids))
	for _, id := range ids {
		if !catalogSettingIDPattern.MatchString(id) {
			return false
		}
		if _, duplicate := seen[id]; duplicate {
			return false
		}
		setting, exists := settings[id]
		if !exists {
			return false
		}
		if _, _, trusted := runtimeSecretReferenceObject(setting); !trusted {
			return false
		}
		seen[id] = struct{}{}
	}
	return true
}

func validCatalogSetting(id string, value catalogSetting) bool {
	if !catalogSettingIDPattern.MatchString(id) || (value.Kind != "MANAGED" && value.Kind != "ADVANCED") || !catalogRoleVariablePattern.MatchString(value.RoleVariable) || len(value.Scopes) == 0 || len(value.Scopes) > 2 || len(value.Validation) > 32 || len(value.Schema) > 128 || len(value.UI.Label) > 256 || len(value.UI.Description) > 4096 || len(value.UI.Section) > 256 || len(value.UI.XReferenceKind) > 128 {
		return false
	}
	validType := map[string]bool{"string": true, "integer": true, "number": true, "boolean": true, "object": true, "array": true, "null": true}
	if !validType[value.Type] {
		return false
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, scope := range value.Scopes {
		if (scope != "deployment" && scope != "member") || seen[scope] {
			return false
		}
		seen[scope] = true
	}
	return boundedCatalogValue(value.Validation, 0) && boundedCatalogValue(value.Schema, 0)
}

func boundedCatalogValue(value any, depth int) bool {
	if depth > 8 {
		return false
	}
	switch typed := value.(type) {
	case nil, bool, int, int64, uint64:
		return true
	case string:
		return len(typed) <= 4096
	case float64:
		return !math.IsNaN(typed) && !math.IsInf(typed, 0)
	case []any:
		if len(typed) > 4096 {
			return false
		}
		for _, item := range typed {
			if !boundedCatalogValue(item, depth+1) {
				return false
			}
		}
		return true
	case map[string]any:
		if len(typed) > 4096 {
			return false
		}
		for key, item := range typed {
			if len(key) > 256 || !boundedCatalogValue(item, depth+1) {
				return false
			}
		}
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func validCatalogRoles(roles []string) bool {
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, role := range roles {
		if !catalogIdentifierPattern.MatchString(role) || seen[role] {
			return false
		}
		seen[role] = true
	}
	return true
}

// Endpoint capability is the published genericEndpoint marker: it is absent
// or exactly an empty object. F1 deliberately assigns no inner semantics.
func validEndpointCapability(value map[string]any) bool { return value == nil || len(value) == 0 }
func validRoleCardinality(values map[string]roleCardinality) bool {
	if len(values) > 128 {
		return false
	}
	for role, value := range values {
		if !catalogIdentifierPattern.MatchString(role) || value.Minimum < 0 || (value.Maximum != nil && *value.Maximum < value.Minimum) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}
func duplicateYAMLKeys(data []byte) bool {
	var root yaml.Node
	if yaml.Unmarshal(data, &root) != nil {
		return true
	}
	var walk func(*yaml.Node) bool
	walk = func(node *yaml.Node) bool {
		if node.Kind == yaml.MappingNode {
			seen := map[string]bool{}
			for index := 0; index < len(node.Content); index += 2 {
				key := node.Content[index]
				if key.Kind != yaml.ScalarNode || seen[key.Value] {
					return true
				}
				seen[key.Value] = true
				if walk(node.Content[index+1]) {
					return true
				}
			}
			return false
		}
		for _, child := range node.Content {
			if walk(child) {
				return true
			}
		}
		return false
	}
	return walk(&root)
}

func (s *Service) resolveProjectCatalog(project manifest) *ProjectCatalogView {
	view := &ProjectCatalogView{Status: "UNAVAILABLE", ExpectedBundleDigest: project.ArtifactLock.Digest, ExpectedCatalogDigest: project.CatalogLock.Digest, Error: &CatalogViewError{Code: "CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE", Message: "Compatible catalog is unavailable"}}
	ids := make([]string, 0, len(s.sources))
	for id := range s.sources {
		ids = append(ids, id)
	}
	sort.Strings(ids)
	exactDeclared := false
	for _, id := range ids {
		entry := s.sources[id]
		verified, err := executionbundle.ValidateRoot(entry.root)
		if err != nil {
			exactDeclared = exactDeclared || executionbundle.DeclaresManifestIdentity(entry.root, project.ArtifactLock.Digest, project.CatalogLock.Digest)
			continue
		}
		if verified.Digest != project.ArtifactLock.Digest || verified.Manifest.CatalogDigest != project.CatalogLock.Digest {
			continue
		}
		exactDeclared = true
		catalog, readErr := readCatalog(verified)
		if readErr != nil || !catalogMatchesLock(catalog, project.CatalogLock) {
			continue
		}
		return catalog.view(verified)
	}
	if exactDeclared {
		view.Status = "INCOMPATIBLE"
	}
	return view
}

func catalogMatchesLock(value catalog, lock struct {
	APIVersion string                 `yaml:"apiVersion"`
	Digest     string                 `yaml:"digest"`
	Services   map[string]serviceLock `yaml:"services"`
}) bool {
	if value.Digest != lock.Digest || len(value.Definitions) != len(lock.Services) {
		return false
	}
	for id, definition := range value.Definitions {
		locked, ok := lock.Services[id]
		if !ok || definition.Metadata.Version != locked.DefinitionVersion || definition.Digest != locked.Digest {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func (value catalog) view(verified executionbundle.Verified) *ProjectCatalogView {
	staticDefaults := readUIStaticDefaults(verified)
	services := make([]ProjectCatalogService, 0, len(value.Definitions))
	for id, definition := range value.Definitions {
		settings := make([]ProjectCatalogSetting, 0, len(definition.Configuration.Settings))
		for settingID, setting := range definition.Configuration.Settings {
			projection := projectCatalogSetting(settingID, setting)
			if entry, ok := staticDefaults[id][settingID]; ok {
				if entry.State == "DEFERRED" {
					projection.StaticDefaultState = "DEFERRED"
				} else if entry.State == "LITERAL" && SafePresentationValue(projection, entry.Value) {
					projection.StaticDefaultState, projection.StaticDefaultValue = "LITERAL", entry.Value
				}
			}
			settings = append(settings, projection)
		}
		sort.Slice(settings, func(left, right int) bool {
			return catalogSettingOrderLess(settings[left], settings[right])
		})
		modes := make([]ProjectCatalogMode, 0, len(definition.Modes))
		for modeID, mode := range definition.Modes {
			roles := append([]string(nil), mode.MemberRoles...)
			kind := "MEMBER_SCOPED"
			if mode.Placement.HostScoped {
				kind = "HOST_SCOPED"
			}
			cardinality := make([]ProjectCatalogRoleCardinality, 0, len(mode.Placement.RoleCardinality))
			for role, rule := range mode.Placement.RoleCardinality {
				cardinality = append(cardinality, ProjectCatalogRoleCardinality{Role: role, Minimum: rule.Minimum, Maximum: rule.Maximum})
			}
			sort.Slice(cardinality, func(left, right int) bool { return cardinality[left].Role < cardinality[right].Role })
			requiredSecrets := append([]string(nil), mode.XRequiredRuntimeSecretSettings...)
			sort.Strings(requiredSecrets)
			modes = append(modes, ProjectCatalogMode{ID: modeID, DisplayName: mode.DisplayName, Description: mode.Description, Roles: roles, PlacementKind: kind, RequiredRuntimeSecretSettings: requiredSecrets, Guidance: ProjectCatalogModeGuidance{MinParticipants: mode.Placement.MinMembers, MaxParticipants: mode.Placement.MaxMembers, DistinctHosts: mode.Placement.DistinctHosts, RoleCardinality: cardinality}})
		}
		sort.Slice(modes, func(left, right int) bool {
			return catalogOrderLess(nil, modes[left].DisplayName, modes[left].ID, nil, modes[right].DisplayName, modes[right].ID)
		})
		services = append(services, ProjectCatalogService{ID: id, DefinitionVersion: definition.Metadata.Version, DisplayName: definition.Metadata.DisplayName, Description: definition.Metadata.Description, Category: definition.Metadata.Category, UI: ProjectCatalogUI{Icon: definition.Metadata.UI.Icon, Order: definition.Metadata.UI.Order, DocumentationTopic: definition.Metadata.UI.DocumentationTopic}, EndpointConsumer: definition.EndpointConsumer != nil, EndpointProvider: definition.EndpointProvider != nil, Modes: modes, ConfigurationSettings: settings, SecretInputs: projectCatalogSecretInputs(definition.SecretInputs), SecretOutputEntries: projectCatalogSecretOutputEntries(definition.SecretOutputs)})
	}
	sort.Slice(services, func(left, right int) bool {
		return catalogOrderLess(services[left].UI.Order, services[left].DisplayName, services[left].ID, services[right].UI.Order, services[right].DisplayName, services[right].ID)
	})
	return &ProjectCatalogView{Status: "READY", ExpectedBundleDigest: verified.Digest, ExpectedCatalogDigest: verified.Manifest.CatalogDigest, BundleVersion: verified.Manifest.BundleVersion, Services: services}
}

type uiStaticDefaultEntry struct {
	State string `json:"state"`
	Value any    `json:"value,omitempty"`
}

func readUIStaticDefaults(verified executionbundle.Verified) map[string]map[string]uiStaticDefaultEntry {
	const component = "catalog/ui-static-defaults.json"
	found := false
	for _, item := range verified.Manifest.Components {
		if item.Path == component {
			found = true
			break
		}
	}
	if !found {
		return nil // Compatibility with previously published immutable bundles.
	}
	data, err := executionbundle.ReadVerifiedComponent(verified, component, 1024*1024)
	if err != nil {
		return nil
	}
	var document struct {
		APIVersion string                                     `json:"apiVersion"`
		Services   map[string]map[string]uiStaticDefaultEntry `json:"services"`
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(strings.NewReader(string(data)))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if decoder.Decode(&document) != nil || document.APIVersion != "platform.installer/ui-static-defaults/v1alpha1" || len(document.Services) > 4096 {
		return nil
	}
	if decoder.Decode(new(any)) != io.EOF {
		return nil
	}
	for _, settings := range document.Services {
		if len(settings) > 4096 {
			return nil
		}
		for _, entry := range settings {
			if entry.State != "LITERAL" && entry.State != "DEFERRED" && entry.State != "UNAVAILABLE" {
				return nil
			}
		}
	}
	return document.Services
}

// SafePresentationValue admits only bounded values of the trusted closed UI shape.
// It never admits secret-reference objects or opaque configuration.
func SafePresentationValue(setting ProjectCatalogSetting, value any) bool {
	if setting.Kind != "MANAGED" {
		return false
	}
	switch setting.EditorShape {
	case "BOOLEAN":
		_, ok := value.(bool)
		return ok
	case "INTEGER", "NUMBER":
		number, ok := value.(float64)
		if !ok || math.IsNaN(number) || math.IsInf(number, 0) || setting.Minimum == nil || setting.Maximum == nil || number < *setting.Minimum || number > *setting.Maximum {
			return false
		}
		return setting.EditorShape != "INTEGER" || math.Trunc(number) == number
	case "ENUM":
		for _, choice := range setting.Enum {
			if text, ok := choice.(string); ok && safePreviewText(text) && text == value {
				return true
			}
			if flag, ok := choice.(bool); ok && flag == value {
				return true
			}
			if number, ok := presentationNumber(choice); ok {
				if given, valid := presentationNumber(value); valid && number == given {
					return true
				}
			}
		}
		return false
	case "BOUNDED_STRING":
		text, ok := value.(string)
		return ok && safePreviewText(text) && setting.MinLength != nil && setting.MaxLength != nil && utf8.RuneCountInString(text) >= *setting.MinLength && utf8.RuneCountInString(text) <= *setting.MaxLength
	case "DNS_DOMAIN":
		text, ok := value.(string)
		return ok && safePreviewText(text) && ValidDNSDomain(text)
	case "TLS_PROFILE", "SERVICE_DEPLOYMENT":
		text, ok := value.(string)
		return ok && safePreviewText(text) && len(text) > 0 && len(text) <= 128 && catalogIdentifierPattern.MatchString(text)
	}
	return false
}

func presentationNumber(value any) (float64, bool) {
	switch number := value.(type) {
	case int:
		return float64(number), number >= -(1<<53) && number <= 1<<53
	case int64:
		return float64(number), number >= -(1<<53) && number <= 1<<53
	case float64:
		return number, !math.IsNaN(number) && !math.IsInf(number, 0) && math.Abs(number) <= 1<<53
	default:
		return 0, false
	}
}

func safePreviewText(value string) bool {
	if !utf8.ValidString(value) || len(value) > 4096 {
		return false
	}
	for _, marker := range []string{"{{", "}}", "{%", "%}", "{#", "#}"} {
		if strings.Contains(value, marker) {
			return false
		}
	}
	for _, char := range value {
		if char < 0x20 || char == 0x7f {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func projectCatalogSetting(id string, source catalogSetting) ProjectCatalogSetting {
	result := ProjectCatalogSetting{ID: id, Kind: source.Kind, Scopes: append([]string(nil), source.Scopes...), Label: source.UI.Label, Description: source.UI.Description, Section: source.UI.Section, Order: source.UI.Order, EditorShape: "UNSUPPORTED"}
	sort.Strings(result.Scopes)
	if source.Kind != "MANAGED" {
		return result
	}
	if len(source.Schema) != 0 {
		if requirement, usernameRequired, ok := runtimeSecretReferenceObject(source); ok {
			result.EditorShape = "RUNTIME_SECRET_REFERENCE_OBJECT"
			result.RuntimeSecretRequirementRef = requirement
			result.RuntimeSecretUsernameRequired = usernameRequired
		}
		return result
	}
	if source.UI.XReferenceKind != "" {
		if source.Type == "string" && validationKeys(source.Validation, "minLength") && integerConstraint(source.Validation["minLength"]) == 1 {
			switch source.UI.XReferenceKind {
			case "TLS_PROFILE":
				result.EditorShape, result.ReferenceKind = "TLS_PROFILE", "TLS_PROFILE"
			case "SERVICE_DEPLOYMENT":
				result.EditorShape, result.ReferenceKind = "SERVICE_DEPLOYMENT", "SERVICE_DEPLOYMENT"
			}
		}
		return result
	}
	if enum, ok := closedEnum(source.Type, source.Validation); ok {
		result.EditorShape, result.Enum = "ENUM", enum
		return result
	}
	switch source.Type {
	case "boolean":
		if len(source.Validation) == 0 {
			result.EditorShape = "BOOLEAN"
		}
	case "integer", "number":
		if validationKeys(source.Validation, "minimum", "maximum") {
			minimum, minOK := finiteConstraint(source.Validation["minimum"])
			maximum, maxOK := finiteConstraint(source.Validation["maximum"])
			if minOK && maxOK && math.Abs(minimum) <= 1<<53 && math.Abs(maximum) <= 1<<53 && minimum <= maximum && (source.Type != "integer" || math.Trunc(minimum) == minimum && math.Trunc(maximum) == maximum) {
				result.Minimum, result.Maximum = &minimum, &maximum
				if source.Type == "integer" {
					result.EditorShape = "INTEGER"
				} else {
					result.EditorShape = "NUMBER"
				}
			}
		}
	case "string":
		if exactDNSDomainValidation(source.Validation) {
			minimum, maximum := 4, 253
			result.MinLength, result.MaxLength, result.EditorShape = &minimum, &maximum, "DNS_DOMAIN"
			break
		}
		if validationKeys(source.Validation, "minLength", "maxLength") {
			minimum, maximum := integerConstraint(source.Validation["minLength"]), integerConstraint(source.Validation["maxLength"])
			if minimum >= 0 && maximum >= minimum && maximum <= 4096 {
				result.MinLength, result.MaxLength, result.EditorShape = &minimum, &maximum, "BOUNDED_STRING"
			}
		}
	}
	return result
}

// runtimeSecretReferenceObject recognizes the sole closed object shape which
// may cross the Installer editor boundary: a schema-declared runtime SecretRef
// with an optional schema-declared PostgreSQL-style username. It never exposes
// arbitrary catalog schema or accepts a name/shape-based guess.
func runtimeSecretReferenceObject(source catalogSetting) (string, bool, bool) {
	meta := source.UI.XRuntimeSecretRequirement
	if source.Type != "object" || len(meta) != 2 || meta["purpose"] != "SERVICE_PASSWORD" {
		return "", false, false
	}
	requirement, ok := meta["requirementRef"].(string)
	if !ok || len(requirement) > 64 || !catalogIdentifierPattern.MatchString(requirement) {
		return "", false, false
	}
	schema := source.Schema
	if len(schema) != 4 || schema["type"] != "object" || schema["additionalProperties"] != false || !sameRequiredFields(source.Validation["required"], schema["required"]) {
		return "", false, false
	}
	properties, ok := schema["properties"].(map[string]any)
	if !ok || len(properties) < 1 || len(properties) > 2 {
		return "", false, false
	}
	password, passwordOK := properties["passwordSecretRef"].(map[string]any)
	if !passwordOK || len(password) != 2 || password["type"] != "string" || integerConstraint(password["minLength"]) != 1 {
		return "", false, false
	}
	username, hasUsername := properties["username"]
	if len(properties) != 1 && !hasUsername {
		return "", false, false
	}
	usernameRequired := requiredField(schema["required"], "username")
	if hasUsername {
		value, ok := username.(map[string]any)
		if !ok || len(value) != 2 || value["type"] != "string" || value["pattern"] != "^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,62}$" {
			return "", false, false
		}
	} else if usernameRequired {
		return "", false, false
	}
	if !requiredField(schema["required"], "passwordSecretRef") {
		return "", false, false
	}
	return requirement, usernameRequired, true
}

func sameRequiredFields(left, right any) bool {
	leftFields, leftOK := requiredFieldSet(left)
	rightFields, rightOK := requiredFieldSet(right)
	if !leftOK || !rightOK || len(leftFields) != len(rightFields) {
		return false
	}
	for field := range leftFields {
		if !rightFields[field] {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func requiredField(value any, wanted string) bool {
	fields, ok := requiredFieldSet(value)
	return ok && fields[wanted]
}

func requiredFieldSet(value any) (map[string]bool, bool) {
	values, ok := value.([]any)
	if !ok || len(values) < 1 || len(values) > 2 {
		return nil, false
	}
	result := make(map[string]bool, len(values))
	for _, raw := range values {
		field, ok := raw.(string)
		if !ok || (field != "username" && field != "passwordSecretRef") || result[field] {
			return nil, false
		}
		result[field] = true
	}
	return result, true
}

// ValidDNSDomain is the closed DNS domain shape admitted to the Installer
// setting editor. It intentionally does not execute catalog-supplied regexes.
func ValidDNSDomain(value string) bool {
	return len(value) >= 4 && len(value) <= 253 && dnsDomainPattern.MatchString(value)
}

func exactDNSDomainValidation(validation map[string]any) bool {
	pattern, patternOK := validation["pattern"].(string)
	return validationKeys(validation, "minLength", "maxLength", "pattern") &&
		patternOK && pattern == dnsDomainValidationPattern &&
		integerConstraint(validation["minLength"]) == 4 &&
		integerConstraint(validation["maxLength"]) == 253
}

func catalogSettingOrderLess(left, right ProjectCatalogSetting) bool {
	if left.Section != right.Section {
		return left.Section < right.Section
	}
	if left.Order != nil || right.Order != nil {
		if left.Order == nil {
			return false
		}
		if right.Order == nil {
			return true
		}
		if *left.Order != *right.Order {
			return *left.Order < *right.Order
		}
	}
	if left.Label != right.Label {
		return left.Label < right.Label
	}
	return left.ID < right.ID
}

func validationKeys(value map[string]any, allowed ...string) bool {
	if len(value) != len(allowed) {
		return false
	}
	set := make(map[string]bool, len(allowed))
	for _, key := range allowed {
		set[key] = true
	}
	for key := range value {
		if !set[key] {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func finiteConstraint(value any) (float64, bool) {
	switch typed := value.(type) {
	case int:
		if typed > 1<<53 || typed < -(1<<53) {
			return 0, false
		}
		return float64(typed), true
	case int64:
		if typed > 1<<53 || typed < -(1<<53) {
			return 0, false
		}
		return float64(typed), true
	case uint64:
		if typed > 1<<53 {
			return 0, false
		}
		return float64(typed), true
	case float64:
		return typed, !math.IsNaN(typed) && !math.IsInf(typed, 0) && math.Abs(typed) <= 1<<53
	default:
		return 0, false
	}
}

func integerConstraint(value any) int {
	number, ok := finiteConstraint(value)
	if !ok || math.Trunc(number) != number || number < math.MinInt || number > math.MaxInt {
		return -1
	}
	return int(number)
}

func closedEnum(valueType string, validation map[string]any) ([]any, bool) {
	if !validationKeys(validation, "enum") {
		return nil, false
	}
	values, ok := validation["enum"].([]any)
	if !ok || len(values) == 0 || len(values) > 256 {
		return nil, false
	}
	result := make([]any, 0, len(values))
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, value := range values {
		valid := false
		switch valueType {
		case "string":
			_, valid = value.(string)
		case "integer":
			number, ok := finiteConstraint(value)
			valid = ok && math.Trunc(number) == number
		case "number":
			_, ok := finiteConstraint(value)
			valid = ok
		case "boolean":
			_, valid = value.(bool)
		}
		if !valid {
			return nil, false
		}
		key := fmt.Sprint(value)
		if seen[key] {
			return nil, false
		}
		seen[key] = true
		result = append(result, value)
	}
	return result, true
}

func catalogOrderLess(leftOrder *int, leftName, leftID string, rightOrder *int, rightName, rightID string) bool {
	if leftOrder != nil || rightOrder != nil {
		if leftOrder == nil {
			return false
		}
		if rightOrder == nil {
			return true
		}
		if *leftOrder != *rightOrder {
			return *leftOrder < *rightOrder
		}
	}
	if leftName != rightName {
		return leftName < rightName
	}
	return leftID < rightID
}

type manifest struct {
	APIVersion string `yaml:"apiVersion"`
	Kind       string `yaml:"kind"`
	Metadata   struct {
		ID     string            `yaml:"id"`
		Name   string            `yaml:"name"`
		Labels map[string]string `yaml:"labels"`
	} `yaml:"metadata"`
	DesiredStateContract string `yaml:"desiredStateContract"`
	CatalogLock          struct {
		APIVersion string                 `yaml:"apiVersion"`
		Digest     string                 `yaml:"digest"`
		Services   map[string]serviceLock `yaml:"services"`
	} `yaml:"catalogLock"`
	ArtifactLock struct {
		APIVersion string `yaml:"apiVersion"`
		Digest     string `yaml:"digest"`
	} `yaml:"artifactLock"`
	SafeEmptyEnvelope bool `yaml:"-"`
	HasDesiredState   bool `yaml:"-"`
}
type serviceLock struct {
	DefinitionVersion string `yaml:"definitionVersion"`
	Digest            string `yaml:"digest"`
}

// RuntimeLockUpgradeCandidate is the closed replacement lock pair derived
// only from one verified immutable runtime bundle. It is not desired state and
// callers cannot provide its catalog service entries independently.
type RuntimeLockUpgradeCandidate struct {
	ArtifactDigest  string
	CatalogDigest   string
	CatalogServices map[string]RuntimeCatalogServiceLock
}

type RuntimeCatalogServiceLock struct {
	DefinitionVersion string `yaml:"definitionVersion"`
	Digest            string `yaml:"digest"`
}

// ResolveRuntimeLockUpgradeCandidate admits a verified new runtime/catalog
// pair for a managed project. Unlike ValidateArtifactLockCandidate it is for
// the explicit catalog-changing upgrade operation, so it deliberately proves
// the new complete catalog lock rather than requiring the old catalog digest.
func ResolveRuntimeLockUpgradeCandidate(ctx context.Context, root, bundleRoot, digest string) (RuntimeLockUpgradeCandidate, error) {
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return RuntimeLockUpgradeCandidate{}, err
	}
	if !validDigest(digest) {
		return RuntimeLockUpgradeCandidate{}, errors.New("ARTIFACT_LOCK_DIGEST_INVALID")
	}
	root, err := existingRoot(root)
	if err != nil {
		return RuntimeLockUpgradeCandidate{}, err
	}
	project, err := readManifest(root)
	if err != nil || project.Metadata.Labels[managedProjectLabel] != managedProjectMarker || !validEmptyManifest(project) {
		return RuntimeLockUpgradeCandidate{}, errors.New("MANAGED_PROJECT_INVALID")
	}
	verified, err := executionbundle.ValidateRoot(bundleRoot)
	if err != nil {
		return RuntimeLockUpgradeCandidate{}, errors.New("ARTIFACT_LOCK_BUNDLE_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	if verified.Digest != digest {
		return RuntimeLockUpgradeCandidate{}, errors.New("ARTIFACT_LOCK_BUNDLE_DIGEST_MISMATCH")
	}
	catalog, err := readCatalog(verified)
	if err != nil || catalog.Digest != verified.Manifest.CatalogDigest || len(catalog.Definitions) == 0 {
@@END
@@PORTABLE {"path":"internal/projectlifecycle/lifecycle.go","mode":420,"size":54455,"sha256":"26d1d5df65719434047ab77470af4855a8d18891223c86fb0ae8eb96ba7a9ee1","index":1,"count":2,"encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":6455}

		return RuntimeLockUpgradeCandidate{}, errors.New("ARTIFACT_LOCK_COMPATIBILITY_INVALID")
	}
	services := make(map[string]RuntimeCatalogServiceLock, len(catalog.Definitions))
	for id, definition := range catalog.Definitions {
		if id == "" || definition.Metadata.Version == "" || !validDigest(definition.Digest) {
			return RuntimeLockUpgradeCandidate{}, errors.New("ARTIFACT_LOCK_COMPATIBILITY_INVALID")
		}
		services[id] = RuntimeCatalogServiceLock{DefinitionVersion: definition.Metadata.Version, Digest: definition.Digest}
	}
	return RuntimeLockUpgradeCandidate{ArtifactDigest: verified.Digest, CatalogDigest: verified.Manifest.CatalogDigest, CatalogServices: services}, nil
}

func marshalManifest(id, name string, source compatibility) ([]byte, error) {
	value := manifest{APIVersion: "platform.installer/v2alpha1", Kind: "PlatformProject", DesiredStateContract: "platform.installer/project-desired-state/v2alpha1"}
	value.Metadata.ID, value.Metadata.Name = id, name
	value.Metadata.Labels = map[string]string{managedProjectLabel: managedProjectMarker}
	value.CatalogLock.APIVersion, value.CatalogLock.Digest = "platform.installer/catalog/v1alpha1", source.verified.Manifest.CatalogDigest
	value.CatalogLock.Services = make(map[string]serviceLock, len(source.catalog.Definitions))
	for id, definition := range source.catalog.Definitions {
		value.CatalogLock.Services[id] = serviceLock{DefinitionVersion: definition.Metadata.Version, Digest: definition.Digest}
	}
	value.ArtifactLock.APIVersion, value.ArtifactLock.Digest = "platform.installer/artifacts/v1alpha1", source.verified.Digest
	return yaml.Marshal(value)
}

func readManifest(root string) (manifest, error) {
	path := filepath.Join(root, "project.yml")
	info, err := os.Lstat(path)
	if err != nil || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Size() > 1024*1024 {
		return manifest{}, errors.New("PROJECT_OPEN_BLOCKED")
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	var value manifest
	if err != nil || yaml.Unmarshal(data, &value) != nil {
		return manifest{}, errors.New("PROJECT_OPEN_BLOCKED")
	}
	var fields map[string]yaml.Node
	if yaml.Unmarshal(data, &fields) != nil {
		return manifest{}, errors.New("PROJECT_OPEN_BLOCKED")
	}
	allowed := map[string]bool{
		"apiVersion": true, "kind": true, "metadata": true,
		"desiredStateContract": true, "catalogLock": true, "artifactLock": true,
	}
	value.SafeEmptyEnvelope = true
	for key := range fields {
		if key == "desiredState" {
			value.HasDesiredState = true
		}
		if !allowed[key] {
			value.SafeEmptyEnvelope = false
		}
	}
	return value, nil
}

func validEmptyManifest(value manifest) bool {
	if !value.SafeEmptyEnvelope || value.HasDesiredState || value.APIVersion != "platform.installer/v2alpha1" || value.Kind != "PlatformProject" || value.DesiredStateContract != "platform.installer/project-desired-state/v2alpha1" || !validProjectID(value.Metadata.ID) || value.Metadata.Name == "" || len(value.Metadata.Labels) != 1 || value.Metadata.Labels[managedProjectLabel] != managedProjectMarker || value.CatalogLock.APIVersion != "platform.installer/catalog/v1alpha1" || !validDigest(value.CatalogLock.Digest) || len(value.CatalogLock.Services) == 0 || value.ArtifactLock.APIVersion != "platform.installer/artifacts/v1alpha1" || !validDigest(value.ArtifactLock.Digest) {
		return false
	}
	for id, lock := range value.CatalogLock.Services {
		if id == "" || lock.DefinitionVersion == "" || !validDigest(lock.Digest) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func canonicalInputsPresent(root string) (bool, error) {
	for _, name := range []string{"ansible.cfg", "inventory"} {
		info, err := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(root, name))
		if err == nil {
			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
				return false, errors.New("PROJECT_OPEN_BLOCKED")
			}
			return true, nil
		}
		if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
			return false, errors.New("PROJECT_OPEN_BLOCKED")
		}
	}
	return false, nil
}

func createDestination(root string) (string, string, error) {
	if root == "" || !filepath.IsAbs(root) || filepath.Clean(root) != root || filepath.Base(root) == "." || filepath.Base(root) == string(filepath.Separator) {
		return "", "", errors.New("PROJECT_PATH_INVALID")
	}
	parent := filepath.Dir(root)
	info, err := os.Stat(parent)
	if err != nil || !info.IsDir() {
		return "", "", errors.New("PROJECT_PARENT_MISSING")
	}
	return root, parent, nil
}

func existingRoot(root string) (string, error) {
	if root == "" || !filepath.IsAbs(root) {
		return "", errors.New("PROJECT_OPEN_BLOCKED")
	}
	root = filepath.Clean(root)
	if err := assertSafeAncestors(root); err != nil {
		return root, err
	}
	info, err := os.Lstat(root)
	if err != nil || !info.IsDir() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
		return root, errors.New("PROJECT_OPEN_BLOCKED")
	}
	return root, nil
}

func assertSafeAncestors(path string) error {
	for current := filepath.Clean(path); ; current = filepath.Dir(current) {
		info, err := os.Lstat(current)
		if err != nil || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || info.Mode()&os.ModeIrregular != 0 {
			return errors.New("PROJECT_PATH_UNSAFE")
		}
		parent := filepath.Dir(current)
		if parent == current {
			return nil
		}
	}
}

func projectID() (string, error) {
	value := make([]byte, 8)
	if _, err := rand.Read(value); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return "project-" + hex.EncodeToString(value), nil
}
func validProjectID(value string) bool {
	if !strings.HasPrefix(value, "project-") || len(value) != len("project-")+16 {
		return false
	}
	_, err := hex.DecodeString(value[len("project-"):])
	return err == nil && strings.ToLower(value) == value
}
func validDigest(value string) bool {
	if !strings.HasPrefix(value, "sha256:") || len(value) != 71 {
		return false
	}
	_, err := hex.DecodeString(value[7:])
	return err == nil
}
func validName(value string) (string, error) {
	value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
	if value == "" || len(value) > 256 || !utf8.ValidString(value) {
		return "", errors.New("PROJECT_DISPLAY_NAME_INVALID")
	}
	for _, r := range value {
		if unicode.IsControl(r) {
			return "", errors.New("PROJECT_DISPLAY_NAME_INVALID")
		}
	}
	return value, nil
}
func writeSync(path string, value []byte) error {
	file, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY, 0o644)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, err := file.Write(value); err != nil {
		_ = file.Close()
		return err
	}
	if err := file.Sync(); err != nil {
		_ = file.Close()
		return err
	}
	return file.Close()
}

package projectlifecycle

import (
	"errors"
	"syscall"
	"unsafe"
)

var moveFileEx = syscall.NewLazyDLL("kernel32.dll").NewProc("MoveFileExW")

const moveFileWriteThrough = 0x8

func atomicPublish(source, destination string) error {
	from, err := syscall.UTF16PtrFromString(source)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	to, err := syscall.UTF16PtrFromString(destination)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	result, _, callErr := moveFileEx.Call(uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(from)), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(to)), moveFileWriteThrough)
	if result == 0 {
		if callErr != syscall.Errno(0) {
			return callErr
		}
		return errors.New("PROJECT_PUBLISH_FAILED")
	}
	return nil
}

@@PORTABLE {"path":"internal/qapromotion/promotion.go","mode":420,"size":12283,"sha256":"617efe5472544d4cd912736ee2734a36a968f7ce6f8e22334c32fe1fdb2f197a","index":0,"count":1,"encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":12283}
// Package qapromotion owns a resumable DEV/QA-only runtime promotion flow.
// It is not part of the Execution Node protocol or normal project lifecycle.
package qapromotion

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"

	"platform-installer/internal/executionbundle"
	"platform-installer/internal/executionnode"
	"platform-installer/internal/installer"
)

const (
	stageBuilt     = "BUILT"
	stagePublished = "PUBLISHED"
	stageActivated = "ACTIVATED"
)

// Request deliberately requires the current lock pair.  The tool never
// selects a runtime or silently changes a project to a newer bundle.
type Request struct {
	CheckpointRoot         string
	CacheRoot              string
	ProjectRoot            string
	ExpectedArtifactDigest string
	ExpectedCatalogDigest  string
	PublishedDigest        string
	RuntimeInput           string
	BundleVersion          string
	Node                   executionnode.Node
}

// Result is safe to print in QA logs. It contains immutable identities only.
type Result struct {
	Resumed            bool
	ArtifactDigest     string
	CatalogDigest      string
	ProjectRevision    string
	PreparationChanged bool
}

type checkpoint struct {
	ProjectRoot            string `json:"projectRoot"`
	ExpectedArtifactDigest string `json:"expectedArtifactDigest"`
	ExpectedCatalogDigest  string `json:"expectedCatalogDigest"`
	NewArtifactDigest      string `json:"newArtifactDigest"`
	NewCatalogDigest       string `json:"newCatalogDigest"`
	Stage                  string `json:"stage"`
}

// Dependencies isolate the external acquisition/activation boundaries. They
// are intentionally small so the state machine can be tested without SSH.
type Dependencies struct {
	Build        func(context.Context, executionnode.Node, string, string) (executionbundle.Verified, error)
	Publish      func(context.Context, executionbundle.Verified) (executionbundle.Verified, error)
	CleanupBuild func(executionbundle.Verified)
	Prepare      func(context.Context, executionnode.Node, executionbundle.Verified) (executionnode.Result, error)
	UpdateLocks  func(context.Context, installer.RuntimeLockSetUpdateRequest) (installer.RuntimeLockSetUpdateResult, error)
	ReadLocks    func(context.Context, string, executionbundle.Verified) (artifactDigest, catalogDigest string, err error)
}

// Promote builds and publishes at most once per checkpoint, then safely
// retries activation and lock rebinding. A published bundle is sufficient to
// resume after the old cache entry has been pruned by immutable publication.
func Promote(ctx context.Context, request Request, dependencies Dependencies) (Result, error) {
	if err := validateRequest(request, dependencies); err != nil {
		return Result{}, err
	}
	path, err := checkpointPath(request.CheckpointRoot, request.ProjectRoot)
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, err
	}
	state, found, err := readCheckpoint(path)
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, err
	}
	resumed := found
	var bundle executionbundle.Verified
	if !found {
		if request.PublishedDigest != "" {
			bundle, err = resolvePublishedBundle(request.CacheRoot, request.PublishedDigest)
			if err != nil {
				return Result{}, err
			}
		} else {
			bundle, err = dependencies.Build(ctx, request.Node, request.RuntimeInput, request.BundleVersion)
			if err != nil {
				return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("QA_RUNTIME_PROMOTION_BUILD_FAILED: %w", err)
			}
			state = checkpoint{ProjectRoot: request.ProjectRoot, ExpectedArtifactDigest: request.ExpectedArtifactDigest, ExpectedCatalogDigest: request.ExpectedCatalogDigest, NewArtifactDigest: bundle.Digest, NewCatalogDigest: bundle.Manifest.CatalogDigest, Stage: stageBuilt}
			if err := writeCheckpoint(path, state); err != nil {
				cleanupBuild(dependencies, bundle)
				return Result{}, err
			}
			bundle, err = publishBuilt(ctx, dependencies, bundle)
			if err != nil {
				return Result{}, err
			}
		}
		state = checkpoint{ProjectRoot: request.ProjectRoot, ExpectedArtifactDigest: request.ExpectedArtifactDigest, ExpectedCatalogDigest: request.ExpectedCatalogDigest, NewArtifactDigest: bundle.Digest, NewCatalogDigest: bundle.Manifest.CatalogDigest, Stage: stagePublished}
		if err := writeCheckpoint(path, state); err != nil {
			return Result{}, err
		}
	} else {
		if !sameRequest(state, request) {
			return Result{}, errors.New("QA_RUNTIME_PROMOTION_CHECKPOINT_MISMATCH")
		}
		bundle, err = resolvePublishedBundle(request.CacheRoot, state.NewArtifactDigest)
		if err != nil && state.Stage == stageBuilt {
			bundle, err = dependencies.Build(ctx, request.Node, request.RuntimeInput, request.BundleVersion)
			if err != nil || bundle.Digest != state.NewArtifactDigest || bundle.Manifest.CatalogDigest != state.NewCatalogDigest {
				cleanupBuild(dependencies, bundle)
				return Result{}, errors.New("QA_RUNTIME_PROMOTION_REBUILD_MISMATCH")
			}
			bundle, err = publishBuilt(ctx, dependencies, bundle)
			if err != nil {
				return Result{}, err
			}
			state.Stage = stagePublished
			if err := writeCheckpoint(path, state); err != nil {
				return Result{}, err
			}
		}
		if err != nil {
			return Result{}, err
		}
		if bundle.Manifest.CatalogDigest != state.NewCatalogDigest {
			return Result{}, errors.New("QA_RUNTIME_PROMOTION_PUBLISHED_BUNDLE_MISMATCH")
		}
	}

	prepared, err := dependencies.Prepare(ctx, request.Node, bundle)
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("QA_RUNTIME_PROMOTION_PREPARE_FAILED: %w", err)
	}
	if prepared.State != executionnode.Ready || prepared.Runtime.BundleDigest != bundle.Digest {
		return Result{}, errors.New("QA_RUNTIME_PROMOTION_PREPARE_UNVERIFIED")
	}
	state.Stage = stageActivated
	if err := writeCheckpoint(path, state); err != nil {
		return Result{}, err
	}

	artifactDigest, catalogDigest, err := dependencies.ReadLocks(ctx, request.ProjectRoot, bundle)
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, err
	}
	var revision string
	if artifactDigest == bundle.Digest && catalogDigest == bundle.Manifest.CatalogDigest {
		revision, err = installer.ProjectRevision(request.ProjectRoot)
		if err != nil {
			return Result{}, err
		}
	} else if artifactDigest == request.ExpectedArtifactDigest && catalogDigest == request.ExpectedCatalogDigest {
		baseRevision, revisionErr := installer.ProjectRevision(request.ProjectRoot)
		if revisionErr != nil {
			return Result{}, revisionErr
		}
		updated, updateErr := dependencies.UpdateLocks(ctx, installer.RuntimeLockSetUpdateRequest{ProjectRoot: request.ProjectRoot, ExpectedProjectRevision: baseRevision, ExpectedOldArtifactDigest: request.ExpectedArtifactDigest, ExpectedOldCatalogDigest: request.ExpectedCatalogDigest, NewDigest: bundle.Digest, NewBundleRoot: bundle.Root})
		if updateErr != nil {
			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("QA_RUNTIME_PROMOTION_LOCK_UPDATE_FAILED: %w", updateErr)
		}
		revision = updated.NewProjectRevision
	} else {
		return Result{}, errors.New("QA_RUNTIME_PROMOTION_PROJECT_LOCKS_UNEXPECTED")
	}

	artifactDigest, catalogDigest, err = dependencies.ReadLocks(ctx, request.ProjectRoot, bundle)
	if err != nil || artifactDigest != bundle.Digest || catalogDigest != bundle.Manifest.CatalogDigest {
		return Result{}, errors.New("QA_RUNTIME_PROMOTION_REOPEN_FAILED")
	}
	if err := os.Remove(path); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
		return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("QA_RUNTIME_PROMOTION_CHECKPOINT_REMOVE_FAILED: %w", err)
	}
	return Result{Resumed: resumed, ArtifactDigest: bundle.Digest, CatalogDigest: bundle.Manifest.CatalogDigest, ProjectRevision: revision, PreparationChanged: prepared.Changed}, nil
}

func validateRequest(request Request, dependencies Dependencies) error {
	if request.CheckpointRoot == "" || request.CacheRoot == "" || request.ProjectRoot == "" || request.ExpectedArtifactDigest == "" || request.ExpectedCatalogDigest == "" || dependencies.Build == nil || dependencies.Publish == nil || dependencies.Prepare == nil || dependencies.UpdateLocks == nil || dependencies.ReadLocks == nil || (request.PublishedDigest == "" && (request.RuntimeInput == "" || request.BundleVersion == "")) {
		return errors.New("QA_RUNTIME_PROMOTION_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	return nil
}

func sameRequest(state checkpoint, request Request) bool {
	return state.ProjectRoot == request.ProjectRoot && state.ExpectedArtifactDigest == request.ExpectedArtifactDigest && state.ExpectedCatalogDigest == request.ExpectedCatalogDigest && (state.Stage == stageBuilt || state.Stage == stagePublished || state.Stage == stageActivated)
}

func checkpointPath(root, projectRoot string) (string, error) {
	abs, err := filepath.Abs(projectRoot)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(filepath.Clean(abs)))
	return filepath.Join(root, "runtime-promotions", hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])+".json"), nil
}

func readCheckpoint(path string) (checkpoint, bool, error) {
	content, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
		return checkpoint{}, false, nil
	}
	if err != nil || len(content) > 4096 {
		return checkpoint{}, false, errors.New("QA_RUNTIME_PROMOTION_CHECKPOINT_INVALID")
	}
	var value checkpoint
	if json.Unmarshal(content, &value) != nil || value.ProjectRoot == "" || value.NewArtifactDigest == "" || value.NewCatalogDigest == "" || (value.Stage != stageBuilt && value.Stage != stagePublished && value.Stage != stageActivated) {
		return checkpoint{}, false, errors.New("QA_RUNTIME_PROMOTION_CHECKPOINT_INVALID")
	}
	return value, true, nil
}

func publishBuilt(ctx context.Context, dependencies Dependencies, bundle executionbundle.Verified) (executionbundle.Verified, error) {
	published, err := dependencies.Publish(ctx, bundle)
	cleanupBuild(dependencies, bundle)
	if err != nil {
		return executionbundle.Verified{}, fmt.Errorf("QA_RUNTIME_PROMOTION_PUBLISH_FAILED: %w", err)
	}
	if published.Digest != bundle.Digest || published.Manifest.CatalogDigest != bundle.Manifest.CatalogDigest {
		return executionbundle.Verified{}, errors.New("QA_RUNTIME_PROMOTION_PUBLICATION_MISMATCH")
	}
	return published, nil
}

func cleanupBuild(dependencies Dependencies, bundle executionbundle.Verified) {
	if dependencies.CleanupBuild != nil && bundle.Root != "" {
		dependencies.CleanupBuild(bundle)
	}
}

func writeCheckpoint(path string, value checkpoint) error {
	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o700); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("QA_RUNTIME_PROMOTION_CHECKPOINT_WRITE_FAILED: %w", err)
	}
	content, err := json.Marshal(value)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	temporary, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(path), ".promotion-")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	name := temporary.Name()
	if _, err := temporary.Write(append(content, '\n')); err != nil || temporary.Sync() != nil || temporary.Close() != nil {
		_ = temporary.Close()
		_ = os.Remove(name)
		return errors.New("QA_RUNTIME_PROMOTION_CHECKPOINT_WRITE_FAILED")
	}
	if err := os.Chmod(name, 0o600); err != nil {
		_ = os.Remove(name)
		return err
	}
	// Rename has atomic replacement semantics on the supported QA Linux and
	// Windows filesystems. A failure leaves the prior checkpoint intact.
	if err := os.Rename(name, path); err != nil {
		_ = os.Remove(name)
		return fmt.Errorf("QA_RUNTIME_PROMOTION_CHECKPOINT_WRITE_FAILED: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}

func resolvePublishedBundle(cacheRoot, digest string) (executionbundle.Verified, error) {
	if !strings.HasPrefix(digest, "sha256:") || len(digest) != len("sha256:")+64 {
		return executionbundle.Verified{}, errors.New("QA_RUNTIME_PROMOTION_CHECKPOINT_INVALID")
	}
	root := filepath.Join(cacheRoot, strings.TrimPrefix(digest, "sha256:"))
	verified, err := executionbundle.ValidateRoot(root)
	if err != nil || verified.Digest != digest {
		return executionbundle.Verified{}, errors.New("QA_RUNTIME_PROMOTION_PUBLISHED_BUNDLE_MISSING")
	}
	return verified, nil
}

// ReadLocks uses the existing managed-project reader and never parses or
// mutates canonical Ansible files locally.
func ReadLocks(ctx context.Context, projectRoot string, _ executionbundle.Verified) (string, string, error) {
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return "", "", err
	}
	locks, err := installer.ReadRuntimeLockSet(projectRoot)
	if err != nil {
		return "", "", errors.New("QA_RUNTIME_PROMOTION_PROJECT_OPEN_FAILED")
	}
	return locks.ArtifactDigest, locks.CatalogDigest, nil
}

// Package runtimesecret holds short-lived, application-local target session
// credentials. It deliberately has no persistence or transport capability.
package runtimesecret

import (
	"crypto/ecdsa"
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/rsa"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"crypto/x509"
	"encoding/pem"
	"errors"
