@@PORTABLE {"path":"scripts/portable_source.py","mode":420,"size":18805,"sha256":"a92efbe18c672ae63590265c194e4a951fe37eeb7163a113d07fbf493dacdb0d","index":0,"count":1,"encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":18805}
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Pack/restore application and Core sources in text parts of at most 5,000,000 bytes."""
import argparse
import base64
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

FORMAT = "platform-installer-portable-source-v2"
LIMIT = 5_000_000
BLOCK = 48_000
HEADER = b"@@PORTABLE "
FOOTER = b"\n@@END\n"
SCRIPT = "scripts/portable_source.py"
RESOURCES = ["build/appicon.png", "build/windows/icon.ico", "build/windows/info.json",
             "build/windows/wails.exe.manifest", "build/linux/build.sh",
             "build/linux/platform-installer-ui.desktop", "build/linux/icon.png"]
WAILS_SOURCE = "third_party/wails"
WAILS_VERSION = "v2.15.0"
# CLI templates are compile-time go:embed resources, including their README files.
WAILS_EMBED_TREES = ("pkg/templates/templates/", "pkg/templates/ides/",
                     "pkg/templates/generate/assets/", "pkg/buildassets/build/",
                     "cmd/wails/internal/template/base/")
EXCLUDED_DIRS = {".git", ".github", ".runtime", ".agents", ".codex", "docs", "tests", "test",
                 "testdata", "__tests__", "e2e", "node_modules", "__pycache__",
                 ".pytest_cache", "dist", "cache", "bundle", "runs", "secrets",
                 "projects", "coverage", "bin", "portable-source"}


def digest(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def safe_path(name):
    require(isinstance(name, str) and bool(name), "Missing path")
    for part in name.split("/"):
        require(part not in {"", ".", ".."} and
                not re.search(r'[\\<>:"|?*\x00-\x1f]', part) and
                not part.endswith((".", " ")) and
                not re.match(r"^(con|prn|aux|nul|com[1-9]|lpt[1-9])(?:\.|$)", part, re.I),
                "Unsafe path: " + name)
    return name


def included(name):
    if name.startswith(WAILS_SOURCE + "/"):
        relative = name[len(WAILS_SOURCE) + 1:]
        if "/" not in relative and relative not in {"go.mod", "go.sum", "wails.go", "LICENSE", "SOURCE.json"}:
            return False
        if relative.startswith(WAILS_EMBED_TREES):
            return True
        # Vendored CLI dependencies already omit tests; preserve compile-time resources.
        if relative.startswith("vendor/"):
            return not relative.endswith("_test.go")
        if relative.split("/")[0] in {"test", "tests", "tools"}:
            return False
        if relative.endswith(".exe") and relative != "internal/webview2runtime/MicrosoftEdgeWebview2Setup.exe":
            return False
        if relative == "internal/webview2runtime/MicrosoftEdgeWebview2Setup.exe":
            return True
    parts = name.lower().split("/")
    leaf = parts[-1]
    if set(parts) & EXCLUDED_DIRS:
        return False
    if leaf in {"agents.md", "current_state.md"} or re.match(r"readme(?:\.|$)", leaf):
        return False
    # Licence/notice files are required for dependency redistribution.
    if re.search(r"\.(md|rst|adoc|docx?|pdf)$", leaf) and not re.match(r"(license|licence|copying|notice)", leaf):
        return False
    if re.search(r"(_test\.go|\.(test|spec)\.[^.]+)$", leaf) or leaf.startswith("test_"):
        return False
    if re.match(r"(vitest|playwright|eslint|prettier)\.config\.", leaf) or leaf == "test-setup.ts":
        return False
    if parts[0] == "scripts" and (leaf.startswith("qa-") or leaf in {"source_text.py", "portable-source.cjs"}):
        return False
    if leaf.startswith((".env", ".coverage")) or re.search(r"\.(key|pem|p12|pfx|vault-password|private-key|log|pyc|pyo|tmp|syso)$", leaf):
        return False
    if re.search(r"\.(rpm|deb|whl|bin|zip|tar|gz|xz|bz2|7z|iso)$", leaf):
        return False
    # Wails vendor has executable/DLL assets embedded in Go at compile time.
    if parts[0] != "vendor" and re.search(r"\.(exe|dll|so|a|lib)$", leaf):
        return False
    return True


def git(root, *args):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(root), *args])


def source_files(root):
    modes = {}
    for entry in git(root, "ls-files", "--stage", "-z").split(b"\0"):
        if not entry:
            continue
        metadata, name = entry.split(b"\t", 1)
        mode, _, stage = metadata.split(b" ")
        require(stage == b"0", "Unmerged source file")
        decoded = name.decode("utf-8")
        if included(decoded):
            require(mode in {b"100644", b"100755"}, "Unsupported Git entry: " + decoded)
            modes[decoded] = 0o755 if mode == b"100755" else 0o644
    for name in [SCRIPT, *RESOURCES]:
        modes[name] = 0o755 if name.endswith(".sh") else 0o644
    wails_root = root / WAILS_SOURCE
    require((wails_root / "vendor/modules.txt").is_file(), "Missing vendored Wails CLI sources")
    for directory, directories, filenames in os.walk(str(wails_root), followlinks=False):
        directories[:] = [name for name in directories if name not in {".git", "node_modules", "__pycache__"}]
        for filename in filenames:
            target = Path(directory) / filename
            name = target.relative_to(root).as_posix()
            if included(name):
                modes.setdefault(name, 0o755 if name.endswith(".sh") else 0o644)
    files = []
    seen = set()
    for name in sorted(modes):
        safe_path(name)
        require(name.casefold() not in seen, "Case-colliding source path: " + name)
        seen.add(name.casefold())
        target = root.joinpath(*name.split("/"))
        require(target.is_file() and not target.is_symlink(), "Missing/nonregular source: " + name)
        files.append((name, modes[name], target))
    return files


def pack(root, output):
    require(not output.exists(), "Output already exists: " + str(output))
    files = source_files(root)
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    staging = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=".portable-pack-", dir=str(output.parent)))
    manifest = {"format": FORMAT, "maxPartBytes": LIMIT,
                "sourceRevision": git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD").decode().strip(),
                "files": len(files), "sourceBytes": 0, "textFiles": 0, "binaryFiles": 0, "parts": []}
    lines = []
    length = 0

    def flush():
        nonlocal lines, length
        if not length:
            return
        data = b"".join(lines)
        name = "source-{:04d}.txt".format(len(manifest["parts"]) + 1)
        (staging / name).write_bytes(data)
        manifest["parts"].append({"name": name, "bytes": len(data), "sha256": digest(data)})
        lines, length = [], 0

    try:
        for name, mode, target in files:
            data = target.read_bytes()
            manifest["sourceBytes"] += len(data)
            checksum = digest(data)
            try:
                text = data.decode("utf-8")
                require("\0" not in text, "Binary NUL")
            except (UnicodeDecodeError, ValueError):
                encoding = "base64"
                chunks = [base64.b64encode(data[start:start + BLOCK])
                          for start in range(0, len(data), BLOCK)] or [b""]
                manifest["binaryFiles"] += 1
            else:
                encoding = "utf-8"
                chunks = [text[start:start + BLOCK].encode("utf-8")
                          for start in range(0, len(text), BLOCK)] or [b""]
                manifest["textFiles"] += 1
            count = len(chunks)
            for index, payload in enumerate(chunks):
                record = {"path": name, "mode": mode, "size": len(data), "sha256": checksum,
                          "index": index, "count": count,
                          "encoding": encoding, "payloadBytes": len(payload)}
                line = HEADER + json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode("ascii") + b"\n" + payload + FOOTER
                require(len(line) <= LIMIT, "Record exceeds part limit")
                if length + len(line) > LIMIT:
                    flush()
                lines.append(line)
                length += len(line)
        flush()
        manifest_data = (json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
        require(len(manifest_data) <= LIMIT, "Manifest exceeds part limit")
        (staging / "manifest.json").write_bytes(manifest_data)
        shutil.copyfile(Path(__file__), staging / "portable_source.py")
        require(not output.exists(), "Output appeared during pack")
        staging.rename(output)
    except Exception:
        shutil.rmtree(staging)
        raise
    print(json.dumps({"files": manifest["files"], "sourceBytes": manifest["sourceBytes"],
                      "parts": len(manifest["parts"]),
                      "textFiles": manifest["textFiles"], "binaryFiles": manifest["binaryFiles"],
                      "maxPartBytes": max(part["bytes"] for part in manifest["parts"]),
                      "output": str(output)}))


def read_package(source):
    manifest = json.loads((source / "manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    require(manifest.get("format") == FORMAT and manifest.get("maxPartBytes") == LIMIT and
            type(manifest.get("files")) is int and manifest["files"] > 0 and
            isinstance(manifest.get("parts"), list) and bool(manifest["parts"]), "Invalid manifest")
    files, seen, blocks = [], set(), []
    current, next_index, total = None, 0, 0
    encodings = {"utf-8": 0, "base64": 0}
    for part_index, part in enumerate(manifest["parts"], 1):
        require(part["name"] == "source-{:04d}.txt".format(part_index), "Invalid part order")
        data = (source / part["name"]).read_bytes()
        require(len(data) <= LIMIT and len(data) == part["bytes"] and digest(data) == part["sha256"],
                "Part checksum/size mismatch: " + part["name"])
        stream = io.BytesIO(data)
        while stream.tell() < len(data):
            header = stream.readline(16385)
            require(len(header) <= 16384 and header.startswith(HEADER) and header.endswith(b"\n"), "Invalid record header")
            record = json.loads(header[len(HEADER):].decode("ascii"))
            safe_path(record["path"])
            require(type(record.get("size")) is int and record["size"] >= 0 and
                    type(record.get("count")) is int and record["count"] > 0 and
                    type(record.get("index")) is int and isinstance(record.get("sha256"), str) and
                    re.fullmatch(r"[a-f0-9]{64}", record["sha256"]) and record.get("mode") in {0o644, 0o755} and
                    record.get("encoding") in {"utf-8", "base64"} and
                    type(record.get("payloadBytes")) is int and 0 <= record["payloadBytes"] <= BLOCK * 4,
                    "Invalid file metadata")
            if record["index"] == 0:
                require(current is None and record["path"].casefold() not in seen,
                        "Duplicate/incomplete file: " + record["path"])
                seen.add(record["path"].casefold())
                current, blocks, next_index = record, [], 0
            require(current is not None and record["index"] == next_index and
                    record["index"] < record["count"] and
                    all(record[key] == current[key] for key in ("path", "mode", "size", "sha256", "count", "encoding")),
                    "Invalid block order/metadata")
            payload = stream.read(record["payloadBytes"])
            require(len(payload) == record["payloadBytes"] and stream.read(len(FOOTER)) == FOOTER,
                    "Incomplete payload or invalid footer")
            if record["encoding"] == "utf-8":
                decoded = payload.decode("utf-8").encode("utf-8")
                require(b"\0" not in decoded, "Binary NUL in text")
            else:
                decoded = base64.b64decode(payload, validate=True)
                require(base64.b64encode(decoded) == payload and len(decoded) <= BLOCK, "Invalid Base64")
            blocks.append(decoded)
            next_index += 1
            if next_index == current["count"]:
                content = b"".join(blocks)
                require(len(content) == current["size"] and digest(content) == current["sha256"],
                        "File checksum mismatch: " + current["path"])
                files.append((current, content))
                encodings[current["encoding"]] += 1
                total += len(content)
                current, blocks = None, []
    require(current is None and len(files) == manifest["files"] and total == manifest["sourceBytes"],
            "Incomplete package")
    require(manifest.get("textFiles") == encodings["utf-8"] and manifest.get("binaryFiles") == encodings["base64"],
            "Encoding counts mismatch")
    return manifest, files


def unpack(source, destination):
    require(not destination.exists(), "Destination already exists: " + str(destination))
    _, files = read_package(source)  # Validate every part before writing.
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    staging = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=".portable-restore-", dir=str(destination.parent)))
    try:
        for record, content in files:
            target = staging.joinpath(*record["path"].split("/"))
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            with target.open("xb") as handle:
                handle.write(content)
            target.chmod(record["mode"])
        require(not destination.exists(), "Destination appeared during restoration")
        staging.rename(destination)
    except Exception:
        shutil.rmtree(staging)
        raise
    print("Restored {} files to {}".format(len(files), destination))


def verify(source, root=None):
    manifest, files = read_package(source)
    if root is not None:
        for record, _ in files:
            target = root.joinpath(*record["path"].split("/"))
            require(not target.is_symlink() and digest(target.read_bytes()) == record["sha256"],
                    "Source mismatch: " + record["path"])
    print("PASS: {} files, {} parts; SHA-256 {}".format(len(files), len(manifest["parts"]),
          "matches source tree" if root else "verified"))


def linux_build_tags(webkit):
    require(shutil.which("pkg-config") and shutil.which("cc"),
            "Linux build requires a C compiler and pkg-config")
    def available(package):
        return subprocess.run(["pkg-config", "--exists", package],
                              stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL).returncode == 0
    require(available("gtk+-3.0"), "Linux build requires GTK3 development libraries")
    abi = webkit
    if abi == "auto":
        abi = "4.1" if available("webkit2gtk-4.1") else "4.0"
    require(available("webkit2gtk-" + abi), "Linux build requires WebKit2GTK " + abi + " development libraries")
    return ["-tags", "webkit2_41"] if abi == "4.1" else []


def build_wails(root):
    source = root / WAILS_SOURCE
    require((source / "go.mod").is_file() and (source / "vendor/modules.txt").is_file(),
            "Missing Wails v2.15.0 sources/vendor")
    require((source / "cmd/wails/internal/version.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip() == WAILS_VERSION,
            "Unexpected Wails source version")
    require(shutil.which("go"), "Building Wails requires Go")
    output = root / ".runtime/tools" / ("wails.exe" if os.name == "nt" else "wails")
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    environment = dict(os.environ, GOFLAGS="-mod=vendor", GOPROXY="off", GOSUMDB="off", GOWORK="off", GOTOOLCHAIN="local")
    command = ["go", "build", "-mod=vendor", "-trimpath", "-o", str(output), "./cmd/wails"]
    print("+ " + " ".join(command), flush=True)
    subprocess.run(command, cwd=str(source), env=environment, check=True)
    subprocess.run([str(output), "version"], cwd=str(root), env=environment, check=True)
    return output


def build(root, webkit="auto"):
    require((root / "vendor/modules.txt").is_file(), "Missing Go vendor")
    npm = shutil.which("npm.cmd" if os.name == "nt" else "npm")
    require(npm and shutil.which("go"), "Build requires Node/npm and Go")
    tags = linux_build_tags(webkit) if sys.platform.startswith("linux") else []
    wails = str(build_wails(root))
    environment = dict(os.environ, GOFLAGS="-mod=vendor", GOPROXY="off", GOSUMDB="off", GOWORK="off", GOTOOLCHAIN="local")
    for command, cwd in [([npm, "ci"], root / "frontend"),
                         ([npm, "run", "build"], root / "frontend"),
                         ([wails, "build", "-nopackage", "-clean", "-m", "-nosyncgomod", "-skipbindings", "-s", *tags], root)]:
        print("+ " + " ".join(command), flush=True)
        subprocess.run(command, cwd=str(cwd), env=environment, check=True)
    if sys.platform.startswith("linux"):
        resources = root / "build/bin/linux-resources"
        resources.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(root / "build/linux/platform-installer-ui.desktop",
                        resources / "platform-installer-ui.desktop")
        shutil.copyfile(root / "build/linux/icon.png", resources / "platform-installer-ui.png")
    print("Build complete: " + str(root / "build/bin"))


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    for name, first, second in [("pack", "root", "output"), ("unpack", "source", "destination"),
                                ("verify", "source", "root"), ("build", "root", None), ("build-wails", "root", None)]:
        command = commands.add_parser(name)
        command.add_argument(first, type=Path)
        if name == "build":
            command.add_argument("--webkit", choices=["auto", "4.0", "4.1"], default="auto",
                                 help="Linux WebKit2GTK ABI; auto prefers 4.1")
        if second:
            command.add_argument(second, type=Path, nargs="?" if name == "verify" else None)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        if args.command == "pack":
            pack(args.root.resolve(), args.output.resolve())
        elif args.command == "unpack":
            unpack(args.source.resolve(), args.destination.resolve())
        elif args.command == "verify":
            verify(args.source.resolve(), args.root.resolve() if args.root else None)
        elif args.command == "build-wails":
            build_wails(args.root.resolve())
        else:
            build(args.root.resolve(), args.webkit)
        return 0
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, subprocess.CalledProcessError) as error:
        print("portable-source: " + str(error), file=sys.stderr)
        return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

@@PORTABLE {"path":"scripts/update_portable_source.py","mode":420,"size":3591,"sha256":"11e8e19515de3506f6efe623cf8c920666d3e4fed7bbda7d39a43835e8ec99bb","index":0,"count":1,"encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":3591}
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Regenerate only portable-source artifacts; validate before replacing files."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

import portable_source


def generated(name):
    return name in {"manifest.json", "portable_source.py"} or bool(
        re.fullmatch(r"source-[0-9]+\.txt", name)
    )


def update(root):
    output = root / "portable-source"
    if output.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError("portable-source must not be a symlink")
    revision = portable_source.git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD").decode().strip()
    manifest_path = output / "manifest.json"
    if manifest_path.is_file():
        manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        previous = manifest.get("sourceRevision")
        already_current = previous == revision
        if not already_current:
            parent = subprocess.run(
                ["git", "-C", str(root), "rev-parse", "HEAD^"],
                capture_output=True, text=True,
            )
            if parent.returncode == 0 and previous == parent.stdout.strip():
                changed = portable_source.git(root, "diff", "--name-only", "-z", "HEAD^", "HEAD")
                already_current = all(
                    path.decode().startswith("portable-source/")
                    and generated(path.decode().removeprefix("portable-source/"))
                    for path in changed.split(b"\0") if path
                )
        if already_current:
            try:
                portable_source.verify(output, root)
            except (ValueError, OSError):
                already_current = False
        if already_current:
            expected = {name for name, _, _ in portable_source.source_files(root)}
            _, records = portable_source.read_package(output)
            expected_outputs = {"manifest.json", "portable_source.py"} | {
                part["name"] for part in manifest["parts"]
            }
            actual_outputs = {path.name for path in output.iterdir() if generated(path.name)}
            if (expected == {record["path"] for record, _ in records}
                    and actual_outputs == expected_outputs
                    and (output / "portable_source.py").read_bytes()
                    == Path(portable_source.__file__).read_bytes()):
                print("Portable snapshot already represents this source revision")
                return

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="portable-source-update-") as workspace:
        candidate = Path(workspace) / "snapshot"
        portable_source.pack(root, candidate)
        portable_source.verify(candidate, root)
        restored = Path(workspace) / "restored"
        portable_source.unpack(candidate, restored)
        portable_source.verify(candidate, restored)
        output.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        new_names = {path.name for path in candidate.iterdir()}
        for path in candidate.iterdir():
            target = output / path.name
            if not generated(path.name) or target.is_symlink():
                raise ValueError("Unsafe generated output: " + str(target))
            shutil.copyfile(path, target)
        for path in output.iterdir():
            if generated(path.name) and path.name not in new_names:
                if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
                    raise ValueError("Unsafe stale output: " + str(path))
                path.unlink()
        portable_source.verify(output, root)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    update(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent)

@@PORTABLE {"path":"services/clickhouse/ansible_collections/platform/clickhouse/plugins/module_utils/application_sql.py","mode":420,"size":7755,"sha256":"540e2a6cbcf5f76aaa5dac39fcaf8b95764dd0d47d46334993581683883443e0","index":0,"count":1,"encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":7755}
"""Private native-client execution for library and logical instance scopes."""
import contextlib
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import stat
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
from xml.sax.saxutils import escape


class ProviderFailure(ValueError):
    pass


def identifier(value):
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not re.fullmatch(r'[a-z_][a-z0-9_-]{0,62}', value) or value in {'default', 'system', 'information_schema', 'INFORMATION_SCHEMA'}:
        raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_IDENTIFIER_INVALID')
    return '`' + value + '`'


def literal(value):
    return "'" + value.replace('\\', '\\\\').replace("'", "\\'") + "'"


class NativeClient:
    def __init__(self, target, directory, password, username='default', timeout=60):
        descriptor, self.path = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.application-client-', suffix='.xml', dir=directory)
        self.timeout = timeout
        try:
            pki = directory + '/pki/'
            content = '<clickhouse><host>%s</host><port>%s</port><secure>true</secure><user>%s</user><password>%s</password><openSSL><client><caConfig>%s</caConfig><certificateFile>%s</certificateFile><privateKeyFile>%s</privateKeyFile><loadDefaultCAFile>false</loadDefaultCAFile><verificationMode>strict</verificationMode><extendedVerification>true</extendedVerification><invalidCertificateHandler><name>RejectCertificateHandler</name></invalidCertificateHandler></client></openSSL></clickhouse>' % (
                escape(target['address']), int(target['port']), escape(username), escape(password),
                escape(pki + 'ca-chain.pem'), escape(pki + 'certificate.pem'), escape(pki + 'private-key.pem'))
            with os.fdopen(descriptor, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
                stream.write(content)
        except Exception:
            os.unlink(self.path)
            raise

    def close(self):
        os.unlink(self.path)

    def query(self, sql):
        result = subprocess.run(['clickhouse-client', '--config-file', self.path, '--multiquery'], input=sql,
                                text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=self.timeout)
        if result.returncode:
            code = re.search(r'\bCode:\s*(\d{1,6})\b', result.stderr)
            raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_QUERY_FAILED' + ('_' + code.group(1) if code else ''))
        if len(result.stdout) > 1048576:
            raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_RESPONSE_INVALID')
        return result.stdout


def private_file(descriptor):
    info = os.fstat(descriptor)
    if not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or info.st_uid != os.getuid() or info.st_mode & 0o077 or info.st_nlink != 1 or info.st_size > 1048576:
        raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_PATH_UNSAFE')


@contextlib.contextmanager
def custody(directory, timeout):
    info = os.lstat(directory)
    if os.path.realpath(directory) != os.path.abspath(directory) or not stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) or info.st_uid != os.getuid() or info.st_mode & 0o077:
        raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_PATH_UNSAFE')
    descriptor = os.open(directory + '/.application-objects.lock', os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
    try:
        private_file(descriptor)
        deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
        while True:
            try:
                fcntl.flock(descriptor, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
                break
            except BlockingIOError:
                if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                    raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_LOCK_TIMEOUT')
                time.sleep(0.05)
        path = directory + '/application-objects.json'
        try:
            witness_descriptor = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            witness = {}
        else:
            with os.fdopen(witness_descriptor, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
                private_file(stream.fileno())
                witness = json.load(stream)
        if not isinstance(witness, dict):
            raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_WITNESS_INVALID')
        yield witness
    finally:
        os.close(descriptor)


def publish(directory, witness):
    descriptor, path = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.application-objects-', dir=directory)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(descriptor, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
            json.dump(witness, stream, sort_keys=True)
            stream.flush()
            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        os.replace(path, directory + '/application-objects.json')
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(path):
            os.unlink(path)


def state(client, databases, accounts):
    sql = ''
    if databases:
        sql += "SELECT 'database' AS kind, name, toString(uuid) AS id FROM system.databases WHERE name IN (%s) FORMAT JSONEachRow;\n" % ','.join(literal(item['name']) for item in databases)
    if accounts:
        names = ','.join(literal(item['name']) for item in accounts)
        sql += "SELECT 'user' AS kind, name, toString(id) AS id FROM system.users WHERE name IN (%s) FORMAT JSONEachRow;\n" % names
        sql += "SELECT 'grant' AS kind, user_name AS name, access_type AS privilege, database, table, column, is_partial_revoke, grant_option FROM system.grants WHERE user_name IN (%s) FORMAT JSONEachRow;\n" % names
        sql += "SELECT 'role' AS kind, user_name AS name FROM system.role_grants WHERE user_name IN (%s) FORMAT JSONEachRow;\n" % names
        tables = {(database, table) for account in accounts for database, table, _ in required_grants(account) if table != '*'}
        if tables:
            pairs = ','.join('(%s,%s)' % (literal(database), literal(table)) for database, table in sorted(tables))
            sql += "SELECT 'table' AS kind, database, name FROM system.tables WHERE (database, name) IN (%s) FORMAT JSONEachRow;\n" % pairs
    return [json.loads(line) for line in client.query(sql).splitlines() if line.strip()] if sql else []


def required_grants(account):
    values = set()
    for grant in account.get('grants', []):
        identifier(grant['database'])
        if grant['table'] != '*':
            identifier(grant['table'])
        if not set(grant['privileges']) <= {'SELECT', 'INSERT'}:
            raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_GRANTS_INVALID')
        values.update((grant['database'], grant['table'], privilege) for privilege in grant['privileges'])
    return values


def user_batch(account, password, missing, create, clustered):
    name = identifier(account['name'])
    cluster = ' ON CLUSTER default' if clustered else ''
    statements = []
    if create:
        verifier = hashlib.sha256(password.encode()).hexdigest()
        statements.append("CREATE USER %s%s IDENTIFIED WITH sha256_hash BY '%s' DEFAULT ROLE NONE;" % (name, cluster, verifier))
    for database, table, privilege in sorted(missing):
        if privilege not in {'SELECT', 'INSERT'}:
            raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_GRANTS_INVALID')
        scope = identifier(database) + '.' + ('*' if table == '*' else identifier(table))
        statements.append('GRANT%s %s ON %s TO %s;' % (cluster, privilege, scope, name))
    return '\n'.join(statements)


def verify_login(client, account, preflight=False):
    expected = required_grants(account)
    sql = 'SELECT 1;\n'
    if not preflight:
        for database, table, privilege in sorted(expected):
            sql += 'CHECK GRANT %s ON %s.%s;\n' % (privilege, identifier(database), '*' if table == '*' else identifier(table))
    if client.query(sql).split() != ['1'] * (1 if preflight else len(expected) + 1):
        raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_LOGIN_OR_GRANTS_FAILED')

"""Service-owned ClickHouse host-local allocation; no target discovery."""
import hashlib


def project_members(instances, deployment, settings):
    result, ordinals = [], {}
    for slot, source in enumerate(sorted(instances, key=lambda item: item['id'])):
        ordinal = ordinals.get(source['host'], 0)
        ordinals[source['host']] = ordinal + 1
        member = dict(source, slot=slot + 1, host_ordinal=ordinal)
        for name, base in [('https_port', 'port'), ('native_port', 'native_port'),
                           ('interserver_port', 'interserver_port'),
                           ('keeper_client_port', 'keeper_client_port'),
                           ('keeper_raft_port', 'keeper_raft_port')]:
            if base not in settings:
                continue
            port = int(source['port']) if name == 'https_port' and 'port' in source else int(settings[base]) + ordinal
            if not 1 <= port <= 65535:
                raise ValueError('CLICKHOUSE_LISTENER_PORT_INVALID')
            member[name] = port
        unit_id = hashlib.sha256((deployment + '\n' + source['id']).encode()).hexdigest()
        member['unit_id'] = unit_id
        for kind in ('server', 'keeper'):
            member[kind + '_unit_name'] = 'platform-clickhouse-' + kind + '@' + deployment + '-' + source['id'].rsplit('-', 1)[-1] + '.service'
            member['legacy_' + kind + '_unit_name'] = 'platform-clickhouse-' + kind + '-' + unit_id[:16] + '.service'
        for kind in ('config', 'data', 'log'):
            if kind + '_root' in settings:
                member[kind + '_directory'] = settings[kind + '_root'] + '/' + deployment + '/' + source['id']
        result.append(member)
    return result

#!/usr/bin/python
"""One library resource batch or logical instance account/grant batch."""
import json
from subprocess import SubprocessError
from ansible.module_utils.basic import AnsibleModule
from ansible_collections.platform.clickhouse.plugins.module_utils.application_sql import (

def identity(rows, kind, name):
    values = [row['id'] for row in rows if row['kind'] == kind and row['name'] == name]
    if len(values) > 1:
        raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_IDENTITY_INVALID')
    return values[0] if values else None


def check_owner(witness, key, marker, actual, mode, phase):
    record = witness.get(key)
    if record is not None and (not isinstance(record, dict) or set(record) != {'marker', 'ids'}
                               or not isinstance(record['ids'], dict)):
        raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_WITNESS_INVALID')
    existing = {member: value for member, value in actual.items() if value is not None}
    if mode == 'managed':
        if existing and (not isinstance(record, dict) or record.get('marker') != marker or record.get('ids') != existing):
            raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_OWNERSHIP_UNKNOWN')
        if record and (record.get('marker') != marker or record.get('ids') != existing):
            raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_OWNERSHIP_DRIFT')
    if (mode == 'existing' or phase == 'verify') and len(existing) != len(actual):
        raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_OBJECT_MISSING')
    return existing


def main():
    module = AnsibleModule(argument_spec={
        'job': {'type': 'dict', 'required': True}, 'directory': {'type': 'path', 'required': True},
        'admin_password': {'type': 'str', 'required': True, 'no_log': True},
        'passwords': {'type': 'dict', 'default': {}, 'no_log': True},
        'phase': {'choices': ['preflight', 'resources', 'accounts', 'verify'], 'required': True},
        'lock_timeout': {'type': 'int', 'default': 15}, 'query_timeout': {'type': 'int', 'default': 60}})
    args, clients, changed = module.params, [], False
    try:
        job, phase, directory = args['job'], args['phase'], args['directory']
        if not 1 <= args['lock_timeout'] <= 120 or not 1 <= args['query_timeout'] <= 120:
            raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_INPUT_INVALID')
        if any(not isinstance(password, str) or not 1 <= len(password) <= 4096
               for password in [args['admin_password']] + list(args['passwords'].values())):
            raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_INPUT_INVALID')
        if job['serviceType'] != 'clickhouse' or job['mode'] not in {'standalone', 'raft-ha'}:
            raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_INPUT_INVALID')
        targets = sorted(job['candidates'], key=lambda target: (target['hostId'], target['memberId']))
        if len(targets) != (3 if job['mode'] == 'raft-ha' else 1) or len({item['memberId'] for item in targets}) != len(targets):
            raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_MEMBERS_INVALID')
        databases, accounts = job['databases'], job['accounts']
        if len(databases) > 128 or len(accounts) > 128 or (phase == 'resources' and accounts):
            raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_INPUT_INVALID')
        for value in databases + accounts:
            identifier(value['name'])
            if value['mode'] not in {'managed', 'existing'} or not isinstance(value['marker'], str) or not value['marker'].startswith('platform.application/v1:'):
                raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_INPUT_INVALID')
        with custody(directory, args['lock_timeout']) as witness:
            original_witness = dict(witness)
            for target in targets:
                clients.append(NativeClient(target, directory, args['admin_password'], timeout=args['query_timeout']))
            if job['mode'] == 'raft-ha':
                topology = clients[0].query("SELECT host_name AS address, port FROM system.clusters WHERE cluster = 'default' FORMAT JSONEachRow;")
                resolved = {(item['address'], int(item['port'])) for item in map(json.loads, topology.splitlines())}
                if resolved != {(target['address'], int(target['port'])) for target in targets}:
                    raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_CLUSTER_INVALID')
            observed = {target['memberId']: state(client, databases, accounts) for target, client in zip(targets, clients)}
            resource_sql = {target['memberId']: [] for target in targets}
            for database in databases:
                actual = {member: identity(rows, 'database', database['name']) for member, rows in observed.items()}
                check_owner(witness, 'database/' + database['name'], database['marker'], actual, database['mode'], phase)
                if phase == 'accounts' and any(value is None for value in actual.values()):
                    raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_DATABASE_MISSING')
                for target in targets:
                    if actual[target['memberId']] is None and phase == 'resources' and database['mode'] == 'managed':
                        resource_sql[target['memberId']].append('CREATE DATABASE ' + identifier(database['name']) + ';')
            for target, client in zip(targets, clients):
                statements = resource_sql[target['memberId']]
                if statements:
                    client.query('\n'.join(statements))
                    changed = True
            account_sql = []
            for account in accounts:
                actual = {member: identity(rows, 'user', account['name']) for member, rows in observed.items()}
                existing = check_owner(witness, 'user/' + account['name'], account['marker'], actual, account['mode'], phase)
                if existing and len(existing) != len(targets):
                    raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_PARTIAL_ACCOUNT')
                expected = required_grants(account)
                missing_union = set()
                for target, client in zip(targets, clients):
                    rows = observed[target['memberId']]
                    grants = [row for row in rows if row['kind'] == 'grant' and row['name'] == account['name']]
                    current = {(row['database'], row['table'] or '*', row['privilege']) for row in grants}
                    if account['mode'] == 'managed' and (not current <= expected or any(row['column'] or row['is_partial_revoke'] or row['grant_option'] for row in grants)
                            or any(row['kind'] == 'role' and row['name'] == account['name'] for row in rows)):
                        raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_GRANTS_DRIFT')
                    missing = expected - current
                    if phase == 'verify' and missing and account['mode'] == 'managed':
                        raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_GRANTS_MISSING')
                    missing_union.update(missing)
                    # Specific table grants require application migrations first.
                    for database, table, _ in expected:
                        if table != '*':
                            if (database, table) not in {(row['database'], row['name']) for row in rows if row['kind'] == 'table'}:
                                raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_MIGRATION_REQUIRED')
                    if existing:
                        user_client = NativeClient(target, directory, args['passwords'][account['passwordRef']], account['name'], args['query_timeout'])
                        try:
                            verify_login(user_client, account, account['mode'] == 'managed' and
                                         (phase == 'preflight' or (phase == 'accounts' and bool(missing))))
                        finally:
                            user_client.close()
                if phase == 'accounts' and account['mode'] == 'managed':
                    account_sql.append(user_batch(account, args['passwords'][account['passwordRef']], missing_union, not existing, job['mode'] == 'raft-ha'))
            if any(account_sql):
                clients[0].query('SET distributed_ddl_task_timeout = 30;\n' + '\n'.join(account_sql))
                changed = True
            # Observed identities/grants and authenticated probes already prove
            # an unchanged scope. Reread only after an actual native mutation.
            if phase in {'resources', 'accounts'} and changed:
                final = {target['memberId']: state(client, databases, accounts) for target, client in zip(targets, clients)}
                for value, kind in [(value, 'database') for value in databases] + [(value, 'user') for value in accounts]:
                    ids = {member: identity(rows, kind, value['name']) for member, rows in final.items()}
                    if any(value is None for value in ids.values()):
                        raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_OBJECT_MISSING')
                    original = {member: identity(rows, kind, value['name']) for member, rows in observed.items()}
                    if any(identifier is not None and ids[member] != identifier for member, identifier in original.items()):
                        raise ProviderFailure('CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_OWNERSHIP_DRIFT')
                    if value['mode'] == 'managed':
                        witness[kind + '/' + value['name']] = {'marker': value['marker'], 'ids': ids}
                for account in accounts:
                    for target in targets:
                        user_client = NativeClient(target, directory, args['passwords'][account['passwordRef']], account['name'], args['query_timeout'])
                        try:
                            verify_login(user_client, account)
                        finally:
                            user_client.close()
                if witness != original_witness:
                    publish(directory, witness)
        module.exit_json(changed=changed)
    except ProviderFailure as error:
        module.fail_json(msg=str(error))
    except (ValueError, OSError, TypeError, KeyError, SubprocessError):
        module.fail_json(msg='CLICKHOUSE_APPLICATION_SCOPE_FAILED')
    finally:
        for client in clients:
            client.close()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

@@END

- name: Restrict managed ClickHouse roots to one owned component under trusted system parents
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that:
      - platform_clickhouse_config_root is match('^/etc/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,95}$')
      - platform_clickhouse_data_root is string
      - platform_clickhouse_log_root is match('^/var/log/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,95}$')
    fail_msg: CLICKHOUSE_MANAGED_ROOT_UNSAFE

- name: Guard ClickHouse data root ancestry before mutation
  ansible.builtin.include_role:
    name: platform.core.managed_data_path_guard
  vars:
    platform_managed_data_path: "{{ platform_clickhouse_data_root }}"
    platform_managed_data_owner: "{{ platform_clickhouse_user }}"
    platform_managed_data_root_directory: "{{ platform_data_root_directory | default('/var/lib') }}"
    platform_managed_data_root_owner: "{{ ansible_user | default('') }}"
    platform_managed_data_root_verify_only: "{{ platform_clickhouse_verify_only | bool }}"

- name: Guard effective ClickHouse member data paths
  ansible.builtin.include_role:
    name: platform.core.managed_data_path_guard
  vars:
    platform_managed_data_path: "{{ platform_managed_data_path_instance.data_directory }}"
    platform_managed_data_owner: "{{ platform_clickhouse_user }}"
    platform_managed_data_root_directory: "{{ platform_data_root_directory | default('/var/lib') }}"
    platform_managed_data_root_owner: "{{ ansible_user | default('') }}"
    platform_managed_data_root_verify_only: "{{ platform_clickhouse_verify_only | bool }}"
  loop: "{{ _platform_clickhouse_local_instances }}"
  loop_control:
    loop_var: platform_managed_data_path_instance
    label: "{{ platform_managed_data_path_instance.id }}"

- name: Inspect shared ClickHouse data root before adding co-located members
  ansible.builtin.stat:
    path: "{{ platform_clickhouse_data_root }}"
    follow: false
    get_mime: false
    get_attributes: false
    get_checksum: false
  register: _platform_clickhouse_shared_data_root
  when: _platform_clickhouse_local_instances | length > 1

- name: Require a root-owned shared ClickHouse data parent
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that:
      - not _platform_clickhouse_shared_data_root.stat.exists or _platform_clickhouse_shared_data_root.stat.uid == 0
      - not _platform_clickhouse_shared_data_root.stat.exists or _platform_clickhouse_shared_data_root.stat.mode == '0755'
    fail_msg: CLICKHOUSE_SHARED_DATA_ROOT_UNSAFE
  when: _platform_clickhouse_local_instances | length > 1

- name: Inspect managed ClickHouse root and deployment ancestors without following links
  ansible.builtin.stat:
    path: "{{ item }}"
    follow: false
    get_checksum: false
    get_mime: false
    get_attributes: false
  loop:
    - "{{ platform_clickhouse_config_root }}"
    - "{{ platform_clickhouse_log_root }}"
    - "{{ platform_clickhouse_config_root }}/{{ platform_clickhouse_deployment_id }}"
    - "{{ platform_clickhouse_log_root }}/{{ platform_clickhouse_deployment_id }}"
  register: _platform_clickhouse_ancestor_stats

- name: Refuse substituted or foreign managed ClickHouse ancestors
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that:
      - not item.stat.exists or (item.stat.isdir | default(false))
      - not item.stat.exists or not (item.stat.islnk | default(false))
      - not item.stat.exists or item.stat.pw_name == 'root'
      - not item.stat.exists or item.stat.gr_name == 'root'
      - not item.stat.exists or item.stat.mode == '0755'
    fail_msg: CLICKHOUSE_FOREIGN_ANCESTOR_PATH
  loop: "{{ _platform_clickhouse_ancestor_stats.results }}"
  loop_control:
    label: "{{ item.item }}"

- name: Inspect member, SQL access-control and private PKI paths without following links
  ansible.builtin.stat:
    path: "{{ item.0.config_directory ~ '/pki' if item.1 == 'config_pki' else (item.0.data_directory ~ '/access' if item.1 == 'access_control_directory' else item.0[item.1]) }}"
    follow: false
    get_checksum: false
    get_mime: false
    get_attributes: false
  loop: "{{ _platform_clickhouse_local_instances | product(['config_directory', 'data_directory', 'log_directory', 'access_control_directory', 'config_pki']) | list }}"
  register: _platform_clickhouse_private_path_stats

- name: Refuse substituted or foreign member and private PKI paths
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that:
      - not item.stat.exists or (item.stat.isdir | default(false))
      - not item.stat.exists or not (item.stat.islnk | default(false))
      - not item.stat.exists or item.stat.pw_name == platform_clickhouse_user
      - not item.stat.exists or item.stat.gr_name == platform_clickhouse_group
      - not item.stat.exists or item.stat.mode == '0700'
    fail_msg: CLICKHOUSE_FOREIGN_PRIVATE_PATH
  loop: "{{ _platform_clickhouse_private_path_stats.results }}"
  loop_control:
    label: "{{ item.item.0.id }}/{{ item.item.1 }}"

@@PORTABLE {"path":"services/clickhouse/ansible_collections/platform/clickhouse/roles/clickhouse_tls/tasks/preflight.yml","mode":420,"size":9522,"sha256":"10115d67b85796721d5db5033842a508ef810c16d873a33cb4e72376a3368c58","index":0,"count":1,"encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":9522}
---
- name: Prove managed ClickHouse path ancestry before privileged mutation
  ansible.builtin.include_tasks: path_safety.yml

- name: Inspect existing ClickHouse package identities without mutation
  ansible.builtin.command:
    argv: [rpm, -q, --qf, '%{NAME}\t%{VERSION}-%{RELEASE}.%{ARCH}\n', clickhouse-common-static, clickhouse-server, clickhouse-client, clickhouse-keeper]
  register: _platform_clickhouse_installed_packages
  changed_when: false
  failed_when: false

- name: Refuse an incompatible foreign ClickHouse package generation
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that:
      - _platform_clickhouse_package_lines | length <= 1
      - >-
        (item == 'clickhouse-keeper' and _platform_clickhouse_package_lines | length == 0) or
        (item != 'clickhouse-keeper' and
         (_platform_clickhouse_package_lines | length == 0 or
          _platform_clickhouse_package_lines == [item ~ '\t' ~ platform_clickhouse_package_version ~ '-1.x86_64']))
    fail_msg: CLICKHOUSE_PACKAGE_VERSION_CONFLICT
  vars:
    _platform_clickhouse_package_lines: "{{ _platform_clickhouse_installed_packages.stdout_lines | select('match', '^' ~ item ~ '\\t') | list }}"
  loop: [clickhouse-common-static, clickhouse-server, clickhouse-client, clickhouse-keeper]
  loop_control:
    label: "{{ item }}"

- name: Check stock ClickHouse server and Keeper unit activity without changing it
  ansible.builtin.command:
    argv: [systemctl, is-active, clickhouse-server.service, clickhouse-keeper.service]
  register: _platform_clickhouse_stock_units
  changed_when: false
  failed_when: false

- name: Refuse to change a host with active stock ClickHouse units
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that: "'active' not in _platform_clickhouse_stock_units.stdout_lines"
    fail_msg: CLICKHOUSE_FOREIGN_UNIT_ACTIVE

- name: Inspect exact instance-unit paths before rendering
  ansible.builtin.stat:
    path: "/etc/systemd/system/{{ item.0.server_unit_name if item.1 == 'server' else item.0.keeper_unit_name }}"
    follow: false
    get_mime: false
    get_attributes: false
    get_checksum: false
  loop: >-
    {{ _platform_clickhouse_local_instances |
       product(['server', 'keeper'] if platform_clickhouse_mode == 'raft-ha' else ['server']) | list }}
  register: _platform_clickhouse_unit_path_stats
  no_log: true

- name: Inspect legacy hash-named ClickHouse unit paths
  ansible.builtin.stat:
    path: "/etc/systemd/system/{{ item }}"
    follow: false
    get_mime: false
    get_attributes: false
    get_checksum: false
  loop: >-
    {{ (_platform_clickhouse_local_instances | map(attribute='legacy_server_unit_name') | list)
       + ((_platform_clickhouse_local_instances | map(attribute='legacy_keeper_unit_name') | list)
          if platform_clickhouse_mode == 'raft-ha' else []) }}
  register: _platform_clickhouse_legacy_unit_path_stats

- name: Refuse automatic adoption of legacy ClickHouse unit names
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that: not item.stat.exists
    fail_msg: CLICKHOUSE_LEGACY_UNIT_REQUIRES_S11_CLEANUP
  loop: "{{ _platform_clickhouse_legacy_unit_path_stats.results }}"
  loop_control:
    label: "{{ item.item }}"

- name: Refuse symlinked instance-unit paths
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that: >-
      _platform_clickhouse_unit_path_stats.results |
      selectattr('stat.exists', 'equalto', true) |
      selectattr('stat.islnk', 'equalto', true) | list | length == 0
    fail_msg: CLICKHOUSE_FOREIGN_UNIT_PATH

- name: Read existing instance-unit ownership headers
  ansible.builtin.slurp:
    path: "/etc/systemd/system/{{ item.item.0.server_unit_name if item.item.1 == 'server' else item.item.0.keeper_unit_name }}"
  loop: "{{ _platform_clickhouse_unit_path_stats.results }}"
  when: item.stat.isreg | default(false)
  register: _platform_clickhouse_existing_unit_headers
  no_log: true

- name: Refuse replacement of a foreign instance unit
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that: >-
      (item.content | b64decode).startswith('# ' ~ platform_clickhouse_name ~ '-managed: ' ~
       platform_clickhouse_deployment_id ~ '/' ~ item.item.item.0.id ~ '/' ~ item.item.item.1 ~ '\n')
    fail_msg: CLICKHOUSE_FOREIGN_UNIT_PATH
  loop: "{{ _platform_clickhouse_existing_unit_headers.results }}"
  when: item.content is defined
  no_log: true

- name: Inspect exact member-owned paths and identity markers
  ansible.builtin.stat:
    path: "{{ item.0[item.1] }}"
    follow: false
    get_mime: false
    get_attributes: false
    get_checksum: false
  loop: "{{ _platform_clickhouse_local_instances | product(['config_directory', 'data_directory', 'log_directory']) | list }}"
  register: _platform_clickhouse_owned_path_stats

- name: Inspect exact member identity markers
  ansible.builtin.stat:
    path: "{{ item.data_directory }}/.{{ platform_clickhouse_name }}-member.json"
    follow: false
    get_mime: false
    get_attributes: false
    get_checksum: false
  loop: "{{ _platform_clickhouse_local_instances }}"
  register: _platform_clickhouse_marker_stats

- name: Refuse foreign paths or symlink substitution
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that:
      - >-
        _platform_clickhouse_owned_path_stats.results |
        selectattr('stat.exists', 'equalto', true) |
        selectattr('stat.islnk', 'equalto', true) | list | length == 0
      - >-
        _platform_clickhouse_marker_stats.results |
        selectattr('stat.exists', 'equalto', true) |
        selectattr('stat.islnk', 'equalto', true) | list | length == 0
      - >-
        not (_platform_clickhouse_owned_path_stats.results |
        selectattr('item.0.id', 'equalto', item.id) |
        selectattr('stat.exists', 'equalto', true) | list | length > 0)
        or (_platform_clickhouse_marker_stats.results |
        selectattr('item.id', 'equalto', item.id) |
        selectattr('stat.exists', 'equalto', true) |
        selectattr('stat.isreg', 'equalto', true) | list | length == 1)
    fail_msg: CLICKHOUSE_FOREIGN_MEMBER_PATH
  loop: "{{ _platform_clickhouse_local_instances }}"
  loop_control:
    label: "{{ item.id }}"

- name: Read existing ClickHouse member markers
  ansible.builtin.slurp:
    path: "{{ item.item.data_directory }}/.{{ platform_clickhouse_name }}-member.json"
  loop: "{{ _platform_clickhouse_marker_stats.results }}"
  when: item.stat.isreg | default(false)
  register: _platform_clickhouse_existing_markers
  no_log: true

- name: Prove existing member paths belong to the same identity
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that:
      - (item.content | b64decode | from_json).apiVersion == 'platform.installer/clickhouse-member-marker/v1alpha1'
      - (item.content | b64decode | from_json).deploymentId == platform_clickhouse_deployment_id
      - (item.content | b64decode | from_json).memberId == item.item.item.id
      - (item.content | b64decode | from_json).unitId == item.item.item.unit_id
    fail_msg: CLICKHOUSE_MEMBER_IDENTITY_MISMATCH
  loop: "{{ _platform_clickhouse_existing_markers.results }}"
  when: item.content is defined
  no_log: true

- name: Count members requiring first-time resource allocation
  ansible.builtin.set_fact:
    _platform_clickhouse_new_member_count: >-
      {{ _platform_clickhouse_marker_stats.results |
         rejectattr('stat.exists', 'equalto', true) | list | length }}

- name: Inspect available target memory for new ClickHouse members
  ansible.builtin.command:
    argv: [free, -b]
  register: _platform_clickhouse_memory
  changed_when: false
  when: _platform_clickhouse_new_member_count | int > 0

- name: Inspect available target disk for new ClickHouse members
  ansible.builtin.command:
    argv: [df, -B1, --output=avail, /var/lib]
  register: _platform_clickhouse_disk
  changed_when: false
  when: _platform_clickhouse_new_member_count | int > 0

- name: Require conservative headroom only for first-time members
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that:
      - (_platform_clickhouse_memory.stdout_lines[1].split()[-1] | int) >= 1073741824 * (_platform_clickhouse_new_member_count | int)
      - (_platform_clickhouse_disk.stdout_lines[-1] | trim | int) >= 1610612736
    fail_msg: CLICKHOUSE_RESOURCE_PREFLIGHT_BLOCKED
  when: _platform_clickhouse_new_member_count | int > 0

- name: Begin listener preflight for new ClickHouse members
  ansible.builtin.set_fact:
    _platform_clickhouse_new_member_ports: []

- name: Collect only ports belonging to members without an existing marker
  ansible.builtin.set_fact:
    _platform_clickhouse_new_member_ports: >-
      {{ _platform_clickhouse_new_member_ports +
         [item.https_port, item.native_port, item.interserver_port] +
         ([item.keeper_client_port, item.keeper_raft_port]
          if platform_clickhouse_mode == 'raft-ha' else []) }}
  loop: "{{ _platform_clickhouse_local_instances }}"
  loop_control:
    index_var: clickhouse_member_index
    label: "{{ item.id }}"
  when: not _platform_clickhouse_marker_stats.results[clickhouse_member_index].stat.exists

- name: Observe all TCP listeners before package or unit mutation
  ansible.builtin.command:
    argv: [ss, -H, -ltn]
  register: _platform_clickhouse_existing_listeners
  changed_when: false
  when: _platform_clickhouse_new_member_ports | length > 0

- name: Refuse a new ClickHouse listener that belongs to another process
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that: _platform_clickhouse_existing_listeners.stdout is not search(':' ~ (item | string) ~ '\\s')
    fail_msg: CLICKHOUSE_LISTENER_IN_USE
  loop: "{{ _platform_clickhouse_new_member_ports }}"
  when: _platform_clickhouse_new_member_ports | length > 0
